Do you combine legal rigor with strong commercial judgment? Would you like to take ownership of commercial contracts and help keep Trackunit’s commercial momentum moving across EMEA and APJ?

As our Legal Counsel – Commercial Contracts, you will own the negotiation and drafting of Trackunit’s commercial contracts, particularly our Master Telematics Agreements (MTAs). You will work closely with our Commercial teams to move negotiations forward, reduce risk exposure, and support customer relationships where fast turnaround matters.

Alongside commercial contracting, you will contribute to broader legal, governance, and regulatory work. By taking full ownership of the commercial contracting process and playbook, you will help reduce deal cycles and free the General Counsel to focus on higher-level strategic matters.

Based in Denmark, you will join our Legal and Compliance department and report to the VP – General Counsel. This is an individual contributor role at IC3 level, with no people management responsibilities.

**What’s in it for you?

**You will have direct operational and tactical impact on commercial deal velocity, primarily across EMEA and APJ, while contributing to legal risk management across Trackunit’s contracting activity.

The role combines ownership of commercial negotiations with a broader range of legal work. Roughly half of your time will focus on commercial contract negotiation, ranging from routine to moderately complex matters using an established playbook. The remainder will cover general legal work across governance, regulatory, and compliance-adjacent matters, which can range from routine to more complex and ambiguous.

You will build a working understanding of Trackunit’s business, products, and customers, using that knowledge to provide advice that is commercially aware as well as legally sound.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Own the negotiation and drafting of commercial contracts, particularly Master Telematics Agreements (MTAs), ensuring fast turnaround without unnecessary escalation.

• Act as a trusted legal partner to Commercial teams across EMEA and APJ, resolving standard redlines independently using the established contract playbook.

• Identify and mitigate risk exposure in contract terms, escalating to the General Counsel when terms fall outside standard playbook parameters and, where material, to the CFO/CEO.

• Support general legal, governance, and regulatory work, including data protection (GDPR) and other EU legislation, alongside commercial contracting.

• Build and maintain an understanding of Trackunit’s business, products, and customers to balance legal precision with commercial needs.

• Take full ownership of the commercial contracting process and playbook, contributing to reducing the General Counsel’s workload.

**Your focus this year

**Your immediate priority will be to address the EMEA and APJ negotiation bottleneck by building fluency and speed in MTA negotiations. You will help establish a clear, well-used contract playbook so that more redlines can be resolved without General Counsel involvement.

A secondary focus will be deepening your GDPR, data privacy, and EU regulatory knowledge to support both commercial contracts and general legal and governance work.

**Who are you?

**

• You bring 5+ years of experience in contract negotiation, ideally gained in-house or in a role with strong commercial exposure.

• You have working knowledge of GDPR and EU data- and software-related legislation.

• You have strong commercial instincts and can balance legal precision with deal pragmatism.

• Industry knowledge in software or construction technology is a plus, but is not a requirement.

• You use sound judgment to distinguish between redlines that fall within the established playbook and those that require escalation.

You will have delegated authority to approve and close redlines within the established contract playbook. Anything outside standard terms requires escalation to the General Counsel and, depending on materiality, potentially to the CFO/CEO. Understanding and applying that boundary is a core part of the role.

**Who will you work with?

**You will work most closely with our Commercial teams, including Sales and regional Pod Leaders. You will also collaborate regularly with Cyber Security, Quality, Supply Chain, and other internal legal and compliance colleagues.

Externally, you will negotiate directly with customer legal and procurement counterparts. Your communication will involve informing, advising, and negotiating, with negotiation being a defining part of your work.

The role has EU-wide scope, with a specific commercial negotiation focus on customer relationships across EMEA and APJ.

At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.

Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,300 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly!

We are recruiting for our Nordics region where you'll be joining a growing team of nearly 30 people supporting clients across the Nordics and across Europe. Our consultants provide flexible support to clients whether it is a rapid assessment, short term savings realisation or embedding in a long-term partnership to deliver lasting and measurable value to clients.

**As a Senior Consultant (SC), you will have complete ownership of complex workstreams or several smaller workstreams and be supported by junior resources. You should be deemed as a subject matter expert (SME) both internally and by clients and you will be responsible for the following:

**

• Managing complex workstreams or multiple smaller workstreams. Often supported by junior resources

• Managing more junior consultants on projects, making sure Efficio methodologies and processes are followed

• Driving complex analysis where data is hard to access and using expertise to creatively develop conclusions and recommended solutions

• Playing a role in advising clients and designing solutions that address complex needs, achieve sustainable results, and demonstrate real impact

• Effectively managing and owning the relationship with senior stakeholders

• Planning and preparing documentation for own workstream

• Taking part in the recruitment process of potential junior consultants

Our collaborative and inclusive culture is what makes us stand out. At Efficio, colleagues with diverse backgrounds, ideas, and viewpoints come together to identify innovative solutions for our clients - and so we're looking for our new team members to bring strong communication, empathy, and relationship-building skills to maintain this culture as we grow.

We encourage our teams to proactively innovate and challenge the status-quo, backed by strong analytical thinking and creative problem-solving abilities alongside comfortable proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint. We're looking for team members who enjoy and have experience of digging into complex challenges at a leading management consultancy or in a relevant industry position.

Strong opportunities for career growth are an important part of our offering; as such, we love seeing ambition and a proactive approach to shaping your career to your goals and interests.

To meet client needs, we look for flexibility to travel; you can give us a heads-up on your preferences when applying.

We'd love to hear about any additional skills or experiences you bring to the table. We're particularly interested in:

• Fluency in both English and a Nordic language

• Management consulting experience within a leading consultancy, ideally within procurement and/or supply chain

• Experience (or an interest) in strategic sourcing, procurement transformation, supply chain, operations, infrastructure, or capital projects

• Proven track record of working closely with senior client stakeholders

• Deep analytical skills and problem-solving skills, with the ability to isolate key issues and draw sound conclusions

• Strong grasp of detail and a 'hands-on' approach

• Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills

• Ability to confidently improve existing ways of working, recognize opportunities and identify innovative solutions that add real value to clients

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

At Factbird, we help manufacturers see what’s really happening on their lines, so they can make better, faster decisions. Our plug-and-play hardware and cloud platform turn live production data into clear insights, and we’re scaling fast across sites, teams, and countries.

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior IoT Solutions Engineer to join Engineering Services, the team that takes on the technical problems that fall outside what our product and Support handle today. You’ll look at a PLC, a sensor, or a 20-year-old CNC and work out how to get its data into Factbird. Sales and Support turn to you when the answer is “it depends,” and you turn that into a clear yes, no, or “here’s how.” Then you write it down so the next person doesn’t need to ask.

About the role

Engineering Services solves the hardest technical problems, documents them, and shares the knowledge, so Factbird gets smarter and the same problem doesn’t come back. You’ll answer feasibility questions before deals close, design and build custom solutions, and fix the cross-domain problems no other team can place.

The team mission we are on: Engineering Services is a small team of experts finding solutions to a wide variety of challenges. In pre-sales we are supporting our AE's and Solution Consultants with feasibility testing the most complex customer setups or requirements. Often directly with the customers and their technical teams. In post-sales we collaborate with Cloud, FW and HW teams, and build and support a range of custom solutions. Our core mission is to increase documentation, standardization and empowering our colleagues in both pre- and post-sales roles to server the customers in the most technical cases.

What You'll Do

• Answer feasibility questions from Sales: can we connect this machine, PLC, or sensor, and how

• Design and build custom solutions: logic boxes, signal converters, IO-Link modules, EDGE flows, and Factbird® powered by OMRON NX1 programs that fill gaps the cloud platform can’t handle yet.

• Design the integration: map the customer’s OT/IT environment and plan the data sources, tag structures, transformations, and security.

• Root cause troubleshooting in live production. Smaller share of time, highest stakes

• Document everything you build and fix: Solution Records, runbooks, and wiring guides for customers and internal teams, clear enough that someone else can pick it up. Version and back up every configuration.

• Bench-test hardware before it ships, test the full data flow end to end (including failure recovery and restarts), and hand hardware to Logistics with a clear packing list.

• Integrate customer systems through Kepware, Ignition, OPC UA, MQTT, EtherNet/IP, Modbus, and Node-RED.

• Share what you know: help Support, Solution Consultants, and Hardware handle more on their own.

• Streamline as you go: spot repeat work and clunky processes, and fix them or flag them. Build templates and scripts that make the next delivery faster.

• Turn repeat workarounds into product input with a business case, so the workaround can disappear.

• Join customer and prospect calls as the technical voice alongside Solution Consultants and Account Managers.

About you

You’re an experienced industrial automation engineer, as happy with a screwdriver as with a terminal. You know how factories work, and you’re comfortable saying “not directly, but here’s the route.”

You document like the next person depends on it, because they do. You can’t leave a clunky process alone: you always have an eye on how to make things simpler and more repeatable.

You’re flexible and self-directed: you take a high level of accountability and ownership. You can prioritize and deliver without daily supervision, and you troubleshoot systematically when things get ambiguous. The work changes week to week, and the team’s shape will keep evolving as Factbird grows. You’re happy to do what’s needed today while helping move things in a more scalable direction.

You love being the expert, but you equally love teaching others and making the teams around you smarter. And most of all, you care about making the answer simple for whoever asked.

Requirements:

• A bachelor's degree in automation, electrical engineering, mechatronics, or similar, or equivalent hands-on experience.

• At least 5 years in industrial automation or controls engineering, including hands-on work on the shop floor (7+ years preferred).

• Hands-on PLC experience with at least one major vendor, e.g. Siemens, Omron, or Rockwell/Allen-Bradley.

• Solid understanding of industrial protocols, e.g. OPC UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, MQTT.

• Working knowledge of sensors and signals, like digital, analog (4–20 mA, 0–10 V), IO-Link, PNP/NPN, and energy metering.

• Root cause analysis across hardware, networks, and software in live production environments.

• Field experience commissioning or troubleshooting equipment in live plants.

• Comfortable troubleshooting site networks, e.g. IP setup, routers, SIMs, and firewalls.

• A clear communicator in English who can explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers.

• A strong documentation habit: when you build it, you write it down.

Why Factbird?

People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide kickoffs & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

We’d love to hear from you

If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out to Khristel, our Global Talent Acquisition & People Operations Lead at khma@factbird.com

At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

All employment decisions at Factbird are made based on business needs, role requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination based on gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or family status, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable European and local employment laws.

We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make our teams stronger and our work better. We warmly encourage all qualified candidates to apply and to bring their whole selves to Factbird.

_**Come drive Efficiency and Impact as Business Cost Consulting Manager!

**_Pandora is on a mission to transform how we manage costs and drive efficiency across our global organization. As part of our strategic development, we’ve established a Global Cost Transformation Office - a central function dedicated to safeguarding profitability and fuel our investment for growth.

We’re now looking for a Business Cost Consulting Manager to join our team in Copenhagen, reporting to the Senior Director, Global Cost Transformation Office. This global role offers a unique opportunity work across functions and markets to shape and lead cost initiatives that deliver meaningful impact across Pandora’s operations, supporting our ambition to enhance efficiency and reinvest in growth.

In this role, you’ll act as a strategic partner, leading the development and execution of cost initiatives across global and cluster tracks. Working closely with Senior Business leader with the support of Finance and Procurement, you’ll challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and build robust business cases that drive sustainable impact. You’ll guide initiatives through a structured decision-making process, facilitate workshops, align stakeholders, and create clear execution roadmaps. You’ll also help strengthen organizational capability by introducing standardized tools and approaches, fostering a cost-conscious culture and contributing directly to Pandora’s bottom line.

**What You’ll Drive

****Key Responsibilities

**

• Build business cases with Senior leaders of Pandora, including financial modeling, savings estimates, and risk assessments.

• Lead the development and progression of cost initiatives through Pandora’s structured decision-making process.

• Provide strategic guidance to teams driving cost initiatives, shape direction and outcomes.

• Collaborate across functions to create execution plans, track progress, and ensure delivery.

• Facilitate workshops to identify opportunities, align stakeholders, and structure initiatives effectively.

• Support capability building across the organization by providing tools, templates, and training

• Ensure accurate reporting and governance alignment with the Results Delivery Office.

**Professional Qualifications

****What We’re Looking For

**

• Strong general business understanding and commercial acumen.

• Experience in consulting, strategy, or business development roles.

• Expertise in cost optimization, financial modeling, and business case development.

• Solid understanding of transformation programs and governance frameworks.

• Proven ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders at all levels.

**Personal Competencies

**

• Analytical and structured problem-solver.

• Excellent communicator with strong stakeholder engagement skills.

• Skilled facilitator with a collaborative mindset.

• Change-oriented and resilient in dynamic environments.

• Driven by impact and continuous improvement.

**Additional Information

**

• Travel: Up to 10–15 days per year

• Location: Pandora Global Office, Copenhagen

**Why Pandora?

**This is your opportunity to join a global brand at a transformative moment. You’ll work with passionate colleagues, senior leaders, and cross-functional teams to shape the future of cost management at Pandora—making a real impact on our ability to grow and thrive.

Did We Get Your Attention?

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply.

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site: www.pandoragroup.com

About Pandora   Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

**Product Strategy & Development Manager – shape wound care innovation

**Passionate about improving care for people in need while making a meaningful difference for healthcare professionals?

Join Coloplast and help shape the next generation of wound and tissue repair solutions.

Here, you will move between market insight, portfolio strategy, innovation and hands-on execution – turning insights and ideas into solutions that help make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs.

**Working together to move wound care forward

**You will join us at our HQ in Humlebæk. Here, you will become part of Wound & Tissue Repair, working with products and solutions that support healthcare professionals in wound management and patient care.

That takes more than one function or one perspective. You will work closely with colleagues across Sales, R&D, Operations and many other functions, with plenty of room to share ideas, learn from each other and have fun along the way.

**From “what if?” to “what next?”

**This is not a role where you spend all your time making strategies about strategies. You will work across the product and portfolio journey – spotting opportunities, figuring out which ones make sense and helping turn the right ones into reality.

Sometimes you will facilitate a workstream from beginning to end. At other times, you will have several things moving at once. That flexibility is very much part of the job.

More specifically, you will:

• Explore customer needs, market trends, competitors, technologies, access, reimbursement and regulatory developments to identify opportunities

• Turn market, clinical, technical and financial insights into business cases, portfolio choices and clear recommendations

• Lead or support innovation and product development from opportunity assessment through concept, feasibility, development and transfer

• Shape launch, market expansion and lifecycle plans based on strategic fit, unmet needs and commercial potential

• Bring cross-functional teams together around clear objectives, responsibilities, decisions and next steps

With a global scope comes the opportunity to get out and meet the people you work with, with approximately 10-15% travel.

**A strategic mindset with a hands-on approach

**You have a strategic and analytical mindset, but you are not afraid to roll up your sleeves when an idea needs moving forward. You are curious, collaborative and comfortable when there is not a ready-made answer – and you know how to bring people with you when priorities, perspectives and possibilities compete for attention.

We also imagine that you:

• Have a master’s degree in business, marketing, economics, healthcare, science, engineering or a related discipline

• Bring approximately 3+ years of relevant experience in product strategy, product development, portfolio management, business development, consulting or a related role, preferably within regulated healthcare

• Have successfully led complex cross-functional initiatives and developed business cases

• Can translate market, clinical, technical and financial information into recommendations

• Have strong English and Microsoft Office skills

**Interested?

**If you would like to know more about the position, please e-mail Senior Director of Strategy & Development

Wound & Tissue Repair, Thomas Kondrup Hardahl, on dktkha@coloplast.com

We will take candidates into the recruitment process continuously, so do not hesitate to apply. This position will remain open until a suitable candidate has been found.

Are you motivated by working in a growing company which develops cutting edge products in the laser industry? Hamamatsu Photonics is an exciting, inspiring place to work where we encourage both personal and career development. To support our plans, we are now expanding our team as we are looking for Senior Electronics Engineers.

**About Us

**Hamamatsu Photonics is a dynamic, international high-tech company and a leader in the development, manufacturing, and supply of high-performance lasers and photonic crystal fibers. We employ some of the best and most creative people in our industry and together we have established one of the fastest growing and most innovative photonics companies in the world.

We embrace a culture in which a healthy work-life balance is encouraged; and we promote a positive, supportive working environment. To support our growth plans, we are investing in our facilities and growing our talented teams. We provide a great place to work with good people and exciting, industry-leading products.

**THE ROLE

**You will be working with a mix of custom-made technologies and ground research. You will design, develop and implement electronic systems and laser products throughout the entire product lifecycle. You will closely collaborate with experts in your own and other fields to meet the demanding requirements. The products you develop are typically low volume but high margin, reflecting the complexity and effort put into each system. You are prepared to learn to interpret and scope fuzzy customer requirements.

• Be responsible for Electronics development for laser products throughout the entire product lifecycle.

• Work closely with experts from other areas like optics and mechanics on system design.

• Take ownership of project work packages within product development projects; work with project managers to ensure delivery of solutions within the planned deadlines and budgets.

• Interact with project and product stakeholders and communicate information clearly across the R&D organization.

• Form new and innovative design concepts and take ownership of electronics system designs.

• Create reference designs for other electronics designers in our organization.

• Support manufacturing of existing laser products, custom orders, product improvement activities.

• Ensure product compliance and certification according to industry standards

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

**

• Experience from senior roles in developing advanced PCBs for complex systems spanning the complete product life cycle.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills engaging with management and other engineering disciplines.

• Proven track record of successful PCB productization.

• Deep domain knowledge in at least one of the following areas: analog design, power supplies, control loops, digital interfaces or low noise designs.

• Detailed knowledge of state of the art electronic and software technologies.

• Experience of working with external partners.

• A scientific mindset, out of the box thinker but still with a practical approach.

• Master’s degree in electronics or similar.

• English – both oral and written

**WE OFFER

**Professional challenges in a highly dynamic and growing business environment with enormous potential for further growth. An opportunity to become part of a successful, enthusiastic, development team in an informal workplace. Competitive employment terms and benefits, good work-life balance, and influence on own tasks. Experienced and skilled colleagues with highly diverse backgrounds in an international organization.

**APPLY TODAY

**We plan to invite candidates for interviews as soon as possible. If you think you have what it takes, please send your CV and a brief cover letter (in one document) to us and we will be in contact soon.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

Hansen Toft is seeking a Director, Product Management on behalf of Systematic A/S.

Do you want a role with a clear sense of purpose, working with mission-critical technology that supports defence organisations and their ability to operate, collaborate and make well-informed decisions in complex environments?

Systematic has experienced significant growth in recent years, with the Defence business playing a key role in this development. Increasing international defence investments, growing requirements for data sovereignty and information security, and a continued need for advanced decision-support solutions are creating new opportunities across the market.

As part of this ongoing development, Systematic is strengthening the leadership around its IRIS Suite and Mobile portfolio. As Director, Product Management, you will take overall responsibility for IRIS Suite, SitaWare Frontline, and SitaWare Edge and lead an experienced Product Management team of eight employees, with plans to expand the team further. Your responsibilities include people leadership, product strategy, and the commercial development of the portfolio.

You will set the direction for the portfolio, translate customer and market needs into clear product priorities, and ensure a strong business rationale for future investments and development initiatives. Reporting directly to the Vice President, Product Management, Defence, you will work closely with senior management, technical functions, and commercial teams as well as strategic customers, giving you a central role in key product and investment decisions.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Execute the strategic direction for the IRIS Suite and Mobile portfolios and translate it into clear product roadmaps and development priorities.

• Drive the commercial development of the portfolio, including business plans, market priorities, and long-term growth opportunities.

• Lead and develop the product management team, taking responsibility for results, competencies, resources, and long-term capacity.

• Prepare business analyses, budgets, and investment proposals, and present recommendations to Product Boards and other relevant decision-making bodies.

• Maintain a close dialogue with customers and operational end-users and translate their needs into product priorities and development initiatives.

• Identify and evaluate new products, features, markets, and business models in collaboration with the innovation department and other relevant stakeholders.

• Work closely with the sales, marketing, and technical departments on strategic customer opportunities, major proposals, and product expansions.

• Monitor the portfolio’s performance and use insights into the market, customers, and the business to adjust priorities and support key product decisions.

Who are you?

You have a relevant degree in engineering, software, computer science, electronics, or a related field such as Business Development Engineering, combining technology with commercial insights.

You bring solid experience from working in a product-driven software company where software is the core business, preferably from a role combining Product Management, commercial responsibility, and leadership. You have proven management experience in building high-performing teams, strong business acumen, and the ability to connect customer needs, product strategy, market opportunities, and investment priorities.

You are not expected to be the leading technical specialist, but you understand complex software products well enough to engage credibly with specialists and make informed product and business decisions.

As a leader, you are pragmatic, curious, and action-oriented. You set a clear direction, build trust, challenge constructively, and give experienced specialists the space to leverage their expertise, while maintaining ownership of key decisions and overall priorities.

You must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years, as Systematic works with security-classified projects.

Influence the direction of mission-critical software

This position gives you significant influence over the development and prioritisation of a strategically important portfolio within one of Systematic’s key growth areas. You will be closely involved in key product and investment decisions and have the opportunity to shape both the portfolio and the continued development of the product management organisation.

At the same time, you will become part of a well-established international software company with a strong position in the defence sector and long-standing relationships with national defence organisations, NATO, and international partners.

Most importantly, you will work with mission-critical software that supports defence organisations in establishing situational awareness, coordinating operations, and making well-informed decisions across land, air, sea, and joint domains.

________________________________________________________________________

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Research Consultant Simone Svenningsen on tel. 2616 3704.

Please note that we only need your CV when you apply for the position. Your enquiry will be treated confidentially and will not be passed on without your consent.

________________________________________________________________________

The company develops mission-critical software for environments where reliability, security and informed decision-making are essential.

Different solutions are used by more than one million users across 50+ countries within Defence, Healthcare, National Security, Critical Infrastructure and Library.

Read more at https://systematic.com/dk/

jobs.description:
Georg Jensen is a Danish design house renowned for its timeless Danish aesthetics, superior craftsmanship and visionary collaborations with leading artists and designers. Founded in Copenhagen in 1904 by master silversmith Georg Jensen, the company creates products ranging from jewellery, watches and homeware to silver hollowware and Christmas Collectables.

Join Our Team as a part-time Sales Associate!

Are you passionate about design and delivering exceptional customer experiences? We are looking for motivated and customer-focused individuals to join our team as a Sales Associate. We currently have both a permanent part-time position and a Christmas assistance position available. As a brand ambassador for Georg Jensen, renowned for its craftsmanship, design heritage, and timeless products, you will play a key role in creating memorable shopping experiences and representing our brand at its very best.

Position: Sales Associate

Location: Amagertorv 4, 1160 København KWorking hours: Both positions are 8-15 hours a week.

Responsibilities:

• 
Engage with customers warmly and professionally, providing personalized assistance and expert product knowledge.

• 
Showcase the artistry and craftsmanship of Georg Jensen's collections, educating customers about the unique designs and rich heritage.

• 
Maintain a visually appealing store environment, ensuring product displays are well-presented and enticing.

• 
Process sales transactions accurately and efficiently.

• 
Proactively address customer inquiries, concerns, and feedback, going above and beyond to exceed expectations and build lasting relationships.

• 
Collaborate with the store team to achieve sales targets and contribute to overall store success.

• 
Use storytelling to engage customers, ignite their imagination, and drive sales.

Jupiter Bach is taking the next step in its development as a partner to the global wind industry. Building on our strong position within composite manufacturing, we are expanding our capabilities across engineering, assembly and full-system delivery, supporting leading wind OEMs globally.

This means getting involved earlier in the customer dialogue and taking greater ownership of how customer requirements translate into technically sound and commercially viable solutions.

As our new Customer Solutions Engineer, Composites, you will be an important part of that development.

The opportunity

You will work at the intersection of customers, Sales and Engineering, shaping composite solutions from early customer engagement through to handover to Product Execution.

Your role is to understand the customer need, challenge and clarify requirements, and apply your composite engineering expertise to develop the right solution. Working closely with customer technical teams and specialists within Jupiter Bach, you will drive the technical dialogue and pre-project activities while considering both engineering feasibility and commercial implications.

This is a role for an engineer who wants to use technical depth beyond the traditional engineering function. You will be close to the customer, influence solutions at an early stage and help create a strong foundation for successful engineering and execution.

What you will work with

You will take responsibility for the technical side of customer opportunities during pre-sales and early project phases.

A key part of the role will be to:

• Act as the technical interface towards customers during pre-sales and early project phases

• Translate customer requirements into feasible composite engineering solutions

• Apply your understanding of composite structures, loads, geometry and strength to solution development

• Support Sales in customer meetings, proposals and negotiations

• Drive pre-project activities and technical alignment between customers and internal specialists

• Prepare and validate technical cost calculations and provide input to pricing decisions

• Assess engineering changes and their technical and commercial impact

• Support customer claims through root cause analysis and corrective actions

• Work within PPAP and APQP4Wind processes to ensure quality and robustness

You will be part of a growing team that combines different technical competencies with ownership of specific customers and opportunities.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for an engineer with strong composite expertise who is motivated by applying that knowledge in a customer- and solution-oriented role.

You understand how composite products move from requirements and design through manufacturing and into serial production. Just as importantly, you can communicate your technical knowledge and work effectively with customers, engineers, manufacturing specialists and commercial colleagues.

We expect you to bring:

• An engineering background in Composites, Materials, Structural or Manufacturing Engineering, or another relevant discipline.

• Experience with the design and manufacturing of composite structures or GFRP products

• Understanding of load conditions, geometry and strength evaluation in composite design

• Relevant experience from the wind industry or another technically complex manufacturing environment

• Good understanding of manufacturing processes and engineering interfaces

• The ability to balance technical, operational and commercial considerations

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• Professional fluency in English

Experience with PPAP and APQP4Wind is an advantage. Danish language skills are an advantage but not a requirement.

Why Jupiter Bach?

Jupiter Bach is expanding from a strong composite manufacturing base towards broader engineering and full-system capabilities.

For an experienced composites engineer, this creates an opportunity to move closer to the customer and influence solutions much earlier in the process.

You will join an international organisation working with leading wind OEMs and have the opportunity to contribute directly to how Jupiter Bach develops its future engineering and customer solution capabilities.

Contact

For more information about the role, please contact recruitment partner, Lotte Christensen, at loc@slaterconsult.com.

Slater Consult is Jupiter Bachs’s recruiting partner for this position.

**Job Description Summary

**Systems engineering is a cross-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the users needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation.

Accountable for the quality of own work. Subject to direct operations supervision/prescribed work instructions/systems checking. Executes within a well-defined operations framework. There is generally a step by step sequence of standard operational tasks which need to be followed to achieve an end result.

jobs.occupation: Join the Crew at Moxy Aarhus
jobs.description:
Are you ready to be part of something from the very beginning? In February 2027, we will open the doors to a brand-new Moxy hotel in Aarhus, and we are now looking for the stars who, together with the management team, will help shape the hotel’s energy, culture and guest experiences from day one.

Moxy is not a traditional hotel. We combine design, energy, technology and personal service in a relaxed atmosphere where guests feel welcome from the moment they arrive. The hotel is operated by Core Hospitality and is part of Marriott International, the world’s largest hotel company.

We are looking for enthusiastic, service-minded colleagues for the following roles:

• Front Office Leader

• Bar Leader

• Breakfast Leader

• Housekeeping Leader

• Front Desk Crew (day and night shifts)

• Bar Crew

• Breakfast Crew

• Housekeeping Crew

What all roles have in common

Regardless of which role you apply for, you will be an important part of the Crew bringing our new hotel to life. We are looking for colleagues who want to make a difference, bring positive energy and help create a workplace where both guests and colleagues feel welcome.

At Moxy, great service is not about stiff formalities. It is about being present, approachable and creating memorable experiences in a personal and relaxed way. We support each other across departments, take responsibility and find solutions when things do not go quite as planned. We believe the best results come from making the most of each other’s strengths and working together as a team.

You do not necessarily need previous hotel experience. What matters most is that you greet people with a smile, are eager to learn and contribute positively to the team. At the same time, we expect you to be ready to roll up your sleeves, remain flexible in a role with varied tasks and be excited about building something new together with the rest of the team.

Who are you?

What matters most to us is not necessarily where you come from, but what you bring to the table.

We imagine that you:

• Have a positive, service-minded approach to guests and colleagues.

• Thrive in an environment where no two days are quite the same.

• Take responsibility for your tasks and actively contribute to the team.

• Are enthusiastic, curious and ready to be part of the journey from day one.

• Enjoy creating great experiences and finding solutions, even when things get busy.

Experience in the hotel, service or restaurant industry is an advantage for several of the roles. For leadership positions, we naturally expect relevant experience and a willingness to take responsibility for both daily operations and the well-being of your colleagues. Across all roles, we place great value on personality, motivation and potential.

What we offer

• The opportunity to help open a brand-new hotel.

• A modern and dynamic working environment full of energy.

• Good working conditions and dedicated colleagues.

• Great opportunities for professional and personal development.

• A strong sense of community, with a focus on teamwork and well-being.

• A workplace where personality, initiative and great ideas are valued.

The recruitment process

The recruitment process is tailored to each role and may therefore vary depending on the position. For some positions, personality assessments or job-related tests may also be part of the process.

How to apply

Depending on the position, your expected start date will be 1 January, 15 January or 1 February 2027, allowing us to prepare together for the hotel’s opening in mid-February 2027.

Submit your application and CV via the link below.

Please clearly state which position you are applying for. You must submit a separate application for each role, and only one role may be applied for per application.

Application deadline: 15 November 2026

We look forward to hearing from you and hopefully welcoming you to our new Crew!

About Core Hospitality

Core Hospitality A/S is one of Denmark’s leading hotel operators, independent of brands and flexible in its approach to operating all types of hotels. Core Hospitality A/S currently operates 18 hotels in Denmark and Norway, including Four Points Flex by Sheraton, Moxy, A Place To Hotel and Kirk Suites.

jobs.description:
atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.

With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.

Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.

By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

**Senior Manager Of Customer Experience & Product At AtNorth

**Are you a senior leader passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences and translating customer needs into meaningful product and service improvements? Do you have the strategic mindset and leadership skills to connect customer insight, commercial priorities and operational realities?

atNorth is looking for a Senior Manager of Customer Experience & Product to lead the Customer Experience & Product function within Customer Operations. In this role, you will shape the customer experience strategy, drive customer journey excellence and oversee product, service catalogue and customer-facing platform priorities across an international and fast-growing digital infrastructure organization.

As Senior Manager of Customer Experience & Product, you will own the frameworks, standards and priorities that ensure a clear, scalable and consistent customer experience across atNorth. You will translate customer insight, business objectives and operational needs into clear priorities, OKRs and roadmaps.

The role combines customer experience strategy, product and service management, digital platform development and leadership. You will work closely with Product, IT, Sales, Client Management, Implementation, Operations, Service Delivery and Performance & Governance to ensure that customer needs are reflected in how atNorth develops its services, processes and digital capabilities.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Define and lead the Customer Experience & Product strategy, operating framework, standards and governance routines.

• Translate business objectives, customer insight and operational needs into priorities, OKRs and roadmaps.

• Own the end-to-end customer journey framework and standards for customer interactions throughout the customer lifecycle.

• Govern customer feedback and satisfaction insights, ensuring that customer insight is translated into tangible improvements.

• Set standards for customer onboarding, communication, enablement, knowledge and self-service experiences.

• Own Customer Operations governance of the service catalogue, customer-facing service definitions and product/service lifecycle input.

• Define and prioritize customer-facing requirements for the portal, CRM, Jira and other digital and self-service capabilities.

• Ensure customer needs, commercial priorities and operational realities are reflected in product, service and platform roadmaps.

• Lead and develop the Product Manager and Customer Experience Manager, setting direction, priorities, performance expectations and development goals

• Represent customer experience and product priorities in management, governance and roadmap forums.

• Drive cross-functional priorities by aligning stakeholders across Product, IT, Sales, Client Management, Implementation, Operations, Service Delivery and Performance & Governance.

• Monitor progress against Customer Experience & Product OKRs, strategic priorities and improvement roadmaps, identifying risks and driving timely decisions.

You will also have the authority to set functional priorities, allocate work across Product Management and Customer Experience, and prioritize customer-facing product, service, process and platform improvements within agreed strategy, budget and governance boundaries. In this role, you will have broad cross-functional exposure and the opportunity to shape how customers experience atNorth – from onboarding and communication to services, products and digital platforms.

**Your profile:

**We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded leader who combines a strong customer focus with strategic thinking, product understanding and the ability to turn insight into action. You are comfortable navigating complex organizations and bringing different stakeholders together around a common customer and business agenda.

• 8–10+ years of experience within customer experience, customer success, product or service management, service delivery or related fields.

• Experience from data center, IT infrastructure, B2B technology or another complex service environment.

• Proven leadership experience and the ability to develop and empower high-performing teams.

• Strong understanding of customer experience strategy, customer journeys and service design.

• Experience with product and service portfolio management and/or service catalogue governance.

• The ability to translate customer, commercial and operational insight into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.

• Experience managing customer-facing digital platforms, requirements or self-service capabilities.

• Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

• Excellent communication, facilitation and executive-level reporting skills.

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Product Management, Service Management, IT, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Fluency in English; proficiency in Danish is preferred.

As a person, you are strategic, customer-focused and decisive, with a strong ability to create clarity in complex environments. You are a natural collaborator who can build relationships across functions while confidently challenging existing ways of working when needed. You combine commercial awareness with an analytical and pragmatic approach and are motivated by creating measurable improvements in both customer experience and business performance.

Experience or certification in ITIL, product management, service design or customer experience is considered an advantage.

**About The AtNorth Culture

**We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.

We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.

At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together.

**Do you want to know more?

**In this process atNorth is working with Level Recruitment. To apply, please click the apply button. If you have further questions don´t hesitate to contact senior recruitment consultant Christian Smith at +46 8 120 50 400.

We will interview ongoingly so please register your application as soon as possible.

**Overview

**The Senior Manager, Clinical Trial Planning is an individual contributor focused on supporting Clinical Trial Teams (CTTs) in the effective management of clinical trial timelines across the portfolio. The role drives planning system enablement (Planisware), owns and maintains a standardized Microsoft Project (MSP) trial planning template, and develops high-quality timeline visualizations to support trial execution and governance decision-making.

The role partners closely with Global Trial Leaders (GTLs), who are accountable for the overall delivery of their trials and retain ownership of trial timelines within internal planning systems. The Clinical Trial Planner complements this accountability by ensuring planning data is structured, standardized, and translated into clear, actionable insights that enable effective execution and decision-making.

**Responsibilities/tasks

****Planisware Enablement & Trial Support

**

• Partner with GTLs across the portfolio to drive effective use of Planisware and ensure trial plans reflect agreed assumptions, dependencies, and execution strategy, while GTLs retain overall accountability.

• Liaise with Development Program Managers (DPMs) to align trial-level plans with program- and asset-level timelines and milestones.

• Collaborate with the Portfolio Planning team to provide structured trial-level insights and recommendations that inform ongoing refinement and maintenance of Planisware templates and standards.

**MS Project (MSP) Template Ownership & Standardization

**

• Develop and maintain a fit for purpose Microsoft Project (MSP) Trial Planning template for GTL use across study phases.

• Ensure alignment between the MSP template, Planisware, and portfolio-level planning standards.

• Provide guidance to GTLs to promote consistent, high-quality timeline development using the MSP template.

**Data Visualization

**

• Develop and deliver clear visualization templates derived from Planisware and/or MSP data, displaying key milestones and activities.

• Tailor visual outputs to support CTTs, governance, and leadership discussions.

**Process & Tool Adoption

**

• Act as a Planisware subject matter expert at the trial-support level.

• Reinforce GTL training through hands-on guidance and real-time coaching.

• Apply and promote standardized planning methodologies and visualization standards across the portfolio.

**Governance Awareness & Decision Support

**

• Prepare timeline views and supporting materials aligned with governance forum expectations (e.g., Project Board, Portfolio Board, Operational Review Committee).

• Anticipate governance triggers based on timeline changes or emerging risks.

• Translate planning data into concise, decision-ready visuals and summaries.

**Requirements/Preferences

****Senior Manager

**

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.

• Approximately 7-10+ years of experience in clinical trial operations, project management, trial planning, or related roles.

• Demonstrated experience driving planning system adoption and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.

• Experience developing or standardizing planning templates, tools, or reporting frameworks across multiple studies.

• Strong understanding of portfolio-level planning considerations and governance expectations.

• Advanced analytical capability and ability to provide structured execution insight to leadership forums.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Build Strong Supplier Partnerships

NG Nordic is a leading provider of circular solutions and environmental services in the Nordics. By transforming waste into valuable resources and removing hazardous substances from the material cycle, we reduce emissions, protect natural ecosystems, and increase access to circular materials. NG Nordic is an important part of the Nordic industrial infrastructure, generating revenue of EUR 1.3 billion with a team of around 3,400 employees and 90 facilities.

Health & Safety Specialist, Nyborg, Denmark

Do you want to be the Safety Shoulder and make a real difference to safety in one of Europe’s most complex industrial environments?

Be the trusted Health & Safety voice in daily operations at NG Nordic’s hazardous waste treatment facility in Nyborg.

As Health & Safety Specialist, you will work close to the operational teams, helping managers and employees turn safety requirements into practical actions. You will be part of a five-person team in Nyborg and work as an integrated partner to Operations.

Nyborg is a Seveso III facility and is described as the EU’s largest hazardous waste treatment plant. Here, health and safety is not simply a compliance exercise: the risks are real, and your work can have a direct impact on people, processes and operational reliability.

Your role combines visible presence in the plant with reporting, statistics, procedures, training and improvement projects. You will advise and challenge Operations constructively, build trust across functions and help ensure a safe, professional operation.

The position is based in Nyborg and requires regular engagement with employees, supervisors and managers throughout the facility.

You will turn safety requirements into practical improvements in daily operations

You will participate in daily and weekly operational meetings, identify and prioritise EHSQ risks, and help the organisation address the issues that matter most. You will balance proactive safety work with administrative responsibilities and timely follow-up.

Your key tasks will include:

• Acting as the Health & Safety partner to Operations, advising managers and employees and participating in daily and weekly operational meetings

• Conducting safety walks, workplace inspections, toolbox talks and awareness activities, and following up on identified risks

• Preparing safety reports, statistics and KPI follow-up, identifying trends and recommending actions

• Developing and implementing practical safety procedures, training programmes, onboarding and contractor inductions

With an IoT platform connecting more millions of devices, and growing - Trackunit is building the connectivity layer underneath the construction industry. Every one of those units carries a cellular radio, and every one of those radios sits inside a web of standards, type approvals, and patent licences that decides whether we can ship and where we can ship.

You will join our IoT Division, Device Reliability Engineering (DRE) team as an expert on IoT certifications, standards, and licensing including Standard Essential Patents (SEP). This position shapes both our exposure and our coverage arguments, and it means this role works in every direction at once, with suppliers, regulatory approvals, legal advisors, product and engineering, and with customers.

This is a role for someone who can hold a genuinely complex domain in their head and then explain it in three sentences to a customer who has never heard the phrase “patent exhaustion.”

Experience level: a deep specialist role. We expect solid, hands-on experience with cellular device approvals and licensing — likely 10+ years across regulatory, certification, or IP/licensing work in mobile, IoT, or telecom hardware. This is a senior individual contributor position with no direct reports, high autonomy, and direct executive visibility.

With locations in the heart of Copenhagen, Kolding, Aarhus, and Aalborg, we offer a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations — or remotely from anywhere in Denmark.

****What's in it for you?

• A domain you will own, not administer. IoT Cellular License, SEP and certification strategy is an executive-level topic at Trackunit right now, with real financial exposure attached. You will not be filing paperwork in a corner, you will be shaping the position the company takes.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching, and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We offer a flexible setup because we believe you know best how to structure your work. Once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring — we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here.

****What you'll do

****Your work splits roughly into four parts: licensing, approvals, guidance, and governance.

• Own our SEP position. Understand where our cellular SEP exposure actually sits across our device portfolio, track the relevant patent pools and licensing programmes, and maintain a clear, evidence-based view of what is covered through our supply chain and what is not.

• Run supplier licensing due diligence. Establish and maintain a consistent set of asks across module suppliers — coverage confirmation, standards and generations covered, and honest disclosure of known gaps — so responses can be compared side by side and fed into supplier qualification.

• Support licensing negotiations and claims. Work alongside our General Counsel, external patent counsel, and economic advisors on royalty basis questions, valuation and apportionment arguments, and claims that reach us through our OEM customers. You bring the technical and supply chain substance; they bring the legal strategy.

• Own global type approvals and certification. Plan and steer RED/CE, FCC, ISED, UKCA, and the wider set of regional approvals, plus GCF/PTCRB and carrier certification, across a multi-region device portfolio. Keep certification on the critical path of new product programmes rather than at the end of them.

• Stay ahead of regulatory change. Cyber Resilience Act, RED delegated acts, radio spectrum and network sunsets, environmental and product compliance requirements — know what is coming, when it bites, and what it means for our roadmap.

• Make the complex simple, and guide without over-promising. Write and maintain the internal playbooks, customer-facing explainers, and OEM guidance that turn this domain into something a commercial colleague or a customer can act on. Be the person Sales, Legal, and customers come to when a licensing notification lands, explaining the landscape accurately, saying clearly where the limits of our position are, and pointing customers to independent specialist advice where that is the right answer.

• Build the governance. Response protocols, decision records, escalation paths, and embedding licensing and compliance requirements into how we qualify suppliers and run the product development lifecycle.

****Who you are

****We think you'll need

• Strong working knowledge of cellular connectivity (e.g. LTE-M, NB-IoT, LTE Cat-1/1bis, 5G) and the direction of travel, plus a real understanding of the module and chipset landscape.

• Solid, practical experience with licensing and Standard Essential Patents in mobile or IoT devices: FRAND principles, patent pools, patent exhaustion and the limits of sublicensing, and how royalties are actually structured and argued.

• Hands-on experience with global type approvals and regulatory certification for radio products — RED/CE, FCC, and the regional approvals that come with selling hardware worldwide.

• Experience working across a hardware supply chain with module suppliers, test houses, notified bodies, and certification partners.

• Communication as a core skill, not a bonus. You can take a genuinely complicated subject and land it in plain language, in writing, with an audience that has no background in it.

• The judgement to know what we can and cannot say to a customer, and the discipline to hold that line even when it would be easier not to.

**What Matters More Than The Checklist

**

• You are honest about uncertainty. In this domain, no one can offer a blanket guarantee, and the people who claim otherwise create problems later. We would rather be accurate than reassuring.

• You are curious and self-driven, this is a field that changes constantly, and nobody is going to hand you a reading list.

• You finish things. A clear one-page answer delivered this week beats a perfect analysis that arrives after the decision was made.

• You are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows a subject, and you use that position to make others smarter rather than to make yourself indispensable.

On AI: experience with AI tooling is not a requirement, but a strong motivation and interest in working with it is. We already use AI in our daily engineering work, including MCP servers and agents against our own platform, and we see clear potential in applying it to research, documentation, and compliance workflows. We don't expect you to have experience with this but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to learn.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this role and your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

****How you'll grow here

****This is a specialist role with an unusually wide view of the business, and we've set it up that way on purpose.

• Executive proximity. You will work closely with the SVP of IoT Division, while reporting into a central function for IoT, as the Device Reliability Engineering. You will help in presenting to executive leadership on exposure, risk, and recommendations. Your analysis will inform on a product technical matter (Not Legal) but with real financial and commercial decisions.

• Cross-functional reach. Legal, Finance, Product Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Sales all depend on this domain. Few roles at Trackunit touch as many parts of the company.

• External network. You will work with external patent counsel, economic consultants, module suppliers, certification bodies, and industry forums — building a network that extends well beyond Trackunit.

• Room to define the function. This discipline is being built out now. What it becomes — and whether it grows into a team — is substantially yours to shape.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We're committed to construction one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products — it's a way of life at Trackunit. We're proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

jobs.occupation: Clinical position as staff specialist combined with a clinical associate professorship (research) in Paediatrics- Børn og Unge, Sjællands Universitetshospital
jobs.description:
A clinical position as staff specialist of Paediatrics at the Department of Paediatrics and Adolescent Medicine at Zealand University Hospital is open for appointment from as soon as possible.

The position as staff specialist is combined with a 5-year externally funded position as clinical associate professor (research) in Paediatrics at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen.

With this new position the Department of Paediatrics and Adolescent Medicine, Zealand University Hospital wishes to strengthen the leadership in clinical research and teaching in collaboration with the University of Copenhagen.

It is a requirement that the applicant is accepted for appointment of both the clinical associate professorship (research) and the clinical position.

About the Department

The Department of Paediatrics and Adolescent Medicine at Zealand University Hospital is a well-established clinical and research-active department with sites in Roskilde (planned move to Køge 2028) and Nykøbing Falster. The department provides comprehensive care across the full spectrum of paediatrics, including specialised services within paediatric endocrinology and the management of childhood diabetes.

The treatment of childhood diabetes in Region Zealand is organised across multiple sites, enabling strong cross-site collaboration and the development of shared clinical pathways. The department works closely with Steno Diabetes Center Zealand and collaborates with paediatric departments both within and beyond the region.

The department offers a dynamic research environment with a focus on strengthening clinical research, including dedicated research within childhood diabetes. This field involves distinct clinical and developmental considerations compared to adult diabetes, and research activities address treatment outcomes, patient development, quality of life and health equality.

Teaching and supervision of medical students and junior doctors are integral parts of the department’s activities, and there is a strong emphasis on developing future clinicians and clinical researchers.

Qualifications:

Applicants for a position as staff specialist must be board-certified specialist in Paediatrics.

Conditions:

In order to be considered, the applicant must send an application to both the Faculty (the clinical associate professorship (research)) and to the hospital (the clinical position) cf. the simultaneously advertised position of the clinical associate professorship (research). Appointment is conditioned by the fact that the applicant obtains both positions. This also applies to the applicants who are already employed as staff specialists at Zealand University Hospital.

Salary and conditions of employment as staff specialist are as agreed between the Danish Regions and the Danish Association of Medical Specialists and between the Capital Region/Region Zealand and University of Copenhagen.

As clinical associate professor (research) at least 50 % of the working time will be allocated to academic tasks (e.g. research, teaching, evaluation tasks and communication with the public) in agreement with the Head of Department of Clinical Medicine at the University of Copenhagen. The remaining time will be allocated for clinical work in agreement with the head of Department of Paediatrics and Adolescent Medicine.

Application procedure:

The application must include the following:

• Curriculum Vitae and a complete list of publications

• A description of how the applicant is qualified as

- Clinical expert

- Communicator

- Collaborator

- Manager/administrator/organizer

- Health advocate

- Scholar/researcher/teacher, professional

For more information please refer to https://sundhedsstyrelsen.dk/en/news/2013/the-seven-roles-of-physicians.

For applicants with a foreign license also a copy of the authorization certificate for specialist in Paediatrics recognition.

The closing date for applications is 30.11.2026.

Further information:

For further information please contact Head of Department of Paediatrics and Adolescent Medicine, Malene Boas, mboa@regionsjaelland.dk

The advertisement for the clinical associate professorship (research) is available from the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen

171819 Clinical Associate Professor (Research) of Paediatrics (Fixed-term, 5 years)

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.

Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Sjællands Universitetshospital

Sjællands Universitetshospital er Danmarks nyeste universitetshospital med aktiviteter i Køge, Roskilde og Nykøbing F. Vi er et modigt og udadvendt universitetshospital, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at skabe et sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen og større lighed i sundhed for borgerne i regionen.

Vores optageområde er præget af flere borgere med kronisk sygdom og sociale udfordringer end landsgennemsnittet. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med innovation, nye samarbejdsformer og løsninger, der bringer behandling tættere på borgerne.

Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde på tværs, høj faglighed og løbende forbedringer er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vores ledelsesværdier er nytænkning, følgeskab, ordentlighed og fællesskab, og de sætter retning for, hvordan vi arbejder, udvikler os og skaber gode resultater – for både borgere og medarbejdere.
