**Job Description

**_Do you enjoy designing highly available network solutions where BGP failover happens seamlessly and downtime is measured in milliseconds? Are you motivated by ownership, technical excellence, and continuous development? If so, Netcompany is looking for a Senior Network Engineer to help drive and evolve our data center and enterprise network infrastructure.

_**Responsibilities And Technologies

**Netcompany Operations is a well-established operations organization responsible for everything from business- and mission-critical application operations to infrastructure management across two modern data centers.

As a Senior Network Engineer, you will join our Network Team, which is part of the broader Infrastructure organization. We deliver secure and reliable solutions within our private cloud environments, supporting critical systems for both public and private sector customers.

You will be working with the operation, maintenance, and evolution of Netcompany’s data center and enterprise network infrastructure. You will work on complex, business-critical initiatives spanning the entire networking domain, with opportunities tailored to support your professional growth and career development.

The role offers technical ownership and direct influence on solutions delivered to public-sector and mission-critical customers. In addition, you will work with security as well as automation and DevOps principles within networking, including stabilization and continuous development—from core routing to security and WAN/edge.

**Your Responsibilites Will Typically Include

**

• Operating, troubleshooting, expanding, and designing network solutions across data center and enterprise/campus environments.

• Enhancing network security through segmentation, policy-based routing (PBR), access control, SIEM and IPS.

• Managing and optimizing Fortinet firewalls, Cisco ASR routers, ACI-switching fabric and related data center technologies.

• Automation/DevOps and Infrastructure as Code initiatives using Python, Ansible, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, templates, pipelines, and code reviews.

• Collaborating closely with specialists across server, storage, and security domains while helping shape the technical direction of the network platform..

**About You

**You are proactive, accountable, and delivery-focused. You take accountability for your work, approach solutions with a structured and analytical mindset, help establish standards and best practices, and contribute to the continuous improvement of both the team and the platform. In addition, you are comfortable taking the lead and approach challenges in a structured and methodical manner.

**To Succeed In This Role, You

**

• Hold a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, network engineering, information technology, or a related field, or possess an equivalent level of qualification.

• Have several years of experience in a similar networking role.

• Have a solid understanding of scripting, automation, and Infrastructure as Code principles.

• Have hands-on experience with firewalls and network security technologies, preferably Fortinet and/or Cisco combined with strong practical experience with enterprise routing/switching, and LAN/WAN environments.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Employment is contingent upon your ability to obtain and maintain security clearance from the Danish Security and Intelligence Service (PET).

**Continue developing with us

**At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

**Join an inclusive community

**At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

**Send us an application

**Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

_All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

_We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

jobs.occupation: Two-year postdoc in developing inventory of agricultural nitrous oxide emissions
jobs.description:
The Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University, Denmark, welcomes applications for a postdoctoral researcher position in developing a Tier 3 model-based national inventory of N₂O emissions modelling from cultivation of soils. The position is part of the SmartField project, which is a cross-organizational research project aimed at obtaining knowledge about N₂O emissions from agricultural fields and solutions for mitigation strategies. Additionally, SmartField will develop and deliver an improved methodology for accounting N₂O emissions at farm and national scale.

Expected start date and duration of employment

The position is to be filled by February 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter and is a two-year fixed-term position.

Job description

You will be part of a research environment addressing greenhouse gas emissions and sustainability transition of agricultural systems, with a particular focus on nitrous oxide emissions from agricultural soil aiming to scale emission estimates from the field to the national scale. Your role will primarily involve supporting the development and implementation of a model-based approach for the national of N₂O emissions from diverse agricultural soils, as well as developing the data pipeline. This will include creating and updating spatio-temporal datasets on soils, cropping systems, and field management, and calculating and assessing and comparing the resulting inventories to other approaches. Scenarios will be used to explore how mitigation technologies and management measures could reduce N₂O emissions and to assess the suitability of the proposed Tier 3 modelling framework for Denmark's national N₂O emission inventory. Your work will support a Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) system, enabling transparent, robust and science-based reporting of mitigation progress regarding agricultural field N₂O emission. You will work in close collaboration with colleagues developing and testing process-oriented models, as well as with those responsible for the national greenhouse gas inventory.

Your profile

We are searching for a highly motivated candidate who has:

• A PhD in agronomy, soil science, data science, environmental sciences, engineering, agroecology, biology, or a related field.

• Experience working with models, managing and analyzing large datasets.

• Experience working with models related to nitrogen/carbon turnover in soil is considered an advantage but is not required.

• Documented experience in scientific writing and publishing in peer-reviewed scientific journals.

• The ability to communicate effectively in English (both written and oral).

• Good collaboration skills and ability to take responsibility to work independently and proactively on the project

Who we are

The position is shared between the Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology under the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University, and it will be hosted by the Land-CRAFT Center at the AU campus in Aarhus.

The Department of Environmental Science is an interdisciplinary department with expertise ranging from physics, chemistry, microbiology, engineering, social science, geography, economics, to policy analysis. Basic as well as applied research are conducted on some of the major challenges facing society, such as pollution and pollution control mechanisms, management of land, soil, water, air and biodiversity, protection of ecosystem services, and climate change. Advisory services within these areas are offered to governmental organizations, non-governmental organizations and companies. The department consists of five sections and currently about 160 staff (including postdocs and Ph.D. students).

The Department of Agroecology contributes to sustainable solutions to some of the world’s biggest problems within the areas of soil, plants, animals, humans, and the environment. We want to make a difference by contributing to both fundamental knowledge generation and the attainment of sustainable production systems via innovative research, contracted policy advice, and education. We offer professional laboratories, greenhouses, semi-field, and field-scale research facilities, advanced computing capacities as well as an extensive national and international researcher network.  The department consists of nine research sections with around 400 highly skilled employees.

This position is hosted by Land-CRAFT - the Center for Landscape Research in Sustainable Agricultural Future, which aims to bring transformational solutions to agricultural systems. Land-CRAFT is a section within the Department of Agroecology. Therefore, there is a strong focus on climate change mitigation and adaptation strategies.

Both departments believe in equality, diversity, inclusion, and creating an attractive work/life balance.

What we offer

• A collaborative, international research environment that combines high academic standards with an informal and supportive atmosphere. We value accountability, curiosity, flexibility, and teamwork in everything we do.

• An inclusive and respectful workplace culture, where mutual trust, kindness, and professional dialogue are part of daily life. We encourage open communication and develop a cohesive sense of community across teams and disciplines.

• A flexible working environment that supports work-life balance and individual needs.

• An active institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion – in recruitment, career development, and everyday interactions.

• An innovative and meaningful workplace where your work contributes to solving real-world challenges. No two days are alike, and we welcome creative thinking and new ideas.

• Support for international researchers and their families, including Relocation Service and an Expat Partner Programme.

Place of work and area of employment

The place of work is Aarhus University (LandCRAFT Center), Ole Worms Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C. The affiliation will be with the Department of Environmental Science. However, it should also be expected that there will be work-related and meeting activities at the Department of Environmental Science which is located at Risø in Roskilde.

Contact information

Further information may be obtained by contacting Head of Section Emissions and Atmospheric Modelling, Professor Peter L. Langen (plangen@envs.au.dk +4520618369), Professor Jørgen E. Olesen (jeo@agro.au.dk +4540821659), or Special consultant related to the national emission inventory Mette Hjorth Mikkelsen (mhm@envs.au.dk +4587158579).

Deadline

All applications must be received no later than November 27, 2026.

Application procedure

Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.

Formalities and salary range

Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people across the globe.

We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food. We work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet.

Everything we do is about Making Better Happen™.

AAK Locations

This position is based at our site in Aarhus, Denmark. We offer a hybrid way of working.

As our Talent Acquisition Specialist in Denmark, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape and establish how Talent Acquisition is delivered locally, while being part of AAK’s growing European Talent Acquisition team.

You will take ownership of end-to-end recruitment across a broad range of functions and levels, combining hands-on recruitment with a strategic and consultative approach. While Denmark will be your primary area of responsibility, you will also collaborate on recruitment projects and initiatives across other regions, giving you exposure to a broad range of stakeholders, functions and markets.

You will play an important role in attracting talent, strengthening AAK’s employer brand, delivering an excellent candidate experience, and continuously improving our recruitment processes and ways of working.

- Manage end-to-end recruitment processes across professional and operational roles in Denmark.

- Partner closely with hiring managers and HR colleagues to understand talent needs and define effective recruitment strategies.

- Build proactive talent pipelines through sourcing, talent mapping, networking, and candidate engagement.

- Conduct interviews and assessments and support hiring managers in making high-quality, structured recruitment decisions.

- Provide talent market insights and constructively challenge stakeholders when needed to support inclusive, data-informed, and long-term hiring outcomes.

- Develop attractive job advertisements, contribute to employer branding activities, and ensure a professional and engaging candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.

- Maintain recruitment data and systems and contribute to continuous improvement of recruitment processes and ways of working.

- Support recruitment across both professional and operational populations, including blue-collar recruitment.

- Manage relationships with recruitment agencies and external vendors to support quality, efficiency, and cost-effective partnerships.

- Collaborate with colleagues across the European Talent Acquisition team and contribute to broader recruitment projects and initiatives.

About you

You are an experienced Talent Acquisition professional who enjoys combining hands-on recruitment with a strategic and consultative approach. You build strong relationships with stakeholders, are comfortable constructively challenging when needed, and enjoy working in an international and evolving environment.

To succeed in this role, we believe you bring:

- Solid experience independently managing end-to-end recruitment processes, from initial briefing through to hire.

- Strong experience in proactive sourcing and candidate engagement, including LinkedIn Recruiter and talent mapping.

- Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

- A good understanding of structured selection methods and assessment tools.

- Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems.

- Excellent communication skills in both Danish and English.

- An interest in working across multiple functions, countries, and cultures.

- Experience from manufacturing, production, FMCG, or another industrial environment would be an advantage, as would experience managing recruitment agencies and external partners.

Contact and information

Please apply through our career portal. The deadline for applications is November 20, 2026.

For further information about the position, please contact: Linn Rubin, Talent Acquisition Specialist linn.rubin@aak.com or Sophie Rezaei, Global Talent Acquisition Manager, sophie.rezaei@aak.com.

About AAK

Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™. We specialize in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable.

At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer, with the unique flexibility of our production assets, and deep knowledge of many products and industries, including Chocolate and confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care.

Our 4,000 employees support our close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and the support of more than 20 production facilities. Listed on Nasdaq Stockholm and with our headquarters in Malmö, Sweden, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years.

jobs.description:
Help build reliable technology that powers sports experiences around the world.

At Trackman, we develop innovative technology used by athletes, coaches, and sports facilities worldwide. Behind these experiences are business-critical platforms that make it easy for customers to book, pay, and access our services.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to help strengthen the quality, reliability, and scalability of our booking, payments, and commerce solutions. You will work closely with developers, product owners, and quality engineers to ensure that our solutions deliver a seamless experience to customers around the world.

This role is ideal for an experienced automation engineer who enjoys building robust test frameworks, improving engineering practices, and working on business-critical payment solutions.

What You'll Do

• 
Design, develop, and maintain automated test solutions using Playwright and TypeScript.

• 
Build UI, API, integration, and end-to-end automated tests for booking and payment services.

• 
Drive risk-based testing and quality engineering practices across the product lifecycle.

• 
Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, and help define and maintain quality gates

• 
Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and quality engineers to improve testability and overall product quality.

• 
Identify quality risks early through requirement reviews and technical discussions.

• 
Mentor and support team members in test automation and quality engineering best practices.

• 
Continuously improve automation coverage, reliability, and execution efficiency.

Job requirements

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a proactive and collaborative approach to quality engineering.

• 
5+ years of experience as an SDET, Test Automation Engineer, or Quality Engineer.

• 
Experience with payment, e-commerce, subscription, billing, POS, or financial transaction platforms.

• 
Strong hands-on experience with Playwright and TypeScript.

• 
Experience testing REST and GraphQL APIs and backend services.

• 
Experience integrating and maintaining automated tests within CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.

• 
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

AI & Emerging Technologies

• Experience with AI and machine learning concepts and an understanding of how they can be applied within a quality engineering context.

Nice to Have

• 
Experience testing integrations with payment gateways such as Adyen, Stripe, PayPal, or Nets.

• 
Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms.

• 
Experience with performance, load, or security testing.

• 
Experience working in Agile product teams.

• 
Interest in sports technology or SaaS products.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Or Robust Design Consultant

Do you enjoy working through complex mechanical problems, questioning assumptions and understanding why a design behaves the way it does?

At RD8, you will work hands-on with mechanical product development, using analysis and practical design work to solve challenging client problems. You will join an international team of mechanical engineers in a dedicated technical environment where specialist expertise is central to the work as part of a dynamic start-up

This role is for engineers who want to stay close to the engineering work and don’t shy away from the hard and interesting challenges where you have to use all of your toolbox

About RD8

We help companies that cannot afford to get it wrong make better engineering design decisions. Through consulting, software and ventures, we strengthen how mechanical R&D teams think, design and deliver.

Our aim is to make Robust Design an everyday engineering practice.

Our engineering ecosystem brings together specialist knowledge, training, documentation and software.

We work with R&D, operations and manufacturing organizations across industries, including major international companies, to make mechanical products less sensitive to variation.

What you will do

As a Robust Design Consultant, you will work directly on clients’ mechanical design challenges. You will investigate how parts interact, how tolerances affect function, and how designs can be improved.

The role combines engineering work with client dialogue and technical responsibility for project delivery.

• Work with small teams to design, analyse, and improve mechanical products. We work either inside our client’s teams or as more independent teams.

• Develop solutions for new products across several industries.

• Analyse and improve existing products in a range of industries.

• Create data-driven transparency in your solutions to improve decision-making.

• Explain findings and design recommendations to clients, help deliver projects, and coordinate technical work within the team.

You will be working on these tasks with frontrunners within the area of Robust Design - experts on a global level, in a start-up with global ambitions.

We are continuously developing our framework and adopting or creating solutions for our engineering ecosystem.

There’s a short way from decision to action and a high degree of freedom to shape the company and solutions. Great opportunities to take responsibility and for shaping business areas going forward

Your background

We welcome engineers with two or more years of relevant professional experience, ideally in mechanical product development, as well as senior specialists who want to deepen their expertise and remain hands-on.

• A master’s degree in mechanical engineering or a related field.

• Strong analytical skills across mechanical function, tolerance variation, and solid mechanics.

• Knowledge of Robust Design principles.

• Knowledge of production technologies and Design for Manufacturing (DFM).

• Fluent English.

Additional experience we value

• Working knowledge of statistical methods and finite element simulation methods.

• Experience with prototyping tools and methods.

• Strong communication and presentation skills.

• Danish or German language skills.

• Advanced simulation expertise.

Location and travel

This is a hybrid role based at our headquarters at Strandboulevarden 122, 3rd floor, 2100 Copenhagen, Denmark.

Expect 0–20 travel days per year.

Why join RD8

• Work alongside Robust Design specialists on mechanical challenges across products and industries.

• Have a high degree of freedom in how you approach your work and contribute to the methods and tools we develop.

• Flexibility to work from home when project and client commitments allow, with support for a home office setup

• Optional monthly social events, a subsidized lunch scheme and coffee, tea and snacks at the office.

• Take on responsibility and help shape our services and business areas as the company develops.

Apply

If you're a problem-solver who is excited about working on cutting-edge technology to create world-class solutions, then apply now with your CV

For further information about the position, contact Casper Høgh at csh@ing.dk

Please write in your application that you've seen the job at TechJob.

Do you have a passion for troubleshooting, repair, and equipment reliability? Join a hands-on technical team working with marine, radar and subsea systems.

On behalf of our client, MARPRO Group is looking for a skilled Technician for the office in Copenhagen and other company locations in central Zealand.

You will become part of a highly specialised organisation working with advanced maritime and electronic systems in a demanding operational environment. The team combines technical expertise, innovation and a strong sense of purpose to deliver reliable solutions where quality, precision and commitment are essential.

The job

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Technician to join a growing technical team supporting advanced marine and subsea solutions.

This is a role for a proactive technical professional who enjoys troubleshooting, maintaining, and improving complex systems. You will work with a broad range of technologies including subsea equipment, radar systems, automation, electrical installations, mechanical systems, and integrated vessel solutions.

As part of a team of experienced specialists, you will be involved in installation, commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and technical support activities both at our facilities and on project sites. The role requires a practical mindset and the ability to independently identify issues and implement effective solutions.

You will be expected to take ownership of tasks, support project execution, and contribute with technical expertise across multiple disciplines. The position combines workshop-based activities in the Copenhagen area with project assignments and travel.

We are looking for someone who is naturally curious about technology, enjoys solving technical challenges, and is willing to go the extra mile to ensure successful project delivery.

People don't show up just to do a job. They show up because they have passion. We are looking for individuals with fire in their eyes and the right attitude.

Professional Qualifications

• Relevant technical education

• Minimum 5 years of experience working with technical systems

• Experience with troubleshooting, maintenance, installation and commissioning of technical equipment

• Valid driving license and willingness to travel up to 60 days per year

• Fluency in English, eligibility to work within the EU and ability to obtain EU security clearance

Personal characteristics

• Hands-on and motivated by solving technical challenges

• Works independently and takes ownership of tasks and projects

• Strong troubleshooting and fault-finding skills with a proactive mindset

• Comfortable working across electrical, mechanical, and automation disciplines

• Reliable, adaptable, and willing to go the extra mile to ensure successful project delivery

Our Client offers

• A competitive salary package aligned with experience and responsibilities.

• The opportunity to work with cutting‑edge technology and innovative systems.

• A professional environment with room to grow, develop and influence workflows.

• A supportive, collaborative team culture focused on high technical standards.

• Employment is subject to security clearance, ensuring a stable and trusted work setting

Application

The application process is handled by MARPRO Group. If you have any questions to this position, please contact MARPRO Group at +45 5370 0995.

If you are interested in the position, please upload a motivated application and an updated CV via the application button. You will receive a confirmation email from us. Please check your spam folder, if you have not received the confirmation within 10 minutes after applying, to ensure future communication.

We strongly encourage you to connect with MARPRO Group, to be considered for job openings that are not publicly listed. It is 100% free and confidential to join our talent pool and you can create your personal profile in few minutes.

We are your gateway to Maritime & Shipping talent. Whether you’re a maritime or logistics company seeking exceptional professionals or a skilled individual searching for the next career opportunity, we connect the right talent with the right employers. Our extensive network and industry-specific expertise ensure a seamless recruitment process, making us the preferred choice for Maritime & Shipping staffing solutions.

We have the full and exclusive mandate to all positions listed and all applications have to go via MARPRO Group.

A unique opportunity to shape and lead a newly created global function at the heart of FLS Crushing business. Operating across the Crushing portfolio, this role will ensure seamless transition from commercial handover through to final acceptance and warranty completion, delivering integrated customer solutions that meet contractual commitments on scope, schedule, cost, and quality. As a key member of the Crushing leadership team, the position will establish the processes, capabilities, and governance required to create a repeatable, scalable execution model that drives customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and sustainable profitable growth

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own the Crushing execution value stream from proposal through customer acceptance.

• Deliver profitable, on-time project execution across the global Crushing portfolio.

• Lead proposal development, bid governance, commercial risk management and execution planning.

• Establish world-class execution processes, governance and performance management.

• Drive customer satisfaction through excellence in project delivery and contract fulfilment.

• Ensure supplier readiness, qualification and performance to support sustainable growth.

• Lead and develop a high-performing global execution organisation.

• Partner across Product Line Management, Engineering, Sales and Aftermarket to deliver integrated customer solutions.

• Drive continuous improvement, standardisation and scalable execution excellence.

**What You Bring

**

• Proven leadership of complex proposals, projects or capital equipment deliveries.

• Strong commercial mindset with a focus on profitable execution and customer outcomes.

• Ability to lead cross-functional global teams and drive accountability.

• Experience managing contractual risk, project performance and customer relationships.

• Passion for operational excellence, continuous improvement and scalable growth.

• A customer-first approach, balancing delivery performance with long-term business success.

Location: _Søborg, Denmark. Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

_At AGC Biologics, we are constantly developing our manufacturing capabilities to support the delivery of life-changing biologics to patients worldwide. As our new OT Operations Specialist, you will play an important role in maintaining and improving the Operational Technology landscape that supports our GMP-regulated manufacturing environment.

You will work at the intersection of technology, manufacturing, and quality, ensuring that our systems are reliable, compliant, and ready to support future digitalization initiatives. This role offers the opportunity to work with advanced manufacturing technologies while collaborating with experts across Automation, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and IT.

**A key role in our Operational Technology landscape

**As a OT Operations Specialist, you will help ensure stable and compliant manufacturing systems while supporting continuous improvements across our digital production environment.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

****Operational Technology

**

• Support and maintain OT infrastructure and manufacturing systems in a GMP-regulated production environment.

• Manage OT servers, virtualization platforms, industrial networks, and system integrations.

• Troubleshoot complex OT-related issues across manufacturing environments.

• Collaborate closely with Automation, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and IT teams to ensure reliable operations.

**GMP & Compliance

**

• Ensure OT systems remain compliant with GMP requirements and data integrity principles (ALCOA+).

• Drive and support Change Controls (CRs), Deviations, CAPAs, and Risk Assessments related to OT systems.

• Support audits, inspections, and periodic system reviews.

• Contribute to Computer System Validation (CSV) activities, including IQ/OQ documentation and execution.

**Digitalization & Integration

**

• Support integration between manufacturing systems and business systems.

• Participate in digitalization initiatives involving MES, Historian, SCADA, ERP, and related manufacturing platforms.

• Support industrial communication technologies such as OPC UA, Modbus, and Profinet.

• Drive continuous improvements and identify opportunities for automation and increased operational efficiency.

**Security & Lifecycle Management

**

• Support OT cybersecurity initiatives and contribute to maintaining a secure technology environment.

• Manage system lifecycle activities including upgrades, patching, backup, disaster recovery, and access management.

• Ensure systems remain secure, reliable, and inspection-ready.

**A collaborative environment with room to make an impact

**You will join a team where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement are key parts of how we work. You will work closely with colleagues across different functions and act as a trusted technology partner to Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality Assurance, and IT.

Success in this role means maintaining a stable and compliant OT environment, driving GMP-related improvements, strengthening system integrations, and identifying opportunities where technology can improve our manufacturing processes.

**We Are Looking For Someone Who Brings

**You have a strong interest in combining technology with manufacturing and thrive in an environment where quality, compliance, and reliability are essential.

**We Imagine That You Have

**

• A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Automation, Computer Science, or a similar field.

• 5+ years of experience within OT, Manufacturing IT, Automation, or Life Sciences.

• Strong understanding of GMP-regulated environments.

• Experience managing Change Controls, Deviations, CAPAs, and validation activities.

• Experience working with OT infrastructure, servers, virtualization, and industrial networking.

• Experience working with manufacturing systems such as SCADA, Historian, MES, or similar platforms.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

**It Is An Advantage If You Have Experience With

**

• MES platforms and manufacturing system integrations.

• APIs and data flows between systems.

• Industrial communication protocols such as OPC UA, Modbus, or Profinet.

• OT cybersecurity frameworks and best practices.

• Supporting FDA, EMA, or other regulatory inspections.

**Why join AGC Biologics?

**At AGC Biologics, you will have the opportunity to shape the future OT landscape and digital manufacturing strategy while working in a highly regulated and technologically advanced production environment.

You will collaborate with talented colleagues across a global organization where innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. Your work will directly contribute to ensuring reliable manufacturing processes that help bring important biologic therapies to patients worldwide.

**Join our team

**We are eager to welcome a new colleague as soon as possible. Please submit your application no later than 15 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the vacancy before the deadline if a suitable candidate is found.

If you have any questions about the position, **please contact Jimmy Jespersen, Director of IT, at jimmy.jespersen@agc.com

**Please apply exclusively through our recruitment system. Applications submitted through other channels will not be considered.

To support an inclusive and unbiased recruitment process, please do not include a photo in your CV. At AGC Biologics, we are committed to fair hiring practices and value diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process.

Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

We look forward to receiving your application!

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

Do you also feel energized by super smooth Operations and a beautiful CI/CD setup? Do you eat Kubernetes and Azure for breakfast? And do you thrive in a sometimes-unpredictable environment where you jump in and save the day? Then we believe we have something great to offer.

__We are looking for an experienced Azure, Kubernetes, and CI/CD Engineer to help elevate our SaaS operations and internal deployment processes to the next level.

_**Key About Your Role

**We aim to take Operations to the next level by onboarding more skilled human power (you) and using your expertise to refine and modernize our existing Azure setup. The goal is to make it more elegant, clean, and scalable.

As a central figure in the infrastructure everyone depends on, communication and collaboration will be a natural part of your work. You will provide ad hoc support to colleagues and customer representatives, contributing directly to the stability and growth of our platform.

We work with two layers of deployments:

• Platform deployments: Low frequency (around once per month), planned well in advance

• Customer component deployments: Higher frequency (around once per week), shorter planning horizon

Both typically take place outside normal office hours. For these, you will be compensated with time off from your regular schedule. Deployments usually last about 15 minutes, with occasional on-call backup needed for unforeseen issues (fortunately, rare).

Your work will revolve around three main areas as follows:

****Key responsibilities:

• Environments: Refining and improving the setup of our internal and external environments in a beautiful Kubernetes architecture in Azure

• CI/CD: Configuring, maintaining and continuously improving our entire CI/CD universe

• Operations: Participate actively in operations tasks, maintenance windows, deployments, and incident debugging. Together with the small operations team, ensure our platform runs smoothly 24/7

There is a lot more behind the Platform than a simple list of tools can show. Instead of giving you a long inventory, we would rather have an informal conversation where we can explore the details together.

**Key About Your Team

**Our team, named Obex, is a business unit of Keylane, employing around twenty-five awesome developers, business analysts and a few other professions. Our main product is our Obex Platform, a SaaS solution for financial advisory used by advisors in a variety of pension funds and banks.

We are proud that finances of an estimated two million Danes have been through our software. The Obex Platform is developed in close collaboration with our customers, resulting in a product that users truly appreciate.

In Obex we care for each other. Thriving is top priority. You will feel that atmosphere as soon as you enter.

Our organization is flat, the best argument wins, not the highest title. We do things because they make sense. If something stops making sense, we stop doing it, whether that's a process, a line of code, or a piece of architecture. We aim for the best solutions, not for rigid conformity.

We believe in mutual elasticity: We go the extra mile to support you, each other, and our customers. And we expect the same spirit in return. Together, we share responsibility for keeping the Obex machine running smoothly.

There's much more to tell about our way of working, our culture, and our social side (fun activities and parties included), but let's save that for a chat, either online or over a great cup of coffee.

**Questions?

**If you have any further questions regarding this position, please reach out to the hiring manager Rasmus Amossen via mail to rasmus.amossen@keylane.com.

When you have any general questions about Keylane or want to have a quick chat before applying, just reach out to Talent Acquisition Specialist Thomas Thomsen via mail to thomas.thomsen@keylane.com.

**Requirements

****Experience?

**

• You are fluent in Kubernetes, have solid experience with Azure services, virtual network configuration, and Azure DevOps

• You know your way around log and performance monitoring tools and have a passion for clean, well-architected systems

• You are not content with things merely working, you want them to work beautifully

• Our platform uses .NET on the backend, React with Typescript on the frontend, and Aspire for local development orchestration. Experience with these technologies is a plus.

• There is a lot more behind the Platform than a simple list of tools can show. Instead of giving you a long inventory, we would rather have an informal conversation where we can explore the details together

**Using AI

**

• You are interested in using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Codex as part of the software development lifecycle. For example, to explore solutions, understand unfamiliar code, generate or improve code and tests, refactoring, troubleshoot issues, document solutions and support code reviews;

• You understand that AI-generated code and suggestions must be critically evaluated, tested and reviewed. You take ownership of the quality, security, correctness and maintainability of the code you deliver;

**Other

**Please send your application with CV via our website. Applications are evaluated continuously

A criminal record and reference check are part of the application process. Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply.

**Benefits

**

• A flat and informal organization with a professional and supportive working environment

• A profit share

• Inclusion days where you decide when to hold your public holidays

• Five weeks of vacation and five Keylane days

• A pension scheme where 13.25% is paid by Keylane and the individual contribution is 3%

• Flexibility in the working environment. We offer a combination of working from home and from the office. We value seeing colleagues in person to stay connected and collaborate effectively

• The Danish office is located a 10-minute walk from Islands Brygge Metro station

• We believe that strong employee relations are key to maintaining well-being in the workplace. To support this, we offer a variety of social activities that all employees can participate in, such as yoga, padel tennis, running, outdoor bathing, and fitness in the basement

• Salary: For this role, the Monthly Base Salary ranges from 43.000 - 56.000 (DKK), corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience

**About Apylon And The Opportunity

**Apylon is building agents for the most complex workflow out there - financial admin in healthcare.

Hospitals and payers move billions of euros through fragmented, manual workflows shaped by clinical data, payer rules, contracts, and local coding systems. We believe this is a data, machine-learning, and automation problem disguised as financial operations.

We are live with leading private hospitals and expanding quickly. Every hospital presents a different challenge: EHR systems are configured differently, national coding rules vary, and contracts describe the same clinical event in different terms. Your job is to help us turn that complexity into a system that learns: each new integration should make the next one faster, safer, and less expensive.

Apylon is backed by experienced operators and top-tier investors in healthcare and fintech. Our team draws on experience from Zendesk, Pleo, Wawa Fertility, Sibill, and some of the largest multi-country hospital groups in Europe. You’ll join the first small engineering team, with massive ownership over both what we build and how we build it.

Delivering healthcare is hard. Getting paid for it shouldn’t be.

You’ll be responsible for

• Own EHR integrations end to end: APIs, schemas, undocumented behaviour, operational failure modes, and vendor changes.

• Build reusable integration-platform primitives for extraction, normalisation, versioning, replay, monitoring, and observability.

• Design the canonical data model that connects heterogeneous EHR data, reimbursement systems, national coding standards, and hospital-specific conventions.

• Build reliable inputs for our billing agents, including the constraints, validation, and evaluation systems that make model-assisted decisions safe to use in production.

• Work directly with hospital IT teams and EHR vendors: technical discovery, implementation, joint debugging, and onboarding.

• Take responsibility for the full lifecycle of your work: design, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and iteration from real-world data.

Who you are

• 3+ years building and operating production systems in complex, messy domains. We care more about demonstrated judgment and ownership than an exact number of years.

• Experience using LLMs as production components—not just developer tools. You understand when to use models, when deterministic systems are better, how to constrain outputs, and how to evaluate reliability.

• Strong data-modelling instincts. You know when abstraction creates leverage and when it hides important real-world variation.

• Comfort working from incomplete information. You form hypotheses, test them against data, and distinguish unknowns that can wait from assumptions that could invalidate the system.

• Confidence in customer-facing technical work: discovery calls, debugging sessions, and direct conversations with vendors and hospital IT teams.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.

• A practical, hands-on approach: equally comfortable designing an integration architecture and writing a quick script to answer an urgent question.

This role may be a strong fit if

You enjoy reverse-engineering systems you do not control, finding structure in messy real-world data, and turning one-off discoveries into reusable software. You are comfortable being the engineer in the room with customers and partners.

What this role is not

• Consulting or bespoke delivery work. Each integration must improve the product and reduce the marginal cost of the next.

• A role insulated from customers or operational reality.

• Pure platform engineering or pure integration work: the value comes from doing both.

• A role where incorrect mappings are merely technical defects. In this domain, they can produce incorrect invoices.

Bonus points

• Experience with healthcare interoperability or coding standards, including HL7v2, FHIR, or national messaging and reimbursement standards.

• Experience building and operating third-party integrations at scale.

• Experience in healthcare, fintech, or another regulated environment.

• Experience in an early-stage or fast-growing company.

• Working proficiency in Danish, or German.

Our tech stack

• Python

• Django

• React

• PostgreSQL

• AWS

• K8s

• Terraform

• Bedrock

• We’re pragmatic. You’ll have a big say in how it evolves.

What Apylon offers

• The chance to solve one of Europe’s biggest healthcare inefficiencies.

• Competitive salary + stock options (you’ll own part of what you build).

• 25 days of annual leave + local public holidays.

• Lunch on us during workdays at the office.

• Regular off-sites and social events. We like building together, not just working together.

• Travel within the EU roughly monthly. Onboarding a hospital, working through an integration with a vendor’s engineers, or spending time on-site to understand how the data is actually produced. If travelling to a hospital basement to figure out why an export is malformed sounds like a bad week, this isn’t your role.

Working at Apylon means embarking on a highly ambitious mission to rebuild the financial infrastructure of European healthcare. We’re already live with leading private hospitals, processing thousands of invoices, proving that complex payer rules can be turned into code, powering transparent, automated, and intelligent revenue systems.

How to apply. If you're excited by the challenge of building intelligent, high-impact systems at the core of European healthcare and enjoy shipping fast, we'd love to hear from you.

**Contact The Hiring Manager

**Nicolò Calcavecchia

CTO & Co-founder

nicolo@apylon.co

Are you an experienced tax professional who enjoys combining technical expertise with practical business advice? Would you like to take ownership of corporate tax compliance while working across an international organisation?

We are looking for a Senior Tax Compliance Manager to join our Tax team in Copenhagen.

In this role, you will oversee key corporate tax deliverables and provide hands-on tax support across the business, with a particular focus on corporate tax and its interaction with hydrocarbon tax. You will work closely with Finance, operational teams and our headquarters in Paris, while supporting projects and engaging regularly with the Danish tax authorities.

This is an opportunity to take on a visible and independent role where your expertise will contribute to sound decision-making, strong compliance and effective cooperation across the organisation.

Activities

Your key responsibilities

As Senior Tax Compliance Manager, you will:

• Provide hands-on tax support across a broad range of areas, with a focus on corporate tax and its interaction with hydrocarbon tax.

• Take ownership of corporate tax calculations for tax returns and tax reporting in the annual report.

• Drive ongoing compliance related to Pillar Two, country-by-country reporting and other recurring data submissions.

• Act as a regular point of contact with the Danish tax authorities.

• Handle authority queries and make decisions within the direction set by the Head of Tax.

• Monitor Danish tax legislation and assess the implications of regulatory developments for the company.

• Advise the business on the tax implications of projects and ad hoc matters.

• Connect the business with Finance, Tax and our headquarters in Paris.

• Cooperate with Finance and other teams to support tax compliance across the organisation.

What we offer

At TotalEnergies, we believe that our people are our greatest strength. Joining us means becoming part of a diverse global organization where expertise, innovation, and collaboration drive our success. We offer opportunities to develop your skills, grow your career, and contribute to the energy transition while benefiting from a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package.

Total Rewards Package:

As part of our commitment to fair and transparent remuneration practices, the base salary range for this position is DKK 669.750 - 893.000 annually, reflecting the expected level and scope of the role.

In addition to the base salary, we offer an annual performance based bonus, pension contribution, employee share ownership program participation, wellbeing and insurance benefits, flexible working practices, training and development opportunities.

The final salary offer will be determined based on objective criteria such as qualifications, relevant experience, competencies, role scope, responsibilities, organizational needs, and market alignment.

Candidate Profile

You are a self-starter who works independently, takes responsibility and confidently leads assignments from analysis through to delivery.

jobs.description:
Context & Environment

Do you want to turn cybersecurity requirements into clear governance that people can actually follow? Are you excited by the challenge of protecting both enterprise and industrial environments? Activities

**_Ready to build the AI engine behind the world's largest jewellery brand?

_**As Lead AI Platform Engineer, you will be the technical force behind Pandora's AI platform, shaping how AI systems are built, scaled, and secured across the business. Combining deep hands-on engineering expertise with strong technical leadership, you will drive architectural excellence, elevate engineering standards, and deliver reliable, production-ready AI solutions at scale.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Be To

****Technical Leadership

**

• Serve as the technical lead for the AI platform engineering team — setting the implementation direction, defining coding standards, and making key technical decisions that govern how the platform is built and evolved.

• Lead code reviews and drive architecture discussions, ensuring engineering decisions are well-reasoned, documented, and aligned with the broader platform strategy — championing engineering standards across code quality, testing practices, documentation, observability, and security hardening.

• Act as a technical mentor and go-to resource for all engineers — sharing knowledge, unblocking complex problems, and actively investing in the technical growth of both senior and junior team members.

**Platform Engineering & AI Infrastructure

**

• Design, build, and operate scalable, high-performance services and platform components that expose AI/ML capabilities across Pandora's digital ecosystem.

• Own and define the standards and governance for Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — ensuring all Azure infrastructure is reproducible, auditable, and securely configured.

• Apply strong network architecture knowledge to design and govern secure connectivity between platform services, AI gateways, and external integrations, including VNet, private endpoints, NSGs, and ingress/egress controls, while collaborating with security stakeholders to uphold the platform's overall security posture.

• Leverage Databricks for big data processing, feature engineering, and ML pipeline support.

**AI Services & Agentic Development

**

• Integrate and operationalise AI services including LLM APIs, vector search, RAG pipelines, embeddings, and multi-layer caching into platform-level services.

• Lead the agentic code development practice: architecting autonomous execution loops that enable tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to safely write, test, and self-correct software within isolated sandboxes.

• Own MLflow governance standards for experiment tracking, model versioning, and ML lifecycle management across the team.

• Configure and manage AI gateways to ensure secure, scalable, and governed access to AI capabilities at production scale.

**CI/CD & Reliability

**

• Define and govern the CI/CD standards for the AI platform team — establishing quality gates, testing frameworks, deployment patterns, and pipeline architecture that all engineers build to.

• Ensure performance, availability, and maintainability of platform services in production; handle incidents in a timely manner to minimise Mean Time to Contain (MTTC).

**Job Requirements

****Education & Experience

**

• Relevant background from Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field with experience in backend or platform engineering, with at least 2 years operating in a technical leadership capacity within AI or cloud-native platform teams.

• Proven experience building and operating AI/ML platform services or LLM-based integrations in a production environment.

**Technical Skills

**

• Strong backend engineering fundamentals: service architecture, REST API design, performance optimisation, and production reliability by design and monitoring, with hands-on proficiency in Python.

• Deep Kubernetes expertise — workload configuration, networking, security policy design, and production debugging; hands-on Docker and Azure App Services.

• Expert-level Terraform and IaC ownership — defining standards, patterns, and governance for cloud infrastructure on Azure.

• Strong network architecture and configuration skills, including Azure networking concepts (VNet, NSG, private endpoints, DNS, ingress/egress).

• MLflow governance, Databricks for ML pipeline integration, and experience with ML serving infrastructure, LLM APIs, prompt integration, and multi-layer caching.

• Proficiency in PostgreSQL and experience in configuring AI gateways for centralized AI governance

• Experience in agentic code development practice, harness engineering and spec-driven development is a plus.

**Soft Skills

**Ideally you are a trusted technical leader who combines strong engineering expertise with clear thinking and a collaborative approach to drive sound decisions, communicate complex platform, security, and architecture topics in a business-friendly way, and foster team growth. Brings a proactive and curious mindset, with a passion for emerging AI technologies balanced by a pragmatic focus on execution and delivery.

**About The Team

**You will be part of Pandora's AI Platform team within AI CoE at Digital & Analytics & AI — a passionate, forward-thinking group dedicated to building the infrastructure and services that bring AI to life across the business. The team works at the intersection of data science, machine learning, cloud engineering, and product development, collaborating closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Architects, and Product stakeholders.

You will report to the AI Platform Manager and serve as the senior technical voice that shapes how the platform is designed, secured, and evolved — influencing both what gets built and how it gets built.

**Did we get your attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

_Do you thrive at the intersection of business and technology? Are you motivated by taking architectural accountability for complex business-critical solutions while shaping architecture across a global manufacturing organisation? If so, you could be our new Domain Architect within Manufacturing Architecture, combining responsibility for a local ERP solution with Domain Architecture leadership across Global Manufacturing & Supply (GMS).

_**The Position

**As a Domain Architect, you will have two connected mandates. You will serve as the accountable Solution Architect for the Local Manufacturing Tehran (LMT) ERP solution, supporting both the affiliate and manufacturing operations throughout the solution lifecycle. At the same time, you will provide Domain Architecture leadership across GMS by shaping target architecture and architectural guardrails, leading solution reviews and architecture forums, and helping ensure technology decisions support our manufacturing strategy and Enterprise IT direction.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Take accountable Solution Architecture responsibility for the LMT ERP solution throughout its lifecycle, from design and implementation through maintenance and operations, translating business strategies and requirements into scalable architecture and solution designs

• Act as the primary architectural counterpart for the ERP vendor, challenging recommendations where needed and ensuring solutions remain maintainable, compliant and aligned with Novo Nordisk architecture, while ensuring strong collaboration between business stakeholders and external partners

• Shape and evolve target architecture, architecture principles and guardrails for relevant GMS domains

• Lead architecture governance across GMS through solution reviews, architecture forums and architectural decision-making, ensuring risks, deviations and cross-domain dependencies are identified and followed through

• Communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and build alignment across functions

**Qualifications

**To succeed in this role, we imagine that you have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field

• Extensive experience within Solution Architecture, Domain Architecture, Enterprise Architecture or a related discipline, including architectural accountability for complex enterprise applications or platforms

• Experience working with ERP or similarly complex business-critical enterprise applications and business processes

• Demonstrated ability to influence architecture decisions across multiple functions, stakeholders and technology domains without direct line authority and proven ability to collaborate with vendors and cross-functional teams

• Experience with architecture governance, target architecture, design/solution reviews, architectural standards or similar practices is strongly preferred

• Experience working in regulated environments, preferably within pharmaceuticals, manufacturing or life sciences

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities

**About The Department

**You will join Manufacturing Architecture, the GMS IT team responsible for shaping target architecture, architecture governance and architectural direction across Global Manufacturing & Supply. Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise.

We're hiring a hands-on engineer to build and own production systems across our full stack. You'll ship real features and platform components, hold your work and your team's work to a high quality bar, and grow your technical scope over time.

How we build has changed. You'll spend less time typing syntax and more time specifying intent, directing AI coding agents, and reviewing what they produce.

You own the correctness of everything you ship, whoever or whatever wrote the first draft.

We hire at two levels, Software Engineer and Senior Software Engineer. The level is set during the process based on your experience and the scope you've owned.

YOUR TASKS:

Build, with AI as a core tool

• Implement features and platform components end-to-end, from design through production.

• Specify, generate, review, and validate AI-generated code with the same rigor as your own.

• Write tests, refactor, and improve the codebase as you go.

• Prototype approaches in real code before committing to them.

Raise the bar on quality

• Write maintainable, well-tested, production-grade code.

• Give thoughtful code reviews, with extra scrutiny on AI-assisted changes.

• Contribute to observability, reliability, security, and CI/CD practices in your team.

• Share what works (and what doesn't) with AI-assisted development.

Design and decide

• Design services, APIs, and components within your team's domain.

• Make pragmatic trade-offs between delivery speed and long-term health, and explain your reasoning.

Understand the product

• Connect your work to product outcomes and customer impact.

• Give technical input on scope and prioritization instead of just taking tickets.

• Work with product and design to keep our data handling compliant and transparent.

What we’re looking for

• 5+ years of professional experience shipping production software.

• A track record of owning a system or domain end to end.

• Evidence that you’ve raised a team’s engineering standards through mentoring and technical influence.

• Strong proficiency in modern full-stack development, for example TypeScript/Node.js, .NET and React.

• Deep hands-on experience with AI coding tools, and the judgment to review and stand behind their output.

• Solid grasp of API design, distributed systems and cloud-native architecture.

• Experience running services in production on a major cloud provider. Containers and Kubernetes are a plus.

• The ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes and reason about cost and value.

• Pragmatic judgment and comfort with ambiguity.

Nice to have

• Experience in privacy, consent management or another regulated-data domain.

• Experience introducing or scaling AI-assisted development practices in a team.

How we work: AI-native by default

Usercentrics is pushing AI adoption across engineering, and we expect you to work this way from day one. You’ll direct AI coding agents and hold their output to the same bar as human-written code.

- Flexible working hours

- Hybrid working, up to 3 remote days per week, plus workcation (work from abroad) per policy

Well-being support: free Headspace subscription, remote meditation and yoga sessions

- Employee referral bonus - Welcome pack of branded Usercentrics merchandise at onboarding

- Yearly work-anniversary rewards

Account Manager till Sverige

Bli en del av Grow365.io i Aarhus

Grow365.io är ett snabbt växande mjukvaruföretag som hjälper B2B-företag att få nya kunder och öppna nya marknader genom vår AI- och automationssoftware. Vi arbetar redan med kunder som Jyllands-Posten, Kingspan, JKS och många fler — och nu söker vi en ambitiös Account Manager som vill vara med och stärka vår satsning på den svenska marknaden.

Som Account Manager får du ansvar för den svenska marknaden och blir en del av ett ungt, energiskt team i Aarhus, där försäljning, rådgivning och hög prestation går hand i hand.

Om tjänsten

I rollen som Account Manager får du ansvar för hela säljprocessen — från första kontakt till att avtalet är på plats. Du kommer både att boka möten, hålla kundmöten online och rådgiva potentiella kunder om hur Grow365.io kan skapa tillväxt i deras verksamhet.

Du får en varierad arbetsdag där du arbetar med:

• 
Uppsökande försäljning via telefon, e-post, LinkedIn och Grow365.io

• 
Mötesbokning och kundmöten online

• 
Behovsanalys och rådgivning

• 
Uppföljning och closing

• 
Löpande sparring med ledningen och teamet

Vi erbjuder

Hos Grow365.io får du möjlighet att bygga en stark säljkarriär i ett företag med höga ambitioner och stor tillväxtpotential. Vi erbjuder bland annat:

• 
Attraktiv provisionsmodell kombinerad med fast grundlön

• 
Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter — både professionellt och personligt

• 
En spännande roll i ett tillväxtorienterat företag

• 
Professionell utrustning och grundlig onboarding

• 
En stark arbetsmiljö med högt humör och högt tempo

• 
Lön utan tak

• 
Sociala och professionella aktiviteter under året

Vem är du?

Vi föreställer oss att du är en person med energi, driv och vilja att skapa resultat. Du trivs med kundkontakt, är bra på att bygga relationer och motiveras av att arbeta målinriktat mot tydliga mål.

Vi lägger särskild vikt vid att du:

• 
Är stark i dialog via telefon och snabbt kan skapa förtroende

• 
Arbetar självständigt och strukturerat

• 
Inte är rädd för att ringa många samtal

• 
Motiveras av resultat och performance

• 
Är ansvarsfull och tar ägarskap

• 
Talar och skriver flytande svenska

Det är en fördel om du har erfarenhet av försäljning, men det är inget krav. Det viktigaste är din inställning, ditt driv och din vilja att utvecklas.

Praktisk information

Tjänsten har sin bas i Aarhus.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta försäljningsdirektör Mads Thomsen på tel. +45 50 42 04 78. Ansökan skickas till mads@grow365.io.
