The Company

˚MEQU is a Danish MedTech company behind the ˚M Warmer System, an innovative medical device that enables healthcare professionals to deliver warm blood and IV-fluids from the point of injury to the hospital. With customers across military, tactical, emergency, HEMS, and hospital environments worldwide, our ambition is to become the global leader in blood and IV-fluid warming solutions for pre-hospital and through hospital care. Learn more about ˚MEQU: www.mequ.dk

On behalf of ˚MEQU, Best Talent is recruiting an International Product Manager.

The Team

You will join a small, ambitious Marketing team with ambitious plans and great impact on the future growth of the company. Success is driven by close collaboration across Marketing, R&D, QA/RA, Operations, and Commercial functions in a fast moving and highly cross-functional environment.

International Product Manager

Drive global product strategy for an innovative Danish MedTech company

• Shape life-saving MedTech solutions through your clinical expertise

• Collaborate with leading healthcare providers, emergency services, and military organizations

• Play a key role in the international growth of a fast-scaling Danish MedTech company with a meaningful and global purpose

The Role

We are looking for an International Product Manager who can bridge clinical insights, users’ needs, regulatory requirements, and technical development to drive successful global product strategies and commercial execution.

You will own the global product lifecycle across emergency, tactical, and hospital segments. With the United States representing ˚MEQU’s most important growth market, you will play a key role in ensuring that product positioning, roadmap priorities, and value propositions algin with the clinical, regulatory, and commercial requirements of US military, EMS, HEMS, and hospital customers.

Working across the organization, you will ensure that user insights, market needs, engineering priorities and regulatory considerations are translated into clear product direction and commercially viable solutions.

As the internal subject-matter expert within pre-hospital blood and IV transfusion, you will convert clinical challenges into prioritized product requirements that guide product development and long-term portfolio decisions. The position reports directly to the COO and requires approximately 30-50 travel days annually.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Shaping global product positioning, value propositions, and market prioritization to support successful international expansion, and continuously monitor:

• Developments in clinical standards of care.

• Tactical and military medical protocols.

• Global procurement and reimbursement structures.

• Competitive and technological developments.

• International market dynamics and commercial opportunities.

• Develop instructions for use, training materials, user guides, and educational content to support sales teams, distributors, and clinical specialists globally.

Your professional background:

You bring a clinical background within emergency medicine, pre-hospital care, HEMS, military medicine, or tactical care, combined with hands-on experience with blood and IV transfusion in critical settings. You understand the realities and challenges faced by end users in high-pressure environments.

In addition, you have commercial insight into the MedTech industry and experience supporting product positioning, launches, and international market development. Experience working with institutional customers medical device markets and understand how to position, launch, and scale products internationally. Experience with institutional and public procurement structures is highly valued.

You understand medical device development and the regulatory environment and are able to translate complex clinical needs into structured product requirements that create both customers value and commercial impact.

Your personality – You are:

• A strong communicator with who bridges clinical technical, regulatory, and commercial perspectives.

• Commercially minded with a strategic and customer-centric approach

• Structured and analytical, with the ability to balance long-term strategy and operational execution

• Proactive, self-driven, and comfortable taking ownership in a dynamic scale-up environment

• Curious, collaborative, and motivated by improving patient outcomes through innovation

˚MEQU offers you:

You will gain international exposure across tactical, emergency, and hospital markets and collaborate closely with global distributors, armed forces, and leading healthcare institutions.

• A high-impact position with global strategic product influence

• A dynamic, international, and collaborative work environment

• A diverse team of 30+ colleagues headquartered in Copenhagen

• A mission-driven culture focused on improving patient outcomes

• Competitive salary with a pension scheme and up-to-date benefits

Application:

Please send your application in English, marked ”1947/International Product Manager” to job@besttalent.dk. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Learn more about Best Talent at www.besttalent.dk.

JYSK is strengthening its use of AI to support data-driven decision making, operational efficiency and innovation across the organization. We are now looking for an AI Delivery Lead to join our AI department at the JYSK Head Office.

As AI Delivery Lead, you are responsible for how AI initiatives are delivered – ensuring flow, execution and predictable delivery from idea to production. You work in close collaboration with the AI Product Owner, who owns the what and why, while you own the how and delivery.

In this hybrid role, you will balance driving day-to-day team execution with hands-on contribution to governance strategy.

You will work directly with cross-functional teams - data scientists, AI engineers, data engineers, platform engineers, AI enablement specialists, IT teams, and business stakeholders to ensure AI solutions are built, deployed, and adopted with high quality and speed.

You will also direct ownership of key governance tasks, guiding teams toward AI maturity, leading AI and Agent Governance assessments, and navigating compliance requirements for the EU AI Act.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You will be responsible for making AI initiatives happen in practice, collaborating closely with teams across JYSK to drive both delivery execution and AI governance maturity.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A hands-on delivery role with clear ownership of how AI solutions are delivered

• Direct impact on shaping JYSK's AI governance, Agent Governance, and EU AI Act compliance roadmap

• Close collaboration with an AI Product Owner and skilled technical specialists

• An international working environment with focus on execution and outcomes

• Opportunities for professional and personal development

• Freedom with responsibility in a values-driven organization

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As AI Delivery Lead, you take operational ownership of AI deliveries and drive AI governance initiatives to ensure responsible and compliant deployment. Your key responsibilities include:

• Owning the end-to-end delivery of AI initiatives from planning to production

• Driving execution based on priorities set by the AI Product Owner

• Driving and facilitating planning and delivery activities (such as planning, refinement, daily stand-up, retrospective, demos, etc.)  to ensure steady flow and progress

• Coordinating work across the AI team, IT teams and business stakeholders

• Actively removing impediments and managing dependencies across initiatives

• Following development, progress closely and ensuring timely deployments and handovers

• Ensuring transparency on progress, risks and delivery status

• Supporting good delivery practices

• Leading compliance and maturity activities in AI Governance and Agent Governance

• Conducting AI assessments to ensure solutions align with governance frameworks

• Supporting and guiding teams toward full compliance with the EU AI Act

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a pragmatic and delivery-focused profile who thrives in execution and close collaboration. You enjoy being close to the work, driving team flow, and taking direct responsibility for AI governance and compliance. You likely bring:

• Hands-on experience delivering solutions within AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, data products and similar

• Experience from roles such as Delivery Lead, Scrum Master, Project Manager or similar

• Solid understanding of agile principles and cross-functional teamwork

• Knowledge of AI governance, Agent Governance, or compliance frameworks such as the EU AI Act

• Practical experience with AI assessments or quality assurance in data/AI initiatives

• Ability to collaborate closely with a Product Owner while maintaining clear role boundaries

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• A structured, proactive and solution-oriented mindset

• Experience with JIRA or similar is considered an advantage, but not a must

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Head of AI, Karan Honavar at +45 2812 8374.

jobs.occupation: Drive Technical Excellence, Lead with Confidence, and Make an Impact as Team Lead for our Hardware Automation team
jobs.description:
Are you a technically strong and decisive leader who sets high standards, takes ownership, and drives results?
At Gram Equipment, we are looking for a Team Lead – Hardware, Automation who combines solid electrical engineering expertise with a strong leadership presence and the determination to make things happen.

We are looking for someone who is confident in their technical decisions, comfortable taking responsibility, and motivated by delivering high-quality results. Someone who brings structure, challenges the status quo when needed, and has the courage to set clear expectations and follow through.

In this role, you will lead our Hardware Team within the Automation department, ensuring that we deliver safe, reliable, and production-ready electrical hardware solutions.

This is a hands-on leadership position where you will combine technical expertise with team leadership. Approximately 80% of your time will be dedicated to technical and operational activities, while 20% will focus on leadership, planning, and employee development.
Your role – technical excellence meets strong leadership
As our new Team Lead, you will take responsibility for the daily coordination, technical quality, and performance of a team of six skilled employees in Denmark and one in Turkey.

You will be expected to provide clear direction, establish priorities, and ensure that decisions are translated into action. At the same time, you will remain actively involved in engineering activities, contributing your own technical expertise to complex challenges and important projects.

An important part of your role will be to drive standardization, increase automation of engineering processes, and identify opportunities for cost optimization, helping us create more efficient, scalable, and competitive hardware solutions.

You will work closely with colleagues across Automation, Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, and Production, where your ability to communicate clearly, challenge constructively, and stand firm on technical quality and safety will be essential.

You will report to the Global Head of Automation and play an important role in strengthening the performance and capabilities of our Global Engineering & Automation organization.
Your key responsibilities
• Lead with clarity and accountability: Set clear expectations, establish priorities, make decisions, and ensure that commitments are followed through.
• Drive technical execution: Take an active role in electrical design, panel engineering, component selection, BOM development, and technical problem-solving.
• Ensure high technical standards: Review and challenge electrical solutions, maintain compliance with safety requirements, and ensure consistent engineering quality and documentation.
• Drive standardization and engineering automation: Develop and implement standardized electrical designs, components, and documentation practices. Promote automated generation of electrical drawings to reduce manual engineering effort, improve consistency, and increase efficiency.
• Focus on cost optimization: Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities through smarter design solutions, component standardization, efficient engineering processes, and close collaboration with Procurement and Production, without compromising safety, quality, or reliability.
• Take ownership of planning and delivery: Allocate resources, monitor capacity and progress, address obstacles, and proactively manage delivery risks.
• Make sound technical decisions: Evaluate complex engineering challenges, balance quality, cost, safety, and delivery requirements, and make well-founded decisions, even under pressure.
• Develop and challenge your team: Provide constructive feedback, coach employees, encourage accountability, and support the development of technical competencies.
• Strengthen cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and panel builders to resolve issues and ensure effective project execution.
• Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve standards, processes, tools, and working methods, and take the initiative to turn improvements into measurable results.What we are looking for
We are looking for an experienced electrical engineering professional with a strong technical foundation and a natural ability to take the lead.

You enjoy responsibility, have a structured and analytical approach, and are comfortable making decisions and standing behind them.

Ideally, you bring:

• A relevant technical or engineering background within electrical engineering, automation, or a related field.
• Solid experience with electrical design and panel engineering for industrial machinery.
• Strong knowledge of electrical safety, technical standards, and regulatory requirements, including CE and DS/EN/IEC 60204-1.
• Experience with electrical components, BOM structures, technical documentation, and engineering standards.
• A strong understanding of standardization and an interest in automated engineering processes, including automated generation of electrical drawings.
• A commercial mindset with the ability to identify cost optimization opportunities while maintaining technical quality and compliance.
• The ability to analyze complex technical challenges and make clear, well-founded decisions.
• Experience coordinating technical work, managing priorities, and ensuring delivery against commitments.
• Previous experience in technical leadership, team coordination, or people management, or demonstrated leadership potential combined with a strong desire to take responsibility.Your personality makes the difference
For this position, your personal drive and leadership approach are just as important as your technical qualifications.

We are looking for someone who brings a strong personality, clear direction, and high professional standards to the team.

You are likely to recognize yourself in the following:

• Decisive and confident: You are comfortable taking the lead, making decisions, and addressing challenges directly rather than waiting for others to act.
• Analytical and detail-oriented: You approach technical challenges systematically, question assumptions, and base your decisions on facts and sound engineering judgment.
• Results-driven and accountable: You set ambitious but realistic expectations, take ownership, and follow through to ensure that objectives are achieved.
• Structured and quality-conscious: You value precision, consistency, and well-defined processes and are unwilling to compromise on safety or critical quality requirements.
• Assertive and constructive: You are willing to challenge ideas, address difficult issues, and stand by your professional assessments while respecting different perspectives.
• Demanding but supportive: You set high standards for yourself and others, provide clear feedback, and help your team develop the skills and confidence to succeed.
• Proactive and improvement-oriented: You identify opportunities, challenge inefficient ways of working, and drive improvements that increase efficiency, standardization, and cost competitiveness.
You have the confidence to lead experienced technical specialists, the credibility to earn their respect, and the ability to create an environment where clear expectations, professional discussions, and shared accountability lead to strong results.
What you can expect from us
At Gram Equipment, you will have the opportunity to combine your technical expertise with leadership responsibility in an engineering environment where quality, reliability, and continuous improvement are essential.

You can look forward to:

• A challenging and varied role combining hands-on engineering with people leadership.
• Responsibility for a team of skilled technical specialists.
• The opportunity to influence technical decisions, engineering standards, and ways of working.
• The opportunity to drive standardization, engineering automation, and cost optimization initiatives.
• Close collaboration across engineering disciplines and other business functions.
• The opportunity to make a visible impact on team performance, technical quality, and project delivery.
• A working environment that values ownership, professional expertise, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• A flexible working approach, with the position primarily based in Kolding and opportunities for hybrid working.Ready to take ownership and make a difference?
If you are a technically strong engineer who enjoys taking the lead, making decisions, and driving high standards while improving engineering efficiency and cost competitiveness, this could be your next career opportunity.

Join Gram Equipment and take the lead in developing our Hardware Team and delivering high-quality, efficient, and competitive automation solutions.

**Our Purpose

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe, Australia and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**As a Data Engineer for Agentic AI & ML, you will be the architectural bridge between raw data and customer-facing intelligence. You will collaborate deeply with our Data and Platform teams to influence upstream pipelines, ensuring high-fidelity data is ready to power our scheduling and planning software. You will be responsible for extracting, preparing, and optimizing complex datasets to fuel prototyping and production-grade ML solutions. By building custom pipelines for agentic systems, you will enable our users to work faster, better, and better informed, directly enhancing the user experience in Planday through intelligent, autonomous workforce management.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Collaborate with Data and Platform teams to advocate for and influence the design of upstream data pipelines to support AI/ML requirements.

• Extract and transform large-scale datasets from various sources specifically for AI/ML prototyping and model training.

• Design and deploy custom, production-ready data pipelines that power agentic AI workflows and real-time ML inference.

• Implement robust data validation and monitoring for ML-specific features, ensuring data quality and lineage for production models.

**Success looks like

**

• Strong working relationships with the Data and Platform teams that result in AI-ready data infrastructure.

• Reduced time-to-market for AI prototypes through efficient data extraction and preparation workflows.

• High-availability production pipelines supporting live ML models and agentic workflows with minimal data latency.

• Consistent delivery of high-quality, feature-rich datasets that directly improve model performance and agent reliability.

• Proactive identification of data gaps and the successful implementation of new data sources for advanced AI capabilities.

**What You’ll Bring With You

**

• At least 3 years of professional experience in data engineering with a focus on supporting ML/AI systems in production.

• Proficiency in SQL and Python for building complex ETL/ELT pipelines and data manipulation for ML.

• Understanding of MLOps principles, including data versioning and feature store management.

• Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and data orchestration tools relevant to LLM and agentic architectures.

• Proven ability to collaborate across engineering disciplines to influence data architecture at the platform level.

• Familiarity with Snowflake, dbt, Databricks, and modern cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure).

**At Planday, we offer you

**

• Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• Flexible remote work

**Product Portfolio Support Manager, Wound and Tissue Repair Product Management team

**Are you ready to join the Wound and Tissue Repair team making an impact for people living with wounds?

**Make a difference together with us

**Your responsibilities will include:

**Interested?

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Climate Solutions, we are committed to advancing sustainable and energy-efficient solutions that help our customers and communities thrive. As a Global Demand Planner (m/f/d), you will play a key role in ensuring our business has a reliable, data-driven view of future customer demand, enabling informed decisions across the value chain.

You will serve as a critical link between our commercial organization and supply chain teams, transforming data, market insights, and stakeholder input into robust demand forecasts. Your work will directly influence inventory levels, production planning, capacity utilization, and customer satisfaction.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys combining analytical thinking with business understanding. As part of our continued global growth, you will help shape best practices, drive continuous improvement, and create alignment across functions, while leveraging data and technology to make a measurable impact on our customers and business performance.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Own and continuously improve demand forecasts for assigned products, markets, or business areas by combining data analysis with commercial and market insights.

• Lead the monthly demand planning process and drive alignment with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Supply Planning, and other key stakeholders.

• Analyze demand trends, forecast performance, and market developments to identify risks, opportunities, and actions that support better business decisions.

• Translate customer developments, product launches, phase-outs, and other business changes into accurate and actionable demand plans.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience working with Excel, ERP systems, planning tools, business intelligence platforms, or related technologies; knowledge of IBP is an advantage.

• A structured, proactive, and self-driven approach, combined with strong collaboration skills and professional English communication abilities.

jobs.occupation: Service Technology and Automation Lead - Global Service
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded Service Technology and Automation Lead to modernize our global Customer Service setup. You will drive the implementation of service technology, AI and automation to deliver best-in-class customer experience while improving operational efficiency.

Working closely with Global and Local Service teams, you will optimize processes, develop our global service platform and translate business needs into practical solutions. Your focus will be on increasing efficiency, strengthening service quality and making it easier for customers and partners to do business with us.

**Welcome to Global Sales

**You will join Global Sales, Training and Service within Demant’s Hearing Aids business, where we work to improve the lives of people with hearing loss around the world. We deliver product and sales training, commercial excellence and customer service excellence to our sales companies across Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa, as well as to our independent distributors.

You will become part of our newly established Global Service department, consisting of 14 colleagues. Reporting to the Head of Global Service and joining the Global Service leadership team, you will help define and implement service excellence across our global organization.

**Drive Global Service Efficiency and Automation

**Joining us, you will drive the digitalization of Customer Service through standardized processes, modern technology, AI and automation. You will collaborate with local teams to identify opportunities, develop solutions and ensure successful implementation and adoption.

Success requires a good understanding of Customer Service operations and the ability to use technology to improve efficiency without compromising the personal relationships that underpin great service.

In this role, you will:

• Own and develop Salesforce Service Cloud, including its global rollout, functionality, user experience and roadmap.

• Drive platform adoption and performance, using data and insights to help markets maximize value and identify improvements.

• Implement AI and automation solutions to optimize workflows, improve service quality and increase operational efficiency.

• Define global service standards and guide markets in optimizing technologies such as IVR, workforce management and knowledge repositories.

• Develop customer and partner integrations for larger customers, maintaining the integration roadmap with Global IT.

• Drive stakeholder engagement and implementation, building alignment and momentum across global and local teams.

You can expect approximately 10–20 travel days per year to support our markets and understand local service operations.

**What You Bring

**You hold a relevant commercial master’s degree and ideally have around five years of experience in a similar function, preferably within a larger international organization. You have a track record of improving Customer Service performance and implementing new solutions.

You understand Customer Service at strategic, tactical and operational levels and know how to optimize processes, systems and ways of working. With a good commercial mindset, you recognize how service excellence contributes to customer satisfaction and business performance.

You thrive at the intersection of Customer Service, data, AI and technology. You have experience implementing AI solutions in a business context and translating insights into measurable improvements. Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, Power BI or similar platforms is an advantage.

As a colleague, you are structured, analytical and collaborative. You can lead projects across organizational boundaries, influence and challenge stakeholders at different levels, and balance global standards with local needs. Your excellent communication and presentation skills enable you to build relationships and create engagement across cultures and functions.

**Come and join us

**This is an opportunity to shape the future of Customer Service across Demant’s global Hearing Aids business. You will work with colleagues and stakeholders across international markets to make our service operations more efficient, scalable and customer-focused through technology, AI and automation.

If you enjoy combining commercial insight, technology and collaboration to create tangible business improvements, we would like to hear from you.

Please submit your CV before the application deadline on November 5.

For inquiries regarding the application process, please use the online application form.

To learn more about the position, contact Steen Busk Marner, Head of Global Service, at skma@demant.com.

We are curious to meet you!

**Recruitment Process Information

**We will begin inviting candidates for interviews after the application deadline. First round of interviews are scheduled for the 12, 13, 16, and 17 of November. You can expect the final round of interviews to be held on the 24 and 25 of November.

**Build with us

**Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

**Your impact

**This is your chance to build Mollie's presence in Denmark from the ground up, as the first person hired with this market as your sole focus. You won't be starting from zero: you'll have the Nordic foundation already built in Sweden to work from, but the Danish playbook is yours to write.

You'll open the market, land our first Danish customers, and turn early learnings into a repeatable approach we can scale. It's a broader, more entrepreneurial scope than a standard sales role. You'll work deals from $100K a month while building toward bigger opportunities of up to $1 million a month, all while shaping how Mollie understands and enters this market for the long run.

What makes this role stand out is the mix: outbound selling, customer discovery, partnerships, and competitive analysis, all rolled into one seat with real ownership. If you want to build something rather than maintain something, this is that opportunity.

**What You'll Ship

**

• Run outbound sales and manage the full sales process, including around 20 cold calls a week

• Build a Danish pipeline and land Mollie's first customers in the market

• Gather market feedback and grow larger opportunities, including deals of up to $1 million a month

• Build relationships with Danish agencies and work on partnerships alongside the partner manager based in Stockholm

• Share what you learn about the Danish marketing landscape with the marketing team to help shape events and go-to-market plans

• Run competitive analysis to sharpen how Mollie positions itself in Denmark

**What You'll Bring

**

• Around 5 years of full-cycle sales experience, with a strong outbound track record and demonstrated success in structured cold outreach

• Value selling capability, with a data-driven approach to activity and pipeline management

• Strong negotiation and contract handling skills, including experience communicating and negotiating with C-level stakeholders

• Creativity in building a pipeline through partnerships or marketing outreach (you don't need to have done this before, just show the potential)

• Experience in payments, fintech, or SaaS sales, built across multiple companies

• Comfortable working hands-on in a role with broad scope and real uncertainty

• Fluency in Danish

**Grow your way

**At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

**AI at Mollie

**We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

The Department of Science Education at the University of Copenhagen invites applications for a 2-year postdoctoral position starting 1 March 2027. The postdoc position will be a part of the SPINE project (Strengthening Pathways and Infrastructures for Navigating Interdisciplinary Collaboration in Existing Academic Structures), funded by the Lundbeck Foundation

  We are looking for an engaged and independent researcher to help us develop and test practical ways of strengthening interdisciplinary collaboration in research and education.

  The SPINE project investigates how interdisciplinary collaboration can be better supported within existing academic structures. The project combines qualitative research, international fieldwork, and participatory action research to develop practical “plug-and-play” tools, such as methods, templates, games, and workshop formats, that can be readily used by researchers, educators, and research organisations.

   

  Your role

  As a postdoc in SPINE, you will lead the testing and refinement of tools and methods at SPINE’s test sites, including designing and facilitating intervention workshops with researchers and other stakeholders. You will evaluate and adapt approaches across different contexts and help turn research findings into practical, “plug-and-play” resources for interdisciplinary collaboration.

  The position combines research and reporting on the development and testing activities with qualitative research, but the main emphasis will be on the development, testing, and refinement of practical tools and interventions.

   

  You will also contribute to:

   	
• Conducting qualitative research and fieldwork 	
• Analysing and evaluating empirical material and interventions 	
• Working with project partners and stakeholders 	
• Disseminating findings through academic and practice-oriented outputs 	
• Teaching at the Department of Science Education   The position is based in Denmark, where most work will take place. Some international travel will be required for fieldwork, test-site visits, and collaboration with project partners.

   

  Who we are looking for

  We are looking for a researcher interested in how interdisciplinary collaboration works in practice, with the ability to move between research, facilitation, and development.

   

  You should have:

   	
• The ability to work independently while contributing actively to a collaborative team 	
• Strong written and oral communication skills 	
• Willingness and ability to travel internationally when required    

  We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in one or more of the following:

   	
• Interdisciplinary higher education research 	
• Participatory action research or co-design 	
• Workshop facilitation and stakeholder engagement 	
• Developing or evaluating practical approaches to research and collaboration 	
• Translating research into practical or policy-relevant outputs 	
• Spoken or written Danish, which is an advantage but not a requirement   We welcome candidates from different disciplinary and methodological backgrounds and do not expect applicants to meet every criterion.

   

  What we offer

  You will join an international and collaborative research environment in central Copenhagen and become part of a project with a strong focus on research that makes a practical difference.

  The SPINE project is led by Associate Professor Katrine Ellemose Lindvig at the Section for Higher Education Research and Development, Department of Science Education, University of Copenhagen. The SPINE team consists of the PI, one postdoc, and one PhD student, and works closely with colleagues in a wider research group on Interdisciplinary Higher Education, which includes an additional PhD student. As postdoc, you will work closely together with the researchers in SPINE and this wider group, while also collaborating with external partners and stakeholders.

   

  Application

  Start date: 1 March 2027
 Application deadline: 1 November 2026, 23:59 CET
  

  Please submit a single application of no more than 2 pages, combining:

   	
• Your motivation and qualifications for the position, including your relevant research, methodological, and facilitation experience. 	
• Your ideas for contributing to SPINE, including how you would approach testing and refining tools and methods, designing intervention workshops, and developing practical “plug-and-play” resources.    

  In addition, please include:

   	
• CV, including research, fieldwork, teaching, and project experience 	
• One publication that best demonstrates your research capabilities and fit with the position 	
• Publication list 	
• Diplomas and transcripts 	
• Contact details for two references   Applications must be submitted in English through the University of Copenhagen's online recruitment system.

  Before applying, prospective applicants are welcome to contact Associate Professor Katrine Ellemose Lindvig to discuss the position and how their experience might fit the project.
 
 Contact:
 Katrine Ellemose Lindvig
 Email: Katrine.lindvig@ind.ku.dk
  

  The University of Copenhagen is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates.

Do you want to join, and help drive, the growth journey of a leading AI-powered SaaS company in automotive? At Autoflows, you will work side by side with our Head of Norway, Customer Success and the rest of the team to take an established customer base further, win new enterprise deals with some of the world's most iconic automotive brands, their dealers and independent workshop groups, and help shape where we go next in Norway. We are looking for a self-driven, proactive and results-oriented Commercial Manager who is ready to own targets and drive growth. If you want strong personal growth, a powerful network across the automotive and tech industries, and a front-row seat to where AI and SaaS are heading, **this is where your next chapter starts.

_Do you want to join a global fund manager in energy infrastructure investments? If so, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) is currently looking for a Team Assistant to join our Investor Relations & Business Development (IR & BD) team based in Copenhagen.

_**Team

**We are seeking a motivated and organized Team Assistant to support our team members in our Investor Relations & Business Development (IR & BD) team. The IR & BD team at CIP is a global, high-performing unit responsible for all investor interactions and business development activities—from product and fund development to fundraising and client engagement. The team comprises approximately 70 professionals from 15 countries, with backgrounds in investment banking, management consulting, and law.

You will be also a part of a broader Executive Support team, and will report to Heidi Jensen, Sr. Personal Assistant.

**Role

**As a Team Assistant based in CIPs Copenhagen office you will be primarily supporting the EMEA team, within the broader Investor Relations team covering clients across the region. You will play a central role both internally and externally, and you will be the closest go-to person for your team in providing broad administrative support.

**Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for an AIT Quality Engineer to join our AIT Project Quality Management team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, driving, and delivering validation and quality activities within complex Automation and IT projects in the pharmaceutical and life science industry.

You will work as part of multidisciplinary project teams and act as a trusted advisor on validation strategy, GMP compliance, quality risk management, and project quality execution from project initiation through to handover. The role combines hands-on technical validation expertise with project quality management responsibilities, ensuring that deliverables, quality expectations, timelines, and customer requirements are aligned throughout the project lifecycle.

Location Denmark - Kalundborg

Experience Minimum 5 Years

Department AIT Project Quality Management

• Developing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, test protocols, and summary reports.

• Collaborating with customers, suppliers, and project teams throughout FAT, SAT, commissioning, validation, and handover.

• Managing validation risks, deviations, compliance issues, and mitigation actions across projects.

• Comfortable balancing compliance, quality, timelines, and project risks.

• Hands-on experience preparing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, and test protocols.

• Knowledge of GMP, GAMP 5, ISPE guidance, data integrity, quality risk management, and validation lifecycle management.

jobs.occupation: Senior Embedded Software Developer within Real-Time Computer Vision
jobs.description:
Are you a skilled embedded software developer with a passion for cross-platform development for multiple SoC targets? Do you also enjoy turning sophisticated mathematics into high-performing and robust implementations? Do you thrive working with the best of the best in your field in a collaborative setting in the very heart of Copenhagen? If so, we have the opportunity for you!

3Shape is looking for a talented Senior Embedded Software Developer to join our Reconstruction Software Area. As a world leader in this domain, we have driven the field’s evolution for decades and are setting the future standard. This is your opportunity to thrive, learn and contribute to cutting-edge solutions used daily to improve dental health around the world.

You will be joining a collaborative and creative team of over twenty Computer Vision and Software professionals at the absolute forefront. You will team up with great system developers, signal processing experts and mathematicians, many of us with PhDs, forming one of the strongest 3D and computer vision teams in Denmark. Being the leader for decades means our problems yet to be solved and solutions yet to be created are the most challenging and rewarding ones. A challenge we address with collaborative efforts of great minds. In a nutshell, our team turns 2D sensor data into 3D and renders the resulting 3D model. The team has the complete ownership of the area spanning research, signal processing, product development, maintenance, tooling, and test automation. As a member of the Reconstruction Software Area, you will team up with one or more colleagues working on an initiative, which could be a longer-term research project or implementing a product improvement hitting the market near-term. In addition, you will act as a sparring partner on other initiatives and take part in our weekly educational sessions.

About us

At 3Shape we aim to advance dental treatment and diagnostics with advanced software and 3D scanners designed for dental professionals across the globe. Our purpose is to advance innovation in dentistry, continuously enhancing patient care and outcomes.

This role places you at the heart of our technological advancements within Product Creation, namely TRIOS & SCANNER SW, offering the chance to shape the trajectory of our innovative products and software applications.

What You’ll Do

• 
Build real-time 3D computer vision components in C++ and GLSL, targeting both ARM and x86 platforms.

• 
Write, test and benchmark your modules, and take ownership of their performance and accuracy.

• 
Help establish a clean, efficient cross-platform development setup (toolchains, testing, benchmarking and CI) that makes development on every target fast and enjoyable.

• 
Write and optimize demanding shader code for OpenGL and OpenGL ES.

• 
Accelerate CPU algorithms with SIMD (NEON and SSE/AVX), and hand-write intrinsics where the compiler falls short.

• 
Work closely with hardware engineers to get the most out of each target device.

• 
Have fun!

What We’re Looking For

• 
5+ years of professional C++ development on performance-critical applications.

• 
Solid experience with GPU programming in GLSL or a comparable shading language.

• 
Proven experience with streaming and tiling strategies for high performance on devices with limited cache.

• 
A deep understanding of how compiled code maps to the hardware (CPU pipelines, memory access patterns, caching and vectorization) on both ARM and x86.

• 
Experience in computer vision, ideally with registration, filtering and 3D data.

• 
An analytical mindset with attention to performance, scalability and maintainability, and a Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field.

• 
Curiosity, drive and intellect to understand challenging problems in depth.

Nice To Have

• 
Experience with VTK and its rendering pipeline.

• 
Experience with sparse volumetric data structures and signed distance fields (e.g., OpenVDB, voxel hashing).

• 
Cross-compiling with Clang and CMake, and testing ARM targets with QEMU.

• 
Experience with Eigen.

• 
Knowledge of existing libraries that can be used for cross-platform development.

• 
Experience with SLAM or 3D reconstruction.

What 3Shape Offers

• 
Attractive offices and R&D lab spaces in downtown Copenhagen close to Kgs. Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.

• 
Good work/life balance e.g., work from home policy for up to 2 days per week.

• 
An international environment with social, diverse, and highly skilled and collaborative colleagues - we are more than 35 nationalities in our DK based office

• 
An attractive healthcare package to keep you fit and well.

• 
Breakfast every day, and delicious and healthy lunch cooked by our private chefs.

• 
We provide a great social work environment with many optional activities and social clubs, ranging from wine & beer, board games, running to bicycle clubs.

• 
Purpose: Endeavor to improve dental patients on a global scale.

Staying true to our values and D&I efforts, we encourage all relevant applicants to apply, and we ask you NOT to add any photos or sensitive information (age, marital status, nationality) during the application process.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

About us

3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday #lifeat3Shape across the globe on LinkedIn.

jobs.occupation: PhD positions in Algebraic Hardness and Applications (AHA) at IT University of Copenhagen
jobs.description:
The IT University of Copenhagen invites highly motivated individuals to apply for a PhD position starting in September 1, 2027, or soon thereafter. 

We invite applicants who want to contribute to the IT University's vision of creating and sharing knowledge that is profound and leads to ground-breaking information technology and services for the benefit of humanity. 

Job description
To be eligible to apply for these positions, the applicants are expected to have a good background and passionate interest in mathematics and computer science, demonstrated by having credited relevant courses such as Complexity Theory, Advanced Algorithms, Probability Theory, Real and Complex Analysis, Calculus, and Combinatorics. Or they may be demonstrated by results at the Olympiads of Mathematics or Informatics, or by publication in relevant internationally recognised conferences or journals.

Applicants need to be motivated for doctoral studies; should possess the ability to work independently and perform critical analysis; and additionally, have good levels of communicative abilities and English language skills. The working language of the group is English, and knowledge of English is also fully sufficient to navigate every-day research life in general.

General information
The IT University of Copenhagen (ITU) is a teaching and research-based university specializing in information technology (IT) and the opportunities it offers. The IT University has more than 160 full-time Faculty members. Research and teaching in information technology span all academic activities which involve computers including computer science, information and media sciences, humanities and social sciences, business impact and the commercialization of IT.

Research at the IT University of Copenhagen
Our research is organized through dynamic research groups, centers, hubs, and labs that promote collaboration across disciplines. These units explore complex challenges at the intersection of people, technology, and society, contributing both to fundamental insights and practical solutions. At ITU, we see research as a shared endeavor – open, critically engaged, and rooted in dialogue with academic communities, industry, and the public sector. We actively pursue international partnerships and networks, and our interdisciplinary approach ensures that our research not only advances knowledge but also generates impact beyond academia.

Teaching at the IT University of Copenhagen
ITU currently offers four BSc degrees, six MSc degrees and one professional master’s degree, spanning across these disciplines. ITU's educations are extremely sought after and produces qualified graduates who are in high demand from the job market.

Working at the IT University
Located in modern architecture, a 6-minute metro ride from the center of Copenhagen, the IT University offers an informal working environment, a varied everyday life, and a highly motivated, innovative, skilled, and diverse international faculty, with PhD degrees from more than 20 different countries. The IT University is an equal opportunity employer and prides itself in actively pursuing an improved gender balance among students and among faculty.

Working in Copenhagen
Copenhagen has a solid educational system, a rich cultural life, universal healthcare, good childcare, and well-functioning infrastructure. Copenhagen is consistently ranked among the world’s most livable cities according to the Economist Global Liveability Index. Living and working in Copenhagen will typically be a great experience for you and your family.

Salary and terms of employment
Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Taxation’s agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) and job structure for academic staff at universities.

Qualification Requirements
The following qualifications are required:

• 
3-year programme: candidates should have an MSc (or equivalent)

• 
4-year programme: candidates should have a BSc and one year of university studies on Master level

Please read the guidelines for applicants carefully before filling in the application form. You can see the guidelines through this link.

The IT University may use shortlisting in connection to the recruitment process. All applicants are notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The shortlisting of candidates for assessment is based on the criteria in the job posting. 

Further information
Questions about the positions can be directed to Professor Nutan Limaye, IT University of Copenhagen, nuli@itu.dk. Early contact with our faculty staff is encouraged.

At The IT University of Copenhagen, we have an international environment and view diversity as a valuable resource. jobs.description:

**

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

**You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI and analytics, ensuring that they are fit for the digital future. Through co-creation and passionate advisory, we aim to make our clients’ data easy to handle and provide useful insights.

In our collective, you will find people with a combination of nerdiness and infectious energy. We are passionate about technology, but we also have a sincere interest in people.

Join us in this role where you’ll carry out specialised inspections, up-tower repairs, troubleshooting and other technical activities across different wind turbine sites and platforms. You’ll combine strong technical capability with a safety-first mindset, sound judgement and the resilience to work effectively while travelling internationally.

Welcome to Special Tasks & Inspections

You’ll be part of the ST&I Travel Technician team, where you and your colleagues will deliver specialist inspections, repairs, technical campaigns and turbine support across Ørsted’s wind turbine sites. As a team, we work in smaller groups across different regions and placing strong emphasis on safety, quality, teamwork and professional development. The role provides exposure to different turbine technologies and complex technical challenges, with opportunities to contribute field experience to improved tools, methods and ways of working.

You’ll play an important role in:

• Conducting turbine condition assessments, end-of-warranty, component and specialist inspections, producing accurate technical reports.

• Perform advanced diagnostic inspections, including endoscopic and stethoscope assessments.

• Carrying out up-tower repairs and support specialised mechanical and electrical activities, troubleshooting complex faults and identifying practical solutions.

• Working within Ørsted's ISO 17020 accredited inspection framework, ensuring compliance, quality and impartiality standards are maintained.

• Leading technical activities as a technical lead, team lead or client representative, collaborating closely with site teams, project teams, OEMs, contractors and technical specialists.

• Contributing to the development and improvement of tools, RAMS, AWPs, work instructions, testing activities and innovative ways of working.

• Championing a strong safety culture, sharing technical expertise, maintaining required competencies and authorisations, and challenging or stopping work where safe execution cannot be assured.

To succeed in the role, you:

• Hold a relevant technical qualification or equivalent hands-on experience, with strong knowledge of wind turbine technology, ideally gained on SGRE or Vestas platforms.

• Apply strong fault-finding and problem-solving skills to unfamiliar and complex technical challenges, developing safe, practical and professional solutions.

• Work independently, prioritising activities and making sound technical decisions when support is not immediately available on site.

• Adapt quickly to different sites, teams and cultures, building effective relationships and representing Ørsted professionally with internal and external stakeholders.

• Communicate clearly in English, producing accurate, structured technical reports and inspection documentation.

• Demonstrate a collaborative, hands-on approach while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality and professional conduct.

• Be resilient and adaptable, with the ability to undertake extensive international travel and secure the work permits, visas and travel authorisations required for offshore work in the UK, EU, US and Taiwan.

It's an advantage if you also have:

• Experience with endoscopic inspections, turbine condition assessments and component inspections.

• Experience supporting up-tower repairs, major component replacements, technical campaigns and testing activities.

• Relevant OEM authorisations, experience working under Wind Turbine Safety Rules, or within accredited inspection and quality frameworks.

• Strong IT skills, including digital inspection and reporting tools, and additional language capabilities such as German.

The position involves extensive international travel as part of a 14/14 rotation with 12-hour shifts. Assignments may involve unfamiliar sites, teams and working environments. There will also be situations where you are expected to work independently while abroad, while remaining connected to the wider ST&I team. Due to the international nature of the role, candidates must be able to obtain and maintain the necessary work permits, visas and travel documentation required for assignments across the UK, EU, US and Taiwan.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

jobs.occupation: Two-year postdoc in developing inventory of agricultural nitrous oxide emissions
jobs.description:
The Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University, Denmark, welcomes applications for a postdoctoral researcher position in developing a Tier 3 model-based national inventory of N₂O emissions modelling from cultivation of soils. The position is part of the SmartField project, which is a cross-organizational research project aimed at obtaining knowledge about N₂O emissions from agricultural fields and solutions for mitigation strategies. Additionally, SmartField will develop and deliver an improved methodology for accounting N₂O emissions at farm and national scale.

Expected start date and duration of employment
The position is to be filled by February 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter and is a two-year fixed-term position.

Job description
You will be part of a research environment addressing greenhouse gas emissions and sustainability transition of agricultural systems, with a particular focus on nitrous oxide emissions from agricultural soil aiming to scale emission estimates from the field to the national scale. Your role will primarily involve supporting the development and implementation of a model-based approach for the national of N₂O emissions from diverse agricultural soils, as well as developing the data pipeline. This will include creating and updating spatio-temporal datasets on soils, cropping systems, and field management, and calculating and assessing and comparing the resulting inventories to other approaches. Scenarios will be used to explore how mitigation technologies and management measures could reduce N₂O emissions and to assess the suitability of the proposed Tier 3 modelling framework for Denmark's national N₂O emission inventory. Your work will support a Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) system, enabling transparent, robust and science-based reporting of mitigation progress regarding agricultural field N₂O emission. You will work in close collaboration with colleagues developing and testing process-oriented models, as well as with those responsible for the national greenhouse gas inventory.

Your profile
We are searching for a highly motivated candidate who has:

• A PhD in agronomy, soil science, data science, environmental sciences, engineering, agroecology, biology, or a related field.
• Experience working with models, managing and analyzing large datasets. 
• Experience working with models related to nitrogen/carbon turnover in soil is considered an advantage but is not required.
• Documented experience in scientific writing and publishing in peer-reviewed scientific journals.
• The ability to communicate effectively in English (both written and oral).
• Good collaboration skills and ability to take responsibility to work independently and proactively on the project
Who we are
The position is shared between the Department of Environmental Science and the Department of Agroecology under the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University, and it will be hosted by the Land-CRAFT Center at the AU campus in Aarhus.

The Department of Environmental Science is an interdisciplinary department with expertise ranging from physics, chemistry, microbiology, engineering, social science, geography, economics, to policy analysis. Basic as well as applied research are conducted on some of the major challenges facing society, such as pollution and pollution control mechanisms, management of land, soil, water, air and biodiversity, protection of ecosystem services, and climate change. Advisory services within these areas are offered to governmental organizations, non-governmental organizations and companies. The department consists of five sections and currently about 160 staff (including postdocs and Ph.D. students). 

The Department of Agroecology contributes to sustainable solutions to some of the world’s biggest problems within the areas of soil, plants, animals, humans, and the environment. We want to make a difference by contributing to both fundamental knowledge generation and the attainment of sustainable production systems via innovative research, contracted policy advice, and education. We offer professional laboratories, greenhouses, semi-field, and field-scale research facilities, advanced computing capacities as well as an extensive national and international researcher network. The department consists of nine research sections with around 400 highly skilled employees.

This position is hosted by Land-CRAFT - the Center for Landscape Research in Sustainable Agricultural Future, which aims to bring transformational solutions to agricultural systems. Land-CRAFT is a section within the Department of Agroecology. Therefore, there is a strong focus on climate change mitigation and adaptation strategies.

Both departments believe in equality, diversity, inclusion, and creating an attractive work/life balance.

What we offer 
• A collaborative, international research environment that combines high academic standards with an informal and supportive atmosphere. We value accountability, curiosity, flexibility, and teamwork in everything we do.
• An inclusive and respectful workplace culture, where mutual trust, kindness, and professional dialogue are part of daily life. We encourage open communication and develop a cohesive sense of community across teams and disciplines.
• A flexible working environment that supports work-life balance and individual needs.
• An active institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion – in recruitment, career development, and everyday interactions.
• An innovative and meaningful workplace where your work contributes to solving real-world challenges. No two days are alike, and we welcome creative thinking and new ideas.
• Support for international researchers and their families, including Relocation Service and an Expat Partner Programme.
Place of work and area of employment 
The place of work is Aarhus University (LandCRAFT Center), Ole Worms Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C. The affiliation will be with the Department of Environmental Science. However, it should also be expected that there will be work-related and meeting activities at the Department of Environmental Science which is located at Risø in Roskilde.

Contact information
Further information may be obtained by contacting Head of Section Emissions and Atmospheric Modelling, Professor Peter L. Langen (plangen@envs.au.dk +4520618369), Professor Jørgen E. Olesen (jeo@agro.au.dk +4540821659), or Special consultant related to the national emission inventory Mette Hjorth Mikkelsen (mhm@envs.au.dk +4587158579). 

Deadline
All applications must be received no later than November 27, 2026. 

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self. 

Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager (12 months parental leave cover) - Wound and Tissue Repair Product Management team

Senior Product Management, Silicone Foams Portfolio

Are you ready to join the Wound and Tissue Repair team making an impact for people living with wounds?

Make a difference together with us

Join us as a key driver of growth within our Wound and Tissue Repair business area, guiding the process from product strategy development to successful product launches.

Join a dynamic and passionate team

You will join an international Product Management team of highly dedicated colleagues, and you will lead the silicone foams portfolio. Based in Humlebæk, we are part of the Product Strategy and Development team. Together, we set the strategic direction, drive global product launches, maximise the potential of the existing WTR portfolio and ensure continuous product support through high levels of interaction across the organization and our sales regions.

“Our key portfolio, silicone foams is one of the biggest growth drivers and we are looking for an experienced Product Manager to lead this portfolio going forward. You will be part of a highly ambitious team where we work closely together, share ideas and help each other whenever needed. Doing so, we reach our goals and deadlines whilst having fun on the way” explains Nayla Ayoub, Head of Product Management.

Balance Strategic Thinking with Execution Details

As the Product Manager for the silicone foams portfolio, you will be the product champion responsible for a portfolio that spans multiple countries and generates a significant portion of our revenue and growth. You will own the global commercial agenda for your product portfolio, ensuring a clear strategic direction and ambitious goals, while proactively identifying initiatives to maximize the value of your business.

When launching products in new markets, you will serve as the commercial lead, setting the strategic direction and coordinating with relevant teams to ensure successful launches.

This role will require travel of approximately 20-30 days per year to collaborate with colleagues in local markets as well as customers.

Experience in Product Management

We are looking for a candidate who excels at prioritization and knows how to seek out vital information—whether it's understanding your portfolio or analyzing competition and market dynamics. You are a true team player, capable of working through challenges with the right stakeholders, while being sensitive to different cultures.

Furthermore, we imagine that you have

•    5+ years of product management preferably in the MedTech industry.

•    A master’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field.

•    A proven track record in the development and execution of global and/or local marketing initiatives, with a history of successful product launches.

•    It is important that you are structured and possess a strong analytical mindset

•    Excellent communication skills in English.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with a diverse range of national and international stakeholders, and manage a wide variety of processes at any given time. A pragmatic mindset, along with both strategic and operational focus, is essential. We also seek a creative thinker who can challenge conventional approaches and contribute innovative ideas.

Interested?

If this sounds like a fit, we would love to hear from you. If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Nayla Ayoub, Head of Product Management- Wound and Tissue Repair, at dknaay@coloplast.com . We will take candidates into the recruitment process continuously, so do not hesitate to apply. This position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.
