jobs.occupation: Test Method Specialist, Quality Assurance Lifecycle Laboratory
jobs.description:
_**Imagine if robust test methods and reliable test equipment helped ensure the quality of both new and existing Coloplast products. That is where you come in.

**_As our new Test Method Specialist, you will become the technical focal point for selected test methods and related equipment in Coloplast Mørdrup, primarily supporting the QA Lifecycle Laboratory and Pilot SVS. This is a practical, hands-on specialist role in which you will work directly with laboratory equipment, including troubleshooting, service and calibration follow-up, qualification, and software and computer upgrades. You will support the full test method and equipment lifecycle, from implementation and qualification to maintenance, transfer and continuous improvement.

If you are motivated by hands-on technical problem-solving, equipment responsibility, quality assurance and data evaluation, this role offers meaningful responsibility and broad organisational impact. You will also work closely with many internal and external stakeholders, making clear communication, coordination and strong stakeholder management an important part of your success.

_“In this role, your technical judgement and ability to create robust solutions will help ensure reliable test results and compliant laboratory processes throughout the product lifecycle,” says Lotte Stoklund, Team Manager, QA Lifecycle Laboratory.

_**Join a skilled and collaborative laboratory team

**At our Coloplast Mørdrup site, you will join the Quality Assurance Lifecycle Laboratory. The team consists of laboratory technicians and test method specialists who work closely together to support ongoing production, process development, quality investigations and test method activities.

You will be part of an engaged team with a strong mix of practical laboratory experience and specialist knowledge. In our daily work, we collaborate closely with colleagues across Quality Assurance, Research and Development, Operations, Global Test Method teams and international manufacturing sites. We value curiosity, knowledge sharing, flexibility and a continuous improvement mindset.

**Own and develop test methods and equipment

**As Test Method Specialist, you will act as a one-point contact and technical superuser for selected test methods and test equipment. A significant part of the role is practical equipment responsibility. You will work hands-on with equipment and coordinate activities to ensure it is qualified, calibrated, serviced, maintained and performing as intended. You will also support software and computer upgrades connected to the equipment, as well as reliable data handling and traceability.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Acting as technical owner and one-point contact for selected test methods and related test equipment

• Planning, coordinating and performing qualification of test equipment, including relocation, capacity expansion and replacement of critical parts

• Preparing and maintaining qualification protocols, reports, procedures, test method documentation and one-point lessons when needed

• Performing hands-on troubleshooting of test equipment and methods, evaluating test results and leading root cause investigations when failures occur

• Taking practical responsibility for test equipment, including service activities, calibration follow-up, preventive maintenance and ensuring that equipment performs as intended

• Handling changes, nonconformities and CAPAs related to test methods, calibration and test equipment

• Supporting compliant storage and traceability of raw data before product release

• Planning and participating in transfers of test methods and equipment to international manufacturing sites

• Providing technical support and sparring to colleagues in the Pilot Plant, Global Operations and international manufacturing sites

• Collaborating with Global Test Method teams and contributing technical input to the development and improvement of test methods

• Training specialists, laboratory technicians, operators and other users in test methods, test principles and use of equipment

• Coordinating software and computer upgrades for test equipment, assessing their impact on qualification and documentation, and managing suppliers, service visits and relevant service agreements

• Participating in internal and external audits related to test methods, equipment and documentation

• Contributing to continuous improvement of laboratory processes, systems and ways of working

**Bring strong technical judgement and a quality mindset

**To succeed in this position, you combine technical depth with a structured, practical and hands-on approach. You enjoy working directly with equipment, take ownership and work systematically when resolving technical issues. You are comfortable making decisions based on data, risk and regulatory requirements.

The role involves close collaboration with many internal and external stakeholders, therefor you communicate clearly, coordinate effectively and are able to build strong working relationships across functions, sites and suppliers.

We imagine that you bring:

• A master’s degree within science, engineering, mechanics, physics, chemistry, pharmacy or a comparable technical field, or have at least five years of relevant experience with test methods

• Solid hands-on experience with test methods, measurement principles and qualification of laboratory or production test equipment

• Strong problem-solving skills and experience with structured root cause analysis

• Confident evaluating, analysing and presenting technical data skills, including the use of statistical methods

• Ability to write, review and understand technical documentation, protocols and reports

• Knowledge of quality systems and regulated environments; knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 13485 and GMP is an advantage

• An understanding of validation, calibration, design control, specifications and process risk management

• Abitlity to plan and prioritise your work effectively and follow activities through to completion

• Strong stakeholder management skills and collaborate effectively across disciplines, functions, geographical locations and external suppliers

• Communicating skills professionally in English, both written and spoken; Danish is an advantage

• A comfortable competence using digital tools for documentation, data analysis and traceability; experience with Microsoft Office, Veeva, JMP or similar systems is an advantage

**A specialist role with broad impact

**This is a permanent specialist position in the QA Lifecycle Laboratory. The role has no direct reports and includes collaboration with international colleagues and manufacturing sites. Some travel may be expected in connection with transfers, supplier activities and site support.

You will join a working environment where quality, safety, technical excellence, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are central to our daily work. You will have the opportunity to build a broad network and influence how test methods and equipment are managed across the product lifecycle.

**Interested?

**If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Lotte Stoklund, Team Manager, QA Lifecycle Laboratory, at dklst@coloplast.com.

We invite candidates for interviews continuously, so we encourage you to submit your CV with a description of your motivation for applying, as soon as possible.

_Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

__Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

__Visit us on Coloplast.com.

__Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

jobs.occupation: Associate Director, Trial Delivery Team Lead
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**Overview

**The Associate Director, Trial Delivery Team Lead plays a key leadership role in overseeing Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs) and Clinical Trial Associates (CTAs) while supporting the broader Clinical Trial Management (CTM) organization. This individual ensures high-quality clinical trial execution by providing strategic guidance, mentorship, and operational oversight. The Line Manager is responsible for team development, resource allocation, process optimization, and ensuring alignment with organizational goals and regulatory standards. The Trial Delivery Team Lead may assume Global Trial Lead (GTL) responsibilities to address fluctuating demands.

**Roles & Responsibilities

****Leadership and Line Management:

**

• Directly manage, mentor, and develop Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs) and Clinical Trial Associates (CTAs), fostering professional growth.

• Conduct performance evaluations, provide feedback, and identify training and career development opportunities.

• Ensure adequate resourcing, workload distribution, and succession planning within the team.

• Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and knowledge-sharing within the clinical operations team.

• Collaborate with Global Trial Leads (GTLs) on trial activities for assigned direct reports.

• Support trial deliverables by facilitating progress, coaching, and mentoring CTMs and CTAs.

• Advise on resource needs and support overall clinical trial resource planning.

• Ensure team success through setting clear expectations, guiding performance, and leading competency development.

• Lead functional working groups; serve as process owner or Subject Matter Expert (SME) within Clinical Operations.

• Support training initiatives across Trial Operations as needed.

• Collaborate with senior leadership to define and implement best practices within the Development Operations organization.

**Process & Compliance Management

**

• Ensure team adherence to Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines, and regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, etc.).

• Develop and refine Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to optimize trial efficiency and compliance.

• Support audits, inspections, and regulatory interactions by ensuring inspection readiness across clinical trials.

• Identify and drive process improvements to enhance trial execution and data quality.

• Lead cross-trial initiatives as needed, such as implementation of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) or new process rollouts across the program.

• Manages the execution and implementation of CTM and CTA tasks, ensuring operational success.

• Initiates and supports the development of processes within the CTM and CTA group, focusing on practical application and continuous improvement.

• Collaborates across functions to drive efficiencies and provide day-to-day guidance to the CTM and CTA groups.

**Requirements – What You Must Have

**

• Bachelor of science degree with relevant specialization; Master of science degree preferred

• Minimum requirement of 12 or more years of experience in clinical operations

• Significant experience in leading and managing complex global clinical projects/programs

• Significant experience managing/guiding internal (cross-functional) and external (CRO, regulatory authorities) teams

• Experience with operational management and budget planning

• Proven performance in earlier role/comparable role

• Global clinical program level experience required

• Experience within the field of oncology is preferred

• Minimum 2 years’ experience as Clinical Operations representative in Clinical Development Teams (CDTs) or Global Project Teams (GPTs) would be preferable

• Experience leading team members in global matrix environment, leveraging tools and technology to ensure business needs are met.

• Strategic thinking with ability to optimize organizational resources for successful program execution

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

**Moreover, You Meet The Following Personal Requirements

**

• Dedicated team player who enjoys leading teams and inspire trust among colleagues

• Quality mindset and able to prioritize your work in a fast paced and changing environment

• Result- and goal-oriented and committed to contributing to the overall success of Genmab

For US based candidates, the proposed salary band for this position is as follows:

$158,720.00---$238,080.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When You Join Genmab, You’re Joining a Culture That Supports Your Physical, Financial, Social, And Emotional Wellness. Within The First Year, Regular Full-time U.S. Employees Are Eligible For

• 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions

• Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance

• Voluntary Plans: Critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance

• Time Off: Paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and 12 weeks of discretionary paid parental leave

• Support Resources: Access to child and adult backup care, family support programs, financial wellness tools, and emotional well-being support

• Additional Perks: Commuter benefits, tuition reimbursement, and a Lifestyle Spending Account for wellness and personal expenses

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on role will be provided during the recruitment process

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Please note that if you are applying for a position in the Netherlands, Genmab’s policy for all permanently budgeted hires in NL is initially to offer a fixed-term employment contract for a year, if the employee performs well and if the business conditions do not change, renewal for an indefinite term may be considered after the fixed-term employment contract.

Spare Parts Coordinator

Are you passionate about customer service, coordination, and delivering results in an international environment? We are looking for a structured and service-minded Spare Parts Coordinator to join our Customer Service team. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring the efficient handling of spare parts inquiries, quotations, and sales orders, contributing to an excellent customer experience through professional support, proactive communication, and reliable order execution.

As a Spare Parts Coordinator, you will be responsible for managing the spare parts process from initial customer inquiry through to final delivery. You will handle spare parts requests, prepare quotations, process sales orders, and proactively follow up with customers regarding availability, lead times, and order status. Working closely with procurement, planning, logistics, warehouse operations, and other internal stakeholders, you will help ensure smooth and timely order fulfillment while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.

To succeed in this role, you have experience within customer service, order processing, spare parts sales, logistics, or a similar operational function. You are comfortable working with ERP systems and digital tools and ideally have the ability to understand and work with technical product information. Strong communication skills in both Danish and English are important, as you will interact with customers and colleagues across different functions and locations.

As a person, you are service-oriented, structured, and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and attention to detail. You are able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment while maintaining a high level of quality and professionalism. You enjoy working collaboratively across departments, are solution-oriented in your approach, and take pride in delivering excellent service to both customers and colleagues.

We offer an exciting and varied position in a growing international company where you will become part of a dedicated and professional team. You will have the opportunity to work closely with customers and colleagues across the organization while contributing to continuous improvements, operational excellence, and the company's ongoing growth and success.

Why Should You Join Körber Supply Chain DK?

We offer an exciting role in an international company in growth, where you will work with advanced technical solutions and be part of a strong professional environment characterized by collaboration and dedication. We offer a range of attractive employee benefits:

Security & Health: In addition to a competitive salary package, you will be enrolled in our mandatory pension scheme, which also includes both health insurance and dental insurance, as well as access to physiotherapy. You will also be part of our lunch program, where our canteen provides healthy and exciting meals every day.

Development: We continuously offer training and courses, as we believe that our success is built on satisfied and skilled employees. That’s why we focus on both personal and professional development to ensure continuous growth.

Social Events: We have a strong company culture that we invest heavily in maintaining and developing. This includes a wide range of events and an active employee association that organizes activities such as Friday bars, Christmas parties, an annual ski trip, cultural events, and much more!

Körber – Conquer Supply Chain Complexity

We value diversity and welcome all applicants, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, identity, or any other protected status.

Apply now:

If you would like to create your future as a part of the Körber Supply Chain DK A/S team, please forward your application and CV already today!

Applications for this position have no deadline, as we will include candidates in the recruitment process on a continuous basis and will close the process once we have found the right candidate.

Apply now and join our team!

jobs.occupation: Expert, Business Area Manager Ecotoxicology and Environment
jobs.description:
Could your expertise in ecotoxicology help shape better environmental decisions—and unlock new opportunities for science-led advisory services?

At DHI, you’ll connect ecotoxicology, environmental science and water modelling to help clients tackle complex challenges in aquatic environments. Join our international Environment & Toxicology team to broaden your impact while helping grow our environmental advisory business.

Responsibilities and Challenges

We are looking for a senior colleague with expertise in ecotoxicology and environmental science with insights and interests in developing our advisory solutions and business.

As a member of DHI’s international Environment & Toxicology team, you will help clients address complex challenges related to chemicals, ecotoxicology and the aquatic environment. You will work closely with clients and colleagues across disciplines to develop practical, science-based solutions that protect human health and the environment.

The main responsibilities are to:

• Deliver expert advisory within the area of regulatory and scientific aspects of eco-toxicology, environmental exposure- and risk assessment, management of chemicals and/or environmental hazardous substances in water environments, and other client projects.

• Lead business development within advisory area of environment and eco-toxicology, enabling and bringing to life the strategy to build on the markets for advisory on environmental exposure- and risk assessment, management of chemicals and/or environmental hazardous substances (incl. micropollutants) in water environments.

• Plan and execute of internal and external activities of knowledge distribution (i.e. network meetings, conferences or courses) as well as business development activities.

• Serve as project manager in own projects, as well as deliver as project participant in projects within the portfolio.

• Perform quality assurance and mentor young colleagues, ensuring high scientific level of solutions.

• Establish and maintain good practices for international collaboration in E&T.

What We're Looking For

Required education, experience and capabilities

• A relevant university degree in ecotoxicology, environmental chemistry, environmental science, biology, chemistry, chemical engineering, water or environmental engineering, or a closely related discipline. A PhD or other advanced qualification is an advantage.

• At least 7 years of relevant professional experience in ecotoxicology, environmental chemistry, environmental risk assessment, chemicals in the environment or a closely related advisory field.

• A strong professional track record gained in consultancy, industry, public authority, research organization, or a comparable environment.

• Demonstrated experience assessing chemicals or environmentally hazardous substances in aquatic or water-related environments.

• Experience leading technically complex projects, including responsibility for scope, quality, budget, schedule and stakeholder management.

• A proven ability to originate or develop business, build client relationships and contribute to successful proposals or tenders.

• A good understanding of relevant environmental regulation, market developments and the needs of industry and public-sector clients.

• Experience working in an international or multidisciplinary setting.

• Proficient in English (professional level)

Additional experience and strengths, which will contribute to success in this role:

• Experience with establishing environmental quality standards and predicted no-effect concentrations, and/or assessing chemicals in wastewater or other water environments

• Knowledge of the EU Water Framework Directive, Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive, Drinking Water Directive or related national requirements.

• Experience with environmental fate, transport or exposure modelling

• Collaboration with authorities, utilities, industrial clients, industry associations, research programmes or international consortia.

• Experience developing services or markets across Denmark and the wider European region.

• Serving as the technical lead and/or mentor for colleagues in a team.

Skills and competences

The successful candidate combines scientific credibility with commercial awareness and a genuine interest in understanding client needs. We are looking for a person who can translate complex scientific and regulatory matters into clear advice and practical solutions.

You are:

• Scientifically strong, with the ability to provide authoritative advice within your field.

• Client-oriented and commercially aware, with the confidence to initiate conversations, develop opportunities and build lasting professional relationships.

• An effective project leader, able to maintain direction and quality across technically complex assignments.

• A clear communicator, capable of engaging scientific experts, decision-makers, authorities and other stakeholders.

• Collaborative and internationally oriented, with an interest in working across disciplines, markets and organisational boundaries.

• Proactive and accountable, taking ownership and exercising sound professional judgement.

• Generous with your expertise, contributing to knowledge sharing, mentoring and the professional development of colleagues.

Why join DHI?

To work at DHI means being part of an organisation that is the global leader in solving the world’s toughest challenges in water, environment and sustainability.

In this position we offer to you the opportunity to join a strong company with dedicated colleagues to:

• Shape and grow DHI’s ecotoxicology and environmental advisory business.

• Work at the intersection of chemicals, water environments, environmental regulation and data-driven decision-making.

• Collaborate with ecotoxicologists, environmental scientists, toxicologists, water specialists and modellers across an international organisation.

• Lead meaningful assignments for industry, authorities, utilities and partners.

• Take on a visible expert role with opportunities to influence strategy, develop clients, lead projects and mentor colleagues.

DHI is a global and independent company dedicated to working on challenges within the fields of water and environment and sustainability. **WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path, our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The Senior Associate Accounts Payable is responsible for ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely processing of supplier invoices and payments globally, safeguarding financial integrity and operational efficiency. The role delivers high-quality Accounts Payable execution, supports month-end and audit processes, and acts as a reliable point of contact for suppliers and internal stakeholders. As part of the Finance team, this position contributes to strong financial governance, VAT compliance, and continuous process improvement, supporting the company's scalability and commercial performance. The role is a full-time position and reports to the AP Manager.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Process and validate supplier invoices, ensuring accurate coding, proper approvals, VAT compliance, and high-quality data integrity.

• Manage supplier communication and vendor onboarding, resolving invoice and payment-related queries in a timely, structured, and service-oriented manner while coordinating effectively with internal stakeholders.

• Perform monthly reconciliations, including vendor statement reconciliations, vendor subledger reviews, and balance sheet reconciliations to ensure financial accuracy and completeness.

• Support month-end closing activities by ensuring Accounts Payable accuracy and timely reporting in line with internal controls and accounting standards.

• Contribute to audit processes by providing documentation, analysis, and reconciliation support to ensure compliance and transparency.

• Drive continuous improvement within Accounts Payable processes by identifying inefficiencies, enhancing controls, and supporting automation or standardization initiatives.

• Ensure adherence to company policies, financial controls, and regulatory requirements, maintaining strong governance within the AP function.

**KEY EXPECTATIONS

**In this role, you take ownership of your workload, manage moderately complex tasks, and help improve processes. You work independently, propose solutions, and adapt quickly when priorities shift. Your solid knowledge makes you a dependable contributor who helps drive team performance.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

• Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

As a global product consultant, you will sit at the heart of Talent, bringing together L&D, Technology and regional stakeholders to transform how learning is curated, delivered and experienced across the firm.

**In this role, you will:

**

• Partner with the Global L&D Product Owner and functional leads to set direction, align priorities and advance Microsoft Viva Learning as a global learning platform

• Translate strategy into a clear roadmap, practical governance and measurable success outcomes

• Drive adoption, engagement and measurable business impact across a complex global stakeholder landscape

**

**EY | Building a better working world

_Are you motivated by becoming the technical expert behind products and solutions that support clean water and energy? Do you thrive in a role where you connect technical development, business needs, and customer requirements? Are you excited by the opportunity to influence products throughout their entire lifecycle while collaborating with stakeholders across the organization?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**In the role as our next Technical Product Specialist within our software applications, your job will be to provide technical expertise across the product lifecycle while ensuring that products, solutions, and technical documentation remain accurate, compliant, and competitive.

More specifically you will be:

• Acting as the technical liaison between Research and Development, Sales, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders

• Providing technical support including tender support, sales support, product training, and advanced troubleshooting

• Serving as the technical expert on products, configurations, software solutions, and applications

• Maintaining technical product information and documentation

• Supporting product lifecycle activities including new product development, maintenance, and phase in and phase out activities

You will experience the freedom to act and leave your mark on how we manage and support our products throughout their lifecycle. Therefore, you will work closely with technical and commercial stakeholders across the organization, gain deep insight into our products and technologies, and play a key role in ensuring knowledge sharing, product adoption, and continuous improvement.

**Meet your future team

**With direct reference to Senior Manager, Technical Product Management, you will become part of the technical product management team. As a team, we are committed to ensuring our products remain technically accurate, competitive, and capable of meeting both market and business requirements, and you will have a key role in achieving this. In the team you will experience close collaboration with colleagues across product management, development, customer service, sales, and supply chain. Together we support products throughout their lifecycle while ensuring strong stakeholder engagement and knowledge sharing across the organization.

Did you know? As a Technical Product Specialist, you will work with stakeholders from many different functions, making every day an opportunity to learn something new about our products, technologies, and customers.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for a Technical Product Specialist who is ready to take ownership of technical product activities and who is motivated by solving complex challenges. You achieve this through strong collaboration skills, technical curiosity, and a structured approach to your work.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Engineering within Electronics, Software, Mechatronics, or a similar field.

• Have an understanding of product development, product lifecycle management, and technical product support

• Have experience with, or an understanding of, software-related systems such as Swagger documentation, Jira, Confluence or comparable platforms. A general end-to-end understanding of hardware and connectivity along with insights to APIsis an advantage.

• Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with the ability to communicate technical information clearly

• Have experience with product related systems such as Configure Price Quote, Product Lifecycle Management, Enterprise Resource Planning, or similar platforms.

We also value experience developing and delivering technical training and knowledge sharing activities

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than the ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, cycle team, during our yearly summer festival or on the padel court. For example, is our Head of System Engineering and Information Technology Denmark also our volunteer padel instructor while our Software Test Engineer runs weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

**At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. **Job Description

**If you want to take a leading role in shaping the IRB model landscape at a major Nordic bank, this is your opportunity. As Chief Data Scientist in our Risk Modelling and Analytics department, you will own complex modelling topics and help colleagues grow. You will work on models that matter, directly contributing to how Danske Bank manages credit risk.

**What you will be doing:

**You will join the LGD and CF development team within Risk Modelling and Analytics, a collaborative group that works across the full model development lifecycle. The team covers everything from understanding regulatory and business requirements and designing methodologies, through data sourcing and analysis, to building robust model solutions and supporting implementation, validation, and ongoing performance assessment. You will work closely with colleagues in Risk Management, Validation, IT and data teams, and the wider business, contributing to a culture where technical depth and clear thinking go hand in hand.

**More specifically, you will:

**

• Lead end-to-end development of IRB LGD and CF models, from data exploration to documentation.

• Take ownership of complex modelling challenges and contribute to key methodological decisions.

• Build robust, explainable, and regulatory-compliant models using statistical and machine learning techniques.

• Act as a technical sparring partner, sharing knowledge and supporting other Data Scientists.

• Contribute to regulatory dialogue and improve IRB modelling standards and practices.

**About you:

**

• Around five or more years of experience in data science, credit risk, or IRB model development.

• Strong experience in IRB model development, ideally including LGD and/or CF models.

• Skilled in writing clean, modular Python and SQL with good software engineering habits.

• Clear communicator, able to translate technical and mathematical concepts for diverse audiences.

• Collaborative and self-directed, comfortable taking ownership and sharing knowledge.

If you are curious about tools such as GitHub Copilot or AI-assisted coding, that is a genuine advantage. We value an open mindset and a willingness to explore smarter ways of working over prior experience with any specific tool.

**We offer:

**The workplace can be in Vilnius, Lithuania or Copenhagen, Denmark. If you are hired in Lithuania, monthly salary range would be from 4320 EUR to 6480 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job).

Additionally, each Danske Bank employee receives employee benefits package (this one is only valid for Lithuania) which includes:

• Growth opportunities: professional & supportive team, e-learnings, numerous development programs; (incl. professional certificates); 100+ professions for internal mobility opportunities.

• Health & Well-being: a diverse, inclusive, work & life balance work environment; additional health insurance; mental well-being practices; partial psychologist counselling compensation; silence and sleep zones at the office; game rooms.

• Hybrid working conditions: Work from home up to two days a week; home office budget (after the probation period); modern Danske Campus workplace developed with anthropologist for the best employee experience.

• Additional days of leave: for rest, health, volunteering, exams in higher education institutions, and other important activities. Moreover, for seniority with Danske Bank.

• Monetary compensation package: accidents & critical diseases insurance; financial support in case of unfortunate events, travel insurance; IIIrd Pillar Pension Fund contribution.

See all the benefits HERE.

Your job function (position) in the job contract will be AI Science.

If you're interested in this role and joining my team, feel free to contact me Justina Petkeviciute | LinkedIn and I will answer your questions! The application deadline is 10 November 2026.

**About Us

**Danske Bank is a Nordic bank with bridges to the world around us. For 150 years, we have supported people and businesses in releasing their potential. A career with us is an opportunity to join a community of 22,000 colleagues in a culture where we are committed to Teaming Up, Owning It and Being Open. Together, we are on a journey to transform Danske Bank into a better bank. For our customers, our employees and the societies around us.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join us as a DevOps & Platform Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in building, operating, and continuously enhancing the platforms and services that drive product development, testing, validation, deployment, and operations within Siemens Gamesa’s digital ecosystem. Whether you are modernizing platform services or contributing to cloud-enabled solutions, your efforts will significantly accelerate how engineering teams deliver innovative solutions. Become part of an international team that values ownership, innovation, and knowledge sharing in a culture driven by a strong engineering mindset.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Design, build, and operate platform services that support product development, testing, validation, and deployment activities.

• Develop automation solutions that enhance reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency.

• Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code, automated deployments, CI/CD pipelines, and platform tooling.

• Knowledge of Linux and/or Windows administration, scripting, troubleshooting, and system integration.

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with platform modernization, self-service platforms, developer experience initiatives, or Infrastructure as Code practices.

• Experience supporting engineering applications, industrial systems, SCADA environments, or operational technology solutions.

About the Team

You will join the Infrastructure Performance & Operations (IPO) team within Digital Products & Solutions. This team is dedicated to developing, operating, and evolving the digital platforms that support product engineering, validation, testing, and business operations across Siemens Gamesa. Our focus areas include platform engineering, automation, virtualization, CI/CD, observability, service reliability, infrastructure modernization, and operational excellence. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking talented individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: Working at Siemens Energy: Careers & Job Opportunities

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. Rewards/Benefits

Would you like to contribute to ensuring high-quality pharmaceutical production while helping us simplify and improve the way we work? Do you have a strong quality mindset, excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to adapt in a changing environment?

Then this may be the opportunity for you to join API Quality M3 in Kalundborg.

Our department provides quality assurance support to six purification facilities. You will become part of a collaborative department with a strong team spirit and highly skilled, ambitious and engaged colleagues. We place great emphasis on teamwork, adaptability and continuous personal and professional development.

We are looking for an experienced QA professional who combines strong quality awareness with curiosity and an improvement mindset. You should be motivated by working in a dynamic environment where priorities and business needs may change, and where we work together to find simple, robust and compliant solutions.

Your new role

You will join one of our two QA teams responsible for supporting daily operations and projects across three purification facilities.

Your main responsibility will be to provide proactive and risk-based QA oversight of processes and documentation related to daily production. Your tasks will include:

• Reviewing batch documentation and supporting product release

• Reviewing and approving deviations, change requests, trend reports and standard operating procedures

• Providing visible and proactive QA support on the shop floor

• Supporting timely resolution of quality-related issues

• Identifying trends, risks and improvement opportunities

• Simplifying and optimizing processes while maintaining compliance and product quality

• Supporting internal audits and inspections by health authorities, including presenting relevant quality data

You will work closely with colleagues across QA, production and supporting functions. Collaboration is therefore essential, and you should enjoy sharing knowledge, asking questions and developing solutions together with others.

Digitalization and AI are becoming increasingly important in our work. You will have the opportunity to contribute to how data, digital solutions and responsibly used AI-supported tools can strengthen trend identification, improve workflows and enable more effective quality oversight. Solutions must remain compliant, transparent and supported by sound professional judgement.

The position offers opportunities to develop your professional QA capabilities and your understanding of pharmaceutical production. We support individual development through feedback, knowledge sharing, increased responsibility and involvement in improvement activities and cross-functional initiatives.

What you'll bring

We are looking for a colleague who contributes both professionally and personally to the team. To succeed in the role, we expect that you:

• Hold a relevant academic degree, for example in pharmacy, veterinary medicine or a related natural science

• Have experience from the pharmaceutical industry, preferably including at least two years within quality assurance or production

• Have a strong quality mindset and can apply a risk-based approach to case handling

• Are motivated by simplification, optimization and continuous improvement

• Are curious about digital tools and the potential responsible use of AI within quality processes

• Are adaptable and able to maintain quality and overview when priorities change

• Take responsibility for your own learning and development

• Are willing to challenge existing ways of working constructively

• Are an inclusive and dedicated team player who builds trust and respect

• Have strong collaboration and communication skills

• Are proficient in written and spoken English

About the department

Our Quality Assurance department consists of 38 dedicated employees responsible for assuring the quality and compliance of API purification processes.

We work closely with production to ensure robust processes, reliable quality oversight and timely support to daily operations. At the same time, we continuously challenge ourselves to simplify, optimize and develop the way we work.

For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

What we offer

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Contact

• Has a strong eye for detail and takes pride in maintaining high standards.

• Is reliable, organised and able to prioritise tasks effectively.

• Can work independently while also being a supportive and collaborative team player.

• Has a positive, proactive and service-minded attitude.

• Is well-groomed and communicates professionally with colleagues and guests.

• Has a good communication in English

If you are ready to contribute to an exceptional guest experience and become part of the d’Angleterre team, we look forward to hearing from you!

Business Analyst

Location - Ballerup

Your new role

The Business Analyst in the Commercial AI & Data department is responsible for business analysis (authoring BRDs, FRS, etc.), business process maps/improvements, communication and quality assurance. They are entrusted with identifying AI and analytics use-cases as well as translating business problems/opportunities into AI product requirements.

You will be part of a business area that drives impact across the full Novo Nordisk value chain. We strive to stay close to our stakeholders in the business to ensure we deliver on their needs, helping reach millions of people living with serious chronic diseases. Our focus is on being at the forefront within our three areas; ensuring the highest quality for patients, being a trusted tech leader and an environmentally responsible business.

Your key responsibilities include:

1. Requirements Gathering and Analysis

• Engage with business stakeholders to understand business problems, goals, and needs.

• Conduct interviews, workshops, surveys, and meetings.

• Gather, document, and validate business requirements.

• Prioritize requirements based on business value and feasibility.

2. Business Process Analysis

• Analyse current ("As-Is") business processes.

• Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.

• Design future-state ("To-Be") processes.

• Recommend process optimization and automation opportunities.

3. Stakeholder Management

• Assist technical AI product owner liaise with business users, leadership, and technical teams.

• Facilitate communication and alignment across functions.

• Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve conflicts.

• Help ensure stakeholder buy-in for proposed solutions.

4. Solution Design Support

jobs.occupation: PhD stipend in thermal modeling and advanced solutions for high-power modules and magnetic components
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a PhD stipend is available within the general study programme in Electrical and Electronic Engineering. The stipend is open for appointment from 1 December 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years and the position is full-time.

Your work tasks
The position is offered in relation to the GreenMag project, and you will be positioned in the Section of Power Electronics Systems and Materials within the research programme Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification (SPELL) at AAU Energy, Aalborg University. You will be based at the Aalborg campus in a highly international research environment with close collaboration with academic and industrial partners in the field of power electronics and energy systems.

The increasing electrification of transport, industry and renewable energy systems is driving the development of high-power-density power converters operating at megawatt levels. Advanced planar magnetic components are emerging as a key technology for achieving higher power density, manufacturability and integration in such converters. However, thermal management remains one of the major challenges that limit the performance, reliability and scalability of planar magnetic solutions, especially at high power and high frequency.

In this PhD project, you will work on the development of innovative thermal management technologies for megawatt planar magnetics used in future electrification systems. Your research will combine advanced modelling, experimental validation and prototype development to improve heat dissipation and thermal reliability while maintaining the required electrical and magnetic performance. You will analyse thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in high-power planar magnetic components, design and evaluate cooling concepts and contribute to the integration of these solutions in realistic converter systems.

You will conduct cutting-edge research on thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in megawatt-class planar magnetic components and use this knowledge to propose and evaluate new design strategies. You will develop multiphysics simulation models using finite element modelling tools to investigate the thermal performance of planar magnetics and to study alternative cooling concepts and material choices. You will design, manufacture and experimentally validate novel thermal management solutions for planar magnetic structures, and you will explore advanced materials and cooling technologies that can be applied in megawatt-class magnetic components. As part of the GreenMag project, you will collaborate with academic and industrial partners, disseminate your research results through publications in international journals and conferences, and contribute to teaching and supervision activities within the department as part of the PhD education programme.

Your competencies 
You have a relevant educational background within Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, Energy Engineering or a closely related field, and you hold a Master’s degree that qualifies you for enrolment in the PhD programme. You are motivated to work at the interface between thermal science, electromagnetics and power electronics, and you are interested in both theoretical and experimental research.

You bring strong analytical skills and a structured approach to modelling and problem solving, and you are comfortable working with numerical tools for thermal and multiphysics analysis. Experience with thermal analysis, power electronics or magnetic component design will be considered an advantage, as will experience with finite element analysis tools such as COMSOL Multiphysics or ANSYS. It is beneficial if you have worked with experimental testing, prototype development or laboratory work in previous projects and if you are prepared to work with both simulation and hands-on experiments in this PhD.

As a person, you are curious and creative, and you are motivated by addressing challenging research questions in collaboration with others. You are able to work independently, take responsibility for your project and contribute actively to collaborative research activities across groups and institutions. Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken, are required, as you will present your results in scientific publications, at international conferences and in meetings with project partners.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges. Aalborg University is recognised internationally for excellence in power electronics and energy systems research, and AAU has been ranked among the leading universities in Europe within energy research. At AAU Energy, you will be part of a highly international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges associated with electrification and the green transition.

The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs approximately 300 staff members from a broad range of nationalities and disciplinary backgrounds, creating a vibrant international research environment with extensive opportunities for collaboration and professional growth. The department offers world-class laboratory and workshop facilities, and maintains close collaboration with industrial partners. As a PhD student, you will have access to advanced facilities for the design, manufacturing and testing of high-power magnetic components and power electronic systems, and you will be part of an active research community in Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
• Curriculum Vitae (CV)
• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
• Other relevant documents
The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Why join Oticon Export?

At Oticon Export, you will join a highly engaged international team committed to helping partners succeed and grow. We combine entrepreneurial thinking with the strength, expertise, and resources of the Demant Group.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence business performance across multiple international markets, collaborate with senior stakeholders, expand your global network, and contribute to bringing life-changing hearing care solutions to more people around the world.

Together, we create an environment where partners, customers, and colleagues thrive through strong partnerships, continuous development, and sustainable growth.

We look forward to welcoming you

Please submit your CV no later than November 12, 2026.

For questions about the position, please contact General Manager, Jakob Brøgger Kjærgaard at  jkbo@demant.com.

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health and innovation since 1904. jobs.occupation: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
 Department of Food Science
 Faculty of Science
 University of Copenhagen

  The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative.

  The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:

   	
• Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing 	
• Food process system engineering 	
• Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools 	
• Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes. 	
• Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing     A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:

   	
• A collaborative and innovative mindset 	
• Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work 	
• A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level 	
• Experience with international collaborations 	
• Ability to establish industrial collaboration 	
• Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills   Tenure-track assistant professor
 The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties.

  The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

  Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

  Associate professor

  Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.
 
 The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities

  Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

  Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

  University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
 General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

  Please read more here
 
 For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf

  For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf

  Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

  The tenure-track assistant programme
 The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures.

  Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields.

  After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

  Salary and employment conditions
 The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. 

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Employment is as either tenure track assistant professor or associate professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  The Professor will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing.  Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk).

  Filing of application
 The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level or associate professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below).

  The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. 

  Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae including: 	 		
• Please describe and document international network and relations 		
• Please describe and document internationally based activities 		
• Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark 		
• Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media 		
• Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants. 	 	 	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)    	
• Research plan - description of current and future research plans    	
• If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document: 	 		
• Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students 		
• Teaching experience 		
• Formal pedagogical training 	 	    	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers   Applying for the associate professorship please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae including information about external funding  	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)  	
• Research plan – description of current and future research plans  	
• Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines 	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers   The deadline for applications is 1 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.  

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews will be held on 8 March 2027.  

  Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case: 

  211-0263/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

  211-0760/26-2E, Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

Turn Business Needs into Scalable Solutions

You can communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences and build working relationships across functions and geographies.

Furthermore, you have good documentation skills and attention to detail, combined with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset. You take ownership of your work, value knowledge sharing and you are motivated by finding practical ways to improve processes and create business value through technology.

Finally, your written and verbal communication skills in English are at a high level, and you thrive in an international, cross-functional environment.

Come and Join Us
