jobs.occupation: Senior Cyber Security Partner - Enterprise IT
jobs.description:
Location

Ballerup, Denmark

Job category

Digital & IT

Department: Enterprise IT & Quality

Location: Ballerup

We are looking for a Senior Cyber Security Partner to join our team to support Enterprise IT .

Your impact begins here

As a Senior Cyber Security Partner, you will be the trusted security advisor for Enterprise IT. You will help ensure that cyber security is built into how your area works, makes decisions and develops.

You will translate current and emerging cyber risks into clear, practical advice, contribute to cyber security strategy, and build a strong partnership between your business area and central Cyber Security organisation. Your work will help protect the systems, technology, and data that Novo depends on to drive change for lasting health. Supporting Enterprise IT, you will work closely with your business area to understand its priorities, technology landscape and risk profile, adapting security guidance to its specific needs.

What you’ll bring

You combine broad cyber security expertise with a strong understanding of enterprise IT environments and the ability to build trust, connect security risk to business objectives, and move the business forward.

For the position supporting Enterprise IT, we are looking for experience advising on cyber security risks across enterprise applications and IT infrastructure, including cloud services, identity and access management, end user devices and networks.

This position requires the ability to translate cyber security risks into practical advice and support informed business decisions.

You will bring:

• 5–10 years of relevant experience within cyber security, information security, IT risk or related disciplines in a large or complex organisation.

• A strong understanding of IT and/or OT and the ability to connect security to business objectives.

• Experience with security frameworks such as NIST CSF or ISO 27001.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with your assigned area.

• Very good interpersonal, communication and coaching skills.

• The ability to collaborate and communicate with external parties such as vendors, consultants and authorities.

• A master’s or bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline.

• Full professional proficiency in English. Danish language skills may be an advantage but are not a requirement.

Useful, but not essential:

• Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM or CISA.

What you’ll do

You will be the go-to security partner for your assigned area: the person who translates threats and frameworks into practical advice that supports informed decisions and helps teams act on them with confidence.

• Act as the cyber security partner for Enterprise IT driving collaboration between your assigned business area and other security professionals.

• Provide expert advice on current and future security threats, translating risk into clear priorities your stakeholders can act on.

• Help stakeholders understand cyber risks, available options and appropriate mitigations, enabling informed, risk-based decisions.

• Support and contribute to cyber security strategies, making sure they reflect the realities and objectives of your assigned area.

• Promote and establish a strong relationship between your assigned area and Cyber Security, so security is considered early rather than added late.

• Work with external parties, including vendors, consultants and authorities, to keep security work moving forward.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Security Partners team within Cyber Risk and Resilience, working alongside eight colleagues serving as Security Partners and Business Information Security Officers (BISOs).

In your assigned area, you will provide trusted, risk-based cyber security leadership and help embed security into business and technology decisions.

Your closest partners may include:

• Data, process, business and contract owners

• IT system managers

• Managers, subject matter experts, architects and process teams

• Domain and enterprise architects

• Colleagues across Enterprise IT

• Cyber Security colleagues and other relevant specialist functions

Bringing these perspectives together, you will create clarity on security priorities, speak up when things stall and help teams make decisions they can own and follow through on. You will report to Erling Jepsen, Director.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to lead on security for areas that matter to how Novo works today and develops new treatments for tomorrow. Your expertise will be valued, your voice will be heard, and your advice will shape real decisions.

You will work with skilled security professionals, architects and partners across IT, OT and research, building your skills through practical, cross-functional experience. You will be supported to perform at your best, with honest feedback and clear expectations, in a team that combines curiosity, collaboration, and ambition.

Salary

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000.00 to  1,245,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits

The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

If you are ready to become a trusted cyber security partner for Enterprise IT we would like to hear from you. Please indicate in your application if you have a particular interest in, or experience relevant to, either of the two areas.

Apply for the Senior Cyber Security Partner role by 30/10/2026.

For further information, please contact Erling Jepsen at (+45) 30759351.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Sr Business Operations Manager

Department: GMA Business Operations

Location: Søborg, Denmark

Your impact begins here

As Sr Business Operations Manager, you will help Global Medical Affairs (GMA) leadership make clearer, faster decisions on strategy, budget and priorities. You will advise senior leaders, lead complex projects where the problem is not yet defined, and co-own a key process that GMA teams rely on. Your work turns ambiguity into decisions, so medical affairs colleagues can focus their time and resources where they matter most for people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

• Master’s degree in business, finance, sciences, engineering or a similar field.

• 5–7 years of relevant experience leading complex, cross-functional strategic projects and owning process improvement in a complex organisation.

• Experience leading financial planning and budget processes, challenging financial assumptions and aligning Finance and senior stakeholders around priorities and decisions.

• A proven ability to frame ambiguous problems, influence senior leaders, guide contributors and turn analysis into decisions.

• Excellent executive communication, strategic judgement and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence without authority and sustain alignment across senior stakeholder groups.

• Cultural awareness and adaptability, and a collaborative way of coaching colleagues.

What you’ll do

Your role combines three connected workstreams: partnering with GMA leaders, owning the budget process and leading projects. Together, they help GMA work with more clarity and speed.

• Advise the head of your assigned GMA area on the annual strategy process and its translation into budget priorities, framing trade-offs and challenging assumptions, dependencies and options.

• Co-own the budget process area with a team colleague, setting direction for templates, guidance and best practice, and leading adoption across GMA.

• Lead highly complex and ambiguous strategic projects: frame the problem, define scope and governance, set milestones and risk responses, and deliver on time, within budget and to the required quality.

• Strengthen governance by clarifying decisions, accountability and follow-up across interdependent work.

• Turn evidence into concise, data-driven recommendations, and prepare analyses, memos and presentations that shape GMA Leadership Team decisions.

• Share what you learn, improve common team methods and mentor colleagues, so the team stays resilient and consistent.

Who you’ll work with

You will join GMA Business Operations in Product & Portfolio Strategy, where colleagues connect commercial strategy, medical affairs and business development across therapy areas to help guide the Novo portfolio and strengthen competitiveness. You will report to the Director, GMA Business Operations, and work closely with your team colleagues to ensure success across the unit.

Your day-to-day partners include the GMA Leadership Team, leaders and specialists across GMA and medical affairs worldwide, Finance partner, and colleagues in Strategy, Executive Office and PMO functions. You will also have occasional contact with external parties.

The role is global in scope, with stakeholders across the world and minimal travel expected. Your influence comes from building trust, creating clarity and aligning functions whose priorities may differ.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to define your own approach to complex, unclear assignments, with minimal guidance and room to make your voice heard at senior level. You will grow by working across GMA and supporting functions, learning from colleagues and sharing your expertise through mentoring and strategic sparring.

We expect high standards and honest, direct conversations, and we support you to perform at your best.

Salary:  For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600.00 to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level,  location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring clarity to the decisions that shape Global Medical Affairs, apply for the Sr Business Operations Manager role by 9 November 2026.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path, our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**We are looking for an FP&A Specialist to strengthen our Corporate FP&A team and take ownership of cash flow forecasting, balance sheet planning, working capital management, and other key planning activities below Adjusted EBITDA across the Group.

Reporting directly to the Head of FP&A, you will play a key role in advancing our financial planning capabilities and driving transparency across cash flow, liquidity, and balance sheet performance. You will work closely with Accounting, Tax, Controlling, regional Finance teams, and key business stakeholders to ensure robust planning processes and high-quality management reporting.

This is a unique opportunity to:

• Take ownership of the Group's cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital planning agenda, helping to improve cash generation and support management decision-making.

• Shape and develop our Workday Adaptive Planning capabilities, leading key initiatives to establish scalable planning models and reporting structures.

• Work across markets and functions, partnering with regional Finance teams and senior stakeholders to strengthen forecasting, reporting, and business insight throughout the organization.

The successful candidate will help establish best-in-class planning processes that connect P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow forecasting, providing management with greater visibility into liquidity, working capital performance, and long-term value creation. The role is a full-time role and reports to the Head of Group Financial Planning & Analysis.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Own the Group's cash flow planning across forecast, budget, and long-range planning cycles.

• Drive the development of balance sheet forecasting capabilities and ensure alignment between P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow planning.

• Lead the implementation and continuous development of cash flow and balance sheet planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning.

• Define business requirements and partner closely with the BI Team to improve planning processes, reporting capabilities, and system functionality.

• Partner with Accounting, Controlling, Tax, and regional Finance teams to strengthen cash flow and balance sheet reporting, improve forecast accuracy, and establish clear ownership across planning activities.

• Develop and maintain monthly cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital reporting, including variance analysis, key risks and opportunities, and actionable management insights.

• Establish and maintain a clear RACI framework across Finance for balance sheet and cash flow planning, forecasting, and follow-up activities.

• Develop driver-based forecasting methodologies for key working capital metrics, including inventory, receivables, payables, and other material balance sheet accounts.

• Monitor working capital performance and identify opportunities to improve cash conversion and optimize working capital.

• Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Accounting, and Controlling to strengthen understanding of working capital drivers and improve forecast accuracy.

• Support Executive Management and Board reporting by providing insights on cash generation, liquidity, working capital performance, and financial risks and opportunities.

• Drive continuous improvement of forecasting methodologies, planning processes, and financial transparency across the organization.

• Support the ongoing development of FP&A capabilities by integrating balance sheet and cash flow considerations into strategic and long-range planning processes.

**WHO YOU ARE

**You are a curious and analytical finance professional with a passion for turning data into insights and helping the business make better decisions. You enjoy working across functions, building strong stakeholder relationships, and taking ownership of complex planning processes.

You thrive in a dynamic and growing environment and are comfortable navigating between operational details and the bigger picture. You enjoy driving improvements, challenging assumptions, and creating structure where it is needed.

You are comfortable working across Finance functions and partnering with regional Finance teams to improve forecasting, strengthen financial transparency, and drive continuous improvement. Most importantly, you are proactive, structured, and motivated by creating impact through high-quality financial planning and analysis.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• 5+ years of experience within FP&A, Financial Controlling, Corporate Finance, or a similar role.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.

• Experience working with cash flow forecasting, working capital, balance sheet analysis, or investment planning.

• Solid financial modelling and analytical skills, including advanced Excel capabilities.

• Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning or other EPM/planning tools is an advantage.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• A proactive mindset and a passion for improving processes, systems, and ways of working.

• Experience from retail, hospitality, food & beverage, consumer goods, or other multi-site businesses is considered a plus.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

**Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

****ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Do you have a passion for pharmaceutical quality, but also believe that Quality should be about more than compliance?

At Fertin Pharma, we develop and manufacture pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products in partnership with leading global and regional brands, combining pharmaceutical expertise with innovative oral delivery technologies.

We are looking for a QA Specialist who wants to work close to our pharmaceutical operations and help us ensure the quality of our products and continuously strengthen the way we manufacture. You will become part of an environment where GMP, manufacturing, and continuous improvement come together.

About the role:

As QA Specialist, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across Quality and Operations. Your role will combine day-to-day quality activities with investigation, problem solving, and continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to influence how we work with quality and help move from simply reacting to quality issues towards preventing them through stronger processes and effective collaboration. Your responsibilities may include:

• Supporting and approving deviation investigations, including root-cause analysis and CAPAs

• Participating in the release process of our pharmaceutical products

• Providing GMP and quality support to pharmaceutical manufacturing

• Reviewing and approving manufacturing documentation

• Participating in change controls, risk assessments, and quality improvement activities

• Contributing to the simplification of our Quality Management System

• Supporting inspection and audit readiness

• Participating in cross-functional projects where quality expertise is needed

Who are you?

Your exact educational background is less important than your ability to understand processes, challenge constructively and turn complex quality issues into practical solutions. We imagine that you:

• Have a relevant scientific, engineering, or pharmaceutical background

• Preferably have experience from pharmaceutical or other highly regulated industry

• It would be considered a strong advantage if your educational background and professional experience meet the requirements for acting as a delegated Qualified Person (QP Delegate) according to Danish requirements

• Understand GMP and preferably have practical experience working within a pharmaceutical Quality Management System

• Can balance compliance, risk and operational reality

• Have experience with, or an interest in, deviations, CAPA, root-cause analysis and risk management

• Is curious and comfortable asking why

• Communicate clearly and collaborate naturally across functions

If you are motivated by making quality work in practice, not simply administering it, we would like to hear from you. Send your cover letter and CV as soon as possible via the link below. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis.

Special Conditions:

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates who accept an offer of employment with Fertin. A satisfactory background check is a condition of employment. The background check is a standard and important part of our hiring process and is carried out in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, as well as Fertin’s internal compliance and integrity requirements.

Your impact begins here

As ESG Reporting Advisor, you will help prepare Novo’s ESG reporting, including the Sustainability statement in the Annual Report, and make sure the data behind it is accurate, transparent and trusted. Investors, regulators, employees and other external stakeholders rely on this reporting to understand Novo’s sustainability commitments and progress. You will be responsible for selected metrics, EU Taxonomy reporting and to improve our data collection and controlling processes.

What you’ll bring

The ESG space is changing fast. You will do well here if you:

• Thrive in a high-pace environment where things are anything but at steady state.

• Enjoy working in a large organisation with many stakeholders and handling many different tasks at once.

• Bring a pragmatic, can-do attitude.

• Communicate clearly and interact confidently with stakeholders at all levels.

Useful, but not essential: one or several of the following

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree related to ESG topics, business or auditing.

• Minimum 3+ years’ experience in sustainability, ESG reporting or as an ESG consultant.

• Knowledge of ESG reporting methodologies and frameworks, such as CSRD, EU Taxonomy and the GHG Protocol.

• Experience with ESG assurance and internal controls.

What you’ll do

You will help deliver high-quality ESG reporting and strengthen how it is produced. Your work will include:

• Preparing Novo’s ESG reporting, including the Sustainability statement in the Annual Report.

• Taking responsibility for selected metrics (climate, pollution, nature, circularity, own workforce, business conduct or equitable access) and making sure they are reported accurately and transparently.

• Working closely with stakeholders across the business on data collection and carrying out controls and checks on key ESG metrics.

• Owning our EU Taxonomy reporting.

• Improving data collection and consolidation processes and strengthening the internal ESG control environment.

• Driving continuous improvement of existing processes with AI and other digital tools.

Who you’ll work with

jobs.description:
_Do you have hands-on experience with SimCorp Dimension and an interest in financial processes across mortgage banking, asset management, risk, regulatory reporting and liquidity management? Join Treasury Products and help develop modern, robust IT solutions.

_You will work with core financial processes and contribute to a strategic programme modernising Treasury’s IT landscape, including SimCorp Dimension, integrations and data.

**Your role

**Nykredit Wealth Technology delivers IT solutions for key financial business areas. Treasury Products supports mortgage banking, proprietary portfolio management, risk, liquidity management and regulatory reporting.

SimCorp Dimension is central to this business-critical value chain. You will work at the intersection of financial products, business processes, data and technology.

You will join a skilled team and collaborate with business units, vendors and colleagues across Wealth Technology.

**Help shape the future Treasury platform

**The Treasury Greenfield Programme is modernising Treasury’s IT landscape and strengthening the robustness of the value chain across SimCorp Dimension, surrounding systems, integrations and data sources.

Our ambition is to replace the older on-premises platform with a modern, cloud-based SimCorp Dimension SaaS solution and shape the future SCD setup and Treasury it architecture.

As our new Specialist, you will contribute to this transformation, apply your experience and develop your specialist capabilities.

**Your Primary Responsibilities

**

• Analyse business needs and translate them into robust, flexible IT solutions

• Develop, configure and implement solutions in SimCorp Dimension

• Collaborate with Treasury, Risk and other business areas

• Contribute to the Treasury Greenfield Programme and future platform

• Solve challenges across processes, data and technology

• Maintain solutions and share knowledge across the team.

**Your profile

**You may come from an IT role involving SimCorp Dimension and financial solutions or from the business side Front Office, Middle Office or Back Office working with Simcorp Dimension. Hands-on experience with SimCorp Dimension is required. You do not need to be an expert, but you must have a solid basic understanding of the platform.

In addition, we imagine that you:

• have a relevant background in IT, economics or finance,

• are interested in Treasury, capital markets and technology,

• are curious and motivated to develop your specialist capabilities,

• work in a structured way, take ownership and follow through,

• collaborate well and communicate complex topics clearly.

**Your team

**You will join a team that values expertise, collaboration and knowledge sharing.

We combine different skills and perspectives in a trusting, informal environment where colleagues help and challenge each other.

We expect curiosity, responsibility and an ambition to develop with the team—not that you know everything from day one.

**What We Offer

**We offer a specialist role combining capital markets, mortgage banking, business and technology in an area of significant importance to Nykredit. You can develop your Treasury and SimCorp Dimension expertise while contributing to a strategic transformation. You will work with committed colleagues and take on greater responsibility as your expertise grows.

We also offer competitive employment terms, attractive employee benefits and flexible working conditions.

**Want to know more?

**If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact me, Thomas Skou, Head of Department, at +45 44 55 99 48.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact our Recruitment Team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis and will close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**Genmab’s CMC Writing team is looking for a Regulatory CMC Writer to support global marketing applications across our growing portfolio.

In this role, you will author and participate in the review of high-quality CMC documentation, with a primary focus on global Biologics License Applications (BLAs), Marketing Authorisation Applications (MAAs), and New Drug Applications (NDAs). Working closely with scientific and technical experts, you will translate complex manufacturing, analytical, and formulation development information into clear, accurate, and consistent regulatory submission documents.

You will join a dedicated team of CMC writers and collaborate with colleagues and external partners across late-stage development, regulatory submission, and lifecycle management activities. Your contribution will help ensure that CMC documentation presents a coherent scientific rationale and is delivered within agreed submission timelines. You will also contribute to improving writing quality and efficiency through the thoughtful use of AI and digital tools.

The position reports to the Director, Head of CMC Writing, and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your primary focus will be CMC documentation supporting global BLA/MAA/NDA filings and responses to health authority questions during assessment.

**Your Responsibilities Include

**

• Authoring and reviewing Module 3 CTD sections, covering manufacturing processes, process controls, analytical procedures, characterization, specifications, formulation development, stability, and facility

• Translating technical reports and source data into clear, scientifically sound regulatory narratives in close collaboration with subject matter experts

• Coordinating document preparation and review with CMC Project Managers, subject matter experts, Regulatory Affairs CMC, Quality Assurance, and external partners, including contract manufacturing organizations

• Consolidating review comments, facilitating their resolution, and ensuring that documents are completed and approved within agreed timelines

• Verifying the accuracy of data presented in CMC documents against source documentation and ensuring consistency across related sections and submissions

• Authoring and coordinating responses to health authority questions and implementing the resulting updates to CMC submission documents

• Maintaining source document trackers and ensuring traceability of supporting information and regulatory document updates

• Supporting lifecycle maintenance of CMC documentation, including post-approval changes, and contributing to IND/CTA submissions and amendments as needed

• Applying AI and digital tools to improve writing quality, consistency, and efficiency, while critically evaluating outputs and ensuring scientific accuracy and appropriate handling of confidential information

• Following and contributing to the continuous improvement of CMC writing and response principles, templates, internal procedures, and style guides

• Performing CMC writing activities in accordance with Genmab’s quality system and applicable procedures

**Requirements

**You hold a master’s degree in science or related technical discipline. An advanced degree or relevant professional certification is preferred.

You bring at least four years of experience in CMC or a related field within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with relevant experience in biologics and/or chemical development and manufacturing. We welcome candidates with backgrounds in biologics, small molecules, or both.

**In Addition, You Have

**

• Experience authoring and reviewing CMC regulatory sections or supporting source documents, with the ability to take ownership of defined sections with limited supervision

• Experience participating in global regulatory submissions and/or a strong background in pharmaceutical or biotechnology product development and manufacturing processes. Direct experience supporting BLA, MAA, or NDA filings is a strong advantage

• A good understanding of CMC regulatory requirements across development stages and familiarity with CTD structure

• Knowledge of GxP, regulatory compliance, and documentation requirements relevant to CMC activities

• Excellent written English and the ability to distil complex scientific information into clear, concise, and well-structured text

• Strong attention to detail, with the ability to verify data, identify inconsistencies, and maintain scientific accuracy across documents

• Practical experience using AI tools to improve scientific or technical writing quality and efficiency, including the ability to formulate effective prompts, critically assess outputs, and verify scientific content

• Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to coordinate cross-functional reviews and facilitate alignment without direct authority

• A proactive and structured approach to planning, prioritizing, and delivering quality work within demanding submission timelines

• A demonstrated track record of effective collaboration and reliable delivery in previous roles, together with curiosity, openness to feedback, and an interest in improving ways of working

Application deadline: 1. November 2026

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK582.400,00---873.600,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Are you passionate about product data and the systems that turn it into consistent, high-quality experiences everywhere it's used? Do you enjoy the technical challenge of connecting complex data flows across platforms? Do you thrive on making product information easy to find, understand, and trust—for customers and for AI? If so, we might have the perfect opportunity for you!

Pandora's team is looking for a Product Manager to own our Product Information Management (PIM) practice. PIM is central to our architecture, syndicating product data to ecommerce, marketplaces, retail, and marketing systems, so you'll work at the intersection of data architecture, content quality, and discoverability.

As our new Product Manager, you'll own the product strategy and delivery for our PIM platform, with InRiver preferred as our PIM technology. You'll work closely with data, engineering, and content teams to define the data model, govern data quality, and ensure product information flows correctly to every downstream channel.

This role is critical to how our products are found and understood—not just by customers on our own site, but increasingly by AI-driven answer engines and generative search. You'll balance strategic roadmap planning with hands-on technical execution, vendor management, and continuous improvement of our data model.

Help Write Our Next Chapter - Job Responsibilities:

• Own the product roadmap and backlog for our PIM platform, ensuring the data model and architecture support both business and technical needs

• Design and optimize data flows between PIM and downstream systems (ecommerce, marketplaces, DAM, ERP), working closely with engineering

• Partner with content, SEO, and marketing teams to structure and enrich product information for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

• Manage vendor relationships, including roadmap alignment, issue escalation, and feature adoption

• Monitor data quality, syndication performance, and platform health, identifying optimization opportunities and driving continuous improvement

• Stay ahead of trends in PIM, product data architecture, and AI-driven discovery, bringing forward strategic recommendations

We would love if you could bring:

• 5+ years of experience in product management, data platforms, or PIM—ideally within ecommerce or product content operations

• Technical understanding of PIM architecture, data modeling, and system integrations (APIs, ETL, syndication)

• Experience with InRiver or similar PIM platforms preferred

• Experience optimizing product information for AEO and GEO—structured data, schema markup, and content formats that AI systems and search engines can parse

• Experience writing clear product requirements and managing backlogs in tools like JIRA

• Analytical mindset with a focus on measuring data quality and discoverability impact

• Excellent stakeholder management skills—you can navigate between technical and business teams with ease

• Familiarity with data privacy regulations (GDPR, consent management) is a plus

We know that great talent comes from different backgrounds and experiences. If this role excites you and you can see yourself bringing many of these skills to the team, we’d love to hear your story!

Meet the People Behind the Sparkle

You’ll join our Product Management team, alongside colleagues in Copenhagen and Baltimore, working in a collaborative and international environment. Reporting directly to the Director, Product Management, you’ll work closely with teams across e-commerce, stores, retail technology, brand, marketplaces and local markets, giving you broad exposure across Pandora and plenty of opportunity to collaborate across the business.

Further Information:

Global Career Band: This role is a Manager, Band 4B, individual contributor position.

Be Part of Something Beautiful

At Pandora, we’re crafting more than jewellery. We’re creating the future of an iconic global brand. You’ll work from our Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen alongside talented colleagues from around the world, helping shape the digital experiences, platforms, and technologies that support millions of customers and employees every day. From our LEED Gold-certified workplace to our commitment to sustainability, innovation, and craftsmanship, Pandora offers an environment where you can do meaningful work, grow your career, and make a lasting impact.

You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology site in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s ambitions. Besides our inspiring workplace design, we’re proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This reflects our commitment to using natural resources responsibly and creating a space that is professional, dynamic, comfortable, and uniquely Pandora. The result is a workplace that is innovative, collaborative and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to everyone who works here or comes to visit.

FPRT is a Danish-based defense technology company, part of the international Fire Point Group — a fast-growing ecosystem born out of Ukraine’s innovation and resilience. The group was founded by engineers and entrepreneurs who, during the first months of the full-scale war, decided to use their expertise to create advanced defense technologies — including long-range drones and precision systems.

About FPRT

FirePoint Rocket Technology is building a new advanced defence manufacturing facility in Denmark. As we grow towards 300+ employees, we are looking for a hands-on Payroll & HR Operations Specialist to establish reliable people processes and support our transition to a multi-shift production environment.

Reporting to the CHRO, you will work closely with Finance, managers and external payroll and benefits providers. This is an opportunity to shape HR operations from an early stage, not simply maintain existing processes.

What you’ll do

• Coordinate the monthly Danish payroll process, checking salaries, shifts, overtime, allowances and payroll data with our external provider.

• Own accurate time and attendance administration in WorkLinq, working with managers to resolve discrepancies.

• Manage essential HR administration, including contracts, employee changes, pension and benefits coordination, and offboarding.

• Keep employee records and HR systems accurate, organised and compliant with Danish requirements and collective agreements.

• Improve everyday HR processes and reporting as the workforce grows, supporting a potential future transition to in-house payroll.

What we’re looking for

• 3-5+ years of hands-on experience with Danish payroll and HR administration; manufacturing or shift-based experience is an advantage.

• Working knowledge of Danish employment, tax, pension and payroll practices, including collective agreements.

• Confidence using payroll, HR and time-registration systems; experience with WorkLinq or similar tools is welcome.

• Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy and a practical, service-minded approach.

• Strong language skills in Danish and English, oral and written

Why join FPRT?

• Build scalable payroll and HR operations for a new high-tech manufacturing site.

• Have direct impact on the employee experience and how a growing company operates.

• Work with an international team on a project supporting European security and defence.

• Competitive compensation and a new facility in Vojens.

Interested? We would be pleased to hear from candidates who enjoy combining accurate execution with building better ways of working.

Practical Information

• Full-time position with an immediate start.

• Location: Vojens, Denmark.

• Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

• Temp-Team is assisting FPRT with this recruiment so during the initial phases of the recruitment process will be done by Temp-Team and all contact must go via Temp-Team.

Temp-Team

Temp-Team A/S is a national recruitment and staffing agency with eight local departments in Denmark. We have 45 years of experience within staffing and cover a wide range of industries. We focus on delivering high quality and a close personal contact to candidates and clients.

Temp-Team is a part of JuhlerGroup – an international group of recruitment agencies.

jobs.occupation: Business Continuity Manager - Business Impact & Criticality
jobs.description:
The position is based in Roskilde or Warsaw at BEC Financial Technologies' headquarters. The position is organizationally anchored in Service Integration & Security with reference to the Head of Projects & Continuity.

The Service Integration & Security area is responsible for strengthening BEC’s operational resilience and ensuring that critical business services can continue through disruption. We work closely with business areas, banking specialists, risk and compliance functions, and technology stakeholders to establish a shared understanding of business criticality, dependencies, continuity requirements, and recovery priorities.

As Business Continuity Manager, you will lead and develop BEC’s Business Impact Analysis and business criticality processes. You will engage with business owners across BEC to identify critical services and processes, assess the consequences of disruption, clarify dependencies, and define proportionate continuity and recovery requirements. The role requires strong business understanding, facilitation skills, and the ability to translate banking needs and regulatory expectations into clear priorities and practical actions.

At BEC, we prefer to collaborate often in the office, while also offering the opportunity to work remotely on average up to 1 day per week.

Primary tasks and responsibilities include:

Continuity & resilience framework:

• Developing and maintaining BEC’s business continuity management framework with a clear business and customer perspective

• Owning the governance and methodology for Business Impact Analysis and business criticality assessments

• Ensuring that continuity priorities and requirements reflect customer impact, banking obligations, financial exposure, regulatory expectations, and operational dependencies

• Supporting the development and maintenance of business continuity plans and ensuring alignment with relevant standards and regulation

Business Impact Analysis (BIA) ownership & execution:

• Planning, facilitating, and driving Business Impact Analyses across BEC’s business areas and shared functions

• Helping business owners identify critical customer services, products, processes, and activities, including the impact of disruption over time

• Facilitating consistent criticality assessments and supporting management decisions on priorities, tolerances, and continuity requirements

• Identifying and documenting key dependencies on people, suppliers, facilities, information, applications, and other business services

• Maintaining the BIA and criticality methodology, governance, templates, guidance, quality criteria, and review cycle

• Consolidating results into management insight for BEC’s most critical services, business impacts, dependencies, and resilience priorities

Coordination & stakeholder engagement:

• Building strong relationships with business owners, banking specialists, risk and compliance functions, service owners, and senior stakeholders

• Leading workshops and interviews that turn business knowledge into clear, evidence-based impact and criticality assessments

• Challenging assumptions constructively and creating alignment where business priorities, regulatory requirements, and operational capabilities differ

• Translating business continuity needs into clear requirements for relevant operational and technology stakeholders without being the technical solution owner

Validation****, exercises & continuous improvement:

• Validating BIA and criticality outcomes through business reviews, continuity exercises, incidents, and organizational changes

• Facilitating business-focused continuity and crisis exercises that test decision-making, priorities, and cross-functional coordination

• Using lessons learned and stakeholder feedback to improve the continuity framework, BIA process, and organizational readiness

Governance, reporting & insight:

• Preparing clear management reporting on business criticality, BIA coverage, key risks, dependencies, gaps, and improvement priorities

• Providing decision support and business insight that help management prioritize resilience investments and continuity actions

To succeed you will have:

• Solid experience with business continuity management, Business Impact Analysis, operational resilience, or a comparable business-focused discipline

• Practical experience facilitating BIAs, criticality assessments, workshops, or other cross-organizational business processes

• Strong stakeholder-management and facilitation skills, with confidence engaging business owners and senior stakeholders

• A structured and analytical approach, including the ability to assess business impacts, challenge input, identify dependencies, and create a coherent enterprise view

• The ability to translate complex business, risk, and regulatory matters into clear requirements, decisions, and practical actions

• A proactive and collaborative mindset with the ability to drive progress without formal authority

• Clear written and spoken English communication skills

It’s nice-to-have:

• Experience from a bank, mortgage-credit institution, financial infrastructure provider, or another regulated financial-services organization

• Knowledge of relevant continuity and operational-resilience expectations, such as DORA or ISO 22301

• Experience with process management, business architecture, or governance in a complex organization

The role will offer:

• A key role in strengthening BEC’s operational resilience and continuity capabilities

• High visibility across the organization and interaction with senior stakeholders

• The opportunity to shape and evolve BEC’s continuity and BIA practices

• A collaborative environment with strong professional expertise

• A role with tangible impact on BEC’s ability to operate under disruption

Be your best self with BEC's benefits!

We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them.

• Professional development budget

• Healthy, varied lunch and fruit in the canteen

• Active staff associations: yoga, cycling, go-karting, games, bowling etc.

• Pension scheme

• Health and dentist insurance

• Referral bonus

What does the recruitment process look like?

• Send us your CV: We want to get to know you

• Screening call: Let's chat and see if we're a match

• Meet your future manager and team: See who you'll be working closely with.

• Personality and cognitive test: Let's learn more about you.

• Meet our talent partner and your future manager once more: Get feedback on your test results.

• Time to sign the contract: We're ready to welcome you to BEC!

If you have any questions related to the position, please contact Head of Projects & Continuity, Kim Bastholm on +45 61 56 76 10.

BEC is in the process of being acquired by our largest customer and co-owner, Nykredit, which is Denmark's largest mortgage provider and third-largest bank. We will become part of a new and larger organization called Nykredit Financial Technologies. In the transition phase, we are recruiting for roles that we expect to be highly needed in our future organization.

Application due: 12/11/2026

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. Capgemini’s Global Insights & Data business line is a market leader in data, analytics, and cloud platforms across multiple industries, including financial services, life sciences, consumer products, utilities, and the public sector.

Your Role

As a Data Architect, you will work with leading organizations to design and govern enterprise-grade data architectures that enable analytics, reporting, operational data products, real-time processing, and AI-driven use cases. You will combine strategic architectural ownership with hands-on collaboration, translating business needs into scalable designs and ensuring alignment across platforms, teams, and standards.

As a key part of your activities, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, translate business and AI-use cases into scalable architecture designs, review data pipelines and models for alignment with standards, and contribute to documentation, design reviews, and architectural decision-making forums.

In this role you will play a key role in:

• Define and evolve enterprise data architecture including principles, standards, and reference models, ensuring consistent alignment across platforms, teams, and business objectives

• Design end-to-end data solutions and modern lakehouse architectures that support batch, streaming, real-time processing, and AI-driven use cases

• Lead event-driven and real-time data strategies, while ensuring that architectures are scalable, secure, and compliant with regulatory and governance requirements

• Establish and govern standards across data modeling, SQL, metadata, lineage, data quality, and security, while defining approaches for schema evolution, temporal data modeling, incremental processing, and resilient data pipelines

Your profile

• Extensive experience with enterprise data platforms, including several years in architecture-focused roles, designing solutions that support advanced analytics and AI use cases

• Strong understanding of modern data platform principles, including lakehouse architecture, event-driven and streaming patterns, and real-time processing strategies for analytics and AI applications

• Strong proficiency in SQL and data modeling patterns, including Star schema (Kimball), Data Vault, hybrid approaches, and temporal data models (e.g., SCD Type 2), with the ability to design models that support both traditional BI and AI/ML workloads

• Solid knowledge of data governance and compliance, covering metadata management, data lineage, quality, and audit requirements to ensure trusted and usable data across platforms

• Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform) combined with strong communication skills, enabling translation of complex technical concepts into clear architectural guidance for technical and business stakeholders

What we believe you will enjoy about working here

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you can shape your career, work with a diverse collective of experts, and help leading organizations unlock the value of data responsibly.

At Capgemini, you will:

• Work on enterprise-scale, mission-critical data platforms

• Influence data architecture standards across industries

• Balance innovation with regulatory and operational excellence

• Be a part of a collaborative culture that values innovation, entrepreneurship, and continuous learning

Application

If you are ready to take the next step in your career, leading organizations to design and govern enterprise-grade data architecture, we look forward to receiving your application.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as require

Dalea · BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen · Full-time

Starts when our funding round closes

Build full-stack AI agents for science, with freedom, room to be creative, and real ownership, in a lively startup in Copenhagen.

An AI agent is only as useful to a scientist as the data it can see and trust. Dalea gives research labs structured data with full provenance, and we want AI co-scientists that do real scientific work on top of it. You'll own the AI side of that.

What you'll own

• 
The agent harness and the framework for AI co-scientist agents, from architecture to the workflows they run.

• 
Our MCP integrations, which give agents access to lab data with a traceable record of what they do.

• 
Model choices: following the field, testing new models against what labs actually need, and adopting what works.

• 
How we evaluate AI quality.

• 
The infrastructure the AI runs on: inference, model serving and agent execution.

• 
Full-stack work wherever the AI needs deeper integration with the platform, and help elsewhere when the team needs it.

What you bring

Must-haves

• 
You've designed and built an LLM agent system used in production, and made the architecture decisions yourself.

• 
Strong full-stack TypeScript (React, Next.js or close equivalents), and you're comfortable in Python.

• 
You've owned the direction of a technical area, including a significant rework.

• 
You've shipped quickly in a small team or an early-stage product.

Nice to have (none of them required)

• 
MCP servers or clients, agent frameworks or harness tooling (open source counts)

• 
Tools for scientists, or a background in bioinformatics, computational biology or AI for science

• 
Mastra or another TypeScript agent framework

• 
Open-weight models, through inference APIs or self-hosting

• 
Kubernetes

• 
Systems where provenance or audit trails matter

You don't need lab or biology knowledge, a PhD or Danish. Hands-on, shipped work counts more than research or publications. If you match the must-haves, apply, even if you have none of the nice-to-haves.

Our stack

TypeScript, Next.js and React. Python for our MCP service. An agent harness built on Mastra. Docker Compose and Kubernetes, hosted on Scaleway.

How we work

Our dev team is the two founders plus up to three new developers, led by our CTO. We discuss progress and priorities closely and continuously, and we expect you to take part: share ideas early, argue for what you think is right, and change course when the evidence says so.

You won't need permission to fix what's broken, and what you build reaches production quickly. We work together at BioInnovation Institute 3–5 days a week. We're building the team and the way we work, and that happens best in person.

About Dalea

Dalea is a data management platform for biology and lab workflows. Experiments, structured data, samples and inventory sit in one place, with full data provenance. Everything a lab builds in Dalea can be packaged and shared, so we're building a GitHub for life science: labs publish and reuse each other's workflows instead of rebuilding them from scratch. We work with biotech startups, academic labs, pharma R&D and CROs.

Timing and our funding round

This position depends on our current funding round closing, which we expect in February/March 2027. We can make a conditional offer before then, and we'll be open with you about the timing throughout the process.

A data platform for life science research, where experiments, data and workflows stay structured, traceable and easy to share. Dalea is a data management platform for research in biotech, pharma and academic labs. Scientists keep experiments, structured data, samples and inventory in one place, with full data provenance, in tools that feel familiar to anyone coming from Excel and Word. Today, much of that work is scattered across spreadsheets, personal computers and paper notebooks. Results are hard to find and harder to trust, so teams often re-run experiments rather than track down the ones they’ve already done. In Dalea, everything a lab builds can be packaged and shared: templates, add-ons and whole workflows. Labs can publish, discuss and reuse each other’s work instead of rebuilding it from scratch. Think of it as a GitHub for life science. The same structured, traceable data is what lets AI agents work reliably on real lab data. Dalea is built for regulated research. It has a full audit log, 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11 compliant infrastructure, and full provenance for everything that happens in the platform. It’s hosted in the EU. We’re a small team at BioInnovation Institute in Copenhagen, working with biotech startups, academic labs, pharma R&D teams and CROs.

Do you want to build the data foundation for a truly data-driven organization? Are you passionate about modern data platforms, analytics, and AI?

You will play a key role in building and continuously enhancing the foundation for data-driven decision-making across Bang & Olufsen. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, you will design, develop, and maintain data products that enable reporting, advanced analytics, and AI use cases.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and operate trusted data pipelines, lakehouse and warehouse solutions that make data available for reporting, advanced analytics and AI.

• Continuously develop the necessary skills in B&O to promote advanced analytics through Microsoft Fabric

• Strengthen data governance and actively contribute to the development of data processes

What You Bring

You are passionate about data and technology and curious about how analytics, AI, and emerging technologies can create business value. You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy turning insights and business needs into practical solutions.

You will join a collaborative team focused on enabling better business decisions through trusted data. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues across IT, Finance, Marketing, Retail, and Operations while helping shape the future of data and analytics.
