Delivering software excellence and pushing the limits of technology to make some of the world’s best hearing aids is what we do in Demant.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with broad competencies who wants to develop and strengthen our Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL).

You will be deep down the software stack in a crucial and complex part of our software eco system.

Development, defect support and platform improvements

Our HAL platform connects to hearing aids, apps, fitting software and sophisticated internal tools. Seamless Bluetooth solutions and connectivity are crucial for the end-users to have great experience with our hearing aids.

We embrace agile software development and use Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and releases the HAL platform 2-4 times per year. The backlog of features and enablers are executed by priority.

The features are platform support of audiological or end user features. The enablers are typically platform improvements for the future and general internal improvements that can be either specific or of an exploratory nature.

What you will do

Your job can be divided into these three main areas:

• 
Most of your daily life is analyzing, designing, coding, testing and integrating our platform, always done with a broad mindset. Analyzing logs and unraveling mysteries is a key activity in the role and team.

• 
With an ever-changing Bluetooth environment and incoming defects there will be adjustments, which you must react fast to as part of the team. You will also act as problem solver for other teams consuming HAL.

• 
Lastly, you will be part of simplifying HAL to make the solutions more effective, maintainable and secure. In collaboration with the team, you will identify improvements and come up with suggestions for how these should be implemented.

We need everybody in the team to be on top of technology to keep on improving and providing best-in-class solutions. To support this, we have a monthly learning day for the team to acquire relevant knowledge either individually or on a team base.

We invest in and take advantage of AI, that is part of our development environment and tooling.

Teamwork, teamwork, teamwork

Part of your team consists of six Software Developers, two Test Developers, a Product Owner and a Scrum Master. They are all very experienced and enthusiastic about their jobs.

We encourage and strive for T-shaping, meaning that it is healthy that we share the responsibilities and grow mutual skills between developers and test developers.

Scrum is used as the basic way of working and encourages collaboration, sparring and sharing of thoughts and enables the best possible solutions.

It is important that you can collaborate with others and see the gain of it, rather than just working on your own. We hope that you, with your energy and enthusiasm, will contribute and encourage cooperation.

Your manager is a “servant leader” and will support your needs and development in our trust-based culture.

We believe in the good life

In Demant we trust and value professionalism, experience, and commitment. We recognize that to bring energy and inspiration to work, you need to re-energize and spend time with family, friends, and hobbies in a healthy work life balance.

To ensure the good life we offer good breakfast and lunch in our canteen, free fitness room including weekly spinning and yoga sessions, massage offer, no child’s first sick day meaning you can stay home with your child as long as the child is not feeling well and the possibility to work from home up to two days per week. Just to mention some of the things.

Your profile

• To candidate for this job, you need to be Senior Software Developer with minimum 8 years of experience. You have experience with hardware abstraction layers either as a provider or consumer.

• You are proficient in .NET and #C and have experience with Bluetooth Low Energy and/or have made apps; IOS, Android or MAUI, and are able to grasp, navigate and make a difference in a large eco-system of software and hardware.

• You like to understand how things work and to untangle complex issues in the complex HAL world.

• It will be nice but is not required if you have experience from pharma / medico or other regulated industries and know how it impact our work.

• Other people will say you have a high focus on quality and testing at all levels and that you enjoy the respect of others as a team player, where you seek the optimal solution through a constructive dialogue.

• Experience translating business and operational needs into clear requirements

• Ability to combine strategic thinking with structured coordination and follow-up

• Experience working with technology portfolios, digital solutions, or implementation roadmaps

• Comfortable facilitating workshops and aligning stakeholders with varying priorities

• Strong analytical and organisational skills with the ability to bring clarity to complex topics

This role gives you direct involvement in shaping the workplace experience for employees, visitors, and operational teams across Danske Bank. Are you ready for the next step?

If you would like to learn more about this position, please reach out to Andrea Toft, Head of Center of Excellence, Group Workplace Management, at andto@danskebank.dk. Please submit your application by 6 November 2026.

We look forward to hearing from you!

The opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager to join Group Development & Strategy at our headquarters in Humlebæk. The role will have a primary focus on M&A while also contributing to selected enterprise strategy projects. You will help develop Coloplast’s M&A agenda, build and maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities across our business segments, support the M&A Director on key priorities and independently lead selected projects.

The transaction scope spans acquisitions, divestments, minority equity investments and strategic partnerships, as well as integration planning. This is a hands-on role with significant exposure to senior leaders, business segments, global functions and external advisers.

Welcome to Group Development & Strategy

You will join a team of five high-performing specialists across strategy, business development and M&A. Together, we work across group strategy, strategic projects, transactions and post-merger integration, collaborating closely with Executive Leadership and teams across the organisation. You will become part of a distinctive performance culture focused on working together to achieve the best results.

Your key responsibilities includes

•    Support the development of the enterprise M&A strategy and strategic priorities across our business units

•    Source opportunities and maintain the pipeline across acquisitions, divestments, equity investments and partnerships

•    Assess potential targets, including strategic fit, value and key risks, in collaboration with internal stakeholders

•    Support the M&A Director on key transactions and independently lead selected processes

•    Prepare financial models, valuations and business cases

•    Coordinate due diligence across relevant functions

•    Manage relationships with targets, owners and external advisers

•    Support integration planning and the handover to the business

•    Prepare proposals and recommendations for senior management and other internal stakeholders

•    Monitor market, competitor and transaction trends relevant to Coloplast

•    Support on selected enterprise strategy and integration projects

What we expect from you:

•    A relevant commercial master’s degree or MBA

•    5–6 years of experience within M&A and ideally with strategic projects

•    Experience from top-tier consulting, investment banking and/or private equity

•    Strong financial and business modelling skills and hands-on M&A execution capabilities

•    Experience across all phases of a transaction

•    Experience managing multiple high-priority projects simultaneously

•    Fluent written and spoken English

•    Experience working in an international environment

•    Experience from healthcare or medical devices industry is an advantage, but not a requirement

How you work

You are intellectually curious and comfortable moving between the big picture and detailed analysis. You create momentum in ambiguous situations, challenge constructively and know when to involve others. You build trust across functions and geographies, remain composed under pressure and balance analytical thoroughness with the pace required in live transactions.

Role details

Location: Humlebæk, Denmark

Team: Group Development & Strategy

Reports to: Group Development & Strategy Director

Travel: Some international travel should be expected, particularly during active transactions.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. A Snapshot of Your Day

Join Siemens Energy as a Technical Project Manager and lead the technical execution of a large-scale high-voltage substation project: a 400 kV AC substation with GIS (Gas Insulated Switchgear), Control & Protection systems, SCADA, telecommunications and auxiliary systems, which will connect future offshore wind. As the technical authority in the project organization, you report to the overall project manager and coordinate all technical disciplines on the Danish part of this flagship infrastructure project in Denmark, which runs until 2034. From design through installation and commissioning, you represent the technical side in meetings with the customer and a large international project organization, making a significant impact on the future of power transmission and the energy transition.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Leading the technical execution of a complex high-voltage substation project from design through installation and commissioning

• Coordinating a multidisciplinary team of 7-10 discipline leads, scope managers and engineering specialists, and ensuring each discipline delivers its commitments on time and to the required quality

• Driving technical planning and engineering schedules with a clear work breakdown, critical path and intermediate milestones, aligning interfaces and dependencies between work packages and monitoring progress against schedules and budgets

Are you ready to shape the tax function of an international shipping company?

Clipper is enhancing its internal tax capability as part of a continued focus on strengthening governance and decision support across the organisation. We are therefore looking for a dedicated and hands-on Tax Manager to be based at Clipper’s headquarters in Copenhagen.

Today, tax matters at Clipper are handled across Finance, Legal and external advisors. With increasing regulatory complexity and risk exposure, we are establishing a more formalized and proactive tax function. The Tax Manager will play a key role in building this capability and embedding robust tax governance across the organization.

You will report directly to the CFO and work closely with the Head of Legal & Corporate Affairs and Head of Controlling and external advisors.

What will be your responsibilities

You will be responsible for both strategic and operational tax matters across Clipper’s global activities. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

• Establish and maintain Clipper’s tax governance framework, including a tax risk register and clear processes for identifying, assessing and managing tax risks.

• Review the tax implications of material transactions and challenge tax positions and advice from external advisors where relevant.

• Own and oversee transfer pricing policies, intercompany agreements, benchmarking and documentation.

• Monitor and manage cross-border tax matters, including withholding tax, freight tax and permanent establishment risks.

• Oversee compliance with Danish tonnage tax requirements, including calculations, documentation and relevant controls.

• Coordinate corporate tax, VAT and employment tax compliance and reporting across jurisdictions, ensuring timely filings and robust documentation.

• Advise on tax matters related to international employee mobility and contractor arrangements.

• Monitor relevant tax and regulatory developments, including OECD Pillar Two and environmental and emissions-related taxes, and assess their impact on Clipper.

• Act as Clipper’s internal tax expert and trusted sparring partner, advising management on tax implications of strategic and operational decisions.

What we are looking for

At Clipper, our employees shape our work environment, so bringing a positive attitude is essential.

• We imagine that you have a relevant educational background within finance, tax, business administration, law or similar, combined with solid experience in corporate and international tax.

• You have hands-on experience with tax governance and tax risk management, combined with strong knowledge of transfer pricing, cross-border taxation and international tax principles.

• You are comfortable working with external advisors while also challenging and validating tax positions when needed.

• You are structured and analytical, but also pragmatic and commercially minded.

• You enjoy taking ownership, working independently and turning complex tax matters into practical advice and solutions for the business.

• You communicate confidently across functions and levels of the organisation and are fluent in both Danish and English.

• Shipping experience, including knowledge of tonnage tax or other shipping-specific tax matters, is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Don’t meet every single requirement?

If you’re enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You could be the ideal candidate for this position, or for another opportunity with us.

What you will love about us

At Clipper, you will become part of a growing and professional work environment where we strive to be the best. We offer:

• A key role with significant influence on Clipper Bulk's tax framework and risk profile

• The opportunity to build and shape an internal tax function

• Close collaboration with senior management and exposure to strategic decision-making

• A welcoming and inclusive work environment with a variety of socal, sports, and cultural events throughout the year

• Attractive employee benefits, including pension, health, dental and critical ilness insurance

• Beautiful office facilities in Nordhavn, located near the metro with on-site paring, delicious lunch arangement and access to fitness facilities and a personal trainer.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a first interview, while candidates progressing to the second round will be asked to complete a personality assessment beforehand. Working closely with industrial designers, engineers, and suppliers, you will ensure CMF intent is realized with quality and consistency.

You will contribute to defining CMF frameworks, palettes, and material strategies, while collaborating across disciplines to ensure alignment and a coherent product expression. jobs.occupation: PhD Stipend in Experimental Quantum Materials Physics
jobs.description:
Join the Physics Group at the Department of Materials and Production at Aalborg University and contribute to research on the quantum properties of matter at the scale of individual atoms and molecules. This is a full-time, fixed-term PhD stipend for three years, commencing on 1 January 2027 or soon hereafter

**Your work tasks

**The Department of Materials and Production is looking for a PhD candidate in experimental physics to investigate how molecular complexes can be used to engineer quantum properties in materials. The project addresses fundamental questions in quantum science while contributing knowledge that may support future applications within electronics, sensing and energy harvesting. You will become part of the Physics Group and work in an international research collaboration funded by Independent Research Fund Denmark.

Your research will focus on preparing and investigating molecular complexes on crystalline surfaces. You will deposit molecular complexes by electrospray techniques under ultra-high-vacuum conditions and study their structural and electronic properties using low-temperature scanning tunnelling microscopy and scanning tunnelling spectroscopy. The work will involve planning and conducting experiments, documenting methods and results, analysing and discussing data, and communicating findings clearly within the research collaboration and through relevant scientific channels. You will carry out a substantial part of the research independently while collaborating closely with researchers in the project.

Your competencies You hold a master's degree in physics, nanoscience or a closely related field. You have a solid experimental background within physics, surface science or nanoscience, together with documented experience in scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy, ultra-high-vacuum techniques, cryogenic systems, surface science and electrospray deposition.

You can organise and conduct experimental research in a systematic manner, from the planning of measurements to the documentation, analysis and interpretation of results. You communicate methods and findings clearly in English, both in writing and in dialogue with other researchers. The position calls for a researcher who can take responsibility for their own work while contributing constructively to a collaborative and international research environment.

**Qualification requirements

**PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are

You will join the Physics Group at the Department of Materials and Production, where research activities explore materials and physical phenomena relevant to both fundamental science and future technologies. In this position, you will work at the intersection of molecular science, surface science and quantum materials research, with access to a research environment in which experimental methods and scientific discussion form the basis for developing new knowledge.

As part of an international collaboration, you will have the opportunity to engage with researchers across disciplines and contribute to a research project with both scientific depth and technological relevance. The position offers a strong foundation for further work in academic research, advanced experimental physics or research-intensive development environments.

**How to apply

**Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades)

• Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.

Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

**Salary and terms of employment

**The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement).

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.employer_name: Center for Kvantitativ Genetik og Genomforskning
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Quantitative Genetics and Genomics programme. The position is available from 1 March 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Better Nitrogen efficiency by improving Cow Resilience, Eating Dynamics, Breeding and Lifetime Efficiency

Research area and project description
The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) holds a leading position in cattle breeding research, particularly in genetic studies on data generated by advanced phenotyping technologies such as the CFIT 3D camera system through industry collaboration with VikingGenetics. This state-of-the-art system enables large-scale, non-invasive measurement of feed intake, body weight, and milk production data in over 30,000 cows directly in their production environment. This PhD project will leverage this extensive phenotypic dataset generated by CFIT, in combination with feeding parameters and other phenotypes from the Danish Cattle Database, to develop genetic tools aimed at enhancing nitrogen efficiency, resilience, eating dynamics and feed efficiency. The goal is to develop novel genomic breeding values for nitrogen efficiency, while considering other important breeding goal traits (e.g., productivity, health, fertility) and other traits, such as resilience, eating dynamics and feed efficiency. The project will apply advanced statistical methods, artificial intelligence, and cutting-edge genetic models to support and enhance management and breeding decision-making by dairy farmers. This project offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the green transition in agriculture by breeding cows that are both more sustainable and economically viable for the future of Danish dairy farming. We encourage candidates finishing their MSc in summer 2027 also to apply.

Qualifications and specific competences
A relevant master’s degree (120 ECTS) in Animal Breeding
Experience with data handling softwares (e.g., R, SAS, Python, Unix Shell) and genetic softwares (e.g., DMU, BLUPF90, AIREML).
Background in working with Livestock data is an advantage.
The ability to speak and write English fluently is a prerequisite for the applicant.
Can speak and write English fluently is a prerequisite.

Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics, C.F. Møllers Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C., Denmark.

jobs.occupation: Two 3-year Postdoc positions in Leadership Studies
jobs.description:
Copenhagen Business School invites applications for two vacant 3-year Postdoc positions in Leadership Studies, both based on a broad understanding of leadership as studies of both governance, organising and management. One Postdoc position will be affiliated with Department of Management, Society and Communication and the other with Department of Organisation. For more information about the two departments, please follow the links.

The two positions form part of CBS Executive Education’s Talent Programme (ETP). The ETP sets out to strengthen CBS’ leadership related research and education capacity within executive education and life-long learning. Expected starting date is 15 February 2027.

Examples of research areas that the Postdocs might cover:

• Leadership Studies with a particular focus on leadership practices and developments in the Nordic context
• Leadership Studies with a particular focus on life-long learning for working professions
The Postdoc positions are non-tenured positions, each for a three-year period with both research and teaching obligations.

To fulfill the research requirements of the positions, the applicants chosen are expected to be physically present on a regular basis and actively participate in the teaching and research activities of their respective Departments.

Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD or the equivalent. In assessing applications, particular emphasis will be placed on

• Research potential within different aspects of leadership studies in a Nordic context and within life-long learning for working professionals.
• Demonstrable experience with executive education and external engagement based on direct participation in executive education activities, including development and teaching of high-quality offerings in the executive education area.
• Demonstrable interest in developing and co-creating new educational formats that address changing learning and competence needs of relevance for life-long learning, in part by further developing CBS Executive Education’s collaboration with external partners and the CBS Executive Education Foundation.
• Professional proficiency in both Danish and English (written and spoken).
Copenhagen Business School has a broad commitment to the excellence, distinctiveness and relevance of its teaching and research programmes. Candidates who wish to join us should demonstrate enthusiasm for working in an organisation of this type.

The application must include:

• A summary of the candidate’s key abilities and qualifications.
• A complete, numbered list of publications (indicating titles, co-authors, page numbers and year) with an * marking of the academic productions to be considered during the review. A maximum of 5 publications for review is allowed. Applicants are requested to prioritise their publications in relation to the field of this job advertisement.
• Copies of the publications marked with an *. Only publications written in English (or another specified principal language, according to research tradition) or one of the Scandinavian languages will be taken into consideration)
• Information indicating experience in research management, teaching incl executive education, industry co-operation and international co-operation.
• Documentation of relevant, significant, original research at an international level.
• Transcript(s) and a full CV
Recruitment procedure

The Recruitment Committee will shortlist a minimum of two applicants; when possible five or more applicants will be shortlisted. The shortlisted applicants will be assessed by the Assessment Committee. All applicants will be notified of their status in the recruitment process shortly after the application deadline. 

The applicants selected for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and later in the process about the result of the assessment.

Once the recruitment process has been completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application.

For further information please contact: Head of Department MSC Dorte Salskov-Iversen tel.: +45 3815 3181, e-mail dsi.msc@cbs.dk.

For information on the recruitment process, please contact: jobcall.msc@cbs.dk

Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Finance’s agreement with the Central Academic Organisation.

Application: Application must be sent via the electronic recruitment system.

Application deadline: 19 November 2026

Copenhagen Business School must receive all application material, including all appendices (see items above), by the application deadline.

WE TRANSFORM SOCIETY WITH BUSINESS

CBS is a globally recognised business school with deep roots in the Nordic socio-economic model. Our faculty has a broad focus on societal challenges, and we have earned a reputation for high-quality disciplinary and interdisciplinary research and education.
We are located at Frederiksberg and have approximately 20,000 full and part-time students, 800 full-time faculty members, 200 PhD students and 700 administrative staff, and a full portfolio of bachelor, master, MBA/EMBA, PhD and executive programmes taught in English and Danish.
Our global profile carries the obligation to address critical challenges in our research and to develop the transformational capabilities of students, graduates and business leaders via our educational activities and opportunities for lifelong learning. Complex challenges call for joint action, and therefore our strategy focuses on strengthening current and starting new partnerships with other sciences, the business community, authorities and civil society.
CBS is working continuously on becoming a diverse and inclusive organisation, and we encourage all regardless of gender identity and expression, ethnicity, religious beliefs, LGBT+ identity, cultural background etc. to apply.Reach out to us if you need assistance in the application or recruitment process, if there is something we should know, or if as a person with disability you wish to make use of your preferential access.

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Energy Harvesting for Bio-Inspired Flying Robots
jobs.description:
The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics in Odense at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering of the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a PhD position in energy harvesting for bio-inspired flying robots. The position focuses on developing energy-harvesting techniques that use the magnetic fields surrounding high-voltage power lines to support autonomous inspection of power lines. The starting date is 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.  

This is a three-year PhD position based at SDU’s campus in Odense, Denmark.

The section focuses on conducting research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communication, utilizing cutting-edge reconfigurable computing and sensors. The aim is to develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions that solve technology-related challenges in fields such as autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grid, and healthcare.

The section contributes to our educational programmes in electrical engineering in Odense, offering Bachelor’s and Master of Science degrees in Electronics Engineering. Its activities span research, industrial collaboration, and education in electrical engineering and related areas.

The SDU campus in Odense comprises six faculties, bringing together academics and students in an environment that supports interdisciplinary research and a rich student life. Odense offers a vibrant robotics community, cultural activities, attractive residential areas, and green spaces along the river that runs through the city centre.

 

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated PhD candidate to join the FreeFly project, an ambitious research project focused on developing a bird-like flying robot for autonomous inspection of power lines. The PhD research will focus on energy harvesting to enable self-sustaining operation of this bio-inspired robotic platform.

Research Focus – Energy Harvesting for Bio-Inspired Flying Robots

You will investigate, analyse, and design novel energy-harvesting techniques that enable bio-inspired aerial robots to draw energy from the strong magnetic fields surrounding high-voltage power lines. Your research will contribute to the development of self-sustaining flying robotic systems, with the aim of enabling extended autonomous inspection missions.

General Responsibilities

As a PhD student on this project, you will:

• 
Conduct research on energy harvesting from the magnetic fields surrounding high-voltage power lines, contributing to the development of a self-sustaining, bird-like autonomous flying robot for inspection of power lines.

• 
Participate in teaching activities, including course planning and instruction in relevant subject areas.

• 
Collaborate closely with fellow PhD students, postdocs, and other members of the research group in a dynamic, interdisciplinary environment.

We are looking for a detail-oriented, self-driven candidate with a strong interest in energy harvesting and its application to bio-inspired flying robots. If you are motivated to contribute to innovative research in autonomous inspection of power lines, we encourage you to apply.

 

Required Qualifications

• 
A completed BSc and MSc in electronics, electrical engineering, physics, mechatronics, or a closely related discipline. Applicants in the final semester of their master’s programme are also encouraged to apply, provided they complete their MSc before the starting date and meet the applicable PhD admission requirements.

• 
Strong technical skills relevant to energy harvesting, particularly magnetic-field energy harvesting, electronics, and embedded hardware architectures.

• 
Demonstrated ability in academic writing, including preparing scientific reports, documentation, and research publications.

For further information about the position, please contact the Head of Digital and High-frequency Electronics section, Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, e-mail: esme@sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application that clearly explains the applicant’s interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages). 

• 
Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, skills, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, computational skills, relevant projects, etc.

• 
Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). Applicants in the final semester of their master’s programme are requested to submit transcripts from all completed semesters. 

• 
Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

• 
An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

• 
List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

• 
Up to three names and emails of researchers who can provide an informed reference letter at short notice. (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included.)

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 20, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.313 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is from January 1, 2027. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

The position is open from January 1, 2027, and the starting date will be agreed with the successful candidate.

 

Job Content

The Assistant Professor will conduct research within energy harvesting for drones, robotic systems, and IoT applications, with a particular focus on enhancing power density and enabling long-term autonomous operation. The research will further address electromagnetic interference (EMI) mitigation and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) for electronic and robotic systems operating in extreme high-voltage environments, contributing to improved system reliability, safety, and performance in infrastructure inspection and maintenance applications.

The successful candidate is expected to develop and sustain a research agenda aligned with or complementing the section’s activities, establish an internationally recognized research profile, publish in high-impact journals and leading international conference proceedings, and actively contribute to securing external research funding from national and international sources. The role includes collaboration with academic colleagues and industrial partners and participation in national and international research activities.

The position includes planning, teaching, and developing Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses in relevant areas of electronics and electrical engineering. The successful candidate will supervise Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD students, provide academic guidance, and contribute to a supportive and collaborative research and learning environment. The role also includes academic service at section and department levels and participation in relevant professional activities.

A strong research track record in electromagnetic energy harvesting, power conversion, or power management systems.

Research experience in electromagnetic interference (EMI) mitigation and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) for operation in extreme high-voltage environments up to 500 kV.

Experience in the design, development, and testing of drone systems.

Demonstrated experience in international research projects and collaborative activities with academic and industrial partners.

jobs.occupation: Design Engineer - Secondary Packaging & Consumer Experience
jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

As a Design Engineer in Secondary Packaging, you will work as a secondary packaging engineer, shaping how Novo’s cartons and leaflets look, feel and work in people’s hands. Packaging is moving in a more consumer-oriented direction, starting with obesity products for the US market. You will turn consumer insight into visually engaging secondary packaging designs that still protect the product and run reliably in production. Your ideas will help make everyday treatment clearer and more personal for the people who use it.

What you’ll bring

We are looking for someone who brings design thinking and fresh perspectives and has the experience to become productive quickly.

• Experience in secondary packaging or practical packaging design, or in developing physical products from concept through prototyping, testing and implementation.

• Strong visual communication and design-thinking skills, including the ability to develop visually attractive concepts, using Adobe Illustrator or comparable tools.

• Practical skills in CAD, 3D modelling and technical drawings.

• An understanding of how design concepts become manufacturable products, and how choices on materials and production affect product protection and feasibility.

• Strong presentation and stakeholder skills, and the ability to explain and defend your design choices.

• A proactive, curious and collaborative way of working: you take initiative, challenge assumptions constructively and stay calm when priorities shift.

• A degree in industrial design, design engineering, mechanical engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience from consumer goods, premium or luxury brands, beauty and cosmetics, food, electronics or similar industries.

• Knowledge of paper-based packaging, converting or printing processes.

• Experience in a regulated industry, sustainable packaging or structured continuous improvement.

What you’ll do

You will take packaging ideas from first brief to a design that works in production, balancing consumer experience with practical constraints.

• Develop and improve secondary packaging, such as cartons and leaflets, so that it creates a stronger visual and consumer experience while meeting functional requirements.

• Translate user needs and technical requirements into structural designs that balance usability, product protection, manufacturability, sustainability and cost.

• Make ideas tangible through CAD, 3D modelling, visual communication and prototypes that help colleagues make informed decisions.

• Prepare and maintain drawings, specifications and design documentation that suppliers and production sites can work from.

• Coordinate stakeholders and keep development moving through testing, decisions and implementation.

• Investigate complaints, deviations and production challenges, and use evidence to develop and verify improvements.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Secondary Pack, a team positioned at the intersection of Device Delivery Innovation, Quality and Production. **WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path, our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The position as Payroll Specialist - Mid EU will be a part of our Financial Shared Services department, which also includes Accounting and Accounts Payables. The position will be embedded and report to the Global Payroll Manager in the HQ - Copenhagen, Denmark. This role provides potential for growth within the company and the role offers an exciting opportunity for the right candidate to develop their career within Joe & The Juice. The role is a full-time position.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• The overall responsibility will be processing monthly Payroll in the following markets: Belgium, France, Switzerland, Netherlands, Monaco and Germany (Note: all mid-EU payrolls are outsourced; you will be coordinating with a provider - for now; exception made for France and the Netherlands where it is done in-house).

• Responsible to onboard new joiners into payroll systems.

• Reconciling payroll data against accounting records, preparing and reviewing payroll-related bookings and journal entries, and supporting month-end close.

• Acting as the point of coordination between local HR, Finance and external payroll providers to ensure accurate and timely payroll delivery.

• Ad-hoc HR / Payroll tasks as necessary.

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• You have high attention to detail and a strong sense of confidentiality when handling sensitive employee data.

• You have strong communication skills and can liaise confidently with employees, HR, Finance and external payroll providers.

• You can manage competing deadlines across multiple markets and payroll cycles simultaneously.

• You have a proactive, problem-solving mindset and are comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• Experience in multi-jurisdiction payroll, ideally covering 2 or more countries within the Mid Europe market (Belgium, France, Switzerland, Netherlands, Germany, Monaco).

• Fluent English required. Working proficiency in Dutch, German and/or French is a strong asset.

• Accounting experience, including reconciliation, bookings/journal entries and month-end close support.

• Solid understanding of payroll principles and local labor/tax compliance across two or more Mid Europe markets.

• Proficiency with Excel and payroll/HRIS systems; comfortable working with large datasets.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

**The Impact You'll Make

As our Global Inventory Manager (m/f/d), you will ensure the right products are available at the right time across our global network, balancing customer service, working capital, and operational efficiency.

Working within a global supply chain organization, you will take ownership of inventory strategy and performance across regions and sites. As part of a business experiencing significant global expansion, you will have the opportunity to shape best practices, drive continuous improvement, and make a visible impact on our customers and our business.

**What You’ll Be Doing

jobs.description:
Copenhagen (Nordhavn)

• Hybrid

• English working language

**About The Role

**Secomea builds secure remote access for industrial machines. Machine builders and manufacturers use our products to reach and service their equipment in the field without opening up the plant network. The portfolio runs from edge hardware (SiteManager) to our cloud platform, Secomea Prime.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who has built identity and access capabilities in B2B SaaS. You will own identity and access across our portfolio: who can reach which machine, when, with whose approval, and how every session is recorded. You take it from the customer problem to adoption. You report to the Director of Product Management and work in a small team of product managers and UX designers & researchers.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own discovery for your area. Talk to the people who buy and use our products: decision-makers at machine builders, distributors, IT and security leaders at end customers, service technicians, OT engineers and IT administrators. Turn what you learn into clear problem statements and outcomes.

• Decide on commercial grounds. Build the business case for your area (market potential, revenue impact, cost to build, margin) and back your priorities with usage data, win/loss insight and market analysis.

• Know the market. Track competitors, buying behaviour and technology shifts, and spot where Secomea can win.

• Run the roadmap. Plan your area 18 to 36 months ahead, with every theme tied to a customer outcome or a business metric.

• Work closely with engineering. Agree on scope and success criteria together. You own the what and the why; engineering owns the how and estimates the effort.

• Manage the full lifecycle. Weigh new capabilities against the health of live, mission-critical deployments. Set release support windows, end-of-life plans and migration paths for legacy products.

• Keep security and regulation in the plan. IEC 62443 (especially identification, authentication and use control), the EU Cyber Resilience Act and NIS2 shape requirements and release gates for our customers and for us.

• Measure the outcome. Define and track KPIs such as adoption, retention and time-to-value, and use them with customer feedback to decide what comes next.

• Get releases product-ready for go-to-market. Product Marketing owns pricing, packaging, enablement and launch communication. You give them the product input they need: what changes, for whom, why it matters, and the data behind it.

**What You Bring

**

• 6+ years in product management, with a substantial part on a B2B SaaS product.

• Product experience with identity and access management, for example single sign-on, user provisioning, role-based permissions, approval workflows or privileged access.

• Products you took from discovery to launch and kept improving.

• Ownership of a business case or revenue target, and an example of a decision that moved a commercial number.

• Comfort with data: you run your own analyses rather than wait for a report.

• Clear writing, and experience making a case with evidence to engineering, sales and leadership.

**Nice to have

**

• Experience with OT, industrial automation, Industrial IoT or remote access.

• Experience with products that combine cloud, software and hardware.

• Working knowledge of identity standards such as SAML, OIDC and SCIM.

• Working knowledge of IEC 62443, CRA or NIS2.

**This role is not for you if…

**

• You have never managed a B2B SaaS product. OT, hardware or security expertise alone is not enough for this role.

• You see product management as coordination, backlog administration or writing detailed user stories. Our PMs start at the customer problem, set the outcome, and work out the details with the team.

**Why join Secomea?

**At Secomea we rely on initiative and an open mindset, where your creativity and dedication come to use in an open and positive work atmosphere. As we are fast-growing and constantly expanding our business, you will have plenty of chances to grow your responsibilities and competencies while working at the heart of contemporary industrial tech.

We are a truly diverse company with offices placed across the globe, 30+ different nationalities, embracing all genders.

• Your own area. The product team is small, so you own your area end to end and your decisions show up in the product.

• Good timing. CRA and NIS2 raise the bar for remote access in industry, and AI is changing how access is audited and threats are detected. You will help decide how Secomea responds.

• An international team. More than 30 nationalities, with offices in Denmark, China, Japan and North America.

**How to apply

**In your application, describe one product decision you based on data and what it did to revenue, retention or cost.

**General information

You will play a key role in making new products ready for production, contributing to the manufacture and testing of prototypes, and ensuring that experience from production, suppliers and customers is translated into specific product improvements.

In collaboration with PCB suppliers and product specialists, you will also contribute to design changes, ECO/ECM processes and component end-of-life (EOL) management.

• Contribute to the manufacture, assembly and testing of prototypes in close collaboration with development, production and suppliers

• Plan and coordinate testing, validation and verification activities, and prepare and maintain test procedures for printed circuit boards, products and subsystems

• Maintain PCB documentation, design documentation, bills of materials, product data and production processes in connection with development, handover and production maturation

• Have experience in product development, production engineering, Product Engineering or NPI processes

• Have experience with electronics. Experience with printed circuit boards, mechanics or mechatronics is considered an advantage

• Thrive at the intersection of hardware, software, production and supplier collaboration, working closely with developers, production teams, product specialists, service functions and external suppliers

• Work systematically with documentation, quality, test procedures and process improvements

**Additional Information

**We offer:

• A central role in a strong professional environment with a high level of responsibility

• Flexibility, development opportunities, and access to highly specialized expertise

• A workplace focused on quality, innovation, and future-proof solutions

• An informal and collaborative culture that values initiative and professional curiosity

At Force Technology, you work alongside specialists who are deeply committed to their fields and proud of the value their expertise creates. Many choose to build their careers here because they enjoy exploring their field in depth and pushing the boundaries of their expertise.

The opportunity to specialise does not mean doing the same thing every day. Customer challenges, new technologies and cross-disciplinary collaboration create opportunities for continuous learning.

Despite the high level of expertise, the culture is informal and approachable. Colleagues take an interest in each other, share their knowledge generously and are always willing to help.

**Does this sound like something for you?

**If you think this job is for you, send us your application today. We process applications on an ongoing basis and invite candidates for interview along the way. Please note that we only accept electronic applications via our recruitment system.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Troels Balmer Christensen on trch@forcetechnology.com.

We look forward to receiving your application, CV and other relevant attachments.

At Force Technology, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment, and we are actively looking for qualified people candidates regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, disability or age.

**Force Technology

**At Force Technology, we help businesses and society navigate technological opportunities and challenges safely.

As one of Denmark's largest GTS institutes, we play a unique role in strengthening innovation, competitiveness and technological resilience. As an independent expert authority and technology advisor, we help ensure that technology creates value for people, businesses and society.

When you join us, you become part of an expert environment with more than 1,000 specialists across 18 offices in 4 countries working together to turn knowledge into sustainable solutions.

Imagine working on Denmark's most critical systems, turning unique customer data into real value through applied machine learning. As our new Data Scientist, you will play a key role in analysing customer data and training models within our established product. Ready to make an impact?

The job

You will be responsible for generating value from customer data within our established product, which underpins national security and critical infrastructure domains. Our customers are classified and cannot be disclosed, so your work will take place in secure environments, often in collaboration with Product teams, security teams and onsite at customer locations. As this is a newly established position, you will have the opportunity to help shape this role as it grows.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Analysing and preparing customer data for use in our established product

• Training, evaluating and refining machine learning models on customer data

• Integrating models and data-driven features that generate measurable value

• Exploring customer data to identify new opportunities for value creation

• Collaborating with security teams to ensure compliance with national classifications and profiles

Joining the team

You will join an organisation where you will be associated with multiple teams, part of our NSI business unit. We develop and maintain military-grade solutions that support a nation's most critical systems. The organisation is highly collaborative, organised around Products that make a difference.

If you are located in Aarhus, we are open to discussing a hybrid arrangement, but you should expect regular presence in Copenhagen (6–8 days per month).

Your qualifications

We are looking for a data scientist with hands-on experience applying machine learning to real-world data in production settings, who can work confidently in high-stakes, security-classified environments.

• Relevant technical education, Bachelor's or Master's, in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or equivalent experience

• Documented experience with applied machine learning on real-world data

• Some hands-on experience with data science and machine learning in production settings

• Strong knowledge of Python, machine learning frameworks (scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow), SQL and data processing tools

• Fluent Danish and English skills

• A strong security mindset and ability to work in high-stakes environments

Alongside this, we value:

• A collaborative and proactive work style

• Comfortable working independently and navigating ambiguity, particularly as this is a newly established role

• Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities

• Comfortable working onsite at customer environments when needed

Expect travel activity to our HQ in Aarhus and to customer sites, primarily in Copenhagen.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Are you our new Data Scientist – Panels & Survey Methodology?

AudienceProject is looking for a Data Scientist – Panels & Survey Methodology for our Copenhagen office to support our continued growth.

—

Are you a quantitative researcher who enjoys working with data about people? And are you interested in how panels and surveys can make audience measurement more reliable? Then, we have an opportunity for a career in a fast-growing scale-up with 100+ employees that collaborates directly with companies such as Heineken, L’Oréal, LVMH, Omnicom Media, Publicis Media, WPP Media, Amazon, Google, Netflix, RTL and Warner Bros. Discovery.

AudienceProject is a leader in independent cross-media measurement, enabling advertisers, media owners and the industry to trust, prove, and improve advertising outcomes through a scalable SaaS platform.

Our platform provides advertisers with a unified view of campaign performance, enabling confident omnichannel investment decisions, and provides media owners with comparable, third-party validation to demonstrate the value of their inventory.

After more than 15 years of leading cross-media measurement, we are now looking for a motivated Data Scientist – Panels & Survey Methodology to join our Data Science Research team.

Joining AudienceProject will give you a front-row seat in the rapidly evolving advertising industry and an opportunity to work within a respected business, delivering insights about audiences across the world's largest media channels to top-tier clients.

What you will do

You will join our Data Science Research pod, led by Jacob Daniel Kirstejn Hansen, and help turn panel and survey data into reliable audience measurement. Our panelists are recruited through several panel partners. They contribute passive measurement data through integrations and take part in surveys that help calibrate our models. You will work with 10 other data scientists and engineers, bringing together a range of academic and professional backgrounds.

Your focus will be quantitative analysis, panel quality and statistical methodology. You will use Python to investigate data and develop reproducible analyses, working closely with researchers and engineers to improve the inputs and methods behind our measurement.

We actively explore and apply AI in our internal work, production systems and products, combining experimentation with sound analytical judgement. You will help evaluate promising approaches with data scientists and developers and turn useful ideas into practical improvements.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Analyse panel composition and coverage across partners, identifying differences, gaps and potential sources of bias.

• Assess the completeness, consistency and plausibility of passive measurement data, and investigate unexpected changes.

• Design and analyse surveys that describe panelists and their behaviour and provide data for model calibration.

• Contribute to the development and evaluation of weighting, calibration, and statistical modelling approaches, testing how methodological choices affect audience estimates.

• Identify survey-response quality issues and assess the trade-off between stricter quality rules and retaining a representative sample.

• Clean, combine, and analyse panel and survey datasets in Python, with clear documentation of assumptions, methods and limitations.

• Work with panel-partner colleagues, data scientists, and engineers to turn findings into practical data-quality improvements and evaluate their effect.

Who you are

You combine strong quantitative skills with curiosity about how people are represented in data. You enjoy tracing an unexpected result back to its source, questioning assumptions and explaining what the evidence supports. Your background may be in statistics, quantitative social science, economics, psychology, data science or another relevant field.

You bring:

• Strong skills in quantitative analysis and applied statistics, including regression, sampling, uncertainty and model validation.

• Hands-on Python skills to clean, explore and analyse real-world data independently and make your work reproducible.

• An understanding of panels and surveys, including representativeness, selection bias, non-response and measurement error.

• A careful approach to data quality and the ability to judge how data issues affect an analysis or model.

• The ability to explain methods and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

• A relevant quantitative education or equivalent applied research experience.

Useful additional experience includes weighting, calibration or passive behavioural data.

We value thoughtful analysis, openness to different perspectives and colleagues who share what they learn. You ask questions, test assumptions and explain your conclusions clearly.

What we offer

You will join a curious, collaborative and energetic environment where data scientists and developers share ideas and learn from one another. Different perspectives help us ask better questions and improve how we measure audiences.

Our social calendar offers plenty of opportunities to get to know colleagues, with activities you can choose to join. There is room to contribute your ideas, take on meaningful research questions and develop your skills with the support of colleagues.

• Competitive salary

• Pension scheme and health insurance

• Home internet paid

• Central Copenhagen office

• International environment

• Friendly, supportive and helpful colleagues

• Innovative and market-leading products and services

• Real-world panel and survey data, with research questions about quality, representativeness and uncertainty

• The opportunity to improve the statistical methods behind independent audience measurement

• Working directly with some of the most modern and successful companies of our time

Send us your application

We welcome different routes into data science. If this role interests you and you bring relevant quantitative and Python skills, we would like to hear from you.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Jacob Daniel Kirstejn Hansen at jacobh@audienceproject.com. Attention: applications and documents sent via email will not be considered.

We are only considering candidates who are already based in Copenhagen, as we are unable to offer relocation support for this position.

We will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so please don’t hesitate to send your application sooner rather than later.

We are looking for a curious, proactive and relationship-driven colleague to join our Danish People & Culture team.

In this role, you will work across a broad range of HR disciplines, supporting initiatives that improve the employee experience, strengthen our employer brand and help bring various People & Culture-priorities to life. **Help hospitals deploy, operate and get the most from UNEEG software solutions

UNEEG EpiSight Solution, our sub-cutaneous EEG monitoring solution enables remote monitoring of brain activity in people with uncontrolled epilepsy and is already making an impact across Europe and the US. You will initially be part of Technology and later join the new Customer Enablement & Governance team. **

**

**

**

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, come and join Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI), a Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) subsidiary company exclusively dedicated to developing energy hubs globally. We are currently looking for a Director to join our team.

_**Team

Energy islands, or energy hubs, are multifunctional energy infrastructure projects, involving large-scale renewable energy production integrated with conversion technologies to deliver electrons and molecules to demand centers. Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI) is a company dedicated to originating and developing these projects.

You will be working closely together with an experienced team in a high paced, dynamic environment. We bring experts together with backgrounds in commercial, regulatory, development, legal, consulting and financial careers, to name a few.

We are a strong, social, and multi-national team with a passion for making a difference. Our collective character can be described as creative, dedicated, resourceful and humble. We are excited to work on something that is complex and will enable a step-change for the renewable industry.

**Role

**As a Director you will supervise several teams that work on opportunities in a number of markets. You will oversee the activities in technical, commercial, stakeholder and financial workstreams; and you will drive our external relationships with partners, advisors, and (non-)governmental organizations.

Your responsibilities will be to:

• Coordinate development activities with workstream managers that form part of the project development team

**You

**The work environment at CEI is lean, stimulating and demanding, within a global context. We are therefore looking for a self-starting, collaborative, and high-performance professional with an entrepreneurial drive. You have 15+ years of relevant experience from project development or infrastructure investment organizations.

Moreover, you have a background in offshore wind, hydrogen, Oil & Gas or other energy development and track record in bringing complex investments successfully to Final Investment Decision.

Key qualifications include:

• Knowledge of regulatory environment in the energy sector, and familiar with stakeholder engagement practices to shape desired outcomes

• Corporate Development and M&A knowledge

• Experience in commercial negotiations

• Ability to contribute to the overarching logic of business case when dealing with senior leadership and to step into the detail when discussing project specific aspects

• Experience in rapidly growing teams and businesses as well as exposure to critical governance structures and processes in an international environment is preferable

• Team player with the confidence to exercise judgement appropriately, engaging with colleagues at all levels of seniority

• Advanced communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English

• Ability to work well under pressure and take on responsibility

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.
