jobs.description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule
• Weekend work is part of the position
• Salary of approximately DKK 20,000–35,000 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience
• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals
• Work clothing provided
• Staff discounts
• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu
• A workplace where English can be used in daily communication

Location
The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Start date
As soon as possible / by agreement.

How to apply
Please send
• Your CV
• A short introduction about yourself
• Your earliest possible start date

For applications and questions, please contact:
Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar
Phone: +45 25 14 44 00

We look forward to hearing from motivated chefs who want to become part of a strong, established kitchen team in Denmark.

We are looking for an experienced Principal Design System Engineer to help shape and drive the continued evolution of Lighthouse Design System, 3Shape’s design system across web, mobile, and on-premises software solutions.

We offer a workplace culture where you´ll arrange with your people leader when you can work from home and from the office.

Join us in this role where you’ll take a leading role in monitoring, triaging, and resolving OT and SCADA incidents across global wind assets. You’ll coordinate incident response across disciplines, drive root cause analysis, and strengthen operational resilience to ensure safe, secure, and reliable energy production. As part of our 24/7 operational setup, you’ll also join an on-duty rotation for one week each month, giving you the opportunity to take ownership when it matters most and help keep our assets running safely and reliably around the clock.

Welcome to OT Guard & Service Management

You’ll be part of OT Guard & Service Management where you, together with your colleagues, will support offshore and onshore assets by ensuring stable, secure, and compliant OT and SCADA operations across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with control rooms, cybersecurity, engineering teams, and suppliers to manage incidents and maintain high operational standards.

As a team, we we collaborate closely, act with integrity, and share knowledge openly to deliver safe, resilient, and high‑performing operations, even in high‑pressure situations.

You’ll play an important role in:

• monitoring OT system health, security events, and operational alerts across wind assets, substations, and onshore facilities

• triaging and responding to OT and SCADA incidents in close coordination with control room, cybersecurity, and engineering teams

• performing root cause analysis and documenting preventive actions to reduce repeat incidents

• conducting remote diagnostics and coordinating field or supplier interventions when required

• maintaining accurate incident records, handovers, and runbooks to support 24/7 operations

• contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen system resilience, supplier performance, and operational standards.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have experience working with OT or SCADA systems in critical infrastructure environments, or equivalent experience

• understand industrial control system architectures and protocols, such as IEC 60870‑5‑104, Modbus/TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, or equivalent experience

• are confident troubleshooting networks, operating systems, and system integrations in complex OT landscapes

• communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across disciplines, regions, and suppliers

• remain structured and calm when handling incidents in changing operational conditions

• hold a degree in engineering, automation, computer science, cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.

• Processing instrument data in specialized software and databases

• Documentation of laboratory work in the electronic laboratory notebook system

• Responsibilities for maintenance of the lab and lab equipment

• Good collaboration both within and across departments to ensure pace, quality, and exchange of experimental methods and ideas

**Your profile

**You have a mindset aligned with the Zealand values, with curiosity to acquire new skills and learn new methods. You bring a positive attitude and drive, and work both independently and collaboratively. You communicate clearly and have a good understanding of written and spoken English (company language).

**Further, You Have

**

• Education as laboratory technologist, laboratory technician, medical laboratory scientist or similar with at least 3 years of experience with laboratory work

• Proficiency in cell-based assays, including intracellular signaling assays

• Experience with assay automation, including setup and use of liquid handlers

• Hands-on experience with cultivation of mammalian cells

• Strong documentation skills and proficiency with data analysis in Excel, GraphPad Prism or similar software

**Your new team

**You will be part of a department of 17 scientists and 9 technicians dedicated to advancing research and development through generation of in vitro pharmacology and biomarker data, and development of cell-based model systems to deepen understanding of drug mechanism of action. The department is organized into two teams to ensure close managerial support and scientific guidance, and works collaboratively across molecular biology, biochemical, biophysical, and cellular assay platforms to support identification, optimization, and characterization of drug candidates. The position is within our In vitro profiling and signaling team, which focuses on cell-based signaling and binding assays for compound profiling and mechanism-of-action studies.

**Let's bond and be bold

**We have a unique culture, characterized by excellent teamwork and strong engagement across the organization. And we want you to help us strengthen this culture.

Making bonds is at the core of everything we do. From discovering and developing the best new peptide drugs for patients, to engaging with our partners or connecting with each other. We bond through curiosity and playfulness as a team, allowing ourselves to challenge common thinking and drive future innovation. Join us and let's bond and be bold.

Interested in bonding with us? Then please apply no later than November 2nd, 2026, or as soon as possible. The applications will be reviewed as they come in. While a cover letter is not required, please include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

For further information, please contact Head of In vitro profiling and signaling, Karin Hägerbrand and KHagerbrand@zealandpharma.com.

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and welcome applications from all job applicants.

**About Zealand Pharma A/S

**Zealand Pharma A/S (Nasdaq: ZEAL) is a biotechnology company focused on the discovery and development of peptide-based medicines. More than 10 drug candidates invented by Zealand Pharma have advanced into clinical development, of which two have reached the market and three candidates are in late-stage development. The company has development partnerships with a number of pharma companies as well as commercial partnerships for its marketed products. Zealand Pharma was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with a team in the U.S. For more information about Zealand Pharma's business and activities, please visit www.zealandpharma.com.

Full-time | On-site in Søborg/Copenhagen | Visibuilt

Join Visibuilt as we take a fossil-free, fermentation-based binder from the lab to the market. We are looking for an experienced financial controller who would like to be the person keeping a growing climate-tech company financially sound, investor-ready and well organised – from the month-end close to the board pack.

Location: Søborg, Greater Copenhagen (on-site)

Start: 1 January 2027 (or as soon as possible)

Type: Full-time employment

Salary: Competitive and in line with the market, reflecting your experience and responsibilities

Reports to: CEO & Founder, Line Kloster Pedersen

Core focus: Financial control and reporting, operations, grants, board and shareholder administration, financial modelling and fundraising support

About Visibuilt

Visibuilt is building fossil-free alternatives for pavement materials. Our core technology, visiBINDER, is a 100% bio-based binder developed from mycelium and designed to reduce energy use and CO2 emissions in infrastructure materials. We are based at Alfa Laval Innovation House in Søborg, just outside Copenhagen.

The role

Visibuilt has grown from an early-stage startup into a company with institutional investors, an active board, several public grant projects and an R&D team whose decisions need solid numbers behind them. You will be our finance and administration function: the person who makes sure our numbers are accurate, on time and useful for decisions – and who owns the operational backbone of the company.

·       A broad role with real ownership. You will be our only finance person, so you plan and manage your own areas – including the operational processes that keep a growing team running – in close collaboration with the CEO, our CTO, our external accountant and payroll administration, auditors and lawyers.

·       Cash is king. You will own the cashflow budget and rolling forecast, so we always know our runway and spot pinch points well before they arrive. With several grant projects running, customer project, and heavy R&D, this means keeping a close eye on when money actually lands compared with when we spend it.

·       You oversee the bookkeeping. Our external accountant handles the day-to-day entries. Your job is to monitor, quality-check and follow up on their work, and to turn it into reporting the CEO and board can rely on.

·       Real business impact. You get to understand our business and provide market analyses for business development and cost models for R&D.

Responsibilities

Financial control

·       Monitor and quality-check invoicing, payroll and bookkeeping carried out by our external accountant (e-conomic) and approve payments together with management.

Reporting, audit & annual accounts

·       Deliver monthly finance reporting, budget-vs-actual and runway forecasts for management and the board.

·       Take responsibility for the annual accounts and the audit process with our auditors, meeting investor deadlines.

Operations ownership

·       Look after our people operations: keep the employee handbook and policies up to date, and run holiday planning and time registration.

Grant management

·       Manage our public grant portfolio (e.g. EUDP): project budgets, timesheets, reimbursement claims and progress reporting.

·       Support new grant applications with budgets and co-financing plans.

Board, shareholders & governance

·       Act as board secretary: prepare board packs, take minutes and follow up on decisions.

·       Manage shareholder matters – shareholder register, warrant programmes, general meetings, investor reporting and filings with the Danish Business Authority – with support from our lawyers. You coordinate and execute a quarterly shareholder report with the CEO.

Support for business development and R&D

·       Build market analyses (market sizing, segments, pricing) that support the CEO’s commercial work.

·       Build cost models together with R&D and production, so technical choices are informed by unit economics.

Fundraising

·       Be responsible for the financial projections and scenario models used in fundraising and investor dialogues.

·       Maintain our data room and coordinate due diligence processes.

What we are looking for

·       Solid experience in finance – typically 8 years or more – including time as financial controller, finance manager or similar. Experience from audit also counts.

·       Experience with the full finance cycle: month-end close, management reporting, annual accounts and working with auditors.

·       Experience reviewing the work of an external accounting partner.

·       Strong Excel skills: you are comfortable building budgets, forecasts and cost models from scratch.

·       You can explain financial analysis clearly to non-finance colleagues, and you are open about your assumptions.

·       Professional English is required; Danish is strongly preferred.

Nice to have

·       Experience from a start-up, scale-up or SME where you covered a broad range of tasks.

·       Experience managing and reporting on public grants (e.g. Innovation Fund Denmark, EUDP, MUDP or Horizon Europe), including timesheets and reimbursement claims.

·       Fundraising experience: data rooms, due diligence and investor financial models.

·       Board secretary work, shareholder registers, general meetings and company filings.

·       Background from manufacturing, materials or construction – helpful for unit-cost models.

·       Comfortable using AI and automation to speed up routine finance work.

How you work

·       Reliable. You are on time and prepared – especially with investors, auditors and other external partners.

·       You follow through. You see tasks through to completion, and ask for input along the way when you need it.

·       You share your view openly. You raise questions and concerns in the room, and once a decision is made you support it fully.

·       You work in shared systems. Everything lives in the company’s systems and shared drive and you have an eye for making systems more efficient to save time.

·       You use AI with care. For speed – never as a replacement for analysis you have checked yourself.

What success looks like

·       Monthly reporting is delivered on time and of high quality.

·       The annual accounts and audit are completed on time and without surprises.

·       Grant reimbursements and reports are submitted on time, with no rework.

·       Our financial and cost models are up to date and actively used in R&D, business development and fundraising decisions.

·       The data room is kept due-diligence ready, and our operational processes simply work.

What you can expect from Visibuilt

Visibuilt offers the chance to shape the finance and operations of a climate-tech company at a defining stage, in a small, committed team where your work has direct impact.

·       A key role close to the CEO and the board, with real influence on how Visibuilt is run and scaled.

·       An attractive salary package incl. pension, and participation in our healthcare program.

·       A mission-driven company building bio-based alternatives for construction materials.

·       On-site collaboration in Søborg at Alfa Laval Innovation House.

·       Flexible working hours, so you can plan your work around the rest of your life.

·       Participation in our warrant program and 30 days of paid holiday each year.

Not ticking every box?

Many candidates only apply when they meet every single requirement.

If you recognise yourself in most of this role but not all of it, we would still very much like to hear from you.

Application process

Please apply by 6 November 2026 by emailing your CV (PDF) to job@visibuilt.dk with the subject line “Finance & Operations Manager – [your name]”. We review applications and hold first interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Interviews will take place between 9 and 20 November.

A cover letter is not required. Instead, please answer these five questions briefly in your email:

• 
Are you legally authorized to work in Denmark?

• 
Have you been responsible for month-end close, management reporting and annual accounts, including the auditor process?

• 
Have you reviewed and quality-checked the work of an external accounting partner?

• 
What is your notice period?

• 
What is your level of Danish (none / basic / professional / native)?

We aim to keep the recruitment process fair and unbiased, so please do not include a photo in your CV.

We use AI tools to assist in the initial review of applications; all decisions are made by people.

Today we are 12 people with very different backgrounds, and we would like even more diversity – so whoever you are, we would love to hear from you.

Questions about the position? Please contact Line Kloster Pedersen, CEO, at line@visibuilt.dk, and put job@visibuilt.dk in copy. You are also welcome to call our chairman, Kresten Kloch, on +45 42 82 82 12

Practical note

We would like our new colleague to start on 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible.

About the role

jobs.occupation: 170026 Clinical Professor of Otorhinolaryngology and Head and Neck Oncology (Fixed-Term, 5 Years)
jobs.description:
Clinical Professor of Otorhinolaryngology and Head and Neck Oncology 
 (Fixed-Term, 5 Years)

  Department of Clinical Medicine
 Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences

  University of Copenhagen

  The University seeks to appoint a clinical professor of Otorhinolaryngology and Head and Neck Oncology to commence as soon as possible. The externally funded professorship is combined with a consultancy at Copenhagen University Hospital - Rigshospitalet, Department of ORL, Head and Neck Surgery and Audiology in the Capital Region.

  It is a requirement for appointment that the applicant is accepted for both the professorship and the consultancy. In order to be considered for the position, the applicant must send two applications: one to the Faculty (the professorship) and one to the hospital (the consultancy) cf. the simultaneously advertised position of the consultancy. This also applies to applicants who are already employed as consultants at the Hospital. Please find the advertisement for the consultancy at www.sundhedsjobs.dk/

  Both the professorship and the consultancy will be financed by Copenhagen University Hospital - Rigshospitalet.

  Find information about the department.

  Job description
 In the consideration of applications for the professorship, the main emphasis will be on the applicant's ability to document a high level of original scientific work at an international level within the area of Otorhinolaryngology.

  The professor's responsibilities will primarily consist of:

   	
• Research, including publication/academic dissemination – The professor is expected to conduct and lead high-quality clinical and translational research within otorhinolaryngology, head and neck surgery and audiology. Relevant research areas that are prioritized will be head and neck surgical oncology and biomarker development. The professor is furthermore expected to contribute to the development and implementation of new diagnostic and treatment approaches within the field. 	
• Research-based teaching, including associated examination – The professor will contribute actively to undergraduate, postgraduate, and continuing medical education through research-based teaching. In particular, the professor is expected to contribute to teaching and examination within the Clinical Course in Otorhinolaryngology and the Medical Specialty Focused Course and Exam in Otorhinolaryngology, and to supervise medical students, PhD candidates, and clinical researchers. The professor will contribute to the integration of current research findings into clinical teaching, curriculum development, and specialist training. 	
• Research leadership, including guidance and supervision of researchers – The professor is expected to play a central role in the development and strategic direction of the research environment within otorhinolaryngology, head and neck surgery and audiologThe professor is expected to contribute to innovation and societal impact through the development, evaluation, and implementation of new knowledge, technologies, and clinical practices. 	
• Obligation to share knowledge with the rest of society, including participation in public debate 	
• Academic assessments   Required qualifications 
 To be qualified for a clinical professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution, and leadership. Find information about each criterion.

  Furthermore, each applicant must be able to:

   	
• Document a high degree of original academic production at an international level, including considerable contributions to the development of the academic discipline 	
• Manage research and other management functions, e.g. engage in the university’s external academic activities, as well as knowledge and technology transfer 	
• Provide research-based teaching   The professor is also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.

  Terms of employment 
 The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of five years. Extension is possible if the employed candidate performs well in the position.

  For the professorship the appointee will receive a pensionable annual honorarium of 219.882,33 DKK (1 August 2026 level).

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.

  Questions
 For further information please contact Head of Department Nicolai W. Albrechtsen, nicolai.albrechtsen@regionh.dk.

  Foreign applicants may find the university’s International Staff Mobility useful.

  Application
 The application must be submitted in English and must include the following documents:

   	
• Application (Including motivations for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages)) 	
• Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding) 	
• Diplomas (Master’s and PhD and other relevant certificates) 	
• Uploads of maximum 10 publications to be considered in the assessment 	
• Self-declaration form (Template under Nyttige links - Upload the completed and mandatory form as “Other relevant material”) 	
• Teaching portfolio (Guidelines / Template for inspiration under Nyttige links) 	
• Research plan (3‐5 pages) 	
• Teaching plan 	
• A complete list of publications   Application procedure 
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Dean then appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee. When the assessment work is completed, each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at the university's Job Portal.

  Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

  The University of Copenhagen encourages all interested applicants to apply for this position.

  Please submit the application with the required attachments. Only online applications will be accepted. The closing date for applications is 23.59 p.m. CET, Sunday, 8 November 2026.

  Interviews for this position are likely to be held in the month of March 2027.

jobs.description:

Gyldigt kørekort (B) og solid erfaring med kørsel i varebil eller lignende.

• 
Mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsfuld omkring dine arbejdstider og opgaver.

• 
Præsentabel, høflig og serviceminded over for kunder og kollegaer.

Hvad tilbyder ASIYE GROUP ApS?

• 
En stabil arbejdsplads med gode, engagerede kollegaer.

• 
Gode og professionelle rammer for udførelsen af dit arbejde.

• 
Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling (særligt i koordinatorrollen).

• 
Løn efter kvalifikationer.

jobs.occupation: 2-year Postdoctoral Researcher in Abstractions for Quantum Software
jobs.description:
The Quantum Hub at University of Southern Denmark is seeking a postdoctoral researcher for a two-year post to conduct research on abstractions for quantum software. As quantum computing advances towards large-scale fault-tolerant devices, robust hardware-independent software abstractions are becoming increasingly important for bridging the gap between quantum algorithms and physical implementations, and for making quantum computing accessible to software developers. We welcome applicants strongly motivated to contribute to this growing field with expertise in one or more of the following areas:

* Quantum algorithms

* Quantum circuit synthesis and optimisation

* Gaussian boson sampling

* Topological quantum computing

* Quantum error correction

* Fault-tolerant quantum computing

* Quantum programming languages and programming abstractions, including LLM-assisted quantum programming

* Quantum intermediate representations

* Quantum compilation, including AI/ML-assisted compilation techniques

* Quantum software engineering

* Quantum software design and testing

* Developer tools and usability in quantum software

The targeted starting date of the position is 1 January, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Note: We are not permitted to directly contact your academic references, so please ensure their letters have reached us by the deadline.  The application requirements are detailed at the end of this advertisement.  

Requirements
The candidate must have a PhD degree in mathematics, physics or computer science. 

Situation of the position
The position at the SDU Quantum Hub, will be situated at the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science, Faculty of Science on the international campus in Odense, Denmark. SDU Quantum Hub is established with the ambition to create a highly international and interdisciplinary group within a broad spectrum of quantum research. Odense is a fast-growing international community with an open Scandinavian culture, affordable housing and living costs. 

Assessment
Shortlisting may be used. Shortlisted applicants will be assessed by an assessment committee. Applicants will be informed of their assessment by the faculty. As part of the overall assessment, the applicant may be called for interview.

Conditions of employment
The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. 

Information of salary rates can be found at: https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu/international-staff

For non-Danish candidates there is an optional researcher taxation scheme (see the link above).

jobs.occupation: Associate Professor in Public Health: Children and Young People
jobs.description:
At the National Institute of Public Health (NIPH), University of Southern Denmark (SDU), a position as Associate Professor in Public Health is hereby advertised with a focus on interdisciplinary, qualitative studies of children’s and young people’s health and well-being, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

About your future research environment  

The National Institute of Public Health (NIPH) is part of the University of Southern Denmark and is located in Copenhagen. As a national public health institute, we conduct research to improve public health in Denmark and Greenland. At the same time, we contribute internationally to the development of knowledge, theories and methods in the field of public health.

We offer an inspiring research environment in the heart of Copenhagen with skilled and dedicated colleagues from diverse research and educational backgrounds. Here, you will have the opportunity for academic exchange and further development of your own research areas, as well as participation in national and international networks. The position is anchored in the research group Health Promotion and Interventions, which conducts research on interventions addressing public health issues and works with methodological and theoretical challenges related to the design and evaluation of intervention and implementation studies. Our research concerns children, young people and families, as well as vulnerable and disadvantaged groups, and takes place in a range of settings, including daycare institutions, primary and lower secondary schools, upper secondary education, the healthcare system, municipal services, supermarkets and local communities.  
You will actively participate in the daily activities of the research group and work closely with other researchers at NIPH.  

The duties include research, teaching and dissemination within the institute’s areas of expertise, including:  
- Children’s and young people’s health, well-being and everyday life
- The significance of digital media for children’s and young people’s lives and health
- Health promotion and implementation research in daycare institutions, schools and upper secondary education
- Interdisciplinary, practice-oriented research and development projects, including process evaluation
- Advanced qualitative methods, including ethnography, interviews, focus groups and child-centred approaches
- Teaching and supervision at bachelor’s and master’s level, including qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and implementation
- Preparation of applications for external funding as well as project management and coordination
- Contributions to the further development of the research environment, including method development and research group activities
 
The following qualifications are highly valued:  
You have established yourself as a qualified researcher within qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and intervention and implementation research, and you possess strong research and teaching qualifications at a high level. You have a relevant publication profile and extensive experience in disseminating research to researchers, practitioners, and other target groups. You have broad collaborative networks and experience in research collaboration with practitioners. As a person, you are dedicated and possess strong communication skills. You are able to build trusting relationships with students, colleagues, and external partners alike. As a teacher, you communicate up-to-date, relevant knowledge in an engaging, clear and understandable way, and as a supervisor you are skilled, inspiring, and supportive.  

Qualifications  
- A PhD degree in Public Health, Education, Sociology, Anthropology or a related field
- Experience with intervention and implementation research
- Documented experience in research on children’s and young people’s health
- A strong profile within qualitative research
- Experience in collaborating with practitioners, exchanging knowledge and disseminating research
- Experience in national and international research collaboration
- Documented teaching experience at university level and experience supervising students (e.g. bachelor’s or master's students)
- Proficiency in Danish and English at a high level, both orally and in writing
- Documented experience with scientific publications within relevant research areas
 

Further information regarding the position can be obtained from:  
Research Leader Susan Andersen,  mailto:suan@sdu.dk

Terms and conditions of employment  
Appointment as an Associate Professor is for a fixed term of three years, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for associate professor as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation process
Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 
Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material. Interviews and tests may form part of the overall assessment carried out by the appointment committee.  
Based on information from the entire recruitment process, the Head of Institute will decide which applicant is offered the position. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

• 
Motivated application

• 
Curriculum vitae

• 
Master’s degree and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original + verified English translation)

• 
Teaching portfolio

• 
Research plan, including an account of your own research and preferably a vision for future research 

• 
A complete list of publications

• 
Up to six of the most relevant publications. Please attach one PDF file per publication. In cases of co-authorship, a co-author declaration must be submitted as part of the PDF file.

• 
Reference letters/references may also be included

• 
A statement of other qualifications relevant to the position.

We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow merging and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘CV’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

If you experience technical problems, please contact mailto:hcm-support@sdu.dk

Application deadline 18 November 2026 at 23.59 (CET) 

We recommend that as an international applicant, you take the time to visit Work in Denmark where you will find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark, as well as the International Staff Office at SDU.  

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.  

About SDU  
The University of Southern Denmark was founded to create value for and together with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talented individuals. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities, which can only be achieved with the right people.  
The university’s researchers, teachers, students, managers, and technical-administrative staff constitute the foundation of our success.

jobs.occupation: Part-time Lecturer in Responsible Business Governance and Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence
jobs.description:
A position as Part-time Lecturer in Responsible Business Governance and Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence is available at the Department of Management, Society and Communication for appointment on 01 January 2027.

As part-time lecturer you will have the opportunity to apply your knowledge to educate young people and to provide them with insight into your practical experience. At CBS, part-time lecturers represent an important supplement to the teaching done by researchers. Your role as part-time lecturer will also provide you with opportunities to update your theoretical knowledge, to share in discussions with engaged students and to be part of an international academic environment.

The position is on a temporary part-time basis, which can be extended within the framework of the Danish Fixed-Term Employment Act (Lov om tidsbegrænset ansættelse).

MSC’s research and teaching addresses the dynamic relations between business and society and the responsible management thereof. To this end, MSC mobilises a wide range of knowledge within management and business disciplines as well as the broader social and human sciences, organized in three interconnected research environments: CBS Sustainability; Centre for Business and Development Studies; the Communication, Organisation and Governance Research Cluster.

The position includes 

• 
Planning and conducting teaching on responsible business governance and corporate responsibility due diligence, with a particular focus on risk management, reporting and finance between sustainability expectations and compliance. The part-time lecturer is expected to have solid knowledge of sustainability (risk-based) due diligence, international governance frameworks on responsible business conduct, EU law and policy on corporate sustainability, demands on companies, social expectations of responsible business conduct, and business uptake, responses and challenges in the interface of management and growing public regulation of responsible business and corporate sustainability.

• 
Online teaching—blended learning

• 
Student supervision

• 
Preparing teaching materials and exam questions

• 
Conducting exams and other evaluations

Qualifications

To fill this position, you have a master’s degree and:

• 
High-level practical experience at a high level, which has not been gained through academic employment with a university, or

• 
Employment in an academic principal position with another university (e.g. as assistant professor/researcher, associate professor/senior researcher, or professor/professor with special responsibilities).

• 
A part-time lecturer who is employed on the merits based on their relevant practical experience must possess in-depth, up-to-date knowledge of the possible applications of the subject/academic discipline. This knowledge is/has been acquired through employment within the subject/academic discipline.

• 
Employment as part-time lecturer presupposes that teaching qualifications are included in the assessment of applicants for an external professor.

Other skills

• 
In addition to having a relevant master’s degree, emphasis is placed on your specialization and professional skills within the content of the respective courses.

• 
Good interpersonal and collaboration skills and the ability to contribute to a good working environment

• 
Teaching is mainly done in English. Proficiency in Danish will be helpful as some supervision opportunities may be in Danish. The conditions of employment and the qualification requirements are described further in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

Terms of employment

Salary and employment will be in accordance with the Cirkulære om aftale om Eksterne lektorer ved universiteter m.fl. under Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet. The maximum number of working hours per academic year is 500 and may vary as needed in individual semesters. Remuneration is based on the number of hours, which is determined twice a year.

When employed as a part-time lecturer you must take an introductory course on university teaching organised by CBS.

You will be assigned a researcher at the department as your professional contact person. You are expected to participate in professional events relevant to your teaching and you will also be part of the department’s network of part-time lecturers.

The recruitment process

Copenhagen Business School invites all qualified candidates to apply for the position. An appointment committee will review the applications and invite a selection of qualified candidates to an interview.

One of CBS’ strategic goals is the promotion of diversity, which is why every effort has been made to ensure a recruitment process that reduces potential bias. Applicants are therefore encouraged not to include a photo or unnecessary personal information in their application.

Further information

If you would like to know more about the position, please do not hesitate to contact Professor Karin Buhmann, email kbu.msc@cbs.dk.

Your application

To apply, click on the link “Apply online”, fill out the application form and attach the following documentation:

• 
Letter of motivation

• 
CV

• 
Diploma(s)

• 
Teaching Portfolio

• 
Publication list, if relevant for the position

Additional information about CBS and the department is available at www.cbs.dk.

Application due 11/3/2026

Would you like to work for a dynamic and innovative publisher? Do you know what a cover that grabs the reader’s attention looks like? Are you detail-oriented when creating graphic products but able to zoom out to the bigger picture when prioritising your tasks? Do you have experience using AI to work more efficiently and deliver even better results? And are you ready for new challenges and not afraid to find alternative solutions?

Then you may be the person we are looking for.

Jentas (part of Bonnier Books) is a small publishing house specialising in the translation of crime, thriller and feel-good fiction from English into a wide range of other European languages, including Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Spanish, Finnish, Polish, German and more. With us, you will be part of a close-knit team of graphic designers, publishers and project developers, and your tasks will centre on graphic production and on developing and improving graphic workflows.

This will involve:

• Designing covers for Jentas’ many new releases, primarily within the thriller, crime and feel-good genres

• Typesetting and, where relevant, entering corrections from proofreaders etc.

• Ongoing optimisation of graphic workflows, including through the use of AI and new technical tools to strengthen efficiency and quality

• Ad hoc graphical tasks of a smaller nature, e.g. related to the publisher’s social media presence, attendance at book fairs and similar

We therefore envision that you…

• Are an Adobe suite power user and are familiar with other relevant graphic design programs

• Have experience with and an interest in new AI tools, both for use in the graphic work itself and for optimising graphic workflows

• Have a strong eye for composition, aesthetics, typography, contrast, imagery and more

• Are structured and detail-oriented, and thrive when working independently

• Can plan and prioritise your tasks and are able to both set and meet deadlines

• Are good at collaborating internally in a small team where cooperation, sparring and shared development are crucial, and are also able to communicate precisely and smoothly with external partners

• Feel comfortable communicating both verbally and in writing in English and, ideally, another European language, which may be Danish but does not have to be

We also expect that you…

• Ideally have at least 1–2 years of experience as a graphic designer

• Have experience with print production, preferably for book publishing

Please send your application, CV, portfolio and any references by email, with the subject line “Grafiker”, to Chief Graphic Designer Holger Lund at holger@jentas.dk. Feel free to write your application in Danish or English, whichever suits you best. See also www.jentas.dk for a Danish version of this job post.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Process consultant - Viby DK
jobs.description:
Would you like to turn complex procurement processes into practical digital solutions that create measurable business value? And are you motivated by working at the intersection of business, process improvement and technology?

“As our new Senior Business Process Consultant, you will connect business needs with digital opportunities within Procurement. You will join our Digital S2C Excellence team, part of Procurement Data and Digital Excellence, where you will work across Procurement, business functions and digital teams to improve the way we work and help translate business requirements into effective processes and solutions”, says Anette Falk Bøgebjerg, Head of Data & Digital Excellence for Procurement.

How you will make an impact

Reporting to the Head of Digital S2C Excellence, you will play an important role in developing and improving Arla's source-to-contract and procure-to-pay processes. Combining process knowledge, data and stakeholder insights, you will identify improvement opportunities, help design solutions and support their implementation across the organisation.

Your key responsibilities will be to

• Facilitate business process improvements and collaborate with stakeholders to define and document clear objectives, requirements and opportunities for improvement.

• Analyse process and performance data to identify trends, challenge existing ways of working and recommend improvements.

• Design process and digital solutions that support business priorities, working closely with Digital Business Consultants and relevant Procurement and business teams.

• Maintain high-quality process documentation, define and monitor performance metrics and ensure alignment with Arla's process framework.

• Support change management, stakeholder training and the successful handover of improved processes to operational teams.

What will make you successful

For this role, we are looking for someone with 2-3 years of Procurement category knowledge and preferably an understanding of Source-to-Pay processes.

You have a Master’s degree in Economics, Supply Chain, or a related field, are interested in how digital solutions and data can enable better ways of working, and you are comfortable turning business requirements and analysis into practical recommendations. LEAN background would be an advantage.

You do not need to know everything from day one. What matters is that you bring solid knowledge about source to contract processes and are motivated to develop your expertise further in a complex, international Procurement environment.

To succeed in the role, you

• Approach complex challenges with curiosity and use data and critical thinking to understand problems and identify practical solutions.

• Build constructive relationships across functions and can communicate requirements and ideas clearly to different stakeholders.

• Take ownership of your work while actively collaborating with others to create improvements that work in practice.

As Arla is an international organisation, professional proficiency in English is required.

What do we offer?

You will become part of Digital S2C Excellence within Procurement Data and Digital Excellence in Aarhus. The team has adopted agile ways of working and you will work in an  environment where business expertise, data and digital capabilities come together to improve the way Procurement operates.

The position offers an opportunity to build your expertise in business process management and digital transformation while working with colleagues across functions and geographies. You will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful improvements while developing your professional capabilities within a global organisation.

We are committed to professional development and creating a collaborative environment where colleagues share knowledge and support each other in delivering results. You will join a global, farmer-owned dairy cooperative working to create value for our customers, our farmer owners and the wider world.

Would you like to join us?

If you would like to combine your category experience and business process skills with data and digital solutions to help shape the future of Procurement at Arla, we would be pleased to hear from you. Please apply as soon as possible, as we will process applications on a continuous basis and close the recruitment once the right candidate is found.

For additional information about the position, please contact Head of Data & Digital Excellence, Anette Falk Bøgebjerg at anefb@arlafoods.com

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Für das Hotel Hesselet wird ein Kellner gesucht.

Möchten Sie dazu beitragen, ein neues Restauranterlebnis im Hotel Hesselet zu eröffnen? Am 1. März 2027 eröffnen wir das Restaurant Hi – ein neu erbautes Pavillonrestaurant im Hotel Hesselet, das als exklusives kulinarisches Universum mit offener Küche, einladendem Ambiente und einem starken Fokus auf Gastfreundschaft, Kultur und ganzheitliche Erlebnisse geschaffen wurde.

Das Hotel Hesselet liegt an einem der schönsten Orte Fünens. Direkt dort, wo der Wald auf das Meer trifft und man die Brücke zwischen Seeland und Fünen sehen kann. Das Hotel befindet sich in Nyborg, das im Mittelalter der Treffpunkt des Königs mit den wichtigsten Persönlichkeiten des Reiches war. Heute ist das Hotel ein Ort der Begegnung, an dem Gastfreundschaft zur Geborgenheit wird.

Das Hotel ist nach dem Wald benannt, in dem es liegt. Hesselet bedeutet „Ort, wo die kleinen Haselnusssträucher wachsen“. Wir sind stolz darauf, zu Dänemarks beliebtesten Strandhotels zu gehören und bemühen uns, all unseren Gästen ein außergewöhnliches Erlebnis zu bieten – egal ob sie bei uns übernachten, speisen oder an einer Konferenz teilnehmen.

Das Hotel Hesselet verändert sich – und ist in guten Händen

Im Jahr 2024 wurde das Hotel Hesselet vom Carama Family Office übernommen, das eine klare Vision verfolgt: die Seele von Hesselet zu bewahren und gleichzeitig das Hotel für zukünftige Gästeerlebnisse weiterzuentwickeln – ohne dabei die Geschichte und die Wärme des Ortes zu beeinträchtigen.

Die neuen Eigentümer haben mit einer behutsamen Renovierung der Hoteleinrichtungen, des Restaurants und der Außenanlagen begonnen. Es wird sowohl in das Ambiente als auch in die Mitarbeiter investiert – mit einem starken Fokus auf Professionalität, Wohlbefinden und erstklassigen Service.

Das Ziel ist ambitioniert, aber klar: Das Hotel Hesselet soll zu den attraktivsten Hotels Dänemarks zählen – sowohl für Gäste als auch für Mitarbeiter. Hier soll man die besondere Ruhe, Qualität und Atmosphäre spüren können, für die Hesselet seit 1967 bekannt ist – in einer zeitgemäßen und modernen Interpretation.

Möchten Sie dazu beitragen, exzellenten Service und großartige Gästeerlebnisse zu bieten?

Wir suchen einen Kellner, der Teil eines kompetenten Teams werden möchte, in dem stolze Traditionen, hohe Qualität und eine gute Atmosphäre Hand in Hand gehen.

Als Teil unseres Servicepersonals arbeiten Sie in unserem Restaurant, in Veranstaltungsräumen und bei Konferenzen.

Sie werden ein wichtiger Bestandteil des Gästeerlebnisses sein – vom Frühstück und Mittagessen bis zum Abendservice und besonderen Veranstaltungen.

Wir bieten:

• Ein starkes, engagiertes Team mit tollen Kollegen und einem Fokus auf Zusammenarbeit

• Ein Arbeitsplatz mit hohem Serviceniveau und vielen Stammkunden

• Möglichkeit zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung und Übernahme von Verantwortung

• Ein abwechslungsreicher Alltag mit alltäglichen Gästen, Partys und Treffen

• Eine fantastische Lage und ein Haus mit Seele und Geschichte

Wir erwarten von Ihnen Folgendes:

• Er ist ein Kellner und legt großen Wert auf guten Service und Gastfreundschaft.

• Behalten Sie den Überblick, bleiben Sie ruhig und lächeln Sie – auch wenn es mal hektisch zugeht.

• Ist flexibel und kann Termine einhalten

• Blüht in Teamarbeit auf, kann aber auch selbstständig Verantwortung übernehmen.

• Ich interessiere mich für Wein, Essen und Gästeerlebnisse.

Arbeitsumfeld

Im Hotel Hesselet pflegen wir eine herzliche, familiäre und freundschaftliche Atmosphäre – sowohl unter Kollegen als auch gegenüber unseren Gästen. Wir sind überzeugt, dass die besten Ergebnisse durch echte Zusammenarbeit, gegenseitige Präsenz und Interesse entstehen.

Data is revolutionizing sports. Join our team to play.

Director, Platform Engineering – Accelerate the SaaS transformation behind one of the world’s leading media platforms

Do you thrive at the intersection of organizational leadership, platform engineering, and SaaS transformation? Are you motivated by building teams and shared capabilities that enable other engineers to move faster, operate with greater autonomy, and deliver at scale?

At Stibo DX, we are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering to lead a strategically important engineering domain and drive our transition toward SaaS.

The role

As Director of Platform Engineering, you will lead three global teams responsible for Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery. Together, these teams provide shared platform foundations, deployment capabilities, gateway infrastructure, APIs, and supporting services used across the Cue media enterprise platform.

Your primary mission is to accelerate the SaaS transformation. You will develop the domain into a coherent platform-engineering organization that provides standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities, enabling application teams to deploy and operate their services without the Platform Engineering organization becoming a central delivery bottleneck.

A central part of the role is to establish clear organizational boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, and Operations. You will help shape a model in which Platform Engineering provides the shared foundation and developer enablement, while application teams remain accountable for the behavior, reliability, and operational outcomes of the services they build.

You will also lead the organization through this transition. Stibo DX is building toward a SaaS-first future while continuing to support self-hosted and hybrid customers. The role therefore requires someone who can balance the target state with pragmatic migration paths, preserving customer value while steadily reducing complexity and fragmentation.

Reporting directly to the CTO and serving both as a member of the Development Leadership Team and the company-wide Senior Leadership Team, you will lead a domain of 14 people and contribute to the continued development of both your domain and the wider engineering organization. The role can be based at any of our Stibo DX offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, Oslo, or Málaga.

Key responsibilities

You will lead and develop a distributed engineering organization while creating the structure, capabilities, and momentum required to scale Stibo DX’s SaaS transformation. The role combines organizational leadership, platform strategy, developer enablement, and operational discipline, and requires close collaboration with Product Management, Architecture, SRE, Operations, and other engineering leaders.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop the distributed Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery teams.

• Build a coherent platform-engineering organization with a shared mission, clear ownership, and strong execution.

• Accelerate the SaaS transformation by translating strategic direction into platform capabilities, adoption paths, and measurable outcomes.

• Provide standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities that enable application teams to deploy and operate services independently.

• Treat the platform as a product, with clear internal users, priorities, adoption measures, and feedback loops.

• Establish clear boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, Operations, and Architecture.

• Drive platform adoption with the other Development leaders while keeping application migration and operational ownership within the application domains.

• Balance development of the target SaaS platform with pragmatic transition paths for self-hosted and hybrid customers.

• Build a culture of trust, accountability, constructive challenge, continuous improvement, and company-first leadership.

The ideal candidate

You are first and foremost an experienced engineering leader. You know how to create clarity, build effective teams, and translate strategic direction into coordinated execution across a complex engineering domain. You have successfully led distributed engineering teams in an international environment and bring experience from a customer-facing SaaS company or an organization transitioning toward SaaS delivery models.

You understand that developer enablement is how platform engineering scales. You know where a central platform team should build reusable capabilities, where it should provide standards and guardrails, and where application teams must retain ownership. You measure success through adoption and autonomy, not through the amount of work centralized in the platform organization.

You bring sufficient technical depth in platform engineering and SaaS to engage credibly with senior engineers and architects, understand trade-offs, ask incisive questions, guide the overall direction, and recognize whether teams are progressing toward a coherent and scalable platform. You are not expected to be hands-on or to act as the chief platform architect. Your role is to create the conditions for strong technical decisions and hold the organization accountable for sustained progress.

You are a strong people leader known for building trust, developing talent, and creating an environment where accountability, ownership, and continuous learning thrive. You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally across organizational boundaries, and contribute to the success of the wider company rather than focusing only on your own area.

Relevant experience

• Proven leadership experience from platform engineering, cloud-native engineering, developer platforms, or a closely related area.

• Experience leading multiple distributed engineering teams through organizational and technological change.

• Experience with customer-facing SaaS products and the organizational changes required to support SaaS-first delivery models.

• Broad understanding of platform engineering, internal developer platforms, self-service, AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, APIs and gateways, observability, security, reliability, and cloud economics.

• Experience modernizing an established software platform while continuing to support legacy, self-hosted, or hybrid customer environments.

• A demonstrated ability to strengthen adoption of shared platforms and improve autonomy for application teams.

• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to align across engineering, product, architecture, and operations.

• Fluency in English, spoken and written.

Interested?

Please apply through LinkedIn. We review applications as they are received and encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview. The position will remain open until we have found the right candidate.

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Chief Technology Officer Jesper Broni Andersen by email at jba@stibodx.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Saab Danmark A/S - Chief Product Officer
jobs.description:
Saab Danmark is entering an exciting phase of growth and transformation. We are looking for a Chief Product Officer (CPO) who can define direction, drive execution, and lead the evolution of our products, technology, and product organization. You will play a key role in strengthening our product platform, advancing our digital capabilities, and positioning Saab Danmark for sustainable long-term growth.

Reporting to the CEO and serving as a member of the Danish Management Team, you will hold overall responsibility for Saab Danmark's Product Organization, including Product Management and Product Development across Software, Hardware, Systems Engineering, and Testing.

As CPO, you will play a pivotal role in shaping Saab Danmark's next chapter. While ensuring successful delivery across an active project portfolio, you will lead the transition towards a stronger product-centric approach, where a scalable core platform enables future innovation, customer solutions, and digital services.

This role requires a leader who can combine strategic vision with operational excellence, create followership across the organization, and unite technology, product development, and business priorities into one coherent direction.

Key responsibilities

• 
Define, maintain, and drive the overall product, technology strategy in alignment with Saab’s vision, business objectives, and future market opportunities.

• 
Develop and execute a product roadmap that balances short-term delivery commitments with long-term product and technology investments.

• 
Lead and develop the Product Organization through Product Management, Software, Hardware, Systems Engineering, and Testing leadership teams.

• 
Strengthen Product Management capabilities and ways of working, ensuring clear ownership of product strategy, portfolio priorities, roadmap decisions, and customer value creation across the organization.

• 
Drive the evolution towards a more software-defined, cloud-enabled, and service-oriented product architecture, translating emerging technologies and digital trends into sustainable customer value.

• 
Ensure alignment between customer needs, business priorities, technology development, and product investments.

• 
Establish and strengthen the core product platform, enabling future customer solutions to be delivered through configuration, extension, and scalable reuse rather than repeated customization.

• 
Foster organizational effectiveness, accountability, and execution across the full product lifecycle.

• 
Build an aligned and high-performing leadership team by creating clarity, strengthening leadership capabilities, and fostering commitment to a shared direction across experienced technical leaders and specialist disciplines.

• 
Ensure clear prioritization of resources and development initiatives across competing demands.

• 
Safeguard the long-term direction, architecture, and integrity of Saab Danmark’s product portfolio.

• 
Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, learning, and ownership.

• 
Contribute actively to company strategy and decision-making as a member of the company Management Team.

What you bring

You are an experienced product and technology leader with a strong track record from Product Management, Software Engineering, Product Development, or similarly complex technology-driven environments.

You have successfully led organizations through growth, change, and transformation and know how to create results through clear direction, strong leadership, and effective collaboration.

You are comfortable operating at both strategic and operational levels and have demonstrated the ability to translate ambitious visions into tangible business outcomes.

Ideally, you bring:

• 
Experience from software-centric or software-defined product environments where product strategy, engineering excellence, and customer value creation are closely connected.

• 
Strong experience with Product Management, product strategy, roadmap management, and portfolio prioritization.

• 
A solid understanding of modern software development practices, platform thinking, and cloud technologies.

• 
Experience leading product, platform, cloud, or digital transformation initiatives and translating strategic ambitions into measurable organizational and business outcomes.

• 
Experience balancing the demands of ongoing customer deliveries with the long-term development of scalable products, platforms, and capabilities.

• 
The ability to balance operational delivery with long-term capability building.

• 
A strong commercial mindset combined with a deep appreciation for technology and innovation.

• 
The ability to navigate competing priorities and make clear decisions in complex environments.

• 
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to create alignment across diverse functions and leadership levels.

• 
Experience building trust, credibility, and followership in organizations with highly experienced technical leaders and specialists.

• 
Curiosity about emerging technologies and their potential impact on products, services, and business models.

In addition, you must be able to obtain and maintain the security clearance required by Danish Defence Intelligence Service for this position. This typically requires candidates to have resided within a NATO or EU member state for the past seven years.

Who you are

You are a pragmatic leader who combines strategic thinking with operational discipline.

You create clarity in complex environments, make priorities visible, and build followership through professional credibility, sound judgement, and consistent leadership. You are comfortable leading experienced managers and specialists and create alignment and commitment around a shared direction.

Why Saab Danmark?

This is an opportunity to play a defining role in shaping the future of Saab Danmark. You will influence the direction of our products, contribute to company strategy, and help position Saab Danmark for its next stage of growth.

If you are motivated by building great products, shaping organizational direction, and creating lasting business impact, this is an opportunity to play a key role in Saab Danmark's continued development and growth.

For further information about the position, please contact Flemming Klovborg, LOHFF | THORNING Partner at +45 4314 4202. All inquiries will be handled with complete confidentiality.

Applications should be submitted through the application link.

jobs.occupation: AIV Planner - help turn spacecraft assembly into a scalable production flow
jobs.description:
In our Satellite Assembly, Integration, and Verification Team, you will be at the center of planning how spacecraft are assembled, integrated, tested, and tracked. You will translate complex AIV activities into executable production flows and system structures, while coordinating the interfaces that make the flow work in practice. If you combine strong systems understanding with structure, initiative, and a drive to build better solutions, this is your opportunity to shape how we manufacture satellites.

About the Position as AIV Planner

As AIV Planner, you will own the planning framework supporting spacecraft assembly and verification. You will establish and maintain production flows, routings, and planning data in our ERP system while coordinating activities across AIV, production, project management, and logistics to ensure efficient execution.

You will play a key role in developing scalable planning processes, improving digital ways of working, and connecting future ERP and MES capabilities to the needs of spacecraft production. Your experience and ideas will directly influence a more controlled, digital, and scalable production flow.

Responsibilities include:

You will ensure that spacecraft build plans are translated into controlled and executable work in our operational systems, while aligning the interfaces needed for reliable AIV execution.

Production Planning and System Execution

• Create and maintain AIV routings, production orders, planning parameters, and relevant production master data in the ERP system.

• Translate engineering structures and AIV plans into practical production sequences with clear dependencies, revisions, effectivity, and material requirements.

• Monitor order progress and data quality, resolve planning issues, and help establish the ERP system as the operational source of truth for spacecraft build execution.

Cross-functional Planning and Material Flow

• Coordinate with Electronic Production, Project Management, AIV, engineering, warehouse, and other planners to align readiness, priorities, materials, and handovers.

• Coordinate AIV inventory and material flow, including allocation, kitting, shortages, transfers, returns, and controlled movement of hardware.

Configuration, Change, and Improvement

• Maintain configuration and traceability in the ERP system, including correct parts, revisions, serial numbers, routings, effectivity, material movements, and as-built status.

• Assist the ECR/ECO process by identifying affected routings and production orders, supporting change-impact assessment, and implementing approved changes in the ERP system with the required traceability.

What you bring

At GomSpace, it’s not just your technical skills that matter - your character is also important. We value individuals who bring a positive, proactive attitude and can build trust across cultures. The ideal candidate will be comfortable taking ownership in an environment that is still being built, combining a strong systems understanding with practical knowledge of production flows and the ability to quickly learn new tools and processes.

You likely:

• Have minimum 3 years of experience in production planning, working with ERP, MES, or similar operational systems. Experience with IFS is a strong plus, but not mandatory.

• Practical understanding of production flows, routings, production orders, material availability, sequencing, and master data.

• Ability to understand system relationships and translate engineering and operational inputs into a clear, executable production flow.

• Experience with configuration management, revision control, serial-number traceability, and as-built records.

• Ability to coordinate across multiple interfaces and turn incomplete or changing inputs into a structured plan.

• Strong drive, ownership, and a solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to establish and improve processes rather than only operate existing ones.

• Clear written and verbal communication in English.

Here’s why you’ll love working with us:

At GomSpace, we’re on a mission to shape the future of space – one mission at a time. Here, you’ll be part of something bigger than just a project or a product. You’ll help build systems that connect people, enable science and expand humanity’s reach beyond Earth.

We believe the best results come when talented people are trusted, supported, and inspired to push boundaries together.

• Be part of a global company making a real impact in the space industry

• Get freedom under responsibility from day one – and grow with us

• Join a dynamic, full-service environment where no two days are alike

• Work across borders and build a strong international network

• Be part of a culture where collaboration beats competition – and milestones are celebrated together

Join our mission

You are welcome to send your application in Danish or English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. Apply for the job by following the link below.

If you have any questions with regard to the position do not hesitate to contact: Simon Holt Olsen, Head of AIV, shol@gomspace.com.

Workplace will be at our premises at Langagervej 6, Aalborg, Denmark and it is expected that most of the time is in the offices.

As part of our recruitment process, employment requires you to complete a background check conducted by an authorized third-party provider in accordance with applicable legislation.

At GomSpace WE MAKE SPACE YOURS

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturized radio technology. At the core of our mission are our core values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, and show true leadership.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. We have more than 300 employees servicing customers in more than 60 countries. Learn more on www.gomspace.com

Join us in shaping the future of space exploration!

Are you ready to turn strategy into action and create visible impact at the heart of a dynamic production site?

At Kruså Dairy, we are looking for a commercially minded and highly structured Business Development Manager who can connect strategy, people and execution. Working closely with the Site Director and the site leadership team, you will help shape the direction of the dairy and ensure that the right priorities and projects move forward.

If you enjoy the analytical and strategic side of consulting but want to get closer to implementation and see the results of your work, this could be the right next step for you.

How you will make an impact

As Business Development Manager, you will act as a trusted sparring partner and right hand to the Site Director. You will consolidate input from across the site, translate strategic ambitions into a clear business plan and create alignment on the initiatives that will deliver the greatest value. The environment is fast-moving, and priorities can change quickly, so your ability to bring structure, remain agile and keep stakeholders connected will be key.

Your main responsibilities will be to

• 
Drive the strategic business planning process by gathering input across the site, challenging assumptions and translating priorities into a coherent short- and long-term plan for our product growth and innovation ambitions

• 
Turn strategy into execution by identifying, structuring and driving larger cross-functional projects that improve site performance and support Kruså Dairy’s ambitions. Drive our sustainability agenda to reduce our CO2 footprint with innovation projects at our waste water plant or reducing energy consumptions of our production facility

• 
Build strong investment cases by aligning CAPEX, savings and improvement opportunities with the site leadership team, Finance and the central CAPEX stakeholders in Viby

• 
Support fact-based decision-making through clear analyses, business cases, presentations, performance insights and decision material for the Site Director and leadership team

• 
Create alignment and momentum by connecting stakeholders, communicating strategic priorities and following up on actions, milestones and value delivery across the project portfolio

The role is based at Kruså Dairy, where you will work closely with the Site Director, the site leadership team and key stakeholders across Arla, including Finance and CAPEX colleagues in Viby. While the role offers a high degree of independence, your success will depend on your ability to involve others, listen to different perspectives and create shared ownership of the site’s agenda. There is flexibility to balance time on site and working from home in line with business and team needs.

What will make you successful

We are looking for a person who brings a strategic and analytical mindset and enjoys turning complex information into clear priorities and practical actions. You are structured, curious and proactive, and you feel comfortable taking ownership while also involving others and valuing their perspectives. With a flexible and constructive approach, you navigate changing priorities and build trusting relationships through sound judgement, openness and clear communication.
