You do not need to be a specialist in every system, but you are motivated to investigate issues, perform structured trouble shooting, and coordinate the right technical support.

**To Succeed In This Position, We Imagine That You

**

• Have a technical background within telecom, networking or related field

• Have practical experience with technical troubleshooting and fault handling

• Strong Microsoft Office software knowledge

• Are comfortable using ticketing systems and documenting technical findings, customer communication, and agreed actions

• Communicate clearly in written and spoken English

• Are willing and able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation

Experience with telecom systems such as PABX, TETRA, VHF, AIS, CCTV, PAGA, LTE or Network infrastructure would also be beneficial. General knowledge with, Window, Linux, Proxmox, Zabbix, TOPdesk, or comparable systems, but your technical curiosity and willingness to learn are equally important.

**Welcome to Semco Maritime

**At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

**The Impact You'll Make

**Our IT Infrastructure Department at Danfoss is looking for an experienced colleague – Senior Professional, IT Client Engineer.

You will play a crucial part in ensuring the security, stability, and performance of our client/endpoint environment. This position, in alignment with the international team and service owners, involves managing our endpoint management systems, deploying software and security policies, resolving complex end-user technical issues, and optimizing the overall client architecture for performance and security. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background in client engineering, excellent problem-solving skills, and a proven track record of managing complex end-user computing environments

This is your opportunity to join a dedicated team of professionals in a dynamic and innovative environment. At Danfoss, you will have the chance to make a real impact, work with leading-edge technology, and grow your career in a global company that is committed to sustainability and engineering a better future.

Your work location shall be either in **Sofia (Bulgaria) or Nordborg (Denmark). The job can be hybrid

****What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Drive the performance, reliability, and scalability of our global Windows and macOS endpoint environment, ensuring employees have a secure and productive digital workplace.\

• Strengthen our security posture by implementing and optimizing endpoint security solutions, compliance standards, and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) technologies.

• Act as a senior technical expert for complex endpoint and device-related challenges, identifying root causes and delivering long-term solutions that improve user experience.

• Shape and evolve our global client architecture through automation, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance performance and operational efficiency.

• Partner with colleagues across Security, Networking, Infrastructure, and Applications teams to deliver integrated solutions and maintain a high-quality end-user experience.

**What We're Looking For

**

• 3+ years of experience in IT Client Engineering, Endpoint Management, or a similar role supporting large-scale enterprise environments.

• Strong expertise in Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Endpoint Manager (MEM), SCCM, co-management, and endpoint lifecycle management.

• Hands-on experience with Windows and macOS administration, endpoint security practices, and cloud identity solutions such as Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).

• Solid scripting and automation skills, preferably using PowerShell, combined with a proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.

• Experience with ZTNA solutions such as Appgate is considered an advantage. Relevant Microsoft certifications are welcome but not required.

• Strong communication skills, the ability to collaborate effectively in a global team, and fluency in English, both written and spoken.

• Willingness and ability to travel internationally when needed.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits on top of your salary. More information shall be provided during the recruitment process.

Do you want to work for an Architecture firm with sustainability at the heart of its strategy? Can you contribute with solutions from your academic studies? Are you currently studying to be an Architect? Then, join us to shape a sustainable and liveable world.

About us

Arkitema was established in 1969 making us one of Denmark's oldest architectural firms. Today, we are well positioned in Scandinavia with offices in Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

In our markets we provide wide range of competencies in our areas of expertise. We cover sectors and disciplines like healthcare, industry, transformation, landscape and residential construction.

Since 2019 Arkitema has been part of COWI, one of Scandinavia’s leading engineering and consultancy companies. Together with customers, partners and colleagues, we shape a future where people and societies grow and flourish. We do that by co-creating more sustainable and beautiful solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and many generations ahead.

Create Solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

As an intern at Arkitema, you will be part of a design team in one of Scandinavia's largest and leading architectural firms, where you will work with experienced architects, construction architects, urban planners and engineers to solve a wide range of professionally relevant tasks.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• To use your academic knowledge of architectural fundamentals to contribute to our projects

• Gain valuable experience in the field of architecture and construction

Also, you will be included in a team and assigned an experienced colleague as a mentor who will guide you throughout your internship. We carry out architecture primarily throughout the Nordic region but also other parts of the world within the areas of; Housing, Learning, Business, Health, Urban, Culture and Infrastructure. Therefore, our assignments range from small preservation-worthy residential neighborhoods to complex super hospitals, bridges and cultural centers.

As an intern, you will have the opportunity to be involved in drawing the first lines, registering old building masses, supervising construction sites on ongoing projects, or modeling and detailing the many complex buildings. Our professional span will give you a broad understanding of the design profession and in-depth knowledge of the workflows in the construction industry.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners, or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you’ll have:

• Actively pursuing either a bachelor's or master's degree in Architectural Program or similar.

• Have good problem-solving skills

• Be a creative and technical thinker

• Be able to demonstrate evidence of research and information gathering skills

Professional development

We strive to develop talented interns who graduate with a high level of professional skills. As part of the internship at Arkitema, there are ongoing presentations where our own specialists share their experience and best practices in topics such as:

• Sustainability, materials & reuse

• BIM, Revit, design & sketching

• Client consultancy & tendering

• Restoration & building preservation

• Competitions & visualizations

• Descriptions & quality assurance

• Urban Planning

These topics represent important knowledge and practical insights that will ensure you stand stronger in your future career.

A place to work and so much more

At Arkitema, we work together with our customers to shape sustainable and customized solutions. By making use of our collective knowledge and curiosity, we create opportunities that contribute to good solutions for a future with ever-changing needs.

We want to develop an environment where curiosity, belonging and good chemistry are in focus.

For us, it is important that the people we share everyday work with are allowed to be themselves, precisely because it is what brings out the best in you and those around us, both at work and at home.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role, please reach out to Susanne Bergholdt Damsted – subd@arkitema.com for Aarhus/Aalborg and Charlotte Lin Pedersen – capd@arkitema.com for Copenhagen.

Get to know us even better at our website, Arkitema where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at Arkitema.

Diversity is fundamental to Arkitema, inclusion is key.

We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are considered valuable. We also take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes when we put together teams and forums. We are looking for a VP People & Culture to lead Boyum IT’s global People agenda and help ensure that our organization, leadership, culture and people practices continue to support our business ambitions and long-term growth.

About the role

This is a senior leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, with close collaboration across the organization.

A central part of the role is being a visible ambassador for our culture and values. Our Energy for LIFE culture — Family, Social, Fit and Excellence — is an important part of who we are, and you will play a key role in protecting what works, strengthening what matters and helping the culture evolve as the business develops.

The role combines strategic People leadership with a pragmatic and hands-on approach. You will advise the CEO and senior leadership on organizational, leadership and People matters while making sure our People practices, leadership capabilities and employee experience work effectively in everyday life.

Key responsibilities

People Strategy, Organization & Leadership

• Lead the global People strategy aligned with Boyum IT’s business priorities.

• Advise the CEO and senior leadership on people, organization, leadership and culture.

• Lead organizational design, workforce planning, succession and leadership development.

• Use workforce data and insights to support business and organizational decisions.

Culture & Employee Experience

• Act as a visible culture ambassador and role model for Boyum IT and Energy for LIFE.

• Protect and strengthen the culture as the organization develops and changes.

• Ensure culture is reflected in leadership behaviour, collaboration, decision-making and People practices.

• Oversee engagement, well-being, retention and employee experience.

• Translate employee feedback into meaningful improvements.

Talent, Performance & Reward

• Oversee attraction, development and retention of talent.

• Ensure meaningful leadership and specialist career paths.

• Lead the approach to performance, development, compensation and benefits in collaboration with leaders and Finance.

Change, Governance & Risk

• Lead the people and culture aspects of transformation, restructuring and M&A integration.

• Ensure scalable global People policies, governance and employment compliance.

• Oversee employee relations, employment risk and relevant external stakeholder relationships.

People Operations, Data & ESG

• Lead and develop the People team.

• Ensure efficient and scalable People operations and continue developing HiBob as our central HR platform.

• Use People data and analytics to support decisions.

• Own the people-related ESG and social sustainability agenda in partnership with Finance.

Leadership expectations

As VP People & Culture, you are expected to lead beyond the People function. You put Boyum IT’s overall interests ahead of functional interests, act as a trusted and constructive advisor to the CEO and leadership team and combine strategic thinking with pragmatic execution. You build trust across countries and functions, create clarity and accountability, and consistently role-model our Energy for LIFE culture.

What we expect you to bring

• 10+ years of progressive People/HR experience, including senior HR leadership responsibility.

• Strong business understanding and the ability to translate business priorities into organizational, leadership and people priorities.

• Experience with organizational development, leadership advisory, workforce planning, talent, succession and change.

• International experience from a multi-country organization.

• Experience leading and developing a People/HR team.

• Strong stakeholder management and the ability to advise and challenge senior leaders constructively.

• A pragmatic and hands-on approach, with the ability to move between strategic topics and day-to-day realities.

• High integrity, sound judgment and discretion.

• Full professional proficiency in English; German is a strong advantage.

• Experience from a private equity-backed environment and/or M&A or integration work is a strong advantage.

You are a visible and credible culture ambassador who builds trust across the organization, leads by example and helps ensure that our Energy for LIFE culture is reflected in how we lead, collaborate and make decisions.

Success in the role

Success in this role means that Boyum IT has the right organizational structure, leadership capability and people practices to support the business; that leaders are equipped to lead effectively; and that our Energy for LIFE culture remains strong, visible and recognizable as we grow and change.

About Boyum IT

Boyum IT is an international software company with colleagues across multiple countries and more than 50 nationalities.Our culture is built around Energy for LIFE — Family, Social, Fit and Excellence — reflecting our ambition to create an environment where people can perform, develop and thrive while contributing to the success of the company. We believe strong business performance and a healthy workplace should reinforce each other.

Work conditions

• Full-time position

• Based in Aarhus

• Office-based or hybrid work environment

• International collaboration across countries, functions and time zones may be required

Interested?

**Then this job as Technical Project Manager for Quantum Systems at Hamamatsu Photonics may be the right job for you!

**

**More about you:

• A relevant educational qualification (Master level) is required, preferably gained within a photonics research environment

**Description

**At Factbird, we help manufacturers see what’s really happening on their lines—so they can make better, faster decisions. Our plug-and-play hardware and cloud platform turn live production data into clear insights, and we’re scaling fast across sites, teams, and countries.

We want to use AI wherever it can create meaningful value for Factbird: improving productivity, quality and the way people work.

Some of our teams use AI every day. Others have barely started. What we're missing is someone who finds where AI should go, builds it, and makes sure it sticks, then helps

everyone else get more out of what they already use, at the right cost. A patch here and a small workflow there won't cut it. You'll get into every department, find what should be built, and build it, while communicating priorities and tradeoffs to the team.

**

About the role

**This is a mid-career, professional-level position on Factbird’s career ladder and a hybrid role in terms of skills: technical enough to question how the tools work, hold your own with our engineers and build agents and automated flows yourself; organised enough to run a company-wide roadmap; and good with people, so what you build actually gets used.

It’s also a brand-new role, so there’s both the opportunity and the need for you to help define it. You’ll thrive here if you like owning a broad, loosely defined area and figuring out for yourself what matters most.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your first 90 days

• Own the setup and the bill. You take over the administration, licensing and cost management of our AI tools: connectors, MCP servers, permissions, workspace setup and caching that keeps cost and performance in check. From week one, you start building a clear picture of what we spend and where.

• Learn the company. You meet every department, learn their processes, and piece together how Factbird works as a whole

• Build the roadmap. You identify what AI should streamline, what’s competing for attention and what comes first based on where we can create the most value. You tell us what to tackle and what to drop.

• Run the first initiative. Take the top item off your roadmap and deliver it, start to finish

Beyond 90 days

• 
Pick the stack. You lead decisions on which AI platforms we keep, add or stop using, based on what works best for the company and its departments.

• 
Stay ahead. You keep up with what’s happening in AI and bring relevant ideas back to Factbird early.

• 
Deliver the roadmap, in two modes:

• 
Builder: where nobody has the time or know-how to start, you design and build the agents and automated flows yourself, hand them over, and drive the adoption so they actually get used

• 
Consultant: many people across Factbird already work with AI. You show them how to use it better and turn the best of their work into shared skills, prompts and agents that everyone can use.

• 
Keep it safe. You build appropriate quality checks into AI processes and own our AI usage guidelines and security practices together with Security & Compliance.

• 
Prove it. You measure the impact AI is having, good and bad, and can show cost against benefit

**About you

**You've spent the last few years in the details of AI. You don't have to be a developer, but your understanding is advanced:

• Not just "How is AI priced?" but “How can we reduce our API costs without compromising output quality?”

• Not just “What is an agent?” but “When should we build one, how should we build it, and when would a multi-agent setup make sense?”

• Not just “What is an LLM?” but “Which model fits this task, and when shouldn’t we use AI at all?”

• Not just “Is it safe?” but “What controls, permissions and human oversight does this agent need?”

• You've done it for real. You’ve taken a real business process and improved or automated it using AI.

• You know how to run a project**.** You don’t need to have held a project lead title. Consulting, operations, product or engineering experience all count, as long as they have made you great at planning and delivering.

• You prioritise clearly**.** You focus on where AI can create the most value, and you’re comfortable explaining why some ideas should not be pursued.

• You watch the money. Tokens, licenses, usage. You notice when spend is getting out of hand before anyone asks

• You make it simple. You can explain AI to anyone, train teams, and make complex tools feel approachable

• You don't wait for a roadmap. This role exists because someone needs to push us forward

Requirements

• 2+ years hands-on with AI in a business setting. Strong AI skills matter more than years of project leadership experience

• Experience with agents, automated flows, and AI tooling across more than one platform

• Experience planning and running projects, either as a project lead or in an adjacent role.

• A plus: experience measuring the cost, savings, or quality of AI work

• A technical degree or equivalent hands-on experience

• Clear communication in English with people of all levels of technical confidence.

• Based in or near Copenhagen, and able to work from our office

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it. Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn't one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We'll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we'll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide gatherings & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what's next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We're proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**

We'd love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we'd be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out at **crva@factbird.com

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception
jobs.description:
The Department of Psychology, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a fully funded postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception. The position is available for up to 36 months and is part of a project led by Dr. Gregory Scott Francis that is supported by the SDU Department of Psychology. The starting date is March 15, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Research environment

The postdoc will be affiliated with the Research Unit of Health and Cognitive Psychology. The position is at the SDU Esbjerg campus but will also involve interaction with staff at the SDU Odense campus. 

Project description

A basic process of the visual system is to monitor the location and characteristics of objects in a scene, and the multiple object tracking (MOT) paradigm has identified many fundamental aspects of this process. With a rich literature of empirical results, this paradigm is ready for theoretical development, which this project intends to pursue using an integrate-and-fire neural network model known as LAMINART. A key aspect of the model is the ability to select/segment visual objects, which may explain how people can (seemingly) effortlessly track multiple objects in a dynamic visual scene. 

The successful candidate will be required to design, program and analyze an integrate-and-fire neural network model of visual perception. Good programming (Python) skills are required along with a good understanding of empirical methods and ways to connect empirical findings with model behavior. The position also involves teaching duties.

The project involves collaboration with Prof. Søren Krogh Andersen, also at SDU.

Qualifications

Ideally, applicants for the position should satisfy the following requirements:

• 
PhD level in psychology, cognitive (neuro)science, vision science, or a related field

• 
Research experience as evidenced by conference contributions and peer-reviewed journal articles in a field related to the offered position

• 
Expertise in visual attention and perception

• 
Strong analytical skills, including the ability to design, implement, and analyze complex experiments

• 
Be willing and able to teach for the Department of Psychology

• 
Prior experience with neural network modeling is a plus

• 
Prior experience with cognitive modelling is a plus

• 
Good command of statistics

• 
Good command of Python (or similar programming languages and a willingness to learn)

• 
Very good command of the English language in spoken and written form

• 
Some knowledge of the Danish language is a plus

Candidates who are about to obtain these qualifications are also encouraged to apply. 

Contact information

For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Greg Francis, SDU (email: gfrancis@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 16 98), or Professor Søren Krogh Andersen (email: skandersen@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 49 57)

Application deadline

The application deadline is November 08, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. CET.

Salary and terms of employment

The base salary for a postdoctoral researcher is DKK 36,877.42, with an additional job structure supplement of DKK 5,230.75. This brings the total monthly salary to DKK 42,108.16.

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application

Applications must be in English and submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". 

Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

• 
A letter of motivation (max. 1 page)

• 
A detailed CV

• 
Master and PhD degree certificates, if available

• 
A complete and numbered list of publications 

• 
Three scientific publications (or preprints) considered to be most important for the advertised position (please note that one file per publication must be submitted)

• 
Contact details of at least two university supervisors or employers who can provide references

If you experience technical problems, you must contact hcm-support@sdu.dk.

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application. 

Incomplete applications and applications received after the application deadline will not be considered. 

Shortlisting of applications may be used in the initial selection process.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

• Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values every individual's perspective and talents.

**Contact and information

For further information about the position, please contact Emily Lumb, Talent Acquisition Specialist: emily.lumb@aak.com

**About AAK

Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™. We specialise in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable.

At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer with the flexibility of our production assets and deep knowledge across multiple industries, including Chocolate and Confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care.

Our 4,000 employees support close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and more than 20 production facilities worldwide. Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years.

AAK is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

Do you want to be a valued part of a global team that works passionately every day to ensure we deliver high-quality services to our customers by upholding high standards on food safety and a high level of business ethics in our supplier base? If this excites you then look no further and come join us.

About The Role Be part of the movement - and play your part.  As Administration Specialist, you are part of the Quality & Compliance team that supports the Danish based logistics legal entities with issues related to quality and compliance. In addition to direct support on the transportation and storage of dry, chilled and frozen goods, the team also supports quality assurance in a broader sense.

You will be supporting the Quality Specialists within certification processes, training and internal auditing. You will also be responsible for the day-to-day handling and coordination of the Global Haulage Compliance program where we, with assistance from external auditors, verify that our haulage partners comply with basic human rights and other regulations related to truck drivers.

You will report directly to the Global Director for Health, Safety & Security, and be based at our Logistics site in Taulov, Denmark. The role requires on-site presence.

**What kind of exciting challenges can you expect to meet in this role?:

****Role

**As Administration Specialist, you will get the opportunity to influence and develop the role, but the initial areas we expect you to cover are to:

• Administer the Haulage Compliance Audit program on a daily basis, including interaction with external suppliers, follow-up with internal stakeholders, planning and reporting

• Support the Quality Specialists in managing and controlling quality processes and food safety, across DFDS’ Danish storage, transportation and office locations

• Participate in regular QEHS audits and inspections of both internal locations as well as 3rd party partners as specified by the IFS/ISO standards

• Track and follow-up on non-conformances from the conducted audits and inspections in close collaboration with QEHS Experts

• Conduct internal audits of operational sites

• Participate in developing training material and facilitate training sessions

**About You

**We think that the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills and strong characters bring out the best in us all. With this in mind, we think that you are:

• A strong administrator

• A good communicator with strong interpersonal skills

• A good listener with ability to digest large amounts of information and convert it into actions

• Structured and self-driven with ability to prioritize and multitask in a dynamic environment

• A collaborative team player who enjoys collaborating with others

Moreover, we imagine that the ideal candidate brings:

• Relevant business experience in an administrative function

• Experience with quality assurance is an advantage

• Experience from a logistics or transport-oriented company is an advantage

• Experience with food safety and food transportation and storage is an advantage

• Experience with internal audits - or a willingness to gain knowledge in this area

• Full proficiency in Danish and English, both spoken and written (English is corporate language)

• The ability to convey training and information to others in a clear and engaging way

• Experience with the Microsoft 365 product suite

• Experience with developing marketing material or training material

Working at DFDS Join the movement and grow with us. While you’re with us, we want you to develop and move yourself on. We’ll encourage you to challenge yourself to acquire new skills and perspectives.

At DFDS, we promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Logistics facility in Taulov, we are placed right in the middle of all our logistics facilities in Denmark and with our global headquarter in Copenhagen only a few hours away.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.

If you think your personality, skills, experience and aspirations match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Send us your CV and a brief motivational letter (in English) as soon as possible as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

Is there something you need to know, we haven’t covered here, please do not hesitate to reach out to Global Director Health, Safety & Security (Landside) Steffen Conradsen on sconr@dfds.com.

Please note that response times may be slightly longer than usual due to the autumn holiday period and business travel activities within the hiring team, however, rest assured that we will get back to you at earliest convenience.

**We look forward to hearing from you.

**This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.

Are you an experienced and motivated OT Security Architect and do you want to leave your mark on the global energy industry? If so, we want to hear from you!

Your position

In your new position as OT Security Architect in the Renewables division, you will be a valuable member of the OT Security Team, whose mission is to ensure excellent OT security deliveries on large-scale EPC substation projects. You will have the chance to take the architectural lead and help shape a collaborative team culture built on expertise and knowledge-sharing. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be at one of our offices in either Esbjerg, Aarhus or Copenhagen. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel 10–30 days per year.

“Every day, we help enable the green energy transition by building secure, resilient OT solutions that ensure renewable energy assets operate safely and reliably.” - OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.

Your tasks & responsibilities

In our Renewables division, we have major EPC projects in the pipeline for both short- and long-term operations. As an OT Security Architect, you will take the architectural lead and support all OT Security areas across the EPC substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Contributing to the implementation of industry-accepted good practice and required Cyber/OT Security architecture at solution level, typically based on standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and NIS

• Helping define products and standards relevant to OT Security and infrastructure

• Hands-on experience with cybersecurity audits and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Critical Infrastructure regulations, and IEC 62443

• Reviewing requirements/ITT packages and providing input to tenders consisting of calculations, solutions, descriptions, clarifications, and reservations

• Taking on an advisory or active role in infrastructure, identity access management, or logging/event-based activities

• Being responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing FAT, SAT, and SIT activities to ensure successful system delivery and integration

• Implementing customer-specific Cyber/OT Security requirements in substation design for multiple systems and subsystems, such as SCADA, low-voltage, HVAC, Auxiliary Control and Monitoring System, etc.

Crucial to this position is your ability to take ownership of project deliverables and coordinate OT Security deadlines with internal and external stakeholders. You should thrive in a leading role where your skills, collaboration, and structured approach help ensure that requirements are met.

Your profile & qualifications

You are a team player who enjoys leading projects and working with stakeholders to align on timing, scope, and objectives. You know when technical expertise should be brought in to support delivery. To us, this means that you have a structured and solution-oriented approach, the ability to influence stakeholders, and the dedication to see tasks through to completion.

You will be part of a team of six colleagues that values quality, attention to detail, and a flexible working environment. We are sociable, helpful, and open to input, and we work in a dedicated, structured, and execution-focused way while respecting the agility that is a natural part of our core tasks. We want the same from you.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

• A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in OT Security from a similar position

• A Tech Lead mentality – we are not seeking an extreme subject matter expert, but a well-rounded colleague who can work through heavily structured large projects involving many stakeholders

• The ability to know when additional technical specialists or resources are needed to complete a project

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English

• Experience working in complex engineering projects, as well as project and stakeholder management, is an advantage

If you have any questions, you are more than welcome to contact OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

jobs.description:
Job posting for Student Instructors at Cognitive Science and Linguistics

Spring 2027

We are looking to hire six-seven student instructors from 1 January to 31 may 2027 for the following courses:

BSc in Cognitive Science:

• Philosophy of Cognitive Science (2 hours/week, 13 weeks)

• Methods 2: General Linear Model (4 hours/week, 13 weeks – two instructors)

• Cognitive Neuroscience (2 hours/week, 11 weeks)

• Methods 4: Bayesian Computational Modeling (2 hours/week, 11 weeks)

• Social and Cultural Dynamics (2 hours/week, 11 weeks)

MA in Linguistics:

• Computational Linguistics (2 hours/week, 12 weeks)

Programming skills necessary - see course description.

BA in Linguistics:

• Studiume Generale (2 hours/week, 13 weeks) (please notice; course in Danish)

Qualifications

Applicants should have:

• A solid background in the relevant academic areas for the position, including good grades for the course they are applying for, and other related courses.

• Good communication skills, including the ability to work well with course coordinators, the ability to communicate well with students, and the ability to facilitate discussion and collaboration between students.

• The ability to help course coordinators in preparing class activities, and to interpret and implement class plans in a clear and organized way.

• Is enrolled as a student at Aarhus University when teaching.

We recommend that you participate in a basic pedagogical course for student instructors, lasting approx. 12 hours. Participation in the course as an instructor is paid once during your study period.

Terms of employment

In most courses, instructors will be required to teach a total of 26 hours. For each hour taught, instructors will receive 1.5 hours paid preparation time, for a total of 65 paid hours. If the instructor has to teach the same content to two different classes, the preparation time for class two will only be 0.75 hours paid preparation time, for a total of 55,25 paid hours.

The hourly rate of pay is DKK 291,80, including holiday pay.

Application process

When applying, please attach your application letter, CV, and grade transcripts.

You are more than welcome to apply for more than one course, please write your prioritized order for the courses. Each course requires a separate application. You will need to write them in the same document or attach it as extra attachments in the application system.

Each application should include a letter stating:

• Which course you are applying to serve as instructor for.

• A short motivation for your application for that course.

• A short description of relevant knowledge and skills for the role of instructor, specific to the course you are applying for.

Application letters for each course should be no longer than a single A4 page.

The deadline is 9 November, and we hope to get back to you before Christmas.

If you have any questions, please contact Head of Department, Joshua Charles Skewes at afdelingsleder.lics@cc.au.dk.

About Arts

The Faculty of Arts is one of Northern Europe’s most significant faculties for research and higher education in the humanities, theology and education. Within this broad academic scope, the faculty comprises approximately 700 researchers, 200 PhD students, 9,000 Bachelor’s and Master’s degree students, and 1,500 further and continuing education students. We believe that the best ideas arise when different perspectives meet – and that research, teaching and innovation are best developed in dialogue with the surrounding society.

You can find more information here: Faculty of Arts | Aarhus University

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

**Job Description

**Do you have a keen interest in financial markets and sustainability? Do you enjoy developing high‑quality financial analysis with strategic impact? And are you ready to take a key role in advising some of the largest and most complex corporates in Denmark on capital structure, funding strategy and sustainability? This entry-level role offers rapid learning and broad exposure to complex advisory work.

**What You Will Be Doing

**As an Analyst in our Corporate & Sustainability Advisory team, you will work alongside senior colleagues to deliver strategic financial advice to large corporate clients. You will be part of our newly integrated Denmark and Norway team, collaborating across markets to provide tailor-made solutions on capital structure, funding strategy, and sustainability initiatives.

• Conduct high-quality financial statement analysis with strategic importance for clients

• Develop expertise in capital structure, credit ratings, acquisition capacity, and funding strategy while integrating sustainability initiatives to enhance financial outcomes and value creation

• Prepare clear and engaging client presentations and management materials

• Support client engagements, pitches, and analytical projects across markets

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or related field with strong academic record

• Strong analytical capabilities and commercial mindset

Job Description

Do you have solid experience leading large-scale IT projects? Are you motivated by delivering innovative IT solutions to complex, society-critical challenges? If so, you may be our next colleague in the role of IT Manager at Netcompany. As a Manager, you will be challenged in a position that requires strong leadership capabilities as well as technical expertise.

Responsibilities and technologies

As an IT Manager, you will be responsible for leading large-scale IT projects from initiation through successful delivery. You will manage project teams, oversee project risks, and ensure high standards of quality, delivery, and stakeholder satisfaction. In addition, you will play a key role in client advisory services, business development activities, and proposal management.

Beyond your leadership responsibilities, you will be expected to contribute with strong technical expertise. You will act as a trusted advisor and sparring partner on technical solution design and implementation, helping project teams and clients solve complex challenges.

Alongside your project management responsibilities, you will serve as a mentor to consultants and senior consultants. This long-term mentoring relationship will give you the opportunity to support, guide, and contribute to the professional development of your mentees throughout their careers at Netcompany.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Leading projects and ensuring successful delivery and progress, typically based on agile development methodologies.

• Participating in steering committee meetings with senior representatives from both Netcompany and the client organization.

• Advising the client on project deliverables.

• Coordinating activities across multiple project workstreams, including testing, organizational implementation, and software development.

• Leading proposal teams and conducting development and performance discussions with your mentees.

About you

We expect you to hold a masters's degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you have:

• 
Strong technical expertise and relevant experience within the IT industry.

• 
Proven experience leading large and complex IT delivery projects, including projects utilizing agile development methodologies.

• 
Strong commercial awareness combined with the ability to build trust and lead high-performing teams.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

****Job Description:

****Are you a detail-focused specialist and ready to apply your enthusiasm for Legal & Compliance matters?

**What the job is:

**We are currently looking for three Export Control and Know Your Customer (KYC) Specialists to join our Legal & Compliance team in Copenhagen

We are a team with diverse profiles working globally to ensure Satair's export business remains compliant with National, European, and US export control laws, sanctions & embargoes, and Airbus directives.

In this exciting role you will leverage your experience in Legal & Compliance affairs, particularly with U.S. regulations, European laws & Airbus policies to make a meaningful impact on our global operations. We value proactive thinkers who can make decisive recommendations and ensure compliance with national and international regulations.

• Work with a global team of six Know Your Customer (KYC) Specialists - located in Copenhagen, Singapore, Hamburg and Herndon (USA)

• Drive process and efficiency initiatives , including IT and automation of compliance processes.

• Collaborate with business functions and the global export control network in Airbus to ensure compliant business operations.

• Analyze and validate Customer End Use Statements.

• Screen and approve customers for Export Control and KYC compliance and risk evaluation.

• Conduct enhanced due diligence for higher-risk clients based on various considerations (geopolitical, sanctions, etc.).

• Develop business processes and conduct awareness training to maintain high export control standards.

• Analyze orders, deliveries & customer profiles to proactively guide the business on best practice and optimization

**How you will contribute to the team:

**Equipped with a degree in Legal/Compliance, Business Administration, or similar (or similar) paired with professional experience ideally as an Export Control or KYC Specialist (or a comparable role) , we are looking for a team player with the following experience, skills, and mindset:

• Education: degree in Legal/Compliance, Business Administration, or similar

• Experience in Compliance KYC screening of customers.

• Knowledge of US, EU, and National export control laws, sanctions & embargoes.

• Proficiency in standard tools mandatory for the job (e.g., Compliance Screening software).

• Familiar with industrial logistics operations and customer support

• Language: English language skills at negotiation level (fluent, both verbal and written).

• Soft Skills: Analytical, detail-oriented, and well-structured, with high professional integrity and ethical standards.

• Capacity to challenge and influence, with a hands-on, structured, and business-oriented approach.

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

**About SATAIR

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 11 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 1,900 people supporting a $3.3 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

• Competitive remuneration, including short term incentive bonus on all levels

• Work/life balance: hybrid working, flex time, maternity/paternity/parental leave, 29 days of holiday + senior and flex days

• Personal development: personalized development plans, large portfolio of learning solutions and many internal mobility opportunities, both locally and globally

• Health and well-being: Health insurance, in-house canteen with many healthy options

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

Please send us your application as soon as possible to get the opportunity to become part of an exceptional global team!

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

When applying for the position, you accept our data privacy statement: http://www.SATAIR.com/privacy

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

********Company:

********Satair A/S

**Contract Type:

**Permanent

**Experience Level:

**Professional

**Job Family:

**Ethics & Compliance

Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to emsom@airbus.com .

At NTI Group, a leading Autodesk partner operating across 15 markets in EMEA and Brazil, we are looking for a commercially driven Global Software Partnerships Manager to take ownership of our portfolio of Global Software Partnerships solutions and accelerate growth across the Group.

**Help shape quality and protect lives through vaccines

**Are you an experienced QA Specialist who can navigate complexity, influence stakeholders, and create progress in a dynamic manufacturing environment?

At Bavarian Nordic in Kvistgaard, we develop and manufacture life-saving vaccines that protect people around the world.

We are looking for a QA Specialist to join our QA Drug Product team and help strengthen quality, compliance, and continuous improvement across our manufacturing operations.

**Your role

**As a QA Specialist, you will work closely with Production and other functions to provide clear quality direction, resolve complex issues, and ensure that critical activities progress in a compliant and timely manner.

You will manage a varied portfolio of operational QA activities, investigations, and improvement initiatives, often with competing priorities and deadlines. You must therefore be able to maintain an overview, make sound risk-based decisions, and drive activities through to completion.

This is an individual-contributor role without formal people-management responsibility. You will lead through expertise, credibility, and influence, building alignment while maintaining an independent QA position.

You will report to the Head of QA Drug Product and join a skilled and collaborative team committed to quality excellence, knowledge sharing, and patient safety.

**Your Responsibilities

**As a QA Specialist, you will:

• Provide clear QA direction and trusted advice to Production and cross-functional stakeholders

• Review and approve Deviations, CAPAs, Change Controls, batch documentation, SOPs, and other GMP-relevant records within your delegated authority

• Perform QA oversight of Drug Product manufacturing and support timely product disposition

• Lead the resolution of complex quality issues and investigations

• Apply quality risk management to identify pragmatic and compliant solutions

• Represent QA in cross-functional projects, forums, and improvement initiatives

• Identify quality and compliance risks and ensure timely escalation and follow-up

• Support inspection readiness and represent QA during inspections, audits, and other significant compliance activities

• Improve quality processes, standards, and ways of working

• Share knowledge and contribute to a strong and proactive quality culture

**What You Bring

**We expect you to have:

• A relevant degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, or a related discipline

• Typically, five or more years of relevant QA experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or vaccine manufacturing

• Strong knowledge of GMP, Process Validation, QMS, and applicable regulatory expectations

• Experience leading complex quality activities, investigations, or cross-functional projects

• A broad understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes and cross-functional dependencies

• The ability to manage several priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously

• Strong risk-based decision-making and problem-solving skills

• Professional proficiency in English and Danish is a requirement

**How You Work

**You establish credibility through your expertise, judgement, and consistent delivery. You communicate clearly and diplomatically, listen to different perspectives, and build commitment without relying on formal authority.

You remain calm and effective when priorities change, constructively challenge decisions when quality or compliance may be at risk, and move activities forward even when the situation is complex or information is incomplete.

**About The Team And Department

**You will join a competent and supportive QA Drug Product team. The team currently consists of six colleagues and will grow to seven with this hire. The group represents a healthy mix of experienced QA specialists, fostering collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development.

You will also become part of our QA Operations department, comprising approximately 40 employees across sites in Kvistgaard, Denmark, and Munich, Germany. The department is characterized by close cross-site collaboration, a strong quality mindset, and a shared commitment to delivering safe and compliant products to patients.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**At Bavarian Nordic, your work will contribute directly to the development and production of life-saving vaccines. We offer:

• Meaningful work with an impact on patients and global health

• A collaborative, inclusive, and international working environment

• A broad role with significant cross-functional interaction

• Opportunities for professional and personal development

• Competitive salary, pension, health insurance, bonus opportunity, and employee benefits

• Flexible working arrangements combining on-site and remote work, depending on the activities involved

• Access to our canteen, staff club, fitness benefits, EV charging stations, and convenient transportation options

**For us, it is all about improving and saving lives together

**We are a fully integrated vaccine company focused on the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of life-saving vaccines, and one of the largest pure-play vaccine companies in the world. The short version

A venture-backed Danish medical imaging company is hiring its first dedicated AI/ML scientist. The company has a CE-marked product already in clinical use and is now building the next generation of diagnostic tools on top of the imaging data that product generates.

This is not a role where you inherit a dataset and a backlog. The data largely does not exist yet. Part of this job is going out to hospitals, working alongside clinicians, and finding out whether the data they hold actually contains the answer to the question they are asking. The other part is turning that into methods and working prototypes.

If you want a clean pipeline and a defined problem, this is the wrong role. If you want to define the problem, it is close to ideal.

The company

Venture-backed, Danish, around 40 people, with offices in Copenhagen. The technology is PET-based functional imaging that produces quantitative measurements rather than pictures alone — the ability to put a number on physiological function, not just describe what an image looks like.

The first product is CE-marked and in clinical use, with a pivotal trial running and a regulatory submission planned in the United States. Quantification is the core of the company’s value: it is what competitors do not offer, and it is the thing this role is hired to extend.

The company is named at first conversation. We have not put it in writing here.

The mission

The imaging data is the future product line. Today the company measures blood flow in the heart. The question is what else the same data can answer – in cardiology, in neurology, and beyond – and what methods are needed to get there.

You are hired to answer that. You will be the company’s dedicated AI/ML voice, joining a software team of eight and reporting to the Head of Software. You will work across R&D, clinical development, quality and regulatory.

Concretely, the first twelve months look like this:

• Building working relationships with clinicians and technicians at partner hospitals, in Denmark and nearby

• Getting into clinics and understanding how the scans are actually acquired and read

• Identifying which data holds real signal — and being honest when it does not

• Running studies and projects alongside hospital doctors

• Building prototypes that show whether a method works

Success at six months is measured in relationships and prototypes, not in shipped features.

What you will actually do

• Invent, prototype and mature algorithms for extracting clinically meaningful information from PET data

• Translate clinical and scientific questions into testable algorithmic solutions

• Build the pipelines around the work — acquisition, quality control, processing, visualisation, presentation of findings

• Go to hospitals. Observe workflows. Ask clinicians what they need and validate that your assumptions survive contact with clinical reality

• Evaluate emerging methods and tools, and shape which directions the company invests in

• Support the AI/ML dimension of medical device compliance as methods mature toward product — CE-marking and FDA

Travel is roughly two to three days per month, primarily within Denmark and southern Sweden.

Who we are looking for

Essential

• Demonstrable AI/ML development experience — applied, and with something you can point to and say “I built that”

• A software engineering and algorithm background, hands-on with PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX or Keras, and disciplined about testing and version control

• Experience with data collection, selection, integration and quality control, and preparing datasets for training

• Comfort starting from a rough idea rather than a specification

• Someone who wants to be in the room with clinicians. This role does not work from a desk — you need to be willing to initiate conversations with doctors and technicians, ask uncomfortable questions, and keep asking

• Roughly three to eight years of relevant experience. A PhD, or a PhD plus postdoc, counts — provided the work was applied and you have built things

Strongly preferred

• Medical imaging: DICOM, and work on 3D or 4D volumetric data — segmentation, registration, classification or quantification. PET, MR or X-ray all count

• PET-specific knowledge — reconstruction, attenuation and scatter correction, tracer kinetics, quantification. Genuinely valuable, genuinely not required on day one. The company expects to teach this

• Medical device software or SaMD experience — IEC 62304, quality systems, verification and validation, CE-marking or FDA

• A background in healthcare, medtech, diagnostics or another regulated field

Education

Computer science, biomedical engineering, medical physics or similar is typical. Proven capability substitutes for credentials.

Relocation

Candidates relocating to Denmark will be considered.

What this is, honestly

The genuine appeal. This is the company’s first and only AI/ML hire. Nobody has done this before you, there is no established way of working to inherit, and the direction the company takes on AI is the direction you argue for. It is an unusual amount of ownership for someone at this level, and it is the main reason to take the role.

What you should weigh. You will be the only AI/ML person among eight developers. There is no in-house peer to review your methods and no senior imaging-AI person to learn from — the clinical and scientific expertise sits with the company’s hospital collaborators and advisors rather than inside the building. Some people find that liberating. Others find it isolating, and it is worth being honest with yourself about which you are before you apply.

The other thing to weigh is the data. It is early. Expect to spend real time on access, agreements, site visits and data quality before you spend it on model architecture.

Interested, or want to know more?

Black Swans Exist is running this search exclusively. We will tell you who the company is at first conversation, and we will tell you the parts that are not in this document.

If it is not right for you but you know who it is right for, we would genuinely like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
We are searching for a skilled and experienced post doc with specific interest in investigating early myeloid disease, clonal haematopoiesis, metabolism and obesity.

Our research/The group

The focus of the Grønbæk group is Translational Haematology. The group is affiliated with Biotech Research and Innovation centre (BRIC), University of Copenhagen and Rigshospitalet (Central Copenhagen University Hospital).

Our overall aim is to understand the molecular mechanisms of haematological cancers and based on this; to design, develop and implement novel, scientifically based, clinical trials, with a strong focus on epigenetic therapies. This is done by bridging between clinical research at Rigshospitalet and the basic cancer biology research at BRIC, and in international collaborations with, among others, the Van Andel Research Institute, Michigan, USA and the Nordic MDS study group.

Our location at the Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC provides optimal conditions for interaction with the basic scientists at BRIC. The group currently consists of 14 scientists, MD/scientists and students, one clinical research coordinator, 1 research nurse and 2 biomedical laboratory scientists.

The project: Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms.

The current position is part of a joint project ‘Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms’ together with Professor George Vassiliou, Cambridge Stem Cell Institute, University of Cambridge, United Kingdom funded by a ‘Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC)’ grant from the Novo Nordisk foundation, which supports collaborative research projects with the purpose ‘t_o reverse-translate clinical observations into mechanistic studies that will increase our understanding of how obesity impacts carcinogenesis’.

Obesity is a global health issue linked to increased risk of cancer, including blood cancers such as myeloid neoplasms (MN). Many MN arise from clonal haematopoiesis (CH)—the abnormal expansion of blood stem cell clones carrying somatic mutations. Haematopoietic stem cells interact with bone marrow adipose tissue (BMAT), which increases with obesity, which may fuel CH growth and progression to MN. Epidemiological and genetic studies already suggest obesity accelerates CH, but the underlying mechanisms remain unclear.

This project integrates large-scale population data, clinical trials, and mechanistic mouse studies to investigate these links and explore preventive or therapeutic strategies.

Your job

The project focuses on translational analyses of live frozen human cells from patient bone marrow (BM)/(BMAT) and blood samples from completed and ongoing clinical trials. We are searching for a skilled post doc who is very interactive and enjoys collaborations with other scientists – including younger scientists and clinician scientists.

Your tasks will include:

• Process of live frozen patient material from clinical trials including isolation of defined cell populations, and quality control for downstream omics

• Perform in-house molecular techniques which may include Proteomics, PCR, ddPCR, and library/sample preparation for RNA-seq, ATAC-seq and DNA methylation analyses

• Coordinate genomic, transcriptomic, lipidomic, metabolomic analyses with our internal and external collaborating laboratories and take the lead on designing relevant sub-studies, integrating and interpreting the data

• Help establish the practical and regulatory framework for these collaborations, including material transfer and data-sharing agreements

• Participate in grant and manuscript writing

• Present at local and international meetings

• Introduce lab techniques to new lab members and students

• Collaborate with both scientists and clinicians

Start: February 1st, 2027

Duration: 2 years

Profile

We expect you to be a highly motivated and highly ambitious, independent scientist with the following qualifications: •

• A PhD in Life Sciences with a preferred focus on haematology

• A strong background in mechanisms of normal and malignant haematopoiesis and molecular haematology techniques

• Comprehensive lab skills in molecular and cellular biology techniques, including work with primary human cells and cryopreserved patient material

• Experience with genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, lipidomics, metabolomics and ability to analyse and interpret such data
