Are you commercially driven, curious about market needs and passionate about turning insights into successful products? We are looking for a Product Manager to take commercial ownership of our workwear assortment within the Construction segment and help shape products that create real value for professional users.

Your role

As Product Manager, you will be the link between the market and our product development organization. You will translate customer needs, market insights and business strategy into competitive, relevant and profitable products.

You will take responsibility for development projects from initial decision through to launch, working closely with Design, Product Development, Purchasing & Quality, Production, Marketing and Sales. Once products are launched, you will follow their commercial performance and use market feedback and data to continuously optimize the assortment.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Analyzing market trends, customer needs, competitors and new developments within workwear and PPE

• Identifying product opportunities and assessing their market and commercial potential

• Defining product positioning, requirements, target pricing and expected profitability

• Preparing clear product briefs and driving development projects from concept to launch

• Working closely with Design and technical teams to ensure the right balance between functionality, quality, fit and market needs

• Coordinating cross-functional stakeholders throughout the development process to ensure progress and timely launches

• Building business cases and supporting commercial decisions for new products and collections

• Monitoring sales, profitability, assortment performance and market feedback and turning insights into concrete actions

• Driving continuous product improvements based on customer feedback, quality data and sustainability considerations

• Developing and optimizing the Construction assortment through product improvements, additions and phase-outs

• Providing clear product USPs and commercial input to Marketing and Sales

Who are you?

You combine a strong commercial mindset with an analytical and structured approach. You understand how customer and market needs translate into product opportunities and are comfortable taking ownership across several projects and stakeholders.

We expect that you:

• Have solid experience in product management and product development within technical textiles or apparel – ideally workwear

• Have experience with market and competitor analysis, benchmarking and product requirements

• Have successfully managed product development projects from concept to launch

• Have a good understanding of textile materials, functionality and technical product solutions

• Are commercially minded and comfortable working with pricing, margins and product performance

• Communicate and collaborate effectively across functions and cultures

• Are fluent in English

You will join a highly cross-functional environment where market understanding, product expertise and commercial thinking come together to develop a competitive and relevant workwear assortment for professional users.

What you can expect at our headquarters

Working at MASCOT is about more than the job itself. At our headquarters in Pårup, we want to create an environment where you can enjoy your working day, connect with colleagues and be part of an international organisation.

As part of the team, you can benefit from:

• On-site staff restaurant: daily freshly prepared meals available through our subsidised lunch scheme

• On-site gym: giving you the opportunity to stay active before or after work.

• Pension plan: providing additional security and helping you plan for the future

• Health insurance: giving you access to additional healthcare support when you need it

• An international working environment: collaborate with colleagues across different countries, functions and cultures

• Employee discounts: enjoy special discounts on MASCOT workwear and safety footwear

And most importantly, you will become part of a Danish family-owned company where collaboration, responsibility and long-term thinking are at the heart of how we work.

Ready to join us? We look forward to hearing from you.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We reserve the right to close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate.

At MASCOT, we value diversity and equal opportunities. We are committed to creating an inclusive and respectful workplace. jobs.occupation: FX Sales Associate, Institutional Clients, DK
jobs.description:
Join our Institutional Sales team as an FX Sales Associate and discover what it means to work at the heart of financial markets. You will develop and support client relationships with some of the largest pension funds and financial institutions in Denmark while gaining daily exposure to foreign exchange, fixed income and macroeconomic developments. This role offers a clear path towards becoming a trusted client adviser in our collaborative trading floor environment.

You do not need to be a seasoned FX salesperson, but you should be curious, commercially minded, proactive and eager to learn.

What you will be doing

As an FX Sales Associate, you will support and gradually take ownership of client relationships across our Institutional segment. At the same time, we expect you to work across segments and be able to cover corporates and SMEs as well.

You will become part of a dynamic team where no two days are the same. Markets move constantly, client needs evolve, and success depends on combining market insight with client needs and commercial execution.

Key responsibilities

• Develop and maintain relationships with Institutional clients.

• Proactively identify and pursue new business opportunities.

• Contribute to growing the FX franchise and expanding client activity.

• Deliver market insights and relevant macroeconomic perspectives to clients.

• Advise clients on FX risk management, hedging strategies, and market developments.

• Collaborate closely with Trading, Research, and other Markets specialists.

• Support clients across segments, including SMEs and Corporate customers.

• Stay informed on global macro developments, central bank actions, geopolitical events, and investment trends that may impact clients.

We are looking for someone who

• Has experience from Markets, Asset Management, Research, Investment Banking, or a related area.

• Has a strong interest in FX markets and risk management. Experience with FX products is a clear advantage.

• Is commercially minded and enjoys winning new business.

• Thrives in a client-facing environment and enjoys building long-term relationships.

• Is proactive, self-driven, and comfortable reaching out to clients.

• Has a genuine curiosity about macroeconomics, investments, financial markets, and current events.

• Can translate market developments into relevant client conversations.

• Enjoys working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.

• Speaks and writes Danish and English fluently.

It is a plus if you

• Have experience from an economic or financial research function.

• Have experience working with institutional investors or financial institutions.

• Have knowledge of derivatives, fixed income, asset allocation, or portfolio management.

• Have experience presenting market views or client-facing analysis.

What we offer

• A role at the heart of Danske Bank Markets.

• Daily exposure to FX, Fixed Income, Equities, and macroeconomic developments.

• A collaborative and ambitious team environment.

• Direct interaction with sophisticated institutional clients.

• Strong development opportunities and a clear path towards becoming a trusted client advisor.

• The opportunity to work across multiple customer segments and build a broad commercial skill set.

Are you ready for the next step?

If you are curious about financial markets and motivated by building client relationships, we would love to hear from you.

Please reach out to Nikolai Thaneswaran-Eriksen at nike@danskebank.dk with any questions. The application deadline is 30 October 2026.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Danske Bank

København V, 1600 København V Besøg hjemmeside

jobs.occupation: Team Assistant, Investor Relations & Business Development
jobs.description:
Do you want to join a global fund manager in energy infrastructure investments? If so, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) is currently looking for a Team Assistant to join our Investor Relations & Business Development (IR & BD) team based in Copenhagen.

Team

We are seeking a motivated and organized Team Assistant to support our team members in our Investor Relations & Business Development (IR & BD) team. The IR & BD team at CIP is a global, high-performing unit responsible for all investor interactions and business development activities—from product and fund development to fundraising and client engagement. The team comprises approximately 70 professionals from 15 countries, with backgrounds in investment banking, management consulting, and law.

You will be also a part of a broader Executive Support team, and will report to Heidi Jensen, Sr. Personal Assistant.

Role

As a Team Assistant based in CIPs Copenhagen office you will be primarily supporting the EMEA team, within the broader Investor Relations team covering clients across the region. You will play a central role both internally and externally, and you will be the closest go-to person for your team in providing broad administrative support.

Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

• 
Organizing and maintaining calendars, ensuring alignment in daily schedule and keeping calendars up-to date

• 
Organizing travel arrangements and logistics and ensuring that roadshows are going smoothly

• 
Providing broad administrative support, e.g., managing incoming inquiries and scheduling meetings

• 
Updating CRM systems (e.g., Dealcloud) with relevant data

• 
Communicating with investors, e.g. replying to emails, sending invitations to events and press releases

You

You have around 5 years of relevant experience in administrative or coordinating roles, preferably from a consulting firm, law firm, investment bank, large international company or a Ministry/Government Agency. You thrive in a high-paced work environment and are motivated, thorough, and resourceful, with a high level of professionalism and able to handle confidential material discreetly.

We look for the following in a candidate

• 
Solid knowledge of Office 365 applications

• 
Excellent communication and time management skills

• 
Ability to balance responsibilities in a busy environment across various projects with changing priorities

• 
Ability to grasp the big picture at the same time being thorough with a high attention to detail

• 
Ability to manage administrative processes and projects independently, at the same time enjoying sparring and collaborating with the team

• 
Resilient, service minded, proactive and with a positive can-do attitude

• 
Experience with CRM tools is a plus

• 
Project management – investor events, road shows

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

Building value that matters

Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) today is the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy investments and a global leader in offshore wind. To date, CIP has developed and constructed more than +50 greenfield renewable projects around the world. CIP is developing a greenfield project portfolio of ~160GW total, and ~16 GW is in operation or under construction. CIP manages 13 funds and has to date raised approximately EUR ~35 billion for investments in energy and associated infrastructure from more than ~200 international institutional investors.

CIP has a multinational team of ~500 full-time employees with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

CIP has built a prominent investment team capable of originating proprietary investment opportunities and executing projects and investments based on the team’s industrial background, large industrial network, and extensive experience in structuring, executing, and managing investments within energy infrastructure. Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP also operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Utrecht, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

_Are you passionate about turning pricing insights into commercial growth? Do you combine strategic thinking, analytical expertise and strong leadership skills with a deep interest in retail and consumer behaviour?

_Join Pandora as Senior Manager, Pricing Strategy and play a central role in shaping how we set, test and evolve pricing across our global product portfolio. Based at our Global Office in Copenhagen, you will lead Pandora’s Pricing Strategy team and help strengthen the data, frameworks and decision-making that support sustainable revenue growth.

Shape Pandora’s global pricing strategy

As Senior Manager, Pricing Strategy, you will lead a team of approximately three colleagues and act as a trusted pricing partner to senior stakeholders across Product, Finance, Merchandising, Supply Chain and Senior leadership.

You will own key elements of Pandora’s global pricing architecture, testing agenda and annual pricing cycle. By combining performance data, competitor intelligence, customer insights and financial modelling, you will translate complex information into clear recommendations that improve pricing decisions and commercial outcomes.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Lead, develop and manage the Pricing Strategy team, setting clear priorities and building strong analytical and commercial capabilities.

• Own the optimization of Pandora’s global recommended retail price architecture across product categories, metals and pricing tiers.

• Lead the global pricing test agenda, including A/B testing and price-sensitivity analysis across key assortment segments.

• Drive the annual global pricing cycles from target-setting and kick-off through to senior leadership approval.

• Lead regular pricing architecture reviews based on performance data, test results, competitor intelligence and market feedback.

• Maintain target-margin frameworks and ensure margin insights inform product development and pricing decisions.

• Act as a strategic pricing partner to Pandora’s product organisation, embedding pricing insights into collection development, portfolio decisions and new product introduction.

• Partner with Commercial Pricing to define global pricing guidelines and the boundaries within which local markets operate.

• Work closely with Finance on P&L validation, average selling price targets and in-season scenario modelling.

• Oversee key pricing tools and operational processes, including price uploads, calculations and the distribution of pricing information to relevant functions.

• Own the monthly global pricing reporting cadence and lead ad hoc commercial deep dives.

• Provide strategic pricing input to transformation projects, e.g. expansion into new materials and other emerging business opportunities.

**Collaborate across Revenue Growth Management

**You will work closely with colleagues across Pandora’s Revenue Growth Management organisation to ensure that pricing decisions are supported by strong insights and aligned with our broader commercial agenda.

This includes partnering with Commercial Pricing on market execution and in-season scenarios, working with Insights & Advanced Analytics on competitor benchmarks and elasticity analysis, and collaborating with Promo Excellence to ensure that pricing and promotional decisions support a clear and consistent commercial strategy.

A strategic and analytical people leader

We are looking for a commercially minded leader who can turn complex data into actionable recommendations and bring clarity to important business decisions.

You are confident working with senior stakeholders and comfortable facilitating discussions where multiple perspectives and priorities must be brought together. You combine a structured and analytical approach with curiosity, humility and the ability to move forward in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• Approximately 6 to 10+ years of relevant experience within pricing, Revenue Growth Management, Collection management, finance, strategy or management consulting.

• Strong experience with pricing strategy, commercial analytics or revenue optimisation.

• People leadership experience and a genuine interest in developing strong teams and individual capabilities.

• Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills.

• Experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI.

• Experience working with large datasets and tools such as Alteryx or similar ETL and analytics platforms.

• Strong problem-solving and project management capabilities.

• A strategic mindset and strong commercial instinct, ideally developed within retail, consumer goods or another customer-focused industry.

• The confidence and credibility to build relationships with and influence senior stakeholders.

• Excellent presentation, facilitation and communication skills.

• Fluency in English.

A degree within finance, strategy, business, economics or a related discipline would be beneficial, but we also welcome candidates with an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

**Your new team

**You will join Pandora’s global Revenue Growth Management organisation and report to the Senior Director, RGM & Pricing. The team partners across Product, Merchandising, Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing and Pandora’s global markets to strengthen commercial decision-making and identify opportunities for sustainable growth.

This is a highly collaborative role with significant exposure across Pandora’s global organisation and an opportunity to shape the future of pricing strategy at scale.

**Additional Information

**

• Global Career Band 4A

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe’s Best Workplaces and ranked #1 among Danish companies, Pandora is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that reflecting the diversity of society in how we engage with our customers is essential to fulfilling our purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We are dedicated to nurturing a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to thrive.

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Data-driven Critical Raw Material Supply Chain Resilience
jobs.description:
Do you want to investigate the resilience of critical raw material supply chains supporting low-carbon and digital technologies? Join us as a PhD student at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, University of Southern Denmark.

The Department of Green Technology at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for a three-year PhD position in data-driven critical raw material supply chain resilience.

The position will be based at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, Department of Green Technology, Faculty of Engineering, at the SDU Odense campus. The expected starting date is 15 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

Project Overview

The deployment of low-carbon technologies, electrification and digital infrastructure is increasing global demand for critical raw materials. At the same time, the production and processing of many of these materials are geographically concentrated and exposed to geopolitical, economic, environmental and logistical disruptions.

Understanding how technology development affects material demand, in-use stocks, end-of-life flows and global supply dependencies is therefore important for assessing and strengthening the resilience of critical raw material supply chains.

The PhD position is jointly funded through research projects on critical raw material supply chains and material requirements for Denmark’s climate-neutral transition. The project will be embedded in an interdisciplinary research environment combining environmental systems analysis, supply-chain research and data science.

 

PhD Topic Description

The PhD project will develop modular and data-driven approaches for analysing critical raw material demand, supply-chain dependencies and resilience.

A central methodological contribution will be the development of transparent, reusable and reproducible computational modules for dynamic material flow analysis. The modules will support the integration of technology deployment scenarios, material intensities, product lifetimes, stocks and flows, end-of-life management, recycling, production, trade, facility and ownership data.

The developed approaches will be applied to selected technology systems, including Denmark’s wind-energy infrastructure and the rapidly expanding infrastructure supporting data centres and AI computing. These cases will be analysed within a common methodological framework to examine how infrastructure expansion and technological change influence demand for critical and scarce materials, in-use stocks, future waste flows, recycling potential and global supply-chain dependencies.

The project may also investigate overlapping material requirements and competition for materials across low-carbon and digital technologies. Particular attention may be given to supply concentration, host–by-product dependencies, trade and ownership structures, supply bottlenecks, cascading risks and potential resilience strategies.

Depending on the candidate’s academic background and the specific research questions, the project may include network analysis, geospatial analysis, scenario modelling, uncertainty analysis, machine learning and other AI-supported approaches.

The candidate will build on selected existing models, datasets and research activities in the group and further develop scientifically robust and reusable methods that improve transparency, comparability and reproducibility in material-system research.

The exact research focus and detailed PhD plan will be developed jointly with the successful candidate, taking into account the project objectives, academic background and research interests.

In addition to a PhD dissertation and high-quality scientific publications, the project is expected to produce reusable modelling methods, documented datasets and reproducible computational workflows.

 

PhD Position and Research Environment

As a PhD student, you will conduct independent research under the supervision of an interdisciplinary team, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy, resource systems and sustainability transitions.

The project connects expertise in engineering, data science, mathematics, business, supply-chain research and geological resources. The wider research environment includes competences in material flow analysis, critical raw material systems, data mining, network analysis, supply-chain science, finance, investment, ownership structures, geological resources and technology systems.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU faculties and with external research partners. It may also include participation in international conferences, research visits and collaboration with relevant industrial and public-sector stakeholders.

The PhD programme follows the Danish PhD framework and includes coursework, participation in active research environments, dissemination activities, and teaching or other knowledge-dissemination duties.

 

What We Expect

We are looking for a highly motivated, independent and collaborative candidate with a strong interest in critical raw materials, quantitative modelling, data-driven research and sustainability.

Applicants must hold a relevant master’s degree or equivalent by the time of enrolment. Relevant academic backgrounds may include engineering, industrial ecology, sustainability science, resource management, data science, computer science, applied mathematics, operations research, supply-chain management, geoinformatics, mining or geological sciences, or another relevant natural science or quantitative discipline.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

• 
A solid academic foundation in quantitative analysis, system modelling, data science or related methods. 

• 
Experience with programming and data analysis, preferably using Python or a similar programming language. 

• 
Experience with data handling, including data cleaning, transformation, integration and exploratory analysis. 

• 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 

• 
The ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment. 

• 
Good written and spoken English. 

• 
A strong interest in sustainability, critical raw materials and supply-chain resilience. 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:

• 
Material flow analysis, industrial ecology or material systems modelling. 

• 
Network, supply-chain or geospatial analysis. 

• 
Scientific computing and reproducible research workflows. 

• 
Statistics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, optimisation, uncertainty or scenario analysis. 

• 
International trade, production facility or corporate ownership data. 

• 
Critical raw materials, wind energy, digital infrastructure or data centres. 

Applicants are not expected to possess expertise in all these areas. Prior experience with material flow analysis is an advantage but is not a requirement. Relevant training will be provided according to the candidate’s background and the needs of the project.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

• 
Curriculum Vitae. 

• 
A motivated application describing the applicant’s research interests, relevant qualifications and motivation for applying. 

• 
Documentation of academic qualifications, including bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and complete transcripts of grades. 

• 
Official English translations of documents not issued in English or Danish. 

• 
Two letters of recommendation. 

• 
A list of publications and up to two examples of relevant publications, if available. 

• 
The completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
The completed TEK form for calculation of grade-point average. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
Official documentation describing the grading system of the awarding university, if the degree was not obtained in Denmark. 

• 
Examples of relevant thesis work, software, code repositories or other research outputs, where available. 

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. The place of employment is in Odense, Denmark and preferred starting date is February 15, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. _Senior Specialist, People Operations Transformation is a strategic transformation role responsible for strengthening People Operations and Payroll through improved data governance, process effectiveness, operational controls, reporting, systems enablement and automation. The role is not accountable for day-to-day operational execution; instead, it focuses on designing, improving and implementing sustainable, scalable and efficient ways of working across People Operations and Payroll.

_The role owns the continuous improvement of People Experience across key operational touchpoints, including preboarding, offboarding, leave management, query management, employee lifecycle administration and employee and manager satisfaction measurement. While the role remains closely connected to operational realities, this is through data, insights, stakeholder feedback and process review rather than direct operational delivery.

As the primary subject matter expert for People Operations and Payroll data quality, operational controls, systems enablement and transformation initiatives, the Specialist is accountable for strengthening data integrity, applying a Six Sigma approach to measuring process effectiveness, establishing sustainable controls, improving operational reporting and driving automation. This includes supporting the implementation of ServiceNow HRSD, introducing automated workflows and working closely with GBS to identify opportunities for robots and automation that reduce manual effort and improve service consistency.

The role works closely with GO People Operations, Payroll, GBS, People Experience, Employee Relations, and other relevant stakeholders to translate operational requirements into scalable processes, technology enhancements, automated workflows and more efficient ways of working. The role also brings external insight into People Operations and Payroll by identifying best practice, latest research and inspiration from other organisations to continuously improve the employee and manager experience.

**Strategic Accountabilities

**

• Service design and operating model: Define and improve scalable People Operations and Payroll processes, service standards, ownership models, hand-offs and escalation routes in line with the One Team model and the future tiered Service Delivery Model.

• Data governance and controls: Establish governance standards, control requirements, reconciliation principles and audit-ready evidence standards across People Operations and Payroll.

• Systems and HRSD enablement: Own strategic requirements for SuccessFactors and ServiceNow HRSD, translating business needs into process design, workflow requirements, system enhancements, testing, training and adoption plans.

• Automation and robotics: Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, variation and repetitive work through automated workflows, robotics and close collaboration with GBS.

• Insights and continuous improvement: Use KPIs, process measures, satisfaction data, stakeholder feedback, external best practice and latest research to identify priorities and drive sustained improvement.

• Change and implementation: Lead structured implementation of transformation initiatives, including stakeholder engagement, communications, change planning, adoption and handover into business ownership.

**Key Success Measures

**

• Improved data accuracy, control effectiveness and audit readiness across People Operations and Payroll.

• Reduced manual effort, errors, rework and process variation through automation, robotics and improved workflows.

• Successful implementation and adoption of ServiceNow HRSD and the tiered Service Delivery Model.

• Clearer service ownership, escalation routes, standards and hand-offs across People Operations, Payroll and relevant People Experience touchpoints.

• Improved employee and manager satisfaction through simpler, more consistent and insight-led service delivery.

• Use of a Six Sigma-inspired measurement approach to define baselines, track errors and rework, identify root causes and evidence sustained process improvement.

• Delivery of agreed transformation milestones with sustainable handover into business ownership.

**Fit within the One Team People Operations Model

**

• Employees and managers are supported collectively by the operational People Operations and Payroll teams, rather than through dedicated Business Unit alignment.

• The wider People Operations role design preserves the One Team model while creating clearer specialist ownership and protected capacity for agreed focus areas.

• Operational specialists and associate specialists deliver day-to-day employee and manager services; this role complements them by creating the conditions for those services to become more scalable, automated, data-led and consistent.

• This role strengthens the foundations that enable consistent service delivery, including standards, governance, controls, reporting, automation, systems, HRSD enablement and service design.

• Day-to-day operational execution remains with the relevant operational teams; this role focuses on strategic improvement, implementation and enablement.

• Transformation priorities are informed by operational insight from operational teams, Payroll, Employee Relations, People Experience, GBS and People Experience & Services, but remain focused on scalable, future-ready solutions rather than live case delivery.

**Fit Within The Wider People Experience Team

**The Senior Specialist, People Operations Transformation also plays an important enabling role across the wider People Experience team. While the role is anchored in People Operations and Payroll transformation, its impact extends across People Experience, Employee Relations and Talent Acquisition because these areas are connected through shared employee and manager journeys, service touchpoints, data, systems and process hand-offs.

Within the wider People Experience team, this role helps turn strategic priorities into practical, scalable service improvements. It supports a more joined-up employee and manager experience by identifying where processes, technology, automation, knowledge, controls and service standards need to be better connected across the full employee lifecycle — from attraction and hiring through preboarding, employment, employee relations matters, leave management, query resolution and offboarding.

• People Operations and Payroll: strengthens the core service delivery model through data governance, automation, HRSD implementation, controls, reporting and process effectiveness.

• People Experience: ensures operational touchpoints are designed around a simple, consistent and positive employee and manager experience, using satisfaction data, best practice and external insights to inform improvements.

• Employee Relations: works closely with the Manager, Employee Relations to ensure processes, hand-offs, documentation, escalation routes and service standards support compliant, consistent and sensitive handling of employee matters.

• Talent Acquisition: connects hiring, preboarding and onboarding touchpoints so candidates, new joiners, hiring managers and People teams experience a clear, consistent and well-managed transition into employment.

In this way, the role acts as a strategic connector across the wider People Experience team. It does not own the functional agendas of People Experience, Employee Relations or Talent Acquisition, but it helps ensure that the processes, systems, data, automation and service design behind those agendas are joined up, measurable and scalable. This makes the role critical to building a more consistent, insight-led and future-ready employee and manager experience across the organisation.

Are you passionate about clinical research and eager to make a significant impact in the world of drug development? NBCD is seeking a dedicated Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to join our dynamic team at the forefront of international drug development research. Join us in an environment fueled by dedication and inspired by our core values: "Team up, Take on, and Try out." Here, you'll have the chance to make a significant difference while expanding your skillset.

Who are we?

NBCD, a key part of the Sanos Group with around 245 employees, is a world-leading CRO specializing in osteoarthritis and musculoskeletal diseases. We provide top-tier scientific and clinical trial services to the biotech and pharmaceutical industries. At NBCD, innovation is at our core, enabling us to develop life-changing medications efficiently through pioneering study designs and flawless execution. We focus on a few therapeutic areas, letting science drive our business, particularly in connective tissue diseases like osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis. Our comprehensive support covers everything from study design to regulatory affairs, ensuring expert handling at every step. Renowned worldwide for our scientific and operational excellence, NBCD leads in international medication development.

Your key role and responsibilities

Your role will be highly varied and include the following responsibilities:

• You will conduct on-site monitoring of NBCD trials according to ICH-GCP, which involves regular visits to hospitals and clinics in Denmark and other countries to:

• Ensure patient rights and safety are protected, and that physicians conduct trials according to protocols, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and approved procedures.

• Verify that electronically reported data is accurate, complete, and matches source data in patient files.

• Educate site staff and provide guidance on study-related matters.

• Write visit reports and follow-up letters to investigators.

NBCD has pioneered Risk-Based Monitoring, and you will play a critical role in Centralized Monitoring, a major part of this process. This includes:

• Remotely reviewing clinical database entries at our Søborg office to ensure data quality by proactively identifying issues, analyzing trends, and querying investigators for appropriate actions.

• Documenting findings and actions in centralized monitoring reports.

• Ensuring the Centralized Monitoring approach effectively identifies issues remotely.

Additionally, you will have the opportunity to work closely with our Clinical Trial Managers (CTM), assist them and gain responsibility for various tasks related to study or vendor management. These tasks can be tailored to your skills and interests.

Desired skills and experience

We are looking for candidates with an educational degree in health sciences who have experience with good clinical practice and clinical trials, whether through university projects or previous positions. Excellent communication skills are essential, and since most of our communication is in English, fluency in business English, both oral and written, is required.

Additionally, as the role involves on-site monitoring at Danish investigational sites, we prefer candidates who speak Danish natively or fluently.

Personal profile

You excel at working independently and take full accountability for your responsibilities. With a keen eye for detail, you understand that study monitoring relies on the accurate and thorough review of patient files and supporting documents. You are dedicated to meeting deadlines and following through on commitments, working persistently and with self-motivation.

You are committed to fostering a positive work environment where colleagues can thrive. You approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset, maintaining a positive and optimistic outlook that encourages collaboration and respects individualism.

You are comfortable with broad responsibilities, as we value agility and efficiency, and believe in empowering our employees with the freedom to operate and innovate. Your enthusiasm for innovative research drives your desire to learn new approaches and expand your core skill set.

Additionally, you are willing and able to travel both within Denmark and internationally, as our CRAs also monitor sites in English-speaking countries such as the UK and USA.

Are we the right cultural fit for you?

Our commitment to you is encapsulated in our promise to every one of our employees saying ‘Trust in you - in your development and impact´.

This pledge extends uniformly across all entities within the Sanos Group organization, including NBCD, ensuring that you feel its effects from the very offset of your interaction.

If you are curious about whether you would thrive within the Sanos Group culture and the Sanos Way of Leading, reflect on whether you see yourself working within our principles:

• Take on - Responsibility is given, and we inspire you to take it.

• Try out - Explore diverse tasks and grow professionally.

• Team up - We don’t just work together; we thrive together.

Want to know more? Check out the Voice of NBCD people here.

Apply and make a real impact

We look forward to hearing from you, so please send your application through the “apply” link.

We will be performing interviews ongoing in the process and look to fill the position as soon as possible. We close the position when we find the right candidate.

For further information about the role please contact, Associate Director, Anne Andresen, anne@nbcd.com.

You will be office-based at our headquarters in Søborg and you will be required to travel on a regular basis to our clinical sites within Denmark and other countries.

If you proceed in the recruitment process, you will go through a few additional steps where both you and we will assess whether this position is the right match for both parties. As part of the recruitment process, we use assessments to ensure the optimal match and the best foundation for future collaboration.

NBCD is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives leads to better decision-making and innovation. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive.

With an IoT platform connecting more millions of devices, and growing - Trackunit is building the connectivity layer underneath the construction industry. Every one of those units carries a cellular radio, and every one of those radios sits inside a web of standards, type approvals, and patent licences that decides whether we can ship and where we can ship.

You will join our IoT Division, Device Reliability Engineering (DRE) team as an expert on IoT certifications, standards, and licensing including Standard Essential Patents (SEP). This position shapes both our exposure and our coverage arguments, and it means this role works in every direction at once, with suppliers, regulatory approvals, legal advisors, product and engineering, and with customers.

This is a role for someone who can hold a genuinely complex domain in their head and then explain it in three sentences to a customer who has never heard the phrase “patent exhaustion.”

Experience level: a deep specialist role. We expect solid, hands-on experience with cellular device approvals and licensing — likely 10+ years across regulatory, certification, or IP/licensing work in mobile, IoT, or telecom hardware. This is a senior individual contributor position with no direct reports, high autonomy, and direct executive visibility.

With locations in the heart of Copenhagen, Kolding, Aarhus, and Aalborg, we offer a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations — or remotely from anywhere in Denmark.

****What's in it for you?

• A domain you will own, not administer. IoT Cellular License, SEP and certification strategy is an executive-level topic at Trackunit right now, with real financial exposure attached. You will not be filing paperwork in a corner, you will be shaping the position the company takes.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching, and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We offer a flexible setup because we believe you know best how to structure your work. Once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring — we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here.

****What you'll do

****Your work splits roughly into four parts: licensing, approvals, guidance, and governance.

• Own our SEP position. Understand where our cellular SEP exposure actually sits across our device portfolio, track the relevant patent pools and licensing programmes, and maintain a clear, evidence-based view of what is covered through our supply chain and what is not.

• Run supplier licensing due diligence. Establish and maintain a consistent set of asks across module suppliers — coverage confirmation, standards and generations covered, and honest disclosure of known gaps — so responses can be compared side by side and fed into supplier qualification.

• Support licensing negotiations and claims. Work alongside our General Counsel, external patent counsel, and economic advisors on royalty basis questions, valuation and apportionment arguments, and claims that reach us through our OEM customers. You bring the technical and supply chain substance; they bring the legal strategy.

• Own global type approvals and certification. Plan and steer RED/CE, FCC, ISED, UKCA, and the wider set of regional approvals, plus GCF/PTCRB and carrier certification, across a multi-region device portfolio. Keep certification on the critical path of new product programmes rather than at the end of them.

• Stay ahead of regulatory change. Cyber Resilience Act, RED delegated acts, radio spectrum and network sunsets, environmental and product compliance requirements — know what is coming, when it bites, and what it means for our roadmap.

• Make the complex simple, and guide without over-promising. Write and maintain the internal playbooks, customer-facing explainers, and OEM guidance that turn this domain into something a commercial colleague or a customer can act on. Be the person Sales, Legal, and customers come to when a licensing notification lands, explaining the landscape accurately, saying clearly where the limits of our position are, and pointing customers to independent specialist advice where that is the right answer.

• Build the governance. Response protocols, decision records, escalation paths, and embedding licensing and compliance requirements into how we qualify suppliers and run the product development lifecycle.

****Who you are

****We think you'll need

• Strong working knowledge of cellular connectivity (e.g. LTE-M, NB-IoT, LTE Cat-1/1bis, 5G) and the direction of travel, plus a real understanding of the module and chipset landscape.

• Solid, practical experience with licensing and Standard Essential Patents in mobile or IoT devices: FRAND principles, patent pools, patent exhaustion and the limits of sublicensing, and how royalties are actually structured and argued.

• Hands-on experience with global type approvals and regulatory certification for radio products — RED/CE, FCC, and the regional approvals that come with selling hardware worldwide.

• Experience working across a hardware supply chain with module suppliers, test houses, notified bodies, and certification partners.

Optimize the distribution network

**

• Experience in logistics sourcing, tenders, carrier management and supplier performance management.

• A strong commercial and cost mindset, with the ability to assess trade-offs across service, lead time, capacity and risk.

• Strong project and change management skills, including the ability to move improvements from analysis into implementation.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence across functions.

**You combine a strategic perspective with a practical approach. You are comfortable challenging existing arrangements but take the time to understand operational needs before recommending changes.

• Architect optimal ways to integrate GenAI into various existing and new products.

• Choose appropriate technical frameworks and optimization techniques for generative AI approaches, e.g., RAG.

• Work with prompt engineering, pre & post model invocation processing.

You will also optimize model usage cost, while you interpret and visualize model outputs for internal stakeholders, explaining complex AI concepts in simple terms. You will stay abreast of emerging AI trends and technologies, supporting the adoption of relevant innovations – while you also maintain high code quality and contribute to best practices in our AI development process.

**What we are looking for:

**We are looking for you with experience working with AI in Python: frameworks for LLM use like Langchain, Haystack 2.0, or Hugging Face. You have an extensive understanding of building enterprise solutions, primarily in Python – that you know how to integrate well into existing applications, services and enterprise architecture and then you also bring:

• Degree in computer science, AI, machine learning or a related field

• Professional experience delivering AI/ML solutions in Python

• Strong understanding of NLP, LLMs and transformer architectures, including practical experience designing and implementing RAG solutions using frameworks such as LangChain, Haystack 2.0 or Hugging Face

• Experience with React (TypeScript) Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals and design patterns

• Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform

• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes

• Experience with AWS and/or Azure

• Exceptional communication skills and fluency in English

**Nice to have

**

• Experience with Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search or similar

• Hands-on experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch

• Experience with .NET/C#

**Location and eligibility

**

• Based in Copenhagen

• Requires a valid Danish work permit

**How To Apply

**We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply early. Submit your CV and a brief cover letter via the Danske Bank careers site. If you have any questions, contact Aleksandar Milacic, Chapter Lead, at amila@danskebank.dk.

We look forward to receiving your application.

Turn photonic quantum processors into real-world value

At Sparrow Quantum, we are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of light-matter interfaces for quantum technology to enable state-of-the-art scalable photonic quantum systems.

Sparrow Quantum is building universal photonic quantum processors based on deterministic quantum emitters. We are looking for a Quantum Applications Scientist to build on Sparrow’s work on use cases and algorithms and to help push the frontier demonstrating what photonic quantum can do for real end users.

You will act as the bridge between our theory, experimental, and business teams and our end users. You will take an end user's problem, work out how our hardware can address it, and turn it into a concrete plan that you help execute together with the teams.

This is a technical role with a clear focus on applications. You have the theoretical depth to develop applications yourself, with an eye for the quantum algorithms behind them, the experimental insight to discuss feasibility with our experimentalists, and the overview to translate between what end users need and what our hardware can do. You are expected to take initiative and move from a loosely defined question to a workable solution.

Responsibilities of the role

• 
Identify and develop use cases and quantum algorithms for our demonstrator, from initial end-user needs to proof of concept

• 
Translate end-user problems into well-defined computational tasks, and assess where our hardware can offer value

• 
Discuss feasibility with our experimental team, and feedback which hardware capabilities matter most for applications

• 
Run and guide simulations of algorithms and use cases to benchmark performance and compare against classical approaches

• 
Join end-user meetings initiated by the business team as the technical bridge, and turn results into clear recommendations

• 
Work with the business team on proposals, demonstrations, partnerships, and funding applications

• 
Represent Sparrow Quantum at conferences, workshops, and end-user meetings

In brief, we offer a unique opportunity for a talented Quantum Applications Scientist to collaborate with world-leading professionals in the field. Your work will shape how end users apply our quantum hardware and help steer our technology towards the problems that matter most.

Required qualifications

• 
PhD in quantum physics or a closely related field, with a strong theoretical foundation, ideally with postdoctoral or industry experience

• 
Good understanding of quantum computing use cases and where they may offer an advantage, e.g. in optimization, machine learning or simulation, with an interest in the underlying algorithms

• 
Worked alongside experimentalists, giving you a solid sense of what is experimentally feasible

• 
Solid programming skills, e.g. in Python, for simulating and benchmarking algorithms

• 
Proven ability to communicate complex technical ideas to non-specialists, including end users and business stakeholders

Nice-to-have qualifications

• 
Experience with quantum photonics, quantum optics or photonic quantum computing

• 
Experience working with industry partners, customers or end users on applied projects

• 
Experience leading projects or supervising junior researchers

• 
Experience with collaborative R&D projects or funding applications

• 
Knowledge of boson sampling, measurement-based or fusion-based quantum computing

• 
A track record of publications in quantum technologies

Additionally, we expect that you thrive in a collaborative work environment and are inspired by the chance to contribute to groundbreaking advancements in quantum computing.

Desired abilities & competencies

• 
Overview: you keep the big picture in view and connect technical detail to what matters for the end user and for Sparrow Quantum.

• 
Translator: you are equally comfortable discussing algorithms with theorists, feasibility with experimentalists and value with end users.

• 
Proactive and solution-oriented: you spot opportunities, take the first step, and come back with options rather than obstacles.

• 
Constructive challenger: you are confident challenging assumptions, just as open to having your own challenged, and look for solutions that work both for the end user and for our hardware.

What we offer

• 
Passionate international team and high individual impact: Join a high-performance team of dynamic and highly motivated international professionals working towards photonic quantum computing. Your innovative ideas, unique perspectives, and unwavering drive to succeed are essential to the team and will have a direct impact on the future of our organization.

• 
Cutting-edge projects and world-renowned collaborators: Collaborate with world-renowned companies and researchers, working on cutting-edge projects that will shape the future of quantum technology. You will contribute to scientific publication, represent the company at conferences, and have the possibility of travelling to our collaborators for new insights and knowledge sharing.

• 
Personal and professional growth: Expect a steep learning curve in a supportive environment at the border between research and industry. Our commitment to your growth and development is reflected in our supportive culture, which includes group-based knowledge transfer, skill development, and opportunities for training and mentorship.

• 
Attractive compensation and career advancement opportunities: Receive a salary that is competitive and commensurate with your qualifications, with ample opportunities to advance your career and achieve your professional goals.

• 
Inclusive and positive work culture: Become part of a positive and inclusive work culture where we build meaningful relationships and celebrate one another and our achievements. Our work culture emphasizes work-life balance, with generous vacation time, flexible working hours with up to 10-20% working from home, lunch paid by the company, and a focus on employee well-being.

How to apply

If you share our passion for delivering a real-world impact through the development of unique quantum photonic technology and have the skills we believe are essential for future Sparrows, we would love to hear from you.

We are committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace at Sparrow Quantum and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities.

How to apply: Scroll down to apply with your CV and a short cover letter (in English).

Application deadline: November 1.

Starting date: As soon as possible.

Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis

Short-listed candidates will be invited for an in-person interview in Copenhagen. Travel and accommodation will be covered.

For questions, contact Larissa Vertchenko.

About Sparrow Quantum

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company dedicated to advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies. We are recognized globally for our high-performance single-photon sources and our foundational contributions to the quantum internet and quantum computing.

Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into

the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people across the globe.

We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food — we work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet.

Everything we do is about **Making Better Happen™.

**AAK Location

**This role can be based at either Aarhus, Hull or Karlshamn.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Global ESG Engineer to join AAK’s Global Operations team and help drive the implementation of our operational ESG strategy across our global manufacturing network.

As the technical ESG expert within Global Operations, you will translate AAK’s sustainability ambitions into practical engineering standards, measurable KPIs and improvement programmes. Your focus will be on identifying opportunities to improve energy efficiency, reduce carbon emissions, optimise water and waste, and improve the overall resource efficiency of our operations.

Working closely with Global Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing Excellence, Procurement, Digital & IT, EHS, Sustainability and regional teams, you will develop consistent approaches to ESG performance, strengthen the quality of our data and support sites in delivering measurable environmental and financial benefits.

This is a hands-on, global role where you will combine technical expertise, data-driven insight and stakeholder management to create scalable solutions across AAK’s manufacturing network. You will also play an important role in developing digital ESG reporting capabilities and embedding continuous improvement into our operations.

**Responsibilities

**

• Identify and prioritise ESG improvement opportunities across AAK’s manufacturing network, with a focus on energy, carbon, water, waste and resource efficiency.

• Co-develop and implement global engineering standards, technical specifications, methodologies and best practices that support consistent ESG performance.

• Work with manufacturing sites to assess technical solutions, develop business cases and quantify the environmental, energy and financial benefits of improvement projects.

• Translate global ESG targets into practical site-level roadmaps, KPIs, improvement projects and implementation plans.

• Drive the deployment of energy monitoring, carbon tracking and digital ESG data solutions to improve data quality, transparency and decision-making.

• Collaborate with Global Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing Excellence, Procurement, Digital & IT, EHS and Sustainability to embed ESG improvements into capital projects and daily operations.

• Use operational data and performance analysis to identify trends, improvement opportunities and priorities across regions.

• Track project progress, verify delivered benefits and share best practices and lessons learned across the global manufacturing network.

• Support the development of consistent ESG reporting and data management processes, ensuring reliable information for internal and external reporting requirements.

• Stay up to date with emerging technologies, ESG standards and regulatory developments, translating relevant changes into practical improvements for AAK’s operations.

**About You

**

• Degree in Chemical, Process, Energy, Environmental, Carbon & Net Zero Engineering or a related technical discipline, with 5–8+ years of relevant industry experience.

• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, industrial utilities, energy systems and operational environments, ideally with experience across multiple sites.

• Proven experience delivering ESG, sustainability, energy efficiency or carbon reduction programmes within manufacturing.

• Strong expertise in energy monitoring and reduction methodologies, with knowledge of approaches such as Pinch Analysis and experience calculating energy, carbon and financial savings.

• Good understanding of carbon accounting, Net Zero and ESG reporting frameworks, including GHG Protocol, CSRD, ESRS, SBTi, CDP and ESG Taxonomy.

• Experience developing engineering standards, technical specifications, project business cases, payback calculations and relevant engineering calculations.

• Strong data and digital capability, including experience with KPI reporting systems, data collection and dashboarding tools such as Power BI, Tableau or similar.

• Excellent project management, stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across regions and organisational levels.

• Structured, analytical and hands-on, with the credibility to engage both with site teams and senior leadership.

• Fluent in English and willing to travel internationally, with approximately 20–30% travel expected.

**In return AAK offers

**

• Join a pioneering company in specialty oils and fats, driving innovation and sustainability.

• In AAK you can work across 25+ countries, gaining international exposure and collaborating with a diverse team.

• AAK invests in your development with training, mentorship, and clear career paths.

• You will contribute to a greener world with AAK's sustainability-focused approach.

• Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values every individual's perspective and talents.

**About AAK

**Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™. We specialise in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable. At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer with the flexibility of our production assets and deep knowledge across multiple industries, including Chocolate and Confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care.

Our 4,000 employees support close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and more than 20 production facilities worldwide. Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden and listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years.

AAK is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms.

**Welcome to Generation CE

**You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions.

As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations

• translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes

• ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends

• overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives

• strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams

• promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience

• bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team

• understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry

• have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management

• can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions

• communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

**Pre-employment background checks:

**For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

What if your curiosity could help build the world we all imagine?

Are you eager to impact modern society while growing your professional and personal skills in a welcoming environment? Launch your career with our Forensic & Integrity Services team at EY, starting August 2027. We’re committed to investing in your potential throughout your journey.

Depending On The Assignments, You May Work On

What We Look For

Approaches complex information in a structured and analytical way

Qualifications:

**In this Compliance Product Enablement Student Assistant role, you’ll be…

**

• Translating legal documents and compliance-related content from English into Danish, ensuring legal precision, clarity, and consistency.

• Translating marketing materials containing compliance concepts to fit regional standards without losing accuracy.

• Supporting our software compliance work by helping maintain alignment with local laws, regulations, and industry standards.

• Assisting in the creation and maintenance of compliance blueprints alongside experienced market experts and our partners.

**Who is the Product Enablement Team?

**The Product Enablement Team sits at the intersection of our compliance domain expertise and market expansion. We ensure that our platform content, legal frameworks, and product materials are localised accurately across every market Formalize operates in.

We are part of Commercial, partnering closely with stakeholders in Product, Marketing, and Legal to bridge domain expertise with localised execution.

Essentially, we contribute to our vision by ensuring our software and messaging speak the language of local compliance with absolute precision.

**
