We’re big on trust and providing the freedom for you to thrive. Together, we’ll make sure you’ll be the best version of you. Because happy employees perform better and we’re in this for the long run. No matter the stage in life you’re in, we’ve got you.

Product Manager – Notifications | Help Dalux Users Focus on What Matters

Construction projects generate an enormous amount of information. Files change. Tasks are assigned. Deadlines approach. Comments are added. Reviews require action. Issues are reported. People are mentioned. Workflows progress. But more information does not necessarily make people better informed.

Dalux is looking for a Product Manager to take dedicated ownership of Notifications and help us answer a deceptively difficult product question:

How do we make sure users know what requires their attention – without overwhelming them with information?

Notifications exist throughout our products today, across email, mobile, and in-product experiences. As Dalux has grown, so has their complexity. We believe this area deserves dedicated product ownership and a coherent strategy across our products.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Notification Strategy: Define a coherent product direction for how Dalux communicates important events and required actions to users.

• Product Discovery: Understand when users need to be informed, when they need to take action, and when a notification simply creates unnecessary noise.

• Customer Insights: Research how different users manage information and attention across complex projects and busy working days.

• Cross-product Ownership: Map and improve notification experiences across Dalux products rather than optimizing individual notifications in isolation.

• Channels & Preferences: Develop experiences spanning in-app notifications, email, mobile push, notification preferences, subscriptions, following, mentions, reminders, and digests.

• Relevance & Prioritization: Explore grouping, prioritization, timing, and deduplication to ensure important information stands out.

• Actionability: Make notifications useful by ensuring users understand why they received them, what has changed, and what action they should take.

• Product Analytics: Use quantitative and qualitative insights to understand which notifications create value and which create noise.

• Shared Capabilities: Work with Development and other Product Managers to create common notification principles and platform capabilities that can be reused across Dalux.

About You

You probably don't currently have "Notifications Product Manager" as your job title – and that's perfectly fine.

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager who finds the underlying problem interesting and has the product and systems thinking required to solve it.

We believe you:

• Have strong Product Management experience, preferably from B2B SaaS, collaboration, productivity, workflow, communication, or similar software.

• Have excellent product discovery and UX instincts.

• Think systematically and can turn many individual use cases into coherent product concepts.

• Understand the tension between keeping users informed and creating notification fatigue.

• Are comfortable owning a horizontal capability spanning multiple products and development teams.

• Can combine user research with product analytics to understand behavior.

• Care about interaction details and understand how seemingly small product decisions can have a large cumulative impact on user experience.

• Can simplify complex systems involving events, recipients, relevance, timing, preferences, and communication channels.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Construction Technology Experience Is Welcome But Not Required .

Experience from collaboration, communication, workflow, or productivity software would be particularly relevant.

_Are you a passionate jewellery designer with extensive experience creating iconic products and collections? Would you like to shape the future of Pandora's Modern Classics & Diamonds category by creating innovative designs that combine timeless elegance with modern expression?

__**Lead creative projects that define the future of Pandora's most iconic collections

**_As our new Senior Designer, Modern Classics & Diamonds, you will work closely with the Design Director to lead creative projects from initial concept generation through design execution and prototype development. Utilizing your strong creative skills, technical expertise, and deep understanding of Pandora's brand DNA, you will play a key role in developing compelling collections that inspire customers around the world.

**Your Role

****Design & Collection Development

**

• Partner with the team to create and develop new collections within the Modern Classics & Diamonds category.

• Translate creative briefs into innovative product concepts, designs, and sketches that align with Pandora's brand identity.

• Lead individual design projects from initial research and concept development through CAD and prototype stages.

• Propose original and future-thinking product ideas that support the strategic direction of the category.

• Ensure projects are developed and launched within agreed timelines and project requirements.

• Review and provide comprehensive feedback on CADs within agreed timeframes.

• Develop creative mood boards, concept presentations, creative sketches, and technical drawings to support product development.

• Brief products to Design Operations & Development (DoD) and collaborate closely to ensure successful prototype execution.

• Review early prototypes and provide feedback ahead of formal prototype review sessions.

• Support prototype reviews and creative evaluations when required.

• Collaborate with Creative Sourcing to explore new materials, techniques, and innovation opportunities.

• Partner with Creative Merchandising to align category and collection structures.

• Ensure legal documentation and inspiration references are provided within agreed timelines.

• Maintain accurate design documentation, presentations, folders, and project records throughout the design process.

• Support and mentor Junior Designers, providing guidance on both creative and technical aspects of their work.

**Research & Innovation

**

• Conduct research projects based on briefs from Creative Leadership.

• Participate in research trips to identify emerging trends, products, techniques, materials, and creative inspiration.

• Translate research findings into strong creative concepts and collection ideas.

• Contribute to the development of new concepts, innovation opportunities, and future category directions.

• Ensure all research, concept development, reviews, and launches are delivered according to agreed timelines and processes.

• Update design presentations with relevant concepts, sketches, and final designs throughout project development.

**A Creative Visionary with a Passion for Jewellery Design

**You might be the person we are looking for if you combine exceptional creativity with strong technical expertise and an eye for commercial product design. You are skilled at transforming inspiration into compelling jewellery concepts and are comfortable working across all stages of the design process, from initial idea generation to final product execution.

You understand how to balance innovation with brand consistency and have a proven ability to create products that strengthen and evolve an established global brand. You enjoy working collaboratively in a fast-paced international environment and thrive when bringing new ideas to life.

**Requirements

**

• Extensive experience designing jewellery within a fashion, luxury, or jewellery brand.

• Strong creative portfolio demonstrating concept development, mood boards, sketches, and finished products.

• Proven experience leading design projects from concept to prototype.

• Advanced knowledge of jewellery design and manufacturing processes.

• Strong hand-sketching and visual communication skills.

• Experience working with CAD development and cross-functional product development teams.

• Ability to translate creative direction into commercially successful products.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• Experience mentoring or supporting junior designers is an advantage.

• Proficiency in relevant design tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.

**Important

**Please include a portfolio showcasing your design work, creative process, technical skills, and collection development experience as part of your application.

**Your New Team

**As a key member of Pandora's Product Design team, you will join an international group of passionate, ambitious, and highly skilled designers dedicated to creating beautiful and innovative jewellery. You will report to the Design Director and collaborate closely with colleagues across Creative Direction, Design Operations & Development, Creative Merchandising, Creative Sourcing, and Product Development.

**Additional Information

**This role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

**Did We Get Your Attention?

**If you see yourself in this position and would like to become part of Pandora's future, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please submit your CV and portfolio through our online application system. We look forward to hearing from you.

We process applications on an ongoing basis and therefore encourage you to submit your application at your earliest convenience. You can read more about Pandora on our corporate website Pandora Group.

**Icing on the Cake

**You will be working from our beautiful Global Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Alongside our inspiring work environment, we are proud to hold LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design, reflecting our commitment to sustainability and responsible use of resources.

The result is a professional and dynamic workspace that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to everyone who works here and visits our offices.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

With an IoT platform connecting more millions of devices, and growing - Trackunit is building the connectivity layer underneath the construction industry. Every one of those units carries a cellular radio, and every one of those radios sits inside a web of standards, type approvals, and patent licences that decides whether we can ship and where we can ship.

You will join our IoT Division, Device Reliability Engineering (DRE) team as an expert on IoT certifications, standards, and licensing including Standard Essential Patents (SEP). This position shapes both our exposure and our coverage arguments, and it means this role works in every direction at once, with suppliers, regulatory approvals, legal advisors, product and engineering, and with customers.

This is a role for someone who can hold a genuinely complex domain in their head and then explain it in three sentences to a customer who has never heard the phrase “patent exhaustion.”

Experience level: a deep specialist role. We expect solid, hands-on experience with cellular device approvals and licensing — likely 10+ years across regulatory, certification, or IP/licensing work in mobile, IoT, or telecom hardware. This is a senior individual contributor position with no direct reports, high autonomy, and direct executive visibility.

With locations in the heart of Copenhagen, Kolding, Aarhus, and Aalborg, we offer a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations — or remotely from anywhere in Denmark.

****What's in it for you?

• A domain you will own, not administer. IoT Cellular License, SEP and certification strategy is an executive-level topic at Trackunit right now, with real financial exposure attached. You will not be filing paperwork in a corner, you will be shaping the position the company takes.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching, and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We offer a flexible setup because we believe you know best how to structure your work. Once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring — we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here.

****What you'll do

****Your work splits roughly into four parts: licensing, approvals, guidance, and governance.

• Own our SEP position. Understand where our cellular SEP exposure actually sits across our device portfolio, track the relevant patent pools and licensing programmes, and maintain a clear, evidence-based view of what is covered through our supply chain and what is not.

• Run supplier licensing due diligence. Establish and maintain a consistent set of asks across module suppliers — coverage confirmation, standards and generations covered, and honest disclosure of known gaps — so responses can be compared side by side and fed into supplier qualification.

• Support licensing negotiations and claims. Work alongside our General Counsel, external patent counsel, and economic advisors on royalty basis questions, valuation and apportionment arguments, and claims that reach us through our OEM customers. You bring the technical and supply chain substance; they bring the legal strategy.

• Own global type approvals and certification. Plan and steer RED/CE, FCC, ISED, UKCA, and the wider set of regional approvals, plus GCF/PTCRB and carrier certification, across a multi-region device portfolio. Keep certification on the critical path of new product programmes rather than at the end of them.

• Stay ahead of regulatory change. Cyber Resilience Act, RED delegated acts, radio spectrum and network sunsets, environmental and product compliance requirements — know what is coming, when it bites, and what it means for our roadmap.

• Make the complex simple, and guide without over-promising. Write and maintain the internal playbooks, customer-facing explainers, and OEM guidance that turn this domain into something a commercial colleague or a customer can act on. Be the person Sales, Legal, and customers come to when a licensing notification lands, explaining the landscape accurately, saying clearly where the limits of our position are, and pointing customers to independent specialist advice where that is the right answer.

• Build the governance. Response protocols, decision records, escalation paths, and embedding licensing and compliance requirements into how we qualify suppliers and run the product development lifecycle.

****Who you are

****We think you'll need

• Strong working knowledge of cellular connectivity (e.g. LTE-M, NB-IoT, LTE Cat-1/1bis, 5G) and the direction of travel, plus a real understanding of the module and chipset landscape.

• Solid, practical experience with licensing and Standard Essential Patents in mobile or IoT devices: FRAND principles, patent pools, patent exhaustion and the limits of sublicensing, and how royalties are actually structured and argued.

• Hands-on experience with global type approvals and regulatory certification for radio products — RED/CE, FCC, and the regional approvals that come with selling hardware worldwide.

• Experience working across a hardware supply chain with module suppliers, test houses, notified bodies, and certification partners.

• Communication as a core skill, not a bonus. You can take a genuinely complicated subject and land it in plain language, in writing, with an audience that has no background in it.

• The judgement to know what we can and cannot say to a customer, and the discipline to hold that line even when it would be easier not to.

**What Matters More Than The Checklist

**

• You are honest about uncertainty. In this domain, no one can offer a blanket guarantee, and the people who claim otherwise create problems later. We would rather be accurate than reassuring.

• You are curious and self-driven, this is a field that changes constantly, and nobody is going to hand you a reading list.

• You finish things. A clear one-page answer delivered this week beats a perfect analysis that arrives after the decision was made.

• You are comfortable being the only person in the room who knows a subject, and you use that position to make others smarter rather than to make yourself indispensable.

On AI: experience with AI tooling is not a requirement, but a strong motivation and interest in working with it is. We already use AI in our daily engineering work, including MCP servers and agents against our own platform, and we see clear potential in applying it to research, documentation, and compliance workflows. We don't expect you to have experience with this but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to learn.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this role and your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

****How you'll grow here

****This is a specialist role with an unusually wide view of the business, and we've set it up that way on purpose.

• Executive proximity. You will work closely with the SVP of IoT Division, while reporting into a central function for IoT, as the Device Reliability Engineering. You will help in presenting to executive leadership on exposure, risk, and recommendations. Your analysis will inform on a product technical matter (Not Legal) but with real financial and commercial decisions.

• Cross-functional reach. Legal, Finance, Product Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Sales all depend on this domain. Few roles at Trackunit touch as many parts of the company.

• External network. You will work with external patent counsel, economic consultants, module suppliers, certification bodies, and industry forums — building a network that extends well beyond Trackunit.

• Room to define the function. This discipline is being built out now. What it becomes — and whether it grows into a team — is substantially yours to shape.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We're committed to construction one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products — it's a way of life at Trackunit. We're proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

Job Description

How does Europe reap the benefits of AI, while remaining secure, sovereign and true to its democratic values? These are some of the questions that Netcompany Institute has set out to answer, and we are looking for two student assistants to help us do just that.

Netcompany Institute is a new analytical unit providing data-driven analyses of how AI and digitalization affect Europe. The aim is to strengthen the evidence base for public debate and help decision-makers navigate the choices that will shape Europe’s digital future.  You'll join a small team: a Chief Economist and two full-time Analytics Consultants.

Responsibilities

You will support analyses throughout their lifecycle – from framing questions to communicating results. Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Monitor policy developments and research on AI and digitalisation in Europe

• Collect and structure data from Eurostat, OECD and statistical offices

• Produce descriptive statistics, tables and charts publication-ready

• Write analytical text and fact-check sources

Responsibility grows with experience. At the beginning you will work closely with an Analytics Consultant on clearly defined tasks; over time we expect you to take ownership of analyses in your own right.

How we work with AI

AI tools are integral to our work. We use them for literature searches, data work and monitoring – so human time focuses on what matters most: finding the right questions, interpreting results and communicating them clearly. About you

We are looking for two students who can each work approximately 16 hours per week. We are flexible during exam periods, but availability is expected in the lead-up to publication deadlines and events. To succeed in this role, you:

• Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a must; Danish is an advantage.

• Are curious about how AI and digitalisation are changing European economies and societies

jobs.occupation: Head of Vestas Production Management System (VPMS)
jobs.description:
VPMS defines and deploys the common Vestas Production Management System across the global manufacturing footprint, establishing the standards and management routines required for sustainable operational excellence.

Vestas is seeking a senior leader to own and evolve the Vestas Production System (VPS) the operating system that drives performance, culture, and competitiveness across our global manufacturing network.

As Director of VPS, you will be accountable for the design, governance, deployment, and continuous improvement of the production system across Nacelles, Blades, Logistics, Warehousing, and new factory ramp‑ups. Your role is to make VPMS the standard approach across every manufacturing site, turning strategy into action and building a culture of operational Excellence.

Responsibilities

• Direct the development, governance, and ongoing refinement of the Vestas Production System (VPS), keeping it aligned with business goals and manufacturing strategy.

• Enable the global deployment and sustainable implementation of VPS standards, tools, and ways of working across manufacturing sites.

• Own and enhance the VPS framework, establishing clear standards for shop floor management, standard work, flow optimisation, problem solving, and loss management.

• Conduct VPS maturity assessments, audits, and gap closure activities to support operational Excellence and continuous improvement.

• Guide strategy deployment activities to align breakthrough objectives with operational priorities across all manufacturing locations.

• Coach and develop plant leadership teams, building capability and embedding a culture of continuous improvement and operational discipline.

• Identify, benchmark, and replicate manufacturing best practices globally to improve performance, consistency, and efficiency.

• Oversee and develop the global VPS team, ensuring VPS initiatives deliver measurable improvements in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.

Qualifications

• Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related field.

• 15+ years of leadership experience within global manufacturing environments.

• Demonstrated ability to deploy and sustain high-performing production systems across multiple plants.

• Deep knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, and continuous improvement.

• Demonstrated experience leading large scale transformation and cultural change initiatives.

• International leadership experience within complex, matrixed organisations.

Competencies

• Experienced in building strong, trusted relationships throughout the organisation, from the shop floor to senior leaders.

• Strategic and commercially minded leader with a practical approach to execution and operational improvement.

• Strong Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement experience, with the ability to produce sustainable results.

• Experienced change agent with experience leading transformation initiatives in complex manufacturing environments.

• Skilled in coaching, mentoring, and problem solving, with the ability to grow capable teams and leaders.

• Able to translate standards, data, and improvement methodologies into simple, effective daily operational practices that improve performance.

What We Offer

A key global leadership opportunity to shape and evolve the Vestas Production Management System (VPMS), improving operational excellence across our worldwide manufacturing network. You will play a pivotal role in shaping strategy, developing organisational capability, and delivering measurable improvements in performance, while collaborating with senior leaders and teams across the globe.

Additional Information

This position can be based in Taranto, Italy, Szczecin, Poland or Aarhus, Denmark, where you will join our global manufacturing team. We reserve the right to amend or withdraw this job posting at any time, including before the advertised closing date. If this opportunity aligns with your skills and experience, we encourage you to apply no later than 4th November 2026. If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Vips Patel, Strategic Search Partner, at Vippa@vestas.com.

jobs.description:
Lead the team. Grow the business. Shape what comes next.

Are you ready to lead commercial growth across a diverse and important healthcare customer segment? This is a visible leadership role where strategy, customer insight and an engaged sales team come together with real ownership of commercial performance and the future direction of the business.

At Mediq Denmark, you will lead a team of 8 sales professionals supporting GP’s, specialist clinics and private hospitals. You will work closely with the Sales Director to turn market insight into action, strengthen customer partnerships and identify the opportunities that can move the segment forward.

This is a role for a leader who enjoys being close to the market. One day you may be shaping the sales strategy or challenging a business case; the next, joining a strategic customer discussion, coaching a colleague or turning a new idea into a practical growth plan.

Your impact

You will set the direction for the segment and translate ambition into profitable, sustainable growth. With ownership of the sales budget, forecast and commercial performance, you will keep customer value, market opportunities and team development firmly in focus.

• Develop and execute the sales strategy for GP’s, specialist clinics and private hospitals, supported by clear segmentation, targeting and account plans.

• Strengthen relationships across the customer landscape, from individual practices to strategic private hospital accounts, and take an active role in key negotiations and customer meetings.

• Use customer, market and competitor insight to identify growth opportunities, shape go-to-market plans and guide pricing and commercial decisions.

• Lead, coach and develop eight sales professionals, creating clear priorities, accountability and the confidence to perform at their best.

• Connect Sales with Category, Product Management and Sourcing to align the assortment, supplier strategy and commercial priorities around a strong customer experience.

What you bring

We are looking for a commercially curious and customer-focused sales leader who sees the bigger picture, acts with pace and brings people with them. You are comfortable moving between strategic business development and hands-on sales leadership, and you know when to explore the detail and when to step back and set direction.

• At least five years of documented experience in a comparable commercial and leadership role, including leading, coaching and developing sales professionals.

• A strong track record in sales execution, performance management and working with sales processes at both operational and strategic level.

• Strong commercial and analytical judgement, including the ability to develop and assess business cases and make sound pricing and growth decisions.

• Confident negotiation, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, supported by a structured and pragmatic approach to projects and processes.

• High energy, clear ownership and the ability to prioritise in a fast-paced and complex environment.

• Fluency in Danish and English. Experience from MedTech or the healthcare sector is an advantage.

Why join Mediq?

You will join a role where sales leadership is close to the action and your decisions will be visible. You will have the opportunity to influence commercial direction, build stronger customer partnerships and develop a team that can take this customer segment into its next chapter.

Our values - Customer Drive, Champion Spirit and Caring Heart - guide how we work, with a constant focus on creating value for patients.

Ready to lead the next stage of growth?

Bring your commercial leadership, customer focus and energy to Mediq. Help us strengthen the business, develop our people and build what comes next for customers across Denmark.

Location: Copenhagen Denmark.

Interested?

Submit your application through CareersatMediq.com or contact Artjoms.Bikovskis@Mediq.com, Talent Acquisition Partner Nordics and Baltics. We review every application with care and look forward to learning what you could bring to the future of Mediq Denmark.

Mediq is a leading European healthcare company with a 125-year legacy, operating in 14 countries with over 3,000 employees. Guided by our vision to enable sustainable healthcare, we focus on improving care outcomes and affordability through innovative products, services and solutions. Partnering with healthcare professionals across hospitals, clinics and home care, we help ensure patients receive the care they need to live independently, securely and feel more human.

At Mediq, we offer jobs that change lives. Join us.

Are you passionate about leading product teams and ensuring technology investments deliver real business value? Then we might have just the job for you at Specsavers.

_**Your role

**As our Technology Product Manager, you will be responsible for leading our Clinical product team and creating the conditions for them to deliver outstanding business value and setting the Strategic direction for the product together with Heads of Product Management and Architects, as well as driving the product Vision together with the Product Owner.

You will work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, developers, architects, and business stakeholders to ensure product development aligns with business priorities and strategic goals. Acting as both a people leader and product leader, you will support your teams in delivering valuable outcomes while fostering a collaborative and agile culture. You are a strong communicator who enjoys bringing people together, navigating complexity, and enabling others to succeed.

**Key Responsibilities Include

**

• Lead and support product teams to deliver valuable business outcomes.

• Drive alignment between product vision, delivery plans, and business objectives.

• Partner with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and stakeholders to enable successful product delivery.

• Foster collaboration, agile ways of working, and continuous improvement across teams.

• Provide people leadership, coaching, and development for team members.

• Build strong stakeholder relationships and communicate product progress, priorities, and outcomes.

• Remove barriers and help teams overcome challenges that impact delivery.

**Your new team

The Platform Supports Our Instore Customer Journey And Consists Of

• Clinical Eye Examination- and Integration platform.

• Clinical Devices for capture of Eye Measurements and EyeHelth examinations, and

• Clinical Journals.

In this role, you'll lead product teams that develop and deliver technology solutions supporting colleagues, customers, and business operations across Northern Europe. Together, you'll focus on creating value through strong product leadership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**What are we looking for?

**We are preferably looking for a candidate with the following competencies:

• Proven experience in Product Management and leading technology product teams in complex environments.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills across all levels of an organisation.

• Deep understanding of agile product development, delivery, and leadership.

• Experience developing people, building high-performing teams, and driving business value through technology investments.

• Strong commercial awareness with the ability to align product strategy, customer needs, and business objectives.

**It Would Be An Advantage If You Have

**

• Experience working across multiple countries, markets, or distributed teams.

• Experience with coaching, mentoring, facilitation, or organisational change initiatives.

• Knowledge of retail, healthcare, optometry, or audiology environments.

• Experience working within large-scale agile organisations and product-led operating models.

**As a Person, We Believe That You Are

**

• A collaborative and inspiring leader who empowers others to succeed.

• Curious and proactive, with a continuous improvement mindset.

• An excellent communicator who builds trust and navigates complexity with confidence.

• Structured and pragmatic, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

• Solution-oriented and motivated by creating value for customers and the business.

**What Awaits You Upon Joining Specsavers

**At Specsavers, you'll get more than just a job. You will join us on a journey to make eye health and hearing services accessible to everyone. We offer an exciting and challenging role in an organisation with strong ambitions, where you'll be part of a collaborative and supportive culture.

**Joining Us, You’ll Get

**

• Competitive compensation and benefits.

• Opportunities for professional and personal development.

• A collaborative and inclusive workplace.

• The opportunity to lead talented product teams in an international environment.

• The chance to influence technology products and services used across multiple countries.

**Is this your next step? Then apply today

**Diversity & Inclusion at Specsavers

jobs.occupation: Commercial Product Manager, Sloped Roof Windows
jobs.description:
**Step into a role where commercial insight meets strategic impact. If you are passionate about understanding customer needs, identifying new growth opportunities and shaping the future of one of the most important product categories in VELUX, you could be our next Commercial Product Manager.

****Meet your future team

**You will join the Sloped Roof Windows Category team at our Head Office in Hørsholm. The team plays a central role in shaping the future of our largest and most important product category, working at the intersection of customer needs, innovation, strategy and commercial performance.

Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. You will work closely with colleagues across Sales, Marketing, Product Development, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations and regional organisations around the world. Together, we translate market opportunities and customer insights into product portfolio decisions that drive sustainable and profitable growth.

The team is characterised by a high level of ambition, an informal and collaborative culture, and a shared commitment to creating meaningful business impact.

**What We Offer

**This is not a traditional product management role focused on maintaining an existing portfolio. Instead, you will play a key role in identifying where future growth will come from, shaping strategic choices and mobilising the organisation to bring them to life.

You will gain exposure across our international business, collaborate with senior stakeholders and influence decisions with significant commercial impact. In return, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while helping shape the future of healthy, comfortable and sustainable living.

More specifically, your tasks will be to:

• Identify and develop growth opportunities across products, solutions, customer segments and markets

• Translate customer, market and commercial insights into portfolio recommendations and compelling business cases

• Strengthen value propositions, positioning, pricing and category differentiation to improve commercial performance

• Drive portfolio priorities, product launches and strategic category initiatives in close collaboration with regional and functional stakeholders

You should expect some travel, both within Denmark and internationally, to engage with customers, markets and colleagues across our global organisation.

**What You Will Bring

**You are commercially minded, customer-focused and motivated by complex business challenges. You enjoy connecting strategic thinking with practical execution and thrive in environments where collaboration, influence and analytical thinking are key to success.

You know how to turn insights into action, create alignment among diverse stakeholders and move initiatives forward. Most importantly, you are motivated by delivering meaningful business results and helping shape the future direction of a category.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Bring experience from product management, category management, business development, commercial strategy or a comparable role, ideally within an international organisation

• Have strong commercial and analytical capabilities and can build robust business cases based on data, customer understanding and sound judgement

• Are skilled at influencing decisions, communicating recommendations clearly and creating alignment across functions and organisational levels

• Work in a structured and proactive manner, balancing multiple priorities while driving initiatives forward with ownership and energy

Experience from building materials, construction, durable goods, consumer products or another product-oriented industry is an advantage, but not a requirement. We are equally interested in candidates who bring a fresh commercial perspective and can apply it successfully within our business.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect from our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof to transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark.

Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**In the VELUX Group, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected and valued.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already part of VELUX. That means we recruit, hire, train and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

jobs.occupation: Excellence & Engagement Manager - Health, Safety & Security
jobs.description:
Do you want to be a valued part of a global team that works passionately every day to ensure employees at DFDS go to work for DFDS and return safely and unharmed home to their loved ones? If this excites you then look no further and come join us.

About The Role  Be part of the movement - and play your part.   As Excellence & Engagement Manager in the Global Health, Safety & Security Team, you will be part of the continuous strengthening of DFDS’ health, safety and security culture. This is a new global role, and we expect you to participate in shaping and developing it. We anticipate that you will contribute by developing, implementing and continuously improving the frameworks, standards, tools, learning processes, communications and engagement activities that enable a strong Health, Safety & Security (HSS) performance across DFDS landside operations.

You will be responsible for ensuring consistent and effective deployment of group-wide HSS initiatives across DFDS operations area, supporting operational teams in anchoring safe and secure behaviors. The role works closely with the HSS Business Partners, other operational stakeholders and senior management to strengthen organizational learning, capability, culture and performance.

The role reports directly to the Global Director for HSS, and you will be based at our Global Headquarters in the port of Copenhagen. The role requires on-site presence.

What kind of exciting challenges can you expect to meet in this role?:  **Role

**As Excellence & Engagement Manager - HSS you will get the opportunity to influence and develop the role but the initial areas we expect you to cover are:

• Develop, coordinate and monitor global HSS initiatives.

• Develop, coordinate and maintain global HSS culture-building activities, campaigns and engagement programs aiming to strengthen safe and secure behaviors.

• Maintain and continuously improve our HSSEQ Management System.

• Develop, implement and continuously improve a Managers Toolkit on HSS.

• Manage Performance Monitoring and Improvement related to HSS in close collaboration with HSS Business Partners.

• Develop and coordinate DFDS’ organizational learning processes on HSS, ensuring learnings from incidents, audits etc. are translated into practical improvements and shared across the organization.

• Support leadership teams in understanding and applying HSS frameworks, standards and improvement methodologies.

• Build strong working relationships with operational leaders, local HSS teams, and functional stakeholders.

About You We think that the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills and strong characters bring out the best in us all. With this in mind, we think that you are passionate about health, safety & security, have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, are a good listener and can digest large amounts of information and convert it into actions.

You Are Structured, Self-supporting And Capable Of Both Prioritizing And Multitasking In a Demanding Environment. Moreover, We Imagine That The Ideal Candidate Brings

• Ability to think strategically, translating HSS strategy into practical solutions and measurable business outcomes.

• A passion for building a strong HSS culture through engagement, communication and leadership influence.

• Experience in developing and implementing standards, frameworks and management systems within operational environments.

• Natural collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence without direct authority.

• Strong organizing skills, bringing structure, governance and consistency to complex initiatives.

• Capability to operate between strategy and execution, balancing long-term objectives with day-to-day deliveries, in a global corporate function.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, good listening abilities, and the ability to digest large amounts of information and convert it into actions.

• A self-driven approach, with the ability to prioritize and multitask in a demanding environment.

**Furthermore, You Have

**

• A degree in business, organizational development, safety or security management, or related field.

• Proven experience (5+ years) within safety or security related functions in a global or matrixed organization.

• Experience in shipping, logistics, or industrial sectors is highly desirable.

• Strong understanding of safety/security culture principles and organizational behavior is an advantage.

• Excellent presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Knowledge of or certification in change management methodologies is a plus.

• Project management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) is an advantage.

• Proficiency in English (oral and written) as English is corporate language.

• Proficiency in Microsoft 365 suite.

• Experience in utilizing AI tools is an advantage.

Working at DFDS  Join the movement and grow with us.  While you’re with us, we want you to develop and move yourself on. We’ll encourage you to challenge yourself to acquire new skills and perspectives.

At DFDS, we promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.   If you think your personality, skills, experience and aspirations match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Send us your resume as soon as possible as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

Is there something you need to know, we haven’t covered here, please do not hesitate to reach out to Global Director HSS (Landside) Steffen Conradsen on sconr@dfds.com.

Please note that response times may be slightly longer than usual due to the autumn holiday period and business travel activities within the hiring team, however, rest assured that we will get back to you at earliest convenience.

We look forward to hearing from you.   This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.

Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation

Hybrid (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)

**

Shape the Future of Privacy**

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

**About the Role

**Revenue Operations is the horizontal backbone behind Usercentrics' three go-to-market motions — Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led. As we scale, our Salesforce ecosystem and wider GTM tech stack need a single owner who can turn ambitious business requirements into governed, scalable systems. As Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation, you'll lead a team spanning Salesforce administration and GTM engineering, and you'll be the one deciding how AI-native automation gets built into our GTM workflows. You'll partner closely with other Revenue Operations teams, the broader GTM organization, and stakeholders across Finance and Product to translate business requirements into efficient, reliable systems.

**Responsibilities

**> Own CRM architecture and governance end-to-end, ensuring Salesforce supports Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led without compromising on data integrity.

> Set the roadmap and standards for the wider GTM tech stack, tying every major investment to a clear business outcome - pipeline quality, forecasting reliability, or support efficiency - not just tool delivery.

> Lead and grow a small team spanning Salesforce administration, Salesforce architecture, and GTM engineering, keeping the team focused on high-impact initiatives tied to clear business outcomes, and acting as the final technical decision-maker on system changes.

> Drive AI-native workflows and automation across GTM - from propensity and churn scoring models to workflow automation - that reduce manual work, increase seller and CS productivity, and improve the customer experience.

> Own attribution and data hygiene practices, partnering closely with BI on the underlying data infrastructure and pipeline.

> Drive adoption and value realization of the systems you build, partnering with GTM Enablement to make sure new capabilities actually change day-to-day behavior, not just go live.

> Continuously evaluate GTM tooling and market trends, bringing investment recommendations to the VP of Revenue Operations based on expected business impact and ROI.

Requirements

Experience

> 5+ years of experience in RevOps, Salesforce administration and GTM systems, with real ownership of architecture-level decisions.

> Experience managing a technical team in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

Technical Skills

> Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise (architecture, automation, integrations).

> Practical experience with tools like n8n, Clay, and Outreach, and with AI-assisted workflows in a revenue context.

Operating Skills

> Strong data instincts: comfortable owning attribution, data hygiene, and governance across a growing tech stack.

> Confident operating independently and making system decisions without needing to escalate every call.

> Comfortable being the technical backstop for a Solution Architect, Administrator, and Engineer, without needing to do the hands-on build yourself day to day.

Benefits

Include:

> Development Budget for every employee: 800,- EUR / year

> Job-related Language Courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish etc.): 350,- EUR / year

> Hybrid working policy and the possibility to take a workcation (90 days per year from a European country

> Online yoga sessions

> Massages

> Headspace App

> Events - Team Buildings, happy hours, parties/get togethers, occasional company covered breakfasts/lunches, in/across offices, online/in person etc

> Gifts - We celebrate life & work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new born babies and similar)

> Snacks, fruits, coffee and drinks in the office

Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together

Company culture is important to us - we strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

Get involved! We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all department enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

Your work-life balance is important to us too - we offer flexible working hours, hybrid working and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon, New York and Buenos Aires or online

You are the most valuable asset to our company which is why we’re happy to offer awesome benefits like our personal development budget, job-related language courses and a lot more (depending on your location) to focus on your well being

Usercentrics is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Do you want to shape the engineering direction behind technology that drives the energy sector?

At Mind Energy, technology enables how we trade, optimise and evolve in a fast-moving energy market. As our Senior Software Engineer, you take a central role in building and evolving the digital backbone that supports critical business decisions every day.

You combine strong technical depth with architectural thinking and a hands-on engineering mindset. Working closely with experienced colleagues across development and business, you help shape scalable systems, influence technical direction and raise the engineering bar around you.

DIVE INTO WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY TASKS WILL BE

In this role, you take an active par t in shaping the technical direction of our digital landscape. You modernise existing systems, build new solutions and turn complexity into reliable, scalable software that supports both trading and long-term growth.

Your mission is to:

• Design, develop, test and deploy stable, scalable and secure software solutions

• Take architectural responsibility and influence the long-term direction of our digital platform

• Build resilient services and systems designed for performance, scalability and maintainability

• Drive technical improvements and challenge existing solutions with a strong engineering mindset

• Collaborate closely across teams while supporting knowledge sharing, sparring and engineering quality

JOIN A TEAM OF MINDFUL ACHIEVERS

You’ll join an autonomous, cross-functional team with end-to-end ownership of its domain, spanning design, architecture, implementation and operations.

Together, you work closely with business stakeholders to translate complex needs into robust, scalable and secure solutions that create real value for our customers.

At Mind Energy, we value both independence and collaboration.

Your work ranges from refining existing systems to shaping entirely new solutions, always with a clear sense of ownership and responsibility. You approach complexity with curiosity and turn challenges into solutions built to last.

LET’S SWITCH THE FOCUS TO YOU

You are an experienced engineer who thrives with ownership, technical responsibility and the opportunity to influence how solutions are designed and built. You bring strong engineering fundamentals, architectural understanding and the confidence to challenge decisions when better

solutions exist.

We imagine that you bring:

• Extensive experience building scalable systems in C# and .NET, with a consistent approach to clean, maintainable code and modern design patterns

• Hands-on experience designing and building resilient, event-driven services in distributed and cloud-native environments

• Experience balancing scalability, reliability and maintainability when designing architectures for complex production systems

• Experience taking technical ownership and helping shape engineering direction through architectural decisions, sparring and pragmatic technical leadership

If you also have insight into the energy sector, it will be an advantage, but it is not required.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply, as we believe that a diverse team leads to innovation and success.

Please note that this role requires working from our office location Aarhus N.

WE MIGHT BE BIASED, BUT IT IS QUITE AWESOME HERE

People here care about doing things well and creating a place people genuinely enjoy being part of. We like to hack the everyday, from breakfast and lunch made in-house with organic ingredients to in-house massage, something in the freezer when the day runs late and the occasional “Just Because” surprise. You also get five Switch Days, equal to a seventh holiday week, giving you extra flexibility and room to recharge throughout the year.

Through Mind Club, people come together around everything from padel and Football Shirt Fridays to clay pigeon shooting and Christmas afternoons with your family and Santa. And with Mind Academy, you grow alongside sharp and curious colleagues who challenge ideas, share knowledge and help each other level up. These are just some of the things that make us special. It’s easier to experience in person.

We’re mindful achievers. It shapes how we work, think and grow together, while recognising that well-being, care and integrity matter just as much as the results we create. This is a place to focus, grow and achieve more.

LET US GET THIS CONVERSATION STARTED

If this sounds like the right fit for you - do not wait - send your resume as soon as you can, and no later than November 6, 2026.

We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Got questions or need more details? Reach out to Tony Frydensberg, Director, Head of IT Development at: tofr@mindenergy.com.

For general questions reach out to people@mindenergy.com

What if your code shaped the future of energy?

Energy is changing. Fast. And at Mind Energy, we’re right at the epicentre of it all.

**What We Value

• 5+ years of people management experience leading teams of platform owners, administrators, business analysts, or related application specialists

**Benefits

Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. And opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we provide custom paths for professional development to support the direction you want to take.

Har du passion for autentisk kinesisk madlavning, gode råvarer og kulinariske oplevelser? Har du samtidig erfaring med sushi, er det en ekstra fordel. Så er du måske vores nye kollega!

YoYo Restaurantionsselskab ApS er en kinesisk restaurant beliggende på Nørregade 29A, 3390 Hundested. Vi lægger vægt på traditionelle kinesiske retter, autentiske smagsoplevelser og god service i hyggelige omgivelser. Vores køkken kombinerer kinesiske madtraditioner med et udvalg af andre asiatiske retter, herunder sushi.

Vi søger en dygtig og engageret kok med erfaring inden for kinesisk gastronomi, som kan bidrage til den daglige drift og den fortsatte udvikling af vores køkken. Du bliver en del af et team, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og respekt for asiatiske madtraditioner er i centrum.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

• 
Tilberede autentiske kinesiske retter med fokus på kvalitet, smag og præsentation.

• 
Klargøre råvarer samt fremstille saucer, marinader og andre centrale elementer i det kinesiske køkken.

• 
Medvirke til udvikling og tilpasning af menuer og nye retter.

• 
Efter behov bidrage til tilberedning og anretning af sushi og andre asiatisk inspirerede retter.

• 
Sikre korrekt håndtering og opbevaring af råvarer samt overholdelse af gældende hygiejne- og fødevaresikkerhedsregler.

• 
Bidrage til en effektiv og velfungerende daglig drift i samarbejde med resten af køkkenteamet.

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Har praktisk erfaring med kinesisk gastronomi og gerne kendskab til forskellige regionale kinesiske køkkentraditioner.

• 
Har en god forståelse for råvarer, traditionelle tilberedningsteknikker og sammensætning af smage.

• 
Gerne har erfaring med tilberedning af sushi, herunder håndtering af råvarer, tilberedning af sushiris, rulleteknikker og anretning. Erfaring med sushi er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

• 
Kan arbejde selvstændigt, struktureret og effektivt – også i travle perioder.

• 
Har sans for detaljer, kvalitet og præsentation af maden.

• 
Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og har gode samarbejdsevner.

• 
Har lyst til at bidrage aktivt til restaurantens udvikling og fastholde en høj gastronomisk standard.

• 
Gerne taler kinesisk, da det kan være en fordel i den daglige kommunikation og i arbejdet med traditionelle kinesiske opskrifter. Det er dog ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

• 
En spændende stilling i en veletableret kinesisk restaurant med stærk lokal forankring.

• 
Mulighed for faglig udvikling og indflydelse på køkkenets retter og menuer.

• 
Mulighed for at arbejde med både traditionelle kinesiske retter og andre asiatiske specialiteter, herunder sushi.

• 
Et uformelt og samarbejdsorienteret arbejdsmiljø med plads til engagement og faglig stolthed.

• 
En varieret arbejdsdag med engagerede kollegaer.

• 
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter kvalifikationer og nærmere aftale.

Om os

Hos YoYo Restaurantionsselskab ApS handler mad om mere end blot at stille sulten. Vi ønsker at skabe autentiske madoplevelser, hvor traditionelle tilberedningsmetoder, velafbalancerede smage og gode råvarer går hånd i hånd.

Fra duften af frisklavede wokretter til omhyggeligt tilberedt sushi stræber vi efter at tilbyde vores gæster en varieret og mindeværdig asiatisk madoplevelse i hjertet af Hundested.

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig? Så hører vi gerne fra dig.

Siteimprove helps organisations make their digital content accessible to everyone. Our accessibility products scan entire web estates and document libraries, find the barriers that stop people using them, and increasingly fix those barriers automatically. The work is measured in public: our customers are universities, health systems, government agencies and Fortune 500 companies who have legal deadlines to meet and auditors to satisfy.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead one of our two accessibility product teams. You will own the delivery, quality and technical direction of a cross-functional team of engineers working alongside a Product Manager and a Designer, and you will be accountable for what that team ships and for how the people in it grow.

This role sits at a genuine inflection point. We are moving from finding accessibility problems to explaining and fixing them, and we are rebuilding how we develop software around AI agents that write, test and review code under human direction. We need a leader who is credible in the code, fluent in modern AI-assisted development, and able to coach a team through that change without trading away quality or the well-being of the people doing the work.

What we will be doing

• Own delivery for your team. Turn a product roadmap into a sequenced, realistic plan, keep commitments honest, and be the person who says early and clearly when something will not land.

• Lead the people. Hold regular one-to-ones, give direct and useful feedback, run performance and growth conversations, and build a team where engineers at different levels can do their best work. Recruit, onboard and retain.

• Stay hands-on enough to be credible. Read and review code and designs, take part in architectural decisions, and pair with engineers when it helps. You are not expected to carry a full delivery load, but you are expected to understand the system well enough to challenge a design and to know when an estimate is wrong.

• Coach the team in AI-assisted development. Raise the whole team's effectiveness with AI tooling: how to decompose a problem so an agent can take it, how to write a prompt and a specification that produce reviewable work, and how to review agent-generated code properly rather than approving it on sight.

• Set the standards for how AI-generated work is accepted. Define with your engineers how such work is reviewed, tested, secured and documented before it merges, and hold the line that a human is always accountable for what ships.

• Partner with Product and Design as equals. Work with your Product Manager on outcomes, scope and sequencing, and make the technical trade-offs visible so the three of you decide together.

• Work across teams. Depend on and contribute to Platform, AI and other product teams. Much of what your team needs will be built elsewhere, and much of what it builds will be consumed elsewhere.

• Protect engineering health. Hold a deliberate balance between roadmap delivery, compliance obligations, customer-reported defects and technical debt, and make that balance explicit rather than letting it be decided by whatever is loudest.

• Own quality and operational responsibility. Testing, accessibility conformance of our own products, security and vulnerability remediation, incident response and the reliability of what your team runs in production.

• Adjust your working hours to overlap with the United States. This role reports to a manager on the US Pacific coast and partners with colleagues across the US. You will regularly take meetings in the late afternoon or early evening Central European Time, and we will protect the rest of your week in return.

• Travel may be required; a valid passport is required

• Perform other duties as assigned

What we will require of you

• Engineering management experience. Several years leading software engineering teams as their direct manager, including hiring, performance management and developing engineers at more than one level. You have owned delivery for a team over a sustained period, not just a project.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral research in plant regulatory genomics and artificial intelligence
jobs.employer_name: Center for Kvantitativ Genetik og Genomforskning
jobs.description:
The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) at Aarhus University, Denmark, invites applications for a two-year postdoctoral position in plant regulatory genomics and artificial intelligence, starting 1 April 2027.

You will design new sequence-to-expression deep learning models that predict gene expression from DNA sequence in plants, using new experimental datasets generated in the project. The position includes a 6- to 12-month research stay at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA, combining plant genomics expertise at Aarhus with AI expertise at CSHL.

This is an opportunity to advance the state of the art in AI for plant biology while working across two leading research environments. For more information, feel free to reach out to Guillaume Ramstein (QGG) and Peter Koo (CSHL).

Expected start date and duration of employment

This is a 2-year position from April 1st 2027, or as soon as possible.

Job description

You will advance the field of artificial intelligence applied to regulatory genomics, as part of the GRASP project funded by the Independent Research Fund Denmark. In this project, you will leverage new training sets, build novel deep learning architectures and define dedicated learning objectives, to learn the effects of genetic variants on gene expression.

The position will focus on data science and genomics in a model plant species, Brachypodium distachyon. You will work at the cutting edge of AI in biology and propose new solutions to predict the effects of regulatory variants in plant genomes, which remains an open research problem in plant genomics. 

These activities will be carried out in close collaboration with the Koo lab, a leading group in AI and regulatory genomics at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA. As part of this collaboration, the position will include a 6- to 12-month research stay in the Koo lab.

Your profile

Applicants should hold a PhD in computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field, or expect to complete it before the start date. They should have research experience in deep learning.

Applicants are expected to have published in international peer-reviewed journals, preferably on topics related to AI and genomics. Experience in developing new deep learning techniques (model architectures or learning objectives) is especially relevant to this position. 

Good communication skills in English are required, as well as the ability to work in an interdisciplinary team of AI experts, computational geneticists, and plant biologists.

Who we are

The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) is a major center for research and education in quantitative genetics and genomics at Aarhus University (http://www.qgg.au.dk/en). We conduct basic and applied research in animal, plant, and human genetics. Our focus areas include quantitative genetics, artificial intelligence applied to agriculture and medicine, population genetics, and integrative genomics. Research within QGG is characterized by a very close synergy between method development and application on practical problems across species, in collaboration with industry partners. QGG is an international research center with about 70 employees and visiting researchers from over 15 nations. QGG works in teams and strives for an excellent working environment, in which we value self-leadership, open communication, and commitment to diversity and inclusion.

What we offer

The succesful candidate will be offered:

• A 6- to 12-month research stay in the Koo lab at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA, providing international experience and the opportunity to work across two leading labs in plant genomics and AI.
• Computational ressources, including the GenomeDK high-performance computing cluster, with growing capabilities such as high-memory nodes and state-of-the-art GPUs.
• An interdisciplinary interdisciplinary environment, in which the candidate will be able to exchange across research fields (machine learning, bioinformatics, biology, and quantitative genetics) and applications (plant biology, agriculture, and biomedicine).
• A research environment characterized by collaboration, professionalism, commitment to diversity and inclusion, and success in mentoring and supervision.
• A healthy work-life balance.
Place of work and area of employment

The primary place of work is C. F. Møllers Allé 3, 8000, Aarhus (Denmark), and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments.

The position will also include a 6- to 12-month research stay at 1 Bungtown Rd, Cold Spring Harbor, NY 11724, United States. The time and duration of the research stay may be negotiated with the supervisors Guillaume Ramstein and Peter Koo.

Contact information

For further information, please contact:

• Tenure-Track Assistant Professor Guillaume Ramstein, +45 42 52 12 66, ramstein@qgg.au.dk
• Associate Professor Peter Koo, +1 516 367 5520, koo@cshl.edu
Deadline

Applications must be received no later than November 20th, 2026.

Om Aarhus Universitet

Aarhus Universitet er et fagligt bredt og forskningsintensivt universitet med høj kvalitet i uddannelse og forskning, og et stærkt engagement i samfundsudviklingen nationalt og globalt. Universitetet tilbyder et inspirerende uddannelses- og forskningsmiljø for 37.500 studerende og 9.000 medarbejdere med en årlig omsætning på 8,9 mia. kr. Læs mere på www.au.dk

SYBO is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

Hundreds of millions of players play Subway Surfers each month, and enjoy smooth gameplay, new features and a concept that’s now worked for over fourteen (Yes, 14!) years - and we’re looking for a talented Game Engineer to keep the fun going for years to come.

As a Game Engineer on Subway Surfers, you’ll work closely with engineers, designers, artists, and other disciplines to take ideas from concept through implementation and into the hands of the above-mentioned hundreds of millions of players. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, contribute to technical decisions, and help us continuously improve both the game and the way we build it.

Working with LiveOps lets you get instant feedback on your work - working with one of the largest LiveOps games makes it unique. Read below and get in touch!

**Responsibilities

**

• Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to the long-term health of the Subway Surfers codebase

• Review code and collaborate with other Engineers to share knowledge and maintain engineering quality

• Debug and resolve technical issues across gameplay systems and live features

Life at SYBO

You’ll work closely with the Technical Owner, Engineers, Designers, and Artists on the game team, familiarize yourself with the codebase and development pipeline, and start contributing to your first features.
