jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Position in Software Engineering: Program Analysis and Repository Mining
jobs.description:
A 2-year postdoctoral researcher position is available at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in the Software Engineering section of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI). The successful candidate will contribute to the VILLUM Experiment project “Is Correctness Necessary? An Experiment in Test-Free Program Repair.” The project investigates whether software bugs can be repaired using information found in the code itself, without relying on test suites or specifications. The position is available from February 1, 2027. 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Project Description

Generating code is becoming cheap; establishing whether it is correct is not. Large language models can now produce and modify software at remarkable speed, and practices such as “vibe coding” are widening the gap between code generation and validation. Requiring a carefully designed test suite or specification for every generated fragment is unlikely to scale. Yet most automated repair techniques depend on exactly such a correctness oracle: without a failing test or specification, they have neither a clear repair target nor a way to assess a proposed change.

This project challenges that dependency by investigating whether software bugs can be repaired using evidence already present in the code. It will combine program analysis with patterns mined from existing software to explore whether multiple, independent sources of evidence can guide repair when tests or specifications are unavailable. The approach will be studied across different programming languages and evaluated on both real-world bugs and code modified by AI coding assistants. The broader aim is to determine when code contains enough information to support its own repair and when knowledge of the intended behavior remains essential.

 

What we offer 

We offer a dynamic and supportive research environment within an internationally recognized institute. You will join an open, collaborative team that values teamwork, professional diligence, and innovation. The Software Engineering section provides flexible work conditions and strong support for individual development, including mentorship and opportunities to expand your skills and responsibilities.

As part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, our section is involved in a variety of national and European research projects and enjoys a robust network of academic and industrial partners. This position provides an opportunity to engage with these collaborations and work on real-world challenges. We encourage and support our postdocs to publish their research in renowned journals and conferences, and to engage in knowledge exchange with colleagues and external research and industrial partners. The working language is English, and we pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive, and inspiring workplace that fosters personal and professional growth.

 

What we expect 

The appointed researcher will investigate whether software defects can be repaired without relying on test suites or specifications. The candidate will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of a framework that combines program analysis with patterns mined from existing software. The work will involve experiments with real-world bugs and code modified by AI coding assistants across multiple programming languages. We are looking for a highly motivated candidate who meets the following qualifications and characteristics:

• 
A PhD (completed or close to completion) in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Programming Languages, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related field.

• 
Research experience or a strong interest in one or more of the following areas: program analysis, mining software repositories, automated software engineering, software testing, or software repair.

• 
An interest in software reliability challenges arising from AI-generated and AI-modified code.

• 
Experience with empirical evaluation, software repositories, or bug benchmarks is an advantage.

• 
Experience with one or more of C, Java, and Python is an advantage.

• 
Proficiency in written and spoken English, with good communication skills.

• 
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a research team.

• 
A strong research record or demonstrated research potential through publications or other relevant research outputs.

 

Workplace description 

The postdoc will be employed in the Software Engineering section at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI), SDU. MMMI is an internationally recognized research institute within the Faculty of Engineering, known for its contributions to software engineering, robotics, and artificial intelligence. The Software Engineering section encompasses a range of research areas in software development, data analytics, and intelligent systems, and it plays a key role in several ongoing European projects.

Our workplace is truly international and collaborative. Researchers in the section come from diverse backgrounds and work closely together on cross-disciplinary projects. We benefit from state-of-the-art facilities and a strong administrative and technical support structure. The institute maintains close collaboration with other departments and centers at SDU, as well as with industry partners, providing a vibrant environment where theoretical research meets practical application. The position will be located on SDU’s Odense campus, which offers an attractive setting and a rich campus life in the city of Odense, Denmark’s hub for robotics and technology development.

 

Further information 

For further information, please contact Associate Professor Abhishek Tiwari (abti@mmmi.sdu.dk) or Assistant Professor Jyoti Prakash (jyp@mmmi.sdu.dk)

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application.

• 
Curriculum Vitae. 

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Publications most relevant to the position.

• 
Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

• 
A research statement may be included.

• 
References/reference letters may also be included.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from February 1, 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher in Computational Proteomics and Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, University of Southern Denmark
Location: Odense, Denmark
Duration: 2 years, with the possibility of a 1-year extension
Starting Date: 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter

Project Description
We invite applications for a postdoctoral position at the interface of computational proteomics, machine learning, and mass spectrometry. The successful candidate will join a pioneering research program focused on peptide ionization and fragmentation in LC-MS/MS, with the aim of developing new computational approaches for peptide fragmentation analysis.

The project centers on large-scale, experimentally curated tandem mass spectrometry datasets and the development of new computational strategies for fragmentation analysis under analytically underexplored conditions. It relies on modern machine learning approaches to model fragmentation behavior, support spectral interpretation, and enable future advances in peptide identification workflows.

The position is embedded in the Protein Research Group (PRG) at the University of Southern Denmark, an internationally recognized environment in proteomics and biological mass spectrometry. The postdoctoral researcher will work in close collaboration with experimental colleagues generating high-quality tandem MS data for computational development.

Research Environment and Collaborative Structure
The Protein Research Group comprises eight PI-led teams and more than 50 researchers and students, offering a highly interactive and interdisciplinary research environment. The successful candidate will play a central role in the computational arm of the project and will collaborate closely with experimental researchers developing new mass spectrometric methods and generating large-scale fragmentation datasets.

The position offers substantial scientific independence and the opportunity to help shape a new research direction at the intersection of machine learning, peptide chemistry, and proteomics.

Responsibilities
The postdoctoral researcher will be expected to:

• 
Develop computational and machine learning workflows for large-scale analysis of tandem mass spectrometry data 

• 
Contribute to the structuring, curation, and quality control of large experimental MS/MS datasets 

• 
Build data-driven models for peptide fragmentation analysis using experimentally generated spectra 

• 
Integrate relevant variables such as peptide sequence, precursor charge state, collision energy, and peptide modifications into computational frameworks 

• 
Evaluate model performance using suitable similarity, quality, and generalization metrics 

• 
Contribute to the extension of computational models toward chemically and biologically relevant peptide classes, including selected post-translational modifications 

• 
Investigate how computational models may help reveal fragmentation trends and chemically meaningful patterns in large-scale MS/MS datasets 

• 
Work independently on model development, implementation, and computational problem solving, while interacting closely with experimental researchers in the group 

• 
Contribute to reproducible and well-documented computational pipelines, data structures, and analysis workflows 

• 
Disseminate findings through peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, and open scientific resources where relevant 

Required Qualifications
Applicants must have:

• 
A PhD in computational proteomics, bioinformatics, machine learning, computer science, chemometrics, analytical chemistry, or a closely related field 

• 
Strong experience in machine learning and/or deep learning applied to complex scientific datasets 

• 
Demonstrated ability to independently develop computational solutions, including model design, implementation, evaluation, and documentation 

• 
Proficiency in Python and relevant machine learning/data science frameworks 

• 
Experience with data preprocessing, curation, and quality control for large and complex datasets 

• 
A strong analytical mindset and the ability to work independently on computational research problems 

• 
Interest in working at the interface of computation, chemistry, and mass spectrometry 

Desirable Qualifications
The following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

• 
Experience with mass spectrometry-based proteomics, computational mass spectrometry, or peptide fragmentation-related data analysis 

• 
Experience with neural network architectures relevant for sequence-based prediction tasks 

• 
Experience with model interpretability, explainable AI, or feature analysis in scientific machine learning 

• 
Interest in peptide chemistry, gas-phase ion behavior, or post-translational modifications 

• 
Experience with reproducible workflows, FAIR data principles, and scalable computational pipelines 

• 
Ability to collaborate effectively across computational and experimental disciplines 

What We Offer
A unique opportunity to work at the intersection of proteomics, mass spectrometry, and machine learning on scientifically ambitious and methodologically innovative research 

• 
The opportunity to develop computational methods for experimentally generated high-quality tandem mass spectrometry data 

• 
A central and independent role in shaping the computational direction of a new research effort 

• 
Close collaboration with experimental researchers working on peptide ionization, fragmentation, and advanced LC-MS/MS method development 

• 
A strong interdisciplinary research environment with expertise spanning proteomics, biological mass spectrometry, peptide chemistry, and data analysis 

• 
Access to state-of-the-art mass spectrometry platforms and large in-house datasets 

• 
An international and collaborative research culture with opportunities for scientific development, publication, and conference participation 

• 
Competitive salary and benefits according to Danish collective agreements, including pension and support for international candidates where relevant 

About the Protein Research Group
The Protein Research Group at SDU is internationally recognized for pioneering work in biological mass spectrometry, peptide and protein chemistry, gas-phase chemistry, and proteomics. Research in the group spans fundamental analytical chemistry, method development, structural biology, post-translational modifications, and translational applications in biomedicine and biotechnology.

Located in Odense, the group offers an open, collaborative, and ambitious research environment with a strong emphasis on scientific rigor, interdisciplinary exchange, and long-term platform building. The successful candidate will join a setting in which computational and experimental researchers work in close interaction.

Application deadline: 16. November 2026 at 23:59 hours local Danish time. 

Please see the full call, including how to apply, on www.sdu.dk

jobs.occupation: Two Post Doctoral positions on the drivers of green capital accumulation in global value chains – GreenWorlds ERC Advanced project
jobs.description:
Copenhagen Business School (CBS) invites applications for two 3-year Post Doctoral positions on the drivers of green capital accumulation in global value chains, located at the Department of Management, Society and Communication (MSC).

The selected candidates will contribute to the ERC Advanced research project Green Worlds: The material and normative drivers of green capital accumulation in global value chains (GreenWorlds), led by Professor Stefano Ponte.

Overall Project Focus

The GreenWorlds project investigates a core tension in the global economy: how capitalism adapts to ecological pressures and normatively legitimizes itself while maintaining its core logic of capital accumulation alongside the carbon economy. To explore this, the project examines how a variety of ‘green worlds’ of value and valuation emerge, consolidate and decline. Green worlds are different sets of internally coherent principles that are drawn upon by value chain actors to deal with challenges and critiques. They are flexibly assembled by a variety of actors in different value chains and situations to enact justifications related to framing products and/or operations as ‘green’.

The research project asks: What counts as green and for whom? What kinds of practices underpin different green worlds – and how do they shape value chain governance? What are the main features of the green regime of accumulation that crystallizes around these worlds? How does this regime in turn support or disrupt dominant green worlds in particular locations and value chains, and in time—reinforcing, adjusting or breaking a green cycle of capital accumulation?

By comparing selected agro-food value chains (avocados, biodiesel, coffee and wine) in five countries (Argentina, Colombia, Indonesia, Italy and South Africa), the project seeks to explain the contradictory entanglement of ecological concern and capital accumulation, and the limits and possibilities of green transformations.

As part of GreenWorlds, the Post Doctoral candidates will contribute to activities such as:

• Conducting literature reviews and theoretical analysis for publication in top-tier academic outlets.
• Conducting and participating in field research (especially by carrying out key informant interviews, focus group discussions, and participant observation).
• Collaborating in coding of qualitative data (including the basics of natural language processing)
• Presenting, writing and publishing academic papers in peer-reviewed international journals, also in collaboration with the other members of the team
• Engaging in public outreach activities (e.g., blog posts, Linkedin entries, short videos, podcasts).
• Post Doc 1 would be expected to work empirically on two agro-food value chains (wine and biodiesel), especially in Argentina but also globally.
• Post Doc 2 would be expected to work empirically on two agro-food value chains (wine and avocados), especially in South Africa but also globally.
Qualifications

The applicant has obtained a PhD or equivalent by the start date of the Post Doctoral position. In assessing applications, particular emphasis will be placed on research potential – both theoretical and empirical.

The Post-Doctoral positions are non-tenured positions for a 3-year period with research obligations.

To meet the research obligations, the selected candidate is expected to be on site and take part in departmental activities.

Emphasis is placed on research relevant to the job description.

Applicants should have:

• A PhD in the social sciences (e.g., political science, sociology, economic geography)
• Experience with qualitative fieldwork
• Knowledge of the academic literature on international political economy, and/or environmental politics, and/or pragmatic sociology/convention theory, and/or global value chain analysis
• High-level English Language proficiency
• Willingness to reside in Denmark and engage regularly with the CBS research community
• For Post Doc 1, ability to conduct fieldwork in Spanish is required

The Department

The Department of Management, Society and Communication (MSC) brings together scholars from a range of research areas within management, communication and the broader social sciences and humanities, studying organizations in global environments and the interaction and interdependencies of business, society and government. They share a common interest in studying organizations in global environments and the relations of organizations to the wider society. Information about the department may be found at www.cbs.dk/msc.

MSC is a significant supplier of research-based teaching to a broad portfolio of programs, which includes undergraduate, graduate and doctoral teaching and supervision as well as executive education in the fields of:

• Responsible management, leadership and governance
• Corporate responsibility and sustainability
• Business and development (with an emphasis on the emerging/growth economies context)
• Organisational communication (corporate communication, strategic communication, leadership communication, marketing communication, international business communication)
Copenhagen Business School has a broad commitment to the excellence, distinctiveness and relevance of its teaching and research programmes. Candidates who wish to join us should demonstrate enthusiasm for working in an organisation of this type. 

For further information please contact:

• Academic Contact: Professor Stefano Ponte spo.msc@cbs.dk 
• HR and hiring process contact: jobcall.msc@cbs.dk 
Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Finance’s agreement with the Central Academic Organisation.

The application must be sent via the electronic recruitment system, using the link.

The application must include:

• Cover letter (summary of research skills) discussing your alignment with the research objectives of GreenWorlds
• An independently written and original (this means no generative AI usage) 3-year project proposal related to the research objectives of GreenWorlds (max 5 pages / 2,000 words excluding references).
• Complete publication list (mark up to 5 for assessment with *)
• Copies of selected publications (English only)
• Documentation of fieldwork and, if relevant, research management experience
• Transcript(s) and all academic diplomas
• A full and up-to-date CV
• Names and contact details of up to 3 academic referees
It must be clearly indicated in the cover letter as well as the project proposal if the application concerns Post Doc project 1 or Post Doc project 2. If an applicant wishes to apply for both positions, a separate project description must be submitted for each.

Recruitment procedure

The Recruitment Committee will shortlist a minimum of two applicants. The shortlisted applicants will be assessed by the Assessment Committee. All applicants will be notified of their status in the recruitment process shortly after the application deadline. 

The applicants selected for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and later in the process about the result of the assessment.

Once the recruitment process is completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application.

Copenhagen Business School must receive all application materials by the application deadline.

Copenhagen Business School invites all qualified candidates to apply for the position. An appointment committee will review the applications and invite a selection of qualified candidates to an interview.

One of CBS’ strategic goals is the promotion of diversity, which is why every effort has been made to ensure a recruitment process that reduces potential bias. Applicants are therefore encouraged not to include a photo or unnecessary personal information in their application.

Details about Copenhagen Business School and the department are available at www.cbs.dk.

Application due: Friday, 6 November 2026. No applications will be accepted beyond the deadline.
Expected starting date: March 2027 or soon thereafter.

Are you passionate about quality, GMP compliance, and supporting successful product launches and technology transfers?

At Orifarm, we are looking for a dedicated Quality Assurance Specialist to join our Innovation & Launch team. You will provide QA support across product launches and technology transfers, ensuring compliance with GMP requirements, internal procedures, and regulatory expectations.

You will work closely with internal stakeholders and Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) to secure compliant and efficient implementation of new products and processes.

About the job

As QA Specialist, you will support product launches and technology transfers from a QA perspective. You will provide quality oversight, collaborate across functions and help ensure compliant and timely product supply while balancing quality requirements with business priorities.

Key responsibilities:

• Providing QA support and oversight for product launches and technology transfers.

• Collaborating with CMOs and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and compliant implementation.

• Ensuring documentation and activities comply with approved procedures, specifications, GMP requirements, and regulatory expectations.

• Reviewing and approving manufacturing documentation, including Master Batch Records and Batch Journals, as part of the broader QA responsibility portfolio.

• Identifying, resolving, and escalating quality and compliance issues when required.

• Participating in change controls, deviations, and risk assessments.

• Driving continuous improvement of QA processes and ways of working.

Who are you?

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where quality, compliance, and business needs must be balanced. You are structured, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of complex tasks.

We expect that you:

• Hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.

• Have experience from QA/QC, manufacturing, process support, or another GMP-regulated environment.

• Experience with manufacturing documentation is an advantage.

• Have solid knowledge of EU GMP requirements.

• Can work independently and manage multiple priorities.

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.

• Enjoy collaborating across functions and cultures.

Who are we?

You will become part of a skilled and collaborative QA organization where professionalism, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement are central to how we work.

In Innovation & Launch, we support product launches and technology transfers across Orifarm’s international supply network. We work closely with manufacturing sites, CMOs, project teams, and commercial stakeholders to ensure products reach the market with the right quality and at the right time.

What we offer?

• A key quality role with significant responsibility and impact.

• International collaboration across manufacturing sites and partners.

• A high degree of independence and flexibility.

• Opportunities for professional growth and development.

• Hybrid working model and flexible working hours.

• Attractive compensation and benefits package – details depend on job location.

Job location

Odense (DK) or Warsaw (PL).

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

jobs.occupation: Continuing Airworthiness Management Organisation (CAMO) Manager – JoinJet
jobs.description:
Are you experienced in continuing airworthiness management and motivated by ensuring safe, efficient and reliable aircraft operations? Do you have strong leadership skills, a technical mindset and an interest in optimizing maintenance planning, costs and processes?

Then you may be our new Continuing Airworthiness Management Organisation (CAMO) Manager.

As CAMO Manager at JoinJet, you will have an exciting and responsible position with a key role in ensuring the continued airworthiness of our aircraft fleet. You will be responsible for planning and following up on maintenance activities and for ensuring that our aircraft are maintained to the highest standards, enabling safe and efficient operations.

You will also be responsible for ensuring that the applicable rules and regulations are implemented and maintained within JoinJet’s CAMO and that the organisation remains compliant with its CAME.

Your responsibilities

Your main tasks and areas of responsibility will include:

· Overseeing all standard continuing airworthiness management functions

· Managing and maintaining the technical documentation for all aircraft

· Responsible for long-term maintenance planning and budgeting

· Ensuring efficient maintenance planning and minimizing aircraft downtime

· Driving LEAN initiatives and continuous improvement of CAMO processes

· Maintaining the technical dialogue with aviation authorities

· Ensuring that the aircraft remain airworthy and compliant with all applicable technical and regulatory requirements

· Monitoring and optimizing maintenance costs and aircraft utilization

· Leading and developing the CAMO team

· Acting as the technical point of contact for relevant internal and external stakeholders

· Performing ad hoc tasks and projects related to CAMO and technical operations

The position reports to the Accountable Manager and works closely with JoinJet and SUN-AIR Technic on technical and operational matters.

Expectations

You have experience from a similar position with management responsibility and at least five years of relevant experience, preferably with at least two years in an administrative or management position within the aviation industry.

You have a solid understanding of airworthiness, maintenance and quality systems and are comfortable using IT as an integral part of your daily work. You have broad technical knowledge and practical experience from aviation, combined with a structured and business-oriented approach.

As the Nominated Postholder for CAMO, you will have overall leadership responsibility for the CAMO department.

A background as an aircraft technician is an advantage.

As a person

You are a natural leader who motivates and develops your employees through trust, clear communication and delegation. You have good interpersonal skills and enjoy working collaboratively across departments.

You are not afraid to challenge existing processes and look for better and more efficient ways of working. You are solution-oriented, structured and take pride in delivering high-quality work.

You have a good sense of humour and contribute positively to the working environment. You have a basic understanding of finance and a sound commercial mindset.

You are proficient in Microsoft Office and communicate confidently in both Danish and English, verbally and in writing.

Some travel activity should be expected in the position, although it will be limited.

Please note that you must have a residence and work permit that allows you to live and work in Denmark.

We offer

We offer an exciting and challenging position in an international business aviation company, where you will have the opportunity to develop both professionally and personally.

You will become part of an experienced team and have the opportunity to take an active role in the continued development of our CAMO organisation and the business as a whole.

We also offer:

· A responsible and varied full-time position

· An international working environment

· Excellent office facilities and canteen

· Competitive salary according to qualifications

· Pension scheme

· Opportunities for professional and personal development

How to apply

If you find the position interesting, we would be pleased to hear from you.

Please send us your application and CV through the application link as soon as possible. Applications are accepted in both Danish and English.

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact us on +45 76 500 100.

We look forward to welcoming you on board JoinJet.

Fly the way you like.

JoinJet is headquartered in Billund and arranges individual flights for, for example, VIPs, companies, bands, sports clubs, etc. JoinJet also manages private and commercial aircraft, as well as aircraft sales and leasing and FBO service, which are part of JoinJet's business areas. With over 30 years of experience, the company understands the diverse needs of its customers, and its products are tailored to meet those needs. JoinJet always focuses on quality and precision. JoinJet is part of the Sundberg Aviation Group, and from the headquarters in Billund, the group's business areas are managed, which today include air ambulance service worldwide, corporate shuttles, aircraft maintenance, spare parts sales, charter flights, as well as international aircraft sales and leasing.

Ready to build the AI engine behind the world's largest jewellery brand?

As Lead AI Platform Engineer, you will be the technical force behind Pandora's AI platform, shaping how AI systems are built, scaled, and secured across the business. Combining deep hands-on engineering expertise with strong technical leadership, you will drive architectural excellence, elevate engineering standards, and deliver reliable, production-ready AI solutions at scale.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Be To:

Technical Leadership

• Serve as the technical lead for the AI platform engineering team — setting the implementation direction, defining coding standards, and making key technical decisions that govern how the platform is built and evolved.

• Lead code reviews and drive architecture discussions, ensuring engineering decisions are well-reasoned, documented, and aligned with the broader platform strategy — championing engineering standards across code quality, testing practices, documentation, observability, and security hardening.

• Act as a technical mentor and go-to resource for all engineers — sharing knowledge, unblocking complex problems, and actively investing in the technical growth of both senior and junior team members.

Platform Engineering & AI Infrastructure

• Design, build, and operate scalable, high-performance services and platform components that expose AI/ML capabilities across Pandora's digital ecosystem.

• Own and define the standards and governance for Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — ensuring all Azure infrastructure is reproducible, auditable, and securely configured.

• Apply strong network architecture knowledge to design and govern secure connectivity between platform services, AI gateways, and external integrations, including VNet, private endpoints, NSGs, and ingress/egress controls, while collaborating with security stakeholders to uphold the platform's overall security posture.

• Leverage Databricks for big data processing, feature engineering, and ML pipeline support.

AI Services & Agentic Development

• Integrate and operationalise AI services including LLM APIs, vector search, RAG pipelines, embeddings, and multi-layer caching into platform-level services.

• Lead the agentic code development practice: architecting autonomous execution loops that enable tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to safely write, test, and self-correct software within isolated sandboxes.

• Own MLflow governance standards for experiment tracking, model versioning, and ML lifecycle management across the team.

• Configure and manage AI gateways to ensure secure, scalable, and governed access to AI capabilities at production scale.

CI/CD & Reliability

• Define and govern the CI/CD standards for the AI platform team — establishing quality gates, testing frameworks, deployment patterns, and pipeline architecture that all engineers build to.

• Ensure performance, availability, and maintainability of platform services in production; handle incidents in a timely manner to minimise Mean Time to Contain (MTTC).

Job Requirements:

Education & Experience

• Relevant background from Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field with experience in backend or platform engineering, with at least 2 years operating in a technical leadership capacity within AI or cloud-native platform teams.

• Proven experience building and operating AI/ML platform services or LLM-based integrations in a production environment.

Technical Skills

• Strong backend engineering fundamentals: service architecture, REST API design, performance optimisation, and production reliability by design and monitoring, with hands-on proficiency in Python.

• Deep Kubernetes expertise — workload configuration, networking, security policy design, and production debugging; hands-on Docker and Azure App Services.

• Expert-level Terraform and IaC ownership — defining standards, patterns, and governance for cloud infrastructure on Azure.

• Strong network architecture and configuration skills, including Azure networking concepts (VNet, NSG, private endpoints, DNS, ingress/egress).

• MLflow governance, Databricks for ML pipeline integration, and experience with ML serving infrastructure, LLM APIs, prompt integration, and multi-layer caching.

• Proficiency in PostgreSQL and experience in configuring AI gateways for centralized AI governance

• Experience in agentic code development practice, harness engineering and spec-driven development is a plus.

Soft Skills

Ideally you are a trusted technical leader who combines strong engineering expertise with clear thinking and a collaborative approach to drive sound decisions, communicate complex platform, security, and architecture topics in a business-friendly way, and foster team growth. Brings a proactive and curious mindset, with a passion for emerging AI technologies balanced by a pragmatic focus on execution and delivery.

About the Team

You will be part of Pandora's AI Platform team within AI CoE at Digital & Analytics & AI — a passionate, forward-thinking group dedicated to building the infrastructure and services that bring AI to life across the business. The team works at the intersection of data science, machine learning, cloud engineering, and product development, collaborating closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Architects, and Product stakeholders.

You will report to the AI Platform Manager and serve as the senior technical voice that shapes how the platform is designed, secured, and evolved — influencing both what gets built and how it gets built.

Did we get your attention?

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

Icing on the cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

jobs.occupation: Senior Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist (Construction Sector)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com

.

Job Description

Turner & Townsend is seeking a proactive and driven Senior Recruiter to support talent acquisition across our fast‑growing European business. This is an exciting opportunity to join a global consultancy with ambitious regional growth plans.

Based in Copenhagen, you will play a key role in attracting and hiring top talent for our Industrial, Science & Technology team in Europe, while supporting recruitment across Data Centre, Life Science and Manufacturing projects in the Nordics.

This is a hands‑on, end‑to‑end recruitment role where you will identify, engage, and hire exceptional project managers, cost managers, and project controls specialists who help deliver world‑class construction projects. You will collaborate closely with the wider European recruitment team, contributing to a high‑performing, fast‑paced environment.

This role would suit an experienced recruitment professional with corporate experience, ideally within a professional services environment, or agency recruiter from a construction background who is looking for more variety and responsibility in a corporate recruitment role within a thriving international consultancy.

Key accountabilities:

• Lead and execute the end-to-end recruitment process for the area of responsibility.

• Responsible for identifying and sourcing active candidates.

• Understand and navigate the local market, promoting market activity and best practices.

• Responsible for ATS (SmartRecruiters) data accuracy and process compliance, from raising requisitions and job posting through to hiring.

• Engage with key programme, country, and regional stakeholders to understand the short-, mid-, and long-term recruitment needs, promoting a positive, proactive response to meeting demand.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and successfully liaise with functions such as HR, Business Operations, Global Mobility, Hiring Managers, and Country MDs to ensure a seamless hiring process.

• Guide candidates through the recruitment process, ensuring a positive candidate experience through proactive communication, timely updates, and professional stakeholder management.

• Act as a trusted recruitment partner, providing market insights and guidance to stakeholders throughout the hiring process.

• Work closely with the wider recruitment team, including coaching, mentoring, and line managing colleagues as agreed.

• Ensure compliance regarding CI and EDI within the European recruitment process.

Qualifications

• Minimum 7 years' experience in recruiting or talent acquisition, ideally gained within a corporate/in-house talent acquisition function or a recruitment agency with a strong focus on permanent placements.

• Experience in the construction market recruiting project managers, cost managers, project controls specialists and and other related disciplines.

• Passion for recruiting and finding top talents in a challenging and competitive environment.

• Excellent written and verbal communicator.

• Strong team player who builds positive relationships across functions

• Fluency in English is essential for this role, a Nordic language (Finnish, Swedish, Norwegian, or Danish) would be considered a strong advantage.

• Highly developed organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Commercial Awareness, with the ability to balance business objectives, project requirements, and market conditions.

Additional Information

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance. We also encourage our staff to strive to ‘make a difference’ and become involved in various working committees and forums (for example, Inclusion Working Group, Social & Wellness, Learning & Development, Corporate Social Responsibilities and Net Zero Vision).

At Turner & Townsend we offer a competitive remuneration package and company benefits.

Turner & Townsend value greatly and have a focus on Corporate Responsibilities (CR), this includes a day’s leave entitlement to support a local charity or community activity along with the opportunity to participate in several office events that held throughout the year.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from people from all sectors of the community.

At Spirii, we are building world-class charging products and digital solutions for the future of mobility. Our Digital Development team drives a listen, learn, and lead culture that keeps us improving how we work and how we build.

We are now looking for a Cloud Engineer to join us on this journey. In this role, you will help our engineering teams embrace the DevOps mindset while designing and running our cloud setup. You will be part of building and maintaining a modern, scalable, and secure cloud platform that powers Spirii’s products.

You will report to our Engineering Manager and work closely with colleagues across our Engineering teams, both in-house and near-shore.

**What You Will Be Working On

**

• Build, operate, and improve Spirii’s AWS and Kubernetes (EKS) infrastructure to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance.

• Automate infrastructure provisioning with CDK for Terraform (CDKTF).

• Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling for fast, secure delivery.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to embed platform capabilities and DevOps best practices.

• Ensure security best practices and protect against threats across our cloud setup.

• Monitor infrastructure health and performance using tools like Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues across infrastructure, CI/CD, and runtime environments.

• Document processes for knowledge sharing and smooth onboarding.

• Contribute to incident management and disaster recovery processes.

**Who You Are

**

• You enjoy working hands-on with cloud infrastructure while enabling others to succeed.

• You bring a DevOps mindset and like to share your knowledge to drive adoption.

• You have a strong sense of ownership and pride in building quality solutions.

• You communicate clearly and collaborate easily across teams.

• You care about developer experience and making platforms easy to use.

• You contribute to an open, friendly, and collaborative team culture.

**What You Bring

****Must-have

**

• A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

• 4+ years in a Cloud/DevOps/Platform Engineer role.

• Strong experience with AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, CloudFront, IAM, etc.) and security best practices.

• Kubernetes (EKS) administration and operations.

• Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CDKTF.

• CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance (GitHub Actions or similar).

• Linux/Unix systems and scripting with TypeScript.

• Monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).

• Excellent troubleshooting skills.

**Nice-to-have

**

• Experience with platform development (shared services, APIs).

• Working with SQL and NoSQL databases.

• Knowledge of security architecture for cloud-native applications.

**Benefits

**It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours, and a good work-life balance.

• Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

**About Spirii – Who We Are

**Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its six-year anniversary as a founded company, however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as development of future transport- and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

Do you want to lead project excellence across some of the largest and most complex infrastructure projects in Denmark? Are you an experienced project leader with a commercial mindset? Can you inspire and develop experienced project managers while improving project and portfolio performance? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

To further strengthen our project leadership and support the development of Transportation in Denmark, we are looking for a Vice President, Head of Projects. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of approximately 15 experienced multidisciplinary project managers, while taking direct responsibility for selected strategic projects. You will also have portfolio responsibility for medium-sized and smaller projects led by project managers across the organisation. You will report to the Senior Vice President, Transportation, in Denmark.

You will play a central role in connecting project delivery, portfolio performance, and strategic priorities. The portfolio comprises approximately 350 projects, from large multidisciplinary projects to smaller single-discipline assignments across key transportation disciplines. As a member of the Transportation leadership team, you will contribute to the strategic and operational development of the business.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Lead and develop a team of multidisciplinary project managers, ensuring clear priorities and high-quality delivery across the portfolio.

• Act as project manager on selected strategic projects, with responsibility for scope, schedule, risk, commercial performance, and client satisfaction.

• Oversee and develop a portfolio of approximately 350 projects, ensuring governance, resource allocation, risk management, financial control, and profitable delivery.

• Improve commercial performance by identifying risks and opportunities early, leading contract and client negotiations, and balancing quality, customer value, and profitability.

• Advance project management excellence across Transportation by developing ways of working and promoting collaboration and knowledge sharing across projects and disciplines.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is your ability to combine strong project management expertise with commercial understanding, stakeholder engagement, and people leadership. You thrive in complex environments where collaboration, cross-team coordination, and professional credibility are essential. You are committed to developing project managers, strengthening project delivery, and creating long-term value for our customers.

On top of that, you will have:

• A degree in civil engineering or other relevant education.

• Extensive project management experience from large multidisciplinary infrastructure projects in Denmark.

• A commercial mindset and solid understanding of portfolio performance, contracts, negotiations, risk, client relations, and financial results.

• Experience developing project management competences and ways of working across teams or portfolios.

• Fluent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Work location

The position is based in Lyngby or Aarhus, Denmark, with regular travel across our offices.

Want to know more?

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Do you want to work on some of the largest Oil & Gas projects in the Danish sector of the North Sea? Have you been looking to join a company in growth with many opportunities for employment and great job security? Do you also want to have more time for your private life?
Then you are the one we have been looking for!

We are looking for welders for offshore work in the Danish sector. Throughout the year we will be adding 250 more workers to our manpower pool.

Your position
We offer you a unique opportunity to join Semco Maritime during our largest growth phase yet. You will be working in a turn based 2:2 or a 2:3 which means you will spend 2 weeks offshore and the 2 to 3 following weeks at home. That also means you will have a work/life balance most people will be envious of, because during the 2 weeks of the rotational period that you are home you can dedicate yourself fully to your family, your hobbies, and your passions.

Your tasks & responsibilities
Together with your team you will be playing a key part in ensuring the quality of our costumers’ offshore assets.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Carrying out daily tasks related to welding and pipefitting
• Assisting the mechanical team if needed
• Helping out the other teams when necessary
Qualifications
We imagine that you are good at teamwork and that you work with attention to detail. Furthermore, you should be comfortable with routine tasks and working with predefined processes and guidelines. It is important that you possess a safety-first mindset.

To be successful in this position we expect that you have the following qualifications:

• Educated/trained welder, smith, mechanic, pipefitter or similar
• Experience with welding processes 141, 111, 136
• Availability to pass site tests
• Preferably have offshore experience

Welcome to Semco Maritime
We offer you an interesting and challenging job in an international organization, where we strive to provide innovative and sustainable solutions globally.

There are opportunities for personal and professional development within the job. Furthermore, Semco Maritime is in growth so there are job opportunities for permanent employment.

There are both permanent positions and long duration project positions available.

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
If you have any questions for the position, contact Stine Jessen at +45 79 16 66 66.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company dedicated to projects in the energy sector. For 40 years, we have been facilitating design, fabrication, service and maintenance of our customers’ assets, providing comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects. From turnkey engineering solutions to outsourcing of manpower and delivery of components, systems and solutions – we make sure our customers and partners in the energy sector experience safe and cost-efficient solutions. Semco Maritime has approx. 1,900 employees and branches in Denmark, Norway, United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore and the US. For further information, please see www.semcomaritime.com.

jobs.occupation: Lead consultant - Information protection and Data security; Workplace: DK - Fredericia, Ballerup
jobs.description:
Do you want to help build the technical protection layers that keep Denmark's electricity, gas and hydrogen infrastructure safe from cyber threats?

Energinet is looking for a skilled cyber security professional for our new Attack Surface Management department in the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. You will be the focal point for translating security requirements into concrete, operational solutions, from requirements documents to the finished implementation of security tools and technologies. 

Key responsibilities

• Oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise information protection capabilities.
• Develop and implement data protection strategies covering data classification, labeling, encryption, data loss prevention (DLP), information governance, and secure data sharing.
• Oversee the deployment and enhancement of technologies such as Microsoft Purview and related information protection solutions.
• Ensure sensitive information is appropriately protected across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. 
• Develop security requirements, technical standards & baselines for infrastructure, platforms, applications, and data.
• Implement information security improvements across networks, endpoints, servers, cloud platforms, and supplier-integrated environments.
• Act as a technical authority on information protection and security engineering practices
• Translate technical findings into actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Define technical standards and security architectures for information protection and data governance.
• Guide project outcomes by ensuring security considerations are embedded early in technology initiatives.
• Collaborate with vendors and strategic partners to ensure solutions meet Energinet's security standards and operational requirements

“We offer a job with a high level of professionalism and great societal significance, where you help protect Denmark's critical energy infrastructure. You will have skilled colleagues, good opportunities for professional development and flexibility in everyday life – in an organization that is growing and where cyber security is a high priority” – Arpan Roy, Director, Attack Surface Management.

We expect you to

• Have a solid technical understanding of infrastructure - e.g. networks, servers, identity, cloud and on-prem environments.
• Have experience in implementing information protection technologies
• Can write precise requirements documents and technical documentation that others can act on.
• Have an education as an engineer, computer scientist or equivalent - or solid practical experience at the same level.
• Preferably have a relevant certification (e.g. Microsoft Security, GIAC or CISSP). 
• Works in a structured and self-managed manner and thrives on both immersion and collaboration.

About the department

At our office in Ballerup or Fredericia, you will be part of Attack Surface Management & Technical Cyber Protection – a new department under the Group Cyber and Information Security unit. The department is responsible for the technical protection layers that reduce Energinet's attack surface, vulnerability management, penetration testing, protection of platforms, data and applications, as well as secure configuration and hardening.

Together with the other departments in Cyber and Information Security, we are responsible for developing and operating the organisation, processes and technologies within cyber and information security in Energinet and for coordinating the IT preparedness in the electricity, gas and hydrogen sectors. You will have a broad interface across the IT and OT environment and get close to some of Denmark's most socially critical systems.

Want to know more?

If you have any questions about the job, you are very welcome to contact Arpan Roy at arroy@energinet.dk or on tel. +45 5161 2898. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send us your motivated cv as soon as possible.

Special conditions: As Energinet performs tasks critical to society, we carry out background checks prior to employment. Employment is conditional upon your background check being compatible with employment at Energinet. The background check is also carried out once a year.

The position also requires that you are able to obtain and maintain security clearance. On PET's website, you can read more about security clearance.

We see diversity as a strength and encourage all qualified people, regardless of background, to apply for the job. We work actively and determinedly with diversity in Energinet and therefore encourage you to exclude information about age, marital status, etc. to minimise outage biases in the process. You can read more about our diversity policy here.

Energinet is an independent public company that reprecents society's interests when supplying Denmark with electricity and gas and that the energy system is converted to green energy. Our culture is closely linked to our social responsibility, and we work actively with the UN's global goals on sustainable energy, climate action, partnerships for action as well as industry, innovation, and infrastructure. By leading the way in the green transition, we can help to solve the global climate challenge. New solutions require us to be able to see problems from many different angles, and diversity is therefore a keyword in our culture. We strive to listen to, involve and share our knowledge. Based on the values of courage and trust, we focus on constantly developing ourselves as an organisation and as people. Read more at our website www.energinet.dk.

jobs.occupation: Advanced Test Engineer, Test Manager, Research & Development
jobs.description:
Would you like to play a key role in leading and coordinating test activities where testing and quality are critical to advanced software solutions? Apply your expertise in a complex and specialized engineering environment. Come and join us!

Your role in our team
 As our new Advanced Test Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our advanced software solutions within the R&D Defense Test Management department. You will be part of the Test Management team, working closely with experienced test engineers across R&D.
With a strong understanding of systems engineering, verification and validation processes, you will be responsible for securing product quality through strategic test planning, team leadership, test execution, test automation, and close collaboration with stakeholders.
 There is an increasing focus on CI/CD and multiple levels of test automation, which forms an important part of the role and is carried out in close cooperation with software developers, system engineers, fellow testers, and other technical specialists.
 The Test Management department is located across our offices in Lystrup and Søborg, and we expect you to work onsite as it is required for the role.
 
How you will make a meaningful contribution
 Your responsibilities will cover a wide range of testing activities to ensure the quality and reliability of our software solutions. Your key responsibilities include:
·         Plan, monitor, and control the integration and verification of the system
·         Responsible for the Verification Master Plan
·         Point of contact for the verification effort
·         Plan and drive in all test activities and ensure that the system meets the required standards and specifications
·         Support the integration of automated tests with the CI-CD pipeline
·         Contribute to a Test Community of Practice: Engage with other test enthusiasts to share knowledge, best practices, and continuously improve testing methodologies and processes
·         Continuously Improving Ways of Working: Participate in process improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of testing activities
 
Bring your world class expertise into play
You are fluent in English both in writing and verbal at a professional level. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement. Moreover, we are also looking for a new colleague with the following qualifications:
·          You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree within Software Engineering or a similar field of study
·         You are certified in software testing principles (ISTQB, TMAP, or similar)
·         You have solid experience with planning and leading test activities in software development
·         You have experience with testing complex systems
·         You have knowledge of software development and an understanding of the fundamentals of software testing and the concepts of system engineering, verification and validation
·         You understand agile development methods (Scrum) and project-oriented processes as well as test automation frameworks and tools 
 
As a person, you have a strong enthusiasm for testing and engineering, motivated by contributing to software solutions that enhance safety through advanced technology. You thrive in complex and specialized environments and maintain a structured, composed approach in fast-paced and demanding situations. With strong communication and leadership capabilities, you are able to lead the test effort effectively while promoting collaboration across teams.
We are an international company representing world-class expertise, delivering complex and high-tech products. We value our colleagues and our meaningful contributions to securing people through advanced technology. You will also experience that we have a strong focus on your development, teaching you useful new competences and further strengthening current ones, both professionally and personally. Our company culture is autonomous and engaging, and we acknowledge the importance of flexibility in a great working environment.
When joining Terma, we promise that you will experience: Great people, challenging tasks, world-class expertise, and meaningful contribution in your daily work.
 
Benefits at Terma
At Terma, we prioritize the well-being of our employees, ensuring they are well taken care of. Joining our team comes with a multitude of perks designed to enhance your social life, cultural experiences, and health.
 
International Environment: Explore great teamwork and professional sparring with colleagues around the world.

Your role as part of the team
As a Systems Engineer within Maritime Projects, you will play a key role in defining technical solutions for some of our advanced defense systems. Most importantly, you are motivated by finding the best solution for the complete system rather than a single discipline.
 
How you will make a meaningful contribution

·         Contributing to proposal work, engineering estimates, and technical planning
·         Helping improve engineering processes, methods, and collaboration across the organization.
 
Bring your expertise into play

·         Experience with systems engineering methodologies, requirements engineering, system architecture, MBSE/INCOSE, interface technologies, distributed software systems, networking, sensor integration, and safety-critical systems is considered a significant advantage
·         Experience with technical leadership, proposal development, defense standards, Linux, and relevant industry standards such as MIL-STDs is an advantage.
Most importantly, we believe diverse experiences add value to our team and organization. Therefore, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the above requirements.
As we are an international organization, it is important that you are fluent in English both in writing and verbal at a professional level.
 
Let’s secure people through advanced technology
When joining Terma, we promise that you will experience great people, challenging tasks, and opportunities to make an impact on your daily work. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and open knowledge sharing, supporting your development along the way. Learning is part of everyday work, supported by colleagues at all stages of their careers – from students just starting out, to colleagues who have been part of Terma for decades.
 
Benefits

We are all Terma - diverse in skills and equal in value.
