jobs.occupation: Head of Center of Excellence for Project Management
jobs.description:
At Bavarian Nordic, we are committed to saving and improving lives by unlocking the power of the immune system. Our commercial portfolio includes market-leading vaccines against smallpox/mpox, rabies, tick-borne encephalitis, typhoid fever, and cholera. We excel in R&D innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization, working every day to protect people’s health and quality of life and protect our tomorrow.

We are looking for an experienced leader for the Head of Center of Excellence (project management) role in our Strategy Execution department who combines strategic thinking, strong change management capabilities, and a genuine passion for building organizational capability. In this role, you will not only define how projects are governed and delivered but also drive the adoption of new ways of working across a global organization.

**About The Role

**This is a broad and hands-on role spanning project leadership and organizational capability building within project excellence. A key aspect of the role is driving organizational change by ensuring that project management frameworks, tools, and processes are successfully adopted, understood, and embedded across the business. In this dual role, you will balance being Head of Center of Excellence while managing high-impact cross-functional projects yourself. Just as importantly, you will turn standards into practice by designing and delivering training, facilitating sessions, coaching colleagues, and creating engagement across the organization.

You will work across R&D, manufacturing, supply chain, commercial, and corporate functions. The portfolio may include merger and acquisition activities, development projects, vaccine launches, technology implementations, and other enterprise-wide transformation initiatives. Success requires someone who enjoys moving between strategic planning, practical implementation, and visible facilitation in front of an audience.

The position is based in Hellerup, Denmark. You will join a team of +20 Project Managers, Program Leads, and Student Assistants and report to the VP of Strategy Execution Office.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own and continuously strengthen project management standards, governance, tools, templates, and ways of working across the organization

• Lead complex, cross-functional strategic projects, including initiatives connected to M&A, product development, vaccine launches, and enterprise transformation

• Drive adoption of project management methodologies and support organizational change through stakeholder engagement, communication, training, and coaching

• Develop project management capability through structured training, facilitation, coaching, and hands-on knowledge sharing across different functions and seniority levels

• Serve as a visible ambassador for project excellence, translating methodology into clear, practical, and engaging learning experiences

• Partner with senior stakeholders to create alignment, transparency, sound decision-making, and clear ownership throughout the project lifecycle

• Drive disciplined planning, risk management, resource coordination, and execution, supported by strong use of project and portfolio management tools

**What You Bring

**You bring extensive experience leading complex projects within pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, vaccines, or another highly regulated healthcare environment. You also bring change management expertise combined with hands-on delivery experience. Besides this, we are looking for someone with the following background;

• A genuine interest in the full scope of project management excellence, from strategic framework design and governance to practical implementation and organizational training

• Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with the confidence and energy to stand in front of an audience, engage participants, and make complex methods practical and relevant

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, create buy-in, and lead through complex global and cross-functional environments

• Strong knowledge of PMI-based project management practices. PMI/PMP certification is an advantage - other relevant certifications are also valued

• Experience with merger and acquisition projects

• A relevant master’s degree within life sciences, engineering, supply chain, business, or a related field

• Advanced expertise in Smartsheet combined with experience with Microsoft Project is an advantage

**Why join us?

**This role gives you the opportunity to influence both how strategic projects are delivered and how project management capability is built across Bavarian Nordic. You will combine high-impact project leadership with the chance to shape standards, develop colleagues, and create a lasting project excellence culture in a purpose-driven global vaccine organization.

If you are motivated by strategy and execution, enjoy building practical solutions, and feel energized by training and engaging others, we would love to hear from you.

**Caught your interest?

**Apply now and join Bavarian Nordic in our mission to improve health outcomes and foster sustainable growth.

We do not offer any relocation packages for this role. Please note that employment is contingent on residing and working in Denmark.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

__Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

_For more information, visit www.bavarian-nordic.com

jobs.occupation: Take ownership of AML, KYC, risk and compliance in Secure Payment (part of AutoProff)
jobs.description:
Secure Payment is the payment entity within AutoProff, handling payments related to our car auctions across the business. We’re looking for a AML, KYC, Risk & Compliance Specialist to take ownership of our compliance framework and help ensure that Secure Payment remains well governed, structured and compliant as we continue to develop the business.

This is a broad and hands-on role where you’ll work closely with management, the Board of Directors and colleagues across Tech, Support and Finance.

At AutoProff, we’re changing the way used vehicles are traded across Europe. Every day, thousands of vehicles are bought and sold through our platform, connecting professional car dealers across markets.

About the role

As our new AML, KYC, Risk & Compliance Specialist, you’ll join Secure Payment and be based at our headquarters in Vejle, Denmark.

You’ll take responsibility for AML, KYC, risk and compliance activities and help ensure that policies, processes, controls and documentation are kept up to date and work effectively in practice.

The role has a broad stakeholder landscape and combines structured compliance work with reporting, administration and practical follow-up. You’ll work closely with the Board of Directors, management, customers and colleagues across AutoProff, including Tech, Support and Finance.

Secure Payment is also developing a new reporting methodology, and you’ll have the opportunity to help shape how we structure management information, controls and reporting going forward.

What you’ll be doing

Your responsibilities will include:

• Own and further develop Secure Payment’s AML, KYC, risk and compliance activities

• Maintain and improve relevant policies, procedures, controls and documentation

• Coordinate and follow up on KYC reviews, customer due diligence, monitoring and relevant AML cases

• Identify, assess and follow up on compliance and operational risks

• Prepare clear and structured reporting for management and the Board of Directors

• Help develop Secure Payment’s reporting methodology and management information

• Follow up on findings, incidents, regulatory requirements and agreed actions

• Work closely with colleagues across Tech, Support, Finance and the wider AutoProff organisation

• Explore how AI and digital tools can support reporting, documentation and compliance processes

• Maintain constructive dialogue with relevant internal and external stakeholders

What we’re looking for

We imagine you have experience with AML and KYC, or a solid understanding of the underlying principles combined with a strong interest in developing your regulatory and legal knowledge further.

More specifically, we’re looking for someone with:

• Experience with AML, KYC or related compliance activities

• A structured and administrative approach to work

• Strong attention to detail and a focus on high-quality documentation and reporting

• The ability to maintain an overview and prioritise when several tasks are moving at the same time

• An interest in compliance, risk and regulatory topics

• Good understanding of IT systems and digital tools

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English

• Confidence working independently and taking ownership of your area

Beyond your experience, we’re looking for someone who is structured, curious and hands-on, and who enjoys creating order, following up and making sure things are done properly.

Nice to have

It’s a plus, but not a requirement, if you have experience with:

• Banking, payment institutions, financial services or another regulated environment

• Risk and compliance in a regulated business

• Reporting to senior management or a Board of Directors

• A banking or financial-services background

• Using AI or digital tools to improve reporting, documentation or compliance processes

Why join AutoProff?

At AutoProff, you’ll become part of an international company that is changing the way used cars are traded across Europe.

You’ll work with colleagues across countries and functions in an environment where there is room to take ownership, share ideas and influence how we do things. We move quickly, work closely together and value people who are comfortable taking responsibility while also asking for input when needed.

As part of AutoScout24 Group, we combine the pace and hands-on environment of AutoProff with the opportunities and international reach of one of Europe’s leading automotive marketplaces.

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to shape a developing compliance function, work closely with senior stakeholders and influence how Secure Payment structures its AML, KYC, risk and reporting processes going forward.

Ready to join us?

If this sounds like an opportunity you’d like to explore, we’d like to hear from you.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the position once we have found the right candidate.

About AutoProff

AutoProff was founded in Denmark in 2013 with one goal: to make B2B used-car trading simpler and more efficient through digital solutions.

Today, AutoProff provides online B2B used-car trading solutions for professional car dealers across Europe, with more than 150,000 vehicles traded through our platforms annually.

In August 2022, AutoScout24, one of Europe’s leading online automotive marketplaces, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. Together, we are working towards creating a fully integrated C2B-B2B-B2C solution for used cars across Europe.

Our ambition is simple: to be the home of B2B car trading for European car dealers.

jobs.occupation: Associate Professor (non-tenured) in archaeometry at SDU in Odense
jobs.description:
A position as non-tenured Associate Professor in archaeometry is available from 1 May 2027 until 31 March 2030 at the Department of Physics Chemistry and Pharmacy, Faculty of Science, SDU in Odense.

About the research group and the project
The research group at which this position is posted is called CHART (Cultural Heritage and Archaeometric Research Team). Cultural Heritage and archaeometric research deal with investigations of samples originating from all sorts of culturally important artefacts: those procured by archaeologists in excavations, medieval buildings, handmade artefacts of all kinds, pieces of art, written materials. Only, the objects must have survived and be preserved today to some tangible degree. The study of cultural heritage is not exclusively for the humanities. In the last four or five decades, natural sciences have been increasingly involved in untangling the events of the past by studying cultural heritage objects to an ever-increasing degree of complexity. 

 

In CHART we take up the challenge of investigating cultural heritage objects on an international level using chemistry and physics. We aim at making a difference on the international scene by inventing new analytical methodologies, investigating objects of national and international interest, and by always securing collaboration between natural science and the humanities.

We do not claim to produce final or stand-alone answers; instead, we strive to achieve solutions together with colleagues from the humanities. In our research laboratories we daily cross the line between natural science and the humanities.

 

The present position is aimed at executing the already financed CIPP Center (Center for the Interior of Parchment and Paper), which involves the investigation of the Dead Sea Scrolls (https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/fakulteterne/naturvidenskab/nyheder-2026/erc-dead-sea-scrolls-archaeometry), the development of new methods for analysing paper and parchment, and a new project on poisonous books conducted in collaboration with the Royal Academy in Copenhagen, Pisa University, and the Library at SDU (https://www.nature.com/articles/s40494-019-0334-2 ).   

 

About the candidate
The successful candidate is expected to hold a PhD in archaeometry, analytical chemistry, or a closely related field, with a research profile centred on the application of analytical and physical-chemical methods to archaeological and heritage materials. A demonstrated expertise in a wide range of archaeomaterials (e.g., ceramics, bricks, pigments, and parchments) spanning diverse chrono-cultural contexts will be considered an asset. 

 

Tasks

• 
The candidate must partake in the execution of the research at the CIPP Center conducted by the CHART research group and contribute to the overall research theme of CHART. 

• 
The candidate must be able to support the ongoing collaboration with ADBOU at the SDU Health Faculty.

• 
The candidate is expected to obtain external funding for independent research, to foster internal collaboration at the Department, and to build and lead an internationally recognized research group. 

• 
The candidate should contribute to public outreach and communication activities.

• 
The candidate should teach (broadly) in degree programmes at the department, as well as participate in departmental administration, strategy development and educational programme development. 

• 
The candidate is expected to mentor undergraduate, graduate, and research students. 

 

Skills

• 
The candidate must have a strong and independent research profile, documented by an excellent track record of peer-reviewed publications in international journals. Hands-on experience with advanced analytical chemical instrumentation, experience with luminescence-based dating methods, and a demonstrated ability to develop or adapt analytical chemical methods will be highly valued.

• 
Experience with international collaboration, of partnerships with museums and cultural-heritage institutions, and of collaboration with the private sector will be an advantage.

• 
The successful candidate should have a strong teaching record. This includes experience with teaching courses within a chemistry curriculum at bachelor and master level as well as experience of project supervision across all levels, from bachelor to PhD. Experience with interdisciplinary, practical, and laboratory-based teaching, and with modern teaching methods, e-learning, flipped classroom, and online learning methods will be an advantage. A teaching CV should be included in the proposal. Teaching at the department includes first year teaching held in Danish, and the successful applicant may be expected to be involved in first year teaching. However, teaching in English is accepted from the start of employment, and the successful applicant is expected to learn basic Danish within 5 years. The university offers language courses.

The candidate will be part of the chemistry section. 

Application deadline: 15. November 2026 at 23:59 hours local Danish time

Please see the full call, including how to apply, on www.sdu.dk

jobs.occupation: Tracking Microbes Across Borders using Genomics to Uncover Biomass-to-Biogas Transmission Pathways
jobs.employer_name: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Animal and Veterinary Sciences programme. The position is available from 01 January 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Tracking Microbes Across Borders using Genomics to Uncover Biomass-to-Biogas Transmission Pathways

Research area and project description
Biogas production supports the transition to renewable energy and a circular bioeconomy. However, the increasing use of imported animal-derived biomass creates connected biosecurity interfaces between European suppliers, international transport, Danish reception points, biogas plants and nearby livestock production. This PhD project will determine whether these pathways are microbiologically plausible and identify where hygienisation and other biosecurity barriers interrupt them.

Using a risk-informed longitudinal design, the candidate will sample linked compartments including incoming biomass vehicles, reception and unloading areas, local vehicles and machinery, plant environments, biomass before and after hygienisation, and selected onward-facing interfaces. The project will combine targeted PCR/RT-qPCR surveillance for epidemiologically relevant transboundary animal-disease agents and other animal pathogens with long-read shotgun metagenomics, culture and viability approaches, and sequencing of selected isolates. Comparative genomic analyses will assess microbial connectivity between compartments while distinguishing co-detection from evidence consistent with persistence or transfer. Findings will be integrated with biomass origin and type, transport history, season and plant/process conditions.

Controlled experiments will quantify persistence, transfer and inactivation under representative transport, storage, cleaning/disinfection and processing conditions. Where work with high-consequence agents is not feasible, appropriate surrogates, indicators or non-infectious materials will be used. The project will deliver evidence on microbial hazards, resistomes, mobile genetic elements, critical control points and effective biosecurity barriers in the Danish biogas sector.

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants to the PhD position must hold a relevant master’s degree, or an equivalent qualification, in Genomics, veterinary science, microbiology, molecular biology, bioinformatics, or a closely related discipline.

Relevant experience in molecular microbiology, microbial genomics/metagenomics, culture-based microbiology, bioinformatics or quantitative data analysis is an advantage; applicants are not expected to be experts in all areas.

The successful candidate should be motivated to combine field sampling, laboratory experiments and computational analysis; work carefully under appropriate biosafety and quality procedures; collaborate across institutions and with external stakeholders; and communicate effectively in written and spoken English. A driving license and willingness to travel to Danish biogas plants are advantages.

Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Aarhus University, Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Blichers Allé 20, 8830 Tjele, Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
 
• Yaovi Mahuton Gildas Hounmanou, gil@anivet.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Anders Dalsgaard, adal@sund.ku.dk (co-supervisor)

For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:

How to apply

Application deadline is 01 November 2026 at 23:59 CET.

For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.
Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which everyone has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in shrub expansion and ecosystem responses in Subarctic tundra
jobs.description:
A 2-year postdoctoral fellowship is available from 16 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter in the Terrestrial Ecology Section within the Department of Biology at the University of Copenhagen.

  The position is available in a project assessing the role of shrubs as drivers of ecosystem changes in the Subarctic. In this project, we conduct field and laboratory analyses in order to get a better understanding of the role of low shrubs in vegetation changes, nitrogen cycling and carbon sequestration in subarctic ecosystems. The host research group focuses on Plant Physiological Ecology & Biogeochemistry and it is led by Professor Anders Michelsen at University of Copenhagen. The work includes field visit(s) to long-term experimental sites near Abisko in Northern Sweden, and collaboration with Associate Research Prof. Matteo Campioli at University of Antwerpen.

  Project overview

  The project is aimed at studying plant responses to long-term experimental warming in Subarctic tundra heath ecosystems, including biomass changes and warming impacts on plant nitrogen uptake as well as primary and secondary growth.

  Subarctic heaths are one of the ecosystem types most affected by the ongoing climatic changes, showing large biotic changes such as shrubification. Both evergreen and deciduous shrubs are expanding and will likely dominate future dry heaths in subarctic Scandinavia. Shrubs have an important role as ecosystem engineers, linked to shrub dominance patterns and performance. We will reveal 1) evergreen and deciduous shrub biomass and nitrogen (N) pool responses in subarctic tundra ecosystems influenced by experimental summer warming for one, two or three decades; 2) primary and secondary growth by dominant shrubs in the same control and warmed plots, and 3) the shrub N uptake in spring and summer in these experiments using an isotope labelled amino acid. The aim is to improve our fundamental understanding of shrub expansion, interactions with soil processes and significance for climate feedbacks in a future warmer Subarctic. The experimental setup is unique in terms of time span and potential for comparing responses at multiple time points at the same site, and at multiple sites with similar vegetation, on a decadal time scale.

  The project relies on established long-term field experiments in Abisko, Northern Sweden. The project combines field-based sampling of plants and soil, analysis of plant trait responses, labelling with stable isotopes, biogeochemical analyses including assessment of soil nutrient availability, microbial biomass and soil carbon stocks, and with analyses of carbon and nitrogen isotopic composition and plant primary and secondary growth as additional tools.

  Main tasks and responsibilities

  The successful candidate will be responsible for developing independent research within the scientific area of the project, in close collaboration with host and the external partner. This includes data and sample collection in field experiments, extensive processing of previously obtained biological material and data, interpretation as well as writing scientific publications. Note that much of the field sampling has already been performed. The candidate should be willing to perform additional field work in subarctic N. Sweden (Abisko) alone and with host and collaborators (short period(s) for up to 3 weeks in total in spring/summer), with research visit at University of Antwerpen, and extensive laboratory work (assisted by PI and lab technician) in Copenhagen where the post doc is based.

  Qualifications

  We are looking for an ambitious, creative, and highly motivated candidate with a PhD in plant ecology, biology, biogeochemistry, or a related field. Solid experiences with field and lab-based experimental work, and data analysis/statistics are expected. Fluency in written and spoken English is a requirement, as well as excellent writing skills demonstrated by the publication record. A successful candidate also has some experience with analyses of plant traits, ecosystem responses and/or biogeochemical responses to environmental changes, and interest in the use of stable isotopes in ecology. Although the candidate must be able to work independently, good interpersonal skills are also needed.

  Procedures and shortlisting

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether an expert committee will assess their application. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee, and the time schedule of an interview (around end of November). Each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. The Head of Department, based on the recommendations of the assessment committee, will make the final selection of the successful candidate.

  You can read about the recruitment process at https://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Place of employment and principal place of work
 University of Copenhagen, Department of Biology, Terrestrial Ecology Section, Universitetsparken 15, DK-2100 Copenhagen.

  Terms of employment
 The position is from 16 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. Employment period is 2 years.

  Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated.

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Further information can be obtained from Prof. Anders Michelsen (e-mail: andersm@bio.ku.dk).

  How to apply
 The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY FOR POSITION below.

  Please Include:

   	
• A cover letter including (i) statement of research interests, (ii) reasons for applying to this position and (iii) few selected concrete proposals/ideas for possible novel and relevant research work within the topics of the project (max. 2 pages) 	
• Curriculum vitae including a list of publications 	
• Copy of the PhD diploma or documentation for planned PhD defense 	
• Separate reprints uploads of 3 particularly relevant papers, and upload or link to PhD thesis 	
• Max. 2 letters of reference   Deadline for application is 1 November 2026 at 23:59 GMT +1. Applications received after the deadline, not using the online application form, or not including the required documents will not be considered.

  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.occupation: Implementation Consultant with expertise in social services – Columna Cura
jobs.description:
Implementation Consultant with expertise in social services – Columna Cura

Do you know municipal case management in social services inside out – VUM, FFB, service catalogues, rates and citizens' co-payments – and would you like to help municipalities get the most out of their IT support for social services? Then seize this unique opportunity to put your professional insight to use in a company with high ambitions, and help our customers get the greatest value from Columna Cura!

Join a collaborative and ambitious team

As our new Implementation Consultant, you'll work with Columna Cura, our IT solution for the health and social care sector, which supports staff, citizens and relatives throughout the citizen's entire care journey. The solution is already live in 38 Danish municipalities, and we're growing in social services, where case management, service provision and collaboration between authority and provider place specific demands on how the system is configured and used.

You'll join the Cura Projects & Services team, made up of dedicated colleagues – consultants, solution architects, service developers and more.

The team's main responsibility is project and service delivery, and your tasks will include implementation projects, training and professional guidance on configuration.

Play a key role and contribute to Systematic's growth

As our new Implementation Consultant on Columna Cura, you'll play a key role in helping municipalities get off to a strong start with Cura in social services – and continue to get optimal value from the Cura product suite afterwards. You'll bridge the gap between the municipality's case management practices, providers' needs and the system's setup, translating assessments, service catalogues, rates and workflows between authority and provider into a well-functioning Cura setup.

Your insights from customer dialogue also feed into our product and service development.

Your key tasks will include:

• advising municipalities on how to configure Cura to support case management in social services, including VUM (the Adult Needs Assessment Method) and the process from assessment and decision to service delivery

• setting up and maintaining service catalogues (FFB – Denmark's Common Professional Concepts framework – and municipal services), rates and rules for citizens' co-payments in collaboration with the customer

• supporting collaboration between case workers and internal and external providers in Cura, including ordering, follow-up and billing of services

• training system administrators and super users to use and configure Cura

• producing and maintaining functional documentation that helps customers configure Cura to their needs

• taking part in tender responses for new customers

• working closely with your colleagues in Cura Projects & Services, Product Management and Domain Advisors, and feeding valuable customer insights from social services into our product development

You should expect around five travel days a month to customers in Denmark and Norway.

Put your social services expertise to use

Our new colleague knows social services inside out – either as a social worker with hands-on experience in case management or with providers, or as a system administrator or super user of Columna Cura or a similar IT solution for social services. You're a strong communicator who's motivated by helping others and committed to laying the groundwork for customer success and satisfaction.

We expect you to have in-depth knowledge of municipal case management in social services – particularly the VUM method, FFB and service catalogues, services, rates, citizens' co-payments, and collaboration with internal and external providers. Experience with Columna Cura or a similar specialist system for social services is a strong advantage, but the right professional insight matters more to us than the exact system you know.

It would be a huge plus if you also know the provider side of social services – for example residential care, supported housing, and activity and employment services – and understand how orders, goals, documentation and follow-up move between authority and provider. That understanding is exactly what enables you to help a municipality set up Cura so that case workers and providers work as one connected process.

We also imagine that you:

• can translate legislation and case management practice into concrete system setup and clear guidance for users

• enjoy coordinating and collaborating with customers and stakeholders – from case workers and providers to system owners and management

are proactive and take the initiative

• speak and write Danish and English fluently - Non Danish Speakers need not apply

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO/EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 social/professional events a year. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, games tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is truly international, proudly Danish and uniquely people-centric. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most – this is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. Systematic is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

You can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers almost 100 events of both social and professional character a year, so there is plenty to choose from. Our colleagues also highlight our canteen, which serves a variety of delicious and healthy dishes each day. In addition, we offer several employee benefits such as paid Home Internet, health insurance and a company pension scheme. Finally, we are always up for a friendly game of padel at our new padel court in Aarhus!

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Mette Skylvad, Program Manager.

Good knowledge of Wi-Fi technical standards, performance parameters, stability considerations, and practical implementation details.

Basic understanding of Wi-Fi regulatory standards.

Pragmatic mindset with focus on stable solutions, measurable improvements, and real-world usability.

Technical Leadership

• Serve as the technical lead for the AI platform engineering team — setting the implementation direction, defining coding standards, and making key technical decisions that govern how the platform is built and evolved.

• Lead code reviews and drive architecture discussions, ensuring engineering decisions are well-reasoned, documented, and aligned with the broader platform strategy — championing engineering standards across code quality, testing practices, documentation, observability, and security hardening.

• Act as a technical mentor and go-to resource for all engineers — sharing knowledge, unblocking complex problems, and actively investing in the technical growth of both senior and junior team members.

Platform Engineering & AI Infrastructure

• Design, build, and operate scalable, high-performance services and platform components that expose AI/ML capabilities across Pandora's digital ecosystem.

• Own and define the standards and governance for Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — ensuring all Azure infrastructure is reproducible, auditable, and securely configured.

• Apply strong network architecture knowledge to design and govern secure connectivity between platform services, AI gateways, and external integrations, including VNet, private endpoints, NSGs, and ingress/egress controls, while collaborating with security stakeholders to uphold the platform's overall security posture.

• Leverage Databricks for big data processing, feature engineering, and ML pipeline support.

AI Services & Agentic Development

• Integrate and operationalise AI services including LLM APIs, vector search, RAG pipelines, embeddings, and multi-layer caching into platform-level services.

• Lead the agentic code development practice: architecting autonomous execution loops that enable tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to safely write, test, and self-correct software within isolated sandboxes.

• Own MLflow governance standards for experiment tracking, model versioning, and ML lifecycle management across the team.

• Configure and manage AI gateways to ensure secure, scalable, and governed access to AI capabilities at production scale.

CI/CD & Reliability

• Define and govern the CI/CD standards for the AI platform team — establishing quality gates, testing frameworks, deployment patterns, and pipeline architecture that all engineers build to.

• Ensure performance, availability, and maintainability of platform services in production; handle incidents in a timely manner to minimise Mean Time to Contain (MTTC).

Job Requirements:

Education & Experience

• Relevant background from Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field with experience in backend or platform engineering, with at least 2 years operating in a technical leadership capacity within AI or cloud-native platform teams.

• Proven experience building and operating AI/ML platform services or LLM-based integrations in a production environment.

Technical Skills

• Strong backend engineering fundamentals: service architecture, REST API design, performance optimisation, and production reliability by design and monitoring, with hands-on proficiency in Python.

• Deep Kubernetes expertise — workload configuration, networking, security policy design, and production debugging; hands-on Docker and Azure App Services.

• Expert-level Terraform and IaC ownership — defining standards, patterns, and governance for cloud infrastructure on Azure.

• Strong network architecture and configuration skills, including Azure networking concepts (VNet, NSG, private endpoints, DNS, ingress/egress).

• MLflow governance, Databricks for ML pipeline integration, and experience with ML serving infrastructure, LLM APIs, prompt integration, and multi-layer caching.

• Proficiency in PostgreSQL and experience in configuring AI gateways for centralized AI governance

• Experience in agentic code development practice, harness engineering and spec-driven development is a plus.

Soft Skills

Ideally you are a trusted technical leader who combines strong engineering expertise with clear thinking and a collaborative approach to drive sound decisions, communicate complex platform, security, and architecture topics in a business-friendly way, and foster team growth. Brings a proactive and curious mindset, with a passion for emerging AI technologies balanced by a pragmatic focus on execution and delivery.

About the Team

You will be part of Pandora's AI Platform team within AI CoE at Digital & Analytics & AI — a passionate, forward-thinking group dedicated to building the infrastructure and services that bring AI to life across the business. The team works at the intersection of data science, machine learning, cloud engineering, and product development, collaborating closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Architects, and Product stakeholders.

You will report to the AI Platform Manager and serve as the senior technical voice that shapes how the platform is designed, secured, and evolved — influencing both what gets built and how it gets built.

Did we get your attention?

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

Icing on the cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Your key responsibilities

You will:

• 
Develop and improve firmware for low-power, wireless IoT devices, from bring-up through production release

• 
Lead the structured transition of selected firmware development and verification activities from external partners to internal ownership, including tooling, documentation, and knowledge transfer

• 
Own firmware architecture in selected projects, including driver development, wireless connectivity stacks, and over-the-air (OTA) update mechanisms

• 
Contribute to verification and validation activities, including hardware/firmware bring-up, test planning, troubleshooting, certification readiness, and release processes

• 
Strengthen Stage-Gate execution, design review practices, documentation quality, engineering change processes, and controlled releases

• 
Collaborate closely with firmware architect, electronics, mechanics, software/cloud, production colleagues, internal stakeholders, and external suppliers

You will become a key technical voice in the firmware discipline, helping raise the engineering standard and ensuring that products are designed not only to work, but to work reliably at scale.

Who you are

You are an experienced firmware engineer with deep technical expertise and a strong interest in building connected products for the real world. You enjoy hands-on embedded development, structured problem-solving, and turning technical findings into robust, production-ready solutions.

• 
7–10+ years of experience in embedded firmware development

• 
Strong experience with embedded C/C++ and real-time operating systems (e.g. FreeRTOS, Zephyr) or bare-metal development

• 
Experience with battery-powered IoT devices and low-power wireless connectivity (e.g. BLE, LoRaWAN, or cellular IoT)

• 
Experience with firmware architecture, driver development, and over-the-air (OTA) update mechanisms

• 
Experience with version control, automated testing, and CI/CD for embedded systems

• 
Experience working in structured product development models such as Stage-Gate

• 
Knowledge of security practices for connected devices (Ideally RED+CRA)

• 
Professional proficiency in English

Company Description

At Coach Solutions, we build software that helps the global shipping industry work smarter and make data-driven decisions — for both profit and sustainability. Backed by Kongsberg Maritime, we're entering a new phase: modernizing our architecture and scaling our impact.

Job Description

We're looking for a Senior Frontend / Full-Stack Developer to join our Platform & Development department. You'll take ownership of frontend development across our SaaS products, working closely with developers, QA, Product, and other stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable software used by customers across the shipping industry.

Our stack centres on Next.js, React, Typescript and Vercel, backed by Azure and .NET Standard services, with Mapbox and tilesets powering our geospatial visualizations. We're an AI-fluent team — you'll be expected to use AI-assisted tools as part of how you work, not just be curious about them.

Qualifications

What you'll do

• Design, build, and maintain modern frontend applications with React and Next.js.

• Build interactive maps and geospatial visualizations using Mapbox and tilesets.

• Integrate frontend applications with backend REST APIs, including .NET Standard services — with room to grow into full-stack work overtime.

• Contribute to modernizing our existing architecture, with an eye on maintainability, scalability, and security.

• Own features end-to-end: from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and monitoring (via tools like Monitive).

• Use GitHub and GitHub Actions for version control, code review, and CI/CD.

• Use AI-assisted development tools day-to-day to improve code quality, testing, and delivery speed.

• Share knowledge, raise technical risks early, and help shape how the team works.

What you bring

Must have

• 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on frontend and production software used by real customers.

• Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript/JavaScript.

• Solid grasp of frontend architecture: component design, state management, responsive UIs.

• Experience integrating frontend apps with REST APIs and backend services.

• Comfortable with Git/GitHub, code review, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Genuinely AI-fluent: you already use AI coding tools and understand their limits, not just open to trying them.

• Clear communicator — able to explain technical trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have (we'll teach the rest)

• Experience with Mapbox, tilesets, or geospatial data — no prior background required if you're keen to learn.

• Exposure to Vercel deployment workflows.

• Comfort working in Azure-based environments.

• .NET Standard experience, or interest in growing into full-stack work.

• Familiarity with monitoring/observability tools such as Monitive.

Additional Information

Practical details

• Location: Copenhagen, on-site with hybrid flexibility

• Team: Platform & Development department

Why Coach Solutions

• A purpose-driven workplace at the intersection of tech and sustainability.

• Real influence: if you see the problem, you own it — and if you make the best argument, you win, regardless of title.

• An informal, social culture — monthly Friday bars, team events, summer and winter parties, family events, and more.

• A skilled mentor and an experienced, engineering-minded team eager to help you succeed.

• Room to grow — new responsibilities and career paths as the company scales.

Don't check every box?

That's okay — we'd still love to hear from you. If you have strong frontend experience, a passion for building great software, and the motivation to learn and grow, reach out. Let's build something meaningful together.

jobs.description:
Are you a tech-minded graduate ready to make an impact within technology and transformation? Do you want to explore different career paths within consulting – and find the right match for you?

On 18-19 November 2026, we invite ambitious soon-to-be or recent Graduates to Deloitte’s Talent Discovery Days - your opportunity to get to know the different career paths and work with cases in Deloitte Technology & Transformation leading to a potential position in one of our offerings.

Technology & Transformation

In Deloitte Denmark, our Technology & Transformation teams work with the intersection of business and technology to help organizations navigate change and turn technology into practical, impactful solutions.

You will join a collaborative environment with ambitious colleagues, where learning, development, and teamwork are key – and where you get the opportunity to grow both professionally and personally.

What can you expect?

During the Talent Discovery Days, not two moments will be alike. You will collaborate with peers on case challenges, meet our consultants, and explore the different opportunities within Technology & Transformation. Among other things you will:

• Work on case exercises and tackle real-life client challenges with peers

• Meet our consultants and hear their career stories first-hand

• Explore our tech teams and discover where your skills and interests fit in

• Get the chance to move forward: based on the days, selected participants will be invited to individual interviews with the possibility of a job offer in the following period

Please note: Discovery Day takes place over two full days, and participants are expected to be able to attend both days. In addition, selected participants must be available for potential follow-up calls after both day 1 and day 2 as part of the assessment process.

Who are we looking for?

At Deloitte, we look for curiosity, drive, and passion for combining business and technology to create impact. A candidate who is:

A soon-to-be or recent graduate (up to 2 years of experience) within Computer Science, Engineering, IT or Business IT

• In possession of a valid Danish work and residence permit

• An interest in the balance and intersection between technology and business

• A problem solver who enjoys tackling complex challenges

• A passionate learner eager to grow your skills and career

• A team player who thrives in collaborative environments

• A candidate with a passion for collaborating with customers to solve their problems

Here you can read more about our offerings and what type of candidates they specifically are looking for:

AI & Data

In AI & Data, we help organizations solve their complex challenges by turning data into a strategic asset. This means you'll be hands-on with projects that span the entire data journey – from shaping AI strategy and building modern data platforms to developing and implementing agentic and generative AI, machine learning, analytics and automation solutions. You will collaborate with a team of advisors and deep-tech specialists to deliver tangible results for clients across all industries. We practice what we preach, applying AI-powered tools in our own work to enhance quality and accelerate delivery.

We are looking for curious and ambitious problem-solvers with a genuine interest in the connection between data, technology, and business. You don't need to be an expert yet, but an understanding of data engineering, data science, or AI concepts is essential, along with a strong desire to learn and grow.

ServiceNow

We combine consulting with hands-on implementation of ServiceNow solutions to help organizations streamline and future-proof their operations. Our work spans process automation, performance tracking, and digital workflow optimization across functions such as IT, HR, Finance, Risk and Compliance.

We are looking for curious and motivated candidates who thrive at the intersection of business and technology. You may lean more towards technical development or towards project and process work, but you should be interested in understanding how digital solutions support business outcomes.

You are not expected to have ServiceNow expertise before joining - competencies will be developed through training and project experience. What matters most is your ability to think abstractly and translate ideas into tangible solutions. For example, you should be able to interpret a written process description and visualize or structure it into a clear process flow.

Customer

At Deloitte Digital, we help organizations transform their front-office by designing and implementing CRM solutions across sales, marketing, and service. We are looking for talented colleagues who understand how technology supports customer-facing processes and are eager to work hands-on with CRM platforms.

The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of business and technology, can translate client requirements into practical solutions and is motivated to develop both functional expertise and technical skills in a dynamic, team-oriented environment.

Finance Transformation

In Finance Transformation, we help organizations modernize and improve the entire CFO area, from invoicing and reporting to finance strategy and financial planning. By combining business insight, technology, data, and process excellence, we help finance functions become more efficient and better equipped to support strategic decision-making.

As a junior consultant, you will gain exposure to a variety of projects across the CFO agenda and work closely with both colleagues and clients. This gives you the opportunity to build a broad understanding of finance transformation before gradually developing deeper expertise within a specific area that matches your interests and strengths.

We are looking for curious and analytical candidates with an interest in the intersection of business, finance, and technology. You enjoy solving complex problems, working with data, and collaborating with stakeholders to create practical solutions that deliver measurable impact.

Supply Chain & Network Operations

In Supply Chain & Network Operations (SCNO), we help organizations transform how they plan, optimize, and execute their supply chains. You'll work hands-on configuring platforms like Kinaxis Maestro and SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP), implementing decision intelligence solutions, and enabling resilient supply chains. You will collaborate with supply chain strategists, technical and industry experts to deliver transformational outcomes across complex, global supply networks.

You will translate supply chain requirements into technical solutions, work directly with client teams on implementation, and develop expertise in planning, logistics, procurement, manufacturing, and product lifecycle management. You'll gain exposure to digital thread designs connecting product design, manufacturing, and supply chain execution. You'll grow both technical skills in platform implementation and consulting skills in translating client challenges into designs.

We seek curious and ambitious candidates who thrive at the intersection of business and technology. You should be a collaborative team player who genuinely cares about client impact and learning from colleagues. You don't need platform expertise - competencies develop through training and project experience. What matters most is your ability to think systematically about interconnected processes, translate business requirements into technical specifications, and collaborate across teams.

Whats next?

Expected start: January 2027 & September 2027

Location: Deloitte, Weidekampsgade 6, 2300 Copenhagen S

We only have a limited number of seats available, so do not hesitate to send your application before 8th November.

To apply, please upload your CV, you transcript of grades, and answer our three short questions. Please note that Talent Discovery Day is an invitation-only event. Once you have submitted your application and all required documents, we will review your profile.

You may attend the event only if you are selected and receive an official invitation email from Deloitte; submitting an application does not itself grant access to the event.

We will look at applications on an ongoing basis and you will receive answer no later than  11 November.

If you have any questions, please contact Sarah Manniche (Manager, People & Purpose).

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

A dynamic and inspiring workplace with dedicated colleagues.

An informal and supportive work environment where your ideas and initiatives are valued.

Opportunities for both professional and personal development.

Salary according to qualifications, health insurance and attractive benefits.

The opportunity to shape how we work with information security, risk and compliance as the company grows.

Lots of social events, Friday bars and opportunities to celebrate our successes together.

Start date and location

Start date by agreement.

Address: Dampfærgevej 21, 2100 Copenhagen Ø.

Do you have any questions?

For further information, please contact Aaron Morley at aam@loyaltykey.com.

Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Civil and Architectural Engineering programme. The position is available from 1 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title:
AI-augmented Physiological Modelling for Prediction and Mitigation of Heat Stress in Pigs

Research area and project description:
Heat stress is an increasing challenge to pig production and animal welfare, particularly during hot seasons. Effective mitigation requires not only the detection of elevated heat load, but also the ability to predict how animals respond dynamically and to determine when and how cooling interventions should be applied. Existing mechanistic thermal models provide an important basis for representing animal heat balance and physiological responses. However, their ability to incorporate real-time physiological observations, account for model assumptions and environmental stochasticity, and support timely intervention decisions remains limited. At the same time, purely data-driven black-box approaches are challenging to develop and validate when high-quality physiological datasets are limited, as is often the case in controlled animal experiments.

This PhD project aims to develop a physics-informed digital model for predicting and mitigating heat stress in pigs. Building on conventional mechanistic models of pig physiological responses, the project will investigate how physiological modelling can be combined with AI approaches to develop a more robust and interpretable representation of the pig’s thermal state. To further enhance the accessibility and practical use of the model, the project will also explore how large language models (LLMs) can be integrated with the physiological model to facilitate interactive exploration of model behaviour and predictions.

Qualifications and specific competences:
We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with:
• A MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related filed.
• A strong academic background and interest in HVAC systems in buildings, and fluid and thermal systems modelling.
• Proven experience in data analytics, machine learning, and optimisation.
• Ability to program using Python, R, MATLAB or similar platforms.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in interdisciplinary teams.
• Excellent written and spoken English skills.It is considered an advantage if you have:
• Knowledge of animal heat stress and animal welfare.
• Knowledge of Large Language Model, stochastic modelling, system identification.
• Experience with CFD simulations.
Place of employment and place of work:
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Department of Civil and Architectural Engineering, Inge Lehmanns Gade 10, 8000 Aarhus C., Denmark.

Contacts:
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Associate Professor Li Rong, e-mail: li.rong@cae.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Assistant Professor Tao Huang, e-mail: taoh@cae.au.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk 
How to apply:
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 30 November 2026 23:59 CET.
Preferred starting date is 1 February 2027.

Please make a project description (½-4 pages). The project description should describe your ideas and research plans for this specific project. If you wish to, you can indicate an URL where further information can be found.

Please note:
• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.
• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via the online recruitment system, which can be accessed under ‘How to apply’.

jobs.occupation: Advanced Laboratory Technician for PAT Team in API MSAT
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about cutting-edge analytical technologies and eager to contribute to the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing? Do you enjoy hands-on laboratory work, solving technical challenges, and translating scientific insights into practical solutions? Join our Process Analytical Technology (PAT) team and play a vital role in developing innovative spectroscopic solutions that support the next generation of manufacturing processes.

Your new role

As an Advanced Laboratory Technician in the PAT team, you will become an integral part of a highly specialised environment focused on developing and implementing Process Analytical Technology solutions across API manufacturing. Working closely with scientists, engineers, and fellow laboratory technicians, you will help mature analytical technologies from laboratory and pilot scale through to manufacturing implementation.

In this role, you will:

• Plan, prepare, and execute experimental activities, including sample preparation and spectroscopic analyses using techniques such as NIR, Raman, FT-IR, UV, and fluorescence.

• Operate, maintain, troubleshoot, and qualify a diverse portfolio of analytical instruments to ensure reliable and high-quality results.

• Support the evaluation, testing, and implementation of new PAT technologies and laboratory equipment.

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders on development projects, process improvements, and technology transfers.

• Contribute to the continued development and operation of the PAT laboratory, ensuring robust solutions that are ready for manufacturing environments.

Your work will primarily be laboratory based, with a strong focus on experimentation, analytical instrumentation, and method development. You will have significant ownership of your activities and be encouraged to take initiative, challenge existing approaches, and help shape future PAT capabilities within Novo Nordisk.

Your new department

You will join the Technology & Process Facilities (TPF) department within API Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT), part of Global Manufacturing & Supply.

The PAT team is responsible for developing and maintaining Process Analytical Technology applications across API manufacturing sites. Our work brings together analytical chemistry, instrumentation, chemometrics, data management, and process integration to enable real-time process understanding and control.

The team is primarily located in Kalundborg, with colleagues based in Gentofte, and operates in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing and innovation are highly valued. We support both development activities and manufacturing operations, making our work diverse, dynamic, and highly impactful.

As part of the team, you will gain exposure to a broad range of technologies, projects, and stakeholders while helping drive improvements that support Novo Nordisk's ability to deliver medicines to patients worldwide.

Your skills and qualifications

We are looking for a proactive and independent Laboratory Technician who thrives in a dynamic environment and is motivated by both scientific exploration and practical implementation.

To succeed in this role, you should have:

• An education as a Laboratory Technician (Laborant) or a similar technical or scientific qualification.

• Experience performing spectroscopic analyses, such as NIR, Raman, FT-IR, UV, fluorescence, or related analytical techniques.

• Experience operating, maintaining, troubleshooting, and qualifying analytical instruments.

• Experience with laboratory-based development work, experimental planning, and data handling.

• Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

It would be considered an advantage if you also have experience with PAT, GMP-regulated environments, cLEAN®, or chemometric principles.

As a person, you are curious, adaptable, and solution oriented. You enjoy taking ownership of your work and are comfortable navigating changing priorities and varying quality requirements across development and manufacturing environments. You naturally build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, including manufacturing teams, QA/QC functions, scientists, engineers, technicians, vendors, and facility specialists.

Working at Novo Nordisk

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

What we offer

Salary and Benefits: The Annual Base Salary ranges from 499,600 to 734,400 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range willbe assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

A competitive benefits package is offered, including a pension scheme (currently 13% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution) in accordance with the applicable Collective Agreement for Salaried Employees (Industriens Funktionær Overenskomst or “IFO”).

Benefits package also include a free choice account of currently 10% and 4% holiday allowance.

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Contact:

For further information about the position, please contact Laura France at lwif@novonordisk.com.

Deadline:

6 November 2026.

You can submit your application in either English or Danish. Please include a link to your LinkedIn profile in your application if possible. You do not need to attach a cover letter, but we ask that you include a few sentences in your CV describing your motivation for applying.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
