jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Material Chemistry at the Mads Clausen Institute – Sønderborg
jobs.description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic new colleague as a PhD student in the field of Materials Chemistry with a strong background, particularly in Solid State Chemistry and Crystal Structure Analysis, and interest in industrial applications and cooperation to join the Mads Clausen Institute (MCI) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in Sønderborg, Denmark. The position is for three years with a preferred starting date of March 1, 2027, or as soon as possible. 

MCI is a part of the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) and covers research and education, including applications of engineering sciences. Our working language is English, reflecting the fact that far more than half of our students and staff are international. We are located at SDU’s beautiful campus in Sønderborg, in the inspiring building of Alsion, which is a centre for science, culture, and learning in the heart of Sønderborg and perched on the strait of water separating the island of Als from the mainland. The university has very close relations with industries in Sønderborg, Southern Denmark, and Northern Germany.

The successful candidate is expected to carry out research mainly within a project funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. The research work involves the synthesis and characterization of novel compounds based on mixed-anion compounds (e.g., transition metal (oxy)nitrides) and the evaluation of their performance in solar water splitting. Also, the successful candidate is expected to be actively involved in the supervision of BSc, MSc, and exchange/visiting students affiliated with SDU NanoSYD, preparing project reports, presentations, and publications, as well as writing grants for supporting research at SDU NanoSYD. 

 

Job Description and Responsibilities:

• 
Implementation of research tasks related to the project

• 
Collaborative and independent research planning, materials synthesis and characterization, crystal structure analysis, and performance evaluation of materials in solar water splitting

• 
Independent characterization, data analysis, and interpretation of research results

• 
Scientific communication and presentation of research results at group seminars, scientific conferences, project meetings, etc.

• 
Writing and publishing of project results in international high-impact scientific journals

Additional Responsibilities may be requested in:

• 
Supervision of BSc, MSc, and exchange/visiting students who perform research work on similar research topics 

• 
Assistance in teaching activities 

• 
Assistance in the preparation of grant proposals for external funding

• 
Assistance in laboratory organization and management 

 

Qualifications (as required):

• 
MSc degree in Materials Science, Materials Chemistry, Solid State Chemistry, Solid State Physics, or related fields 

• 
Proven hands-on experience and knowledge of various synthesis methods in solid-state chemistry, preferably the methods used for the synthesis of mixed-anion compounds

• 
Technical skills in materials characterization techniques (e.g., XRD, XPS, SEM, etc.)       

• 
Technical skills in crystal structure analysis 

• 
Fluency in English (both spoken and written)

• 
Ability to work both in teams and independently 

• 
Strong communication and social skills 

• 
Willingness to collaborate with other scientists and industry 

Qualifications (as assets):

• 
Research experience in X-ray, synchrotron, and neutron radiation facilities

• 
Research experience in solid state chemistry and crystal structure analysis 

• 
A track record of experience in writing scientific publications

• 
Technical skills in scientific illustration and animation to deliver visual knowledge of the project 

• 
Proven record in participating in national and international research projects and programs

• 
Strong interest in a long-term commitment to a growing research group

 

Contact information

Further information is available from Prof. Mirabbos Hojamberdiev (mirabbos@mci.sdu.dk; Tel: +45 6550 7483 or the Head of the Institute, Prof. Dr. Horst-Günter Rubahn (rubahn@mci.sdu.dk). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying, candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
One-page motivation letter that describes the applicant’s educational background and previous research experience most relevant to the offered position and the reason for applying to the PhD program.  

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

• 
List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

• 
Research statement on developing novel mixed anion compounds, particularly metal (oxy)nitrides, for solar water splitting may also be included.

• 
References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

• 
Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

• 
An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 31, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Hardware Engineer: Lead the integration of the hardware that powers ambitious satellite missions
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Hardware Engineer to drive the integration, technical ownership, and continuous improvement of the hardware platforms that enable GomSpace's satellite missions.

You will join our Satellite Systems Business Unit in Aalborg and play a central role in supporting satellite missions from proposal and electrical design through assembly, integration, testing, and delivery to customers worldwide. You will work closely with hardware designers, systems engineers, AIV engineers, manufacturing teams, and project managers while helping shape the future development of our hardware engineering capabilities.

Your Role

As experienced Hardware Engineer, you will act as the technical lead for the integration of electrical hardware and GomSpace products into satellite platforms.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Own the technical integration of GomSpace products into nanosatellite and microsatellite missions.

• Serve as a product expert for GomSpace hardware platforms, interfaces, functionality, configuration, and performance.

• Drive technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis during development, integration, testing, and customer projects.

• Lead the integration and verification of new GomSpace products and third-party hardware within satellite platforms.

• Define electrical interface solutions, schematic-level designs, harness concepts, and supporting hardware required for mission integration.

• Coordinate prototyping, validation, documentation, and manufacturing introduction activities for new hardware solutions.

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers.

• Support technical decision-making and trade-off analyses across customer programmes and internal developments.

• Contribute to process improvements, engineering standards, and product maturity initiatives across the organisation.

• Support proposal activities and customer discussions by providing credible technical solutions, effort estimates, and engineering input.

• Prepare technical documentation and communicate effectively in English, including technical reports, specifications, procedures, and interactions with international stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

In the initial phase, success means:

• Becoming a recognised technical expert on GomSpace's hardware portfolio.

• Successfully leading hardware integration activities on active customer missions.

• Resolving complex technical issues through systematic troubleshooting and engineering analysis.

• Building strong working relationships with Satellite Systems HW Team, Products HW Team, AIV, Manufacturing, and Systems Engineering.

• Supporting the growth and development of less experienced engineers.

Over time, you will be recognised as a trusted technical authority for hardware integration and product implementation, driving engineering excellence and helping scale GomSpace's hardware capabilities as our missions and teams continue to grow.

What You Bring

You are an experienced hardware engineer who enjoys solving technically demanding challenges and transforming complex products into reliable space systems.

You likely bring:

• An MSc or BSc in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.

• 10+ years of experience in hardware design, hardware integration, electronics development, verification, or systems integration.

• Strong knowledge of digital electronics, embedded hardware, and microcontroller-based systems.

• Experience with hardware communication interfaces and buses, including RS485/-422, CAN, SPI, I²C, USB, Ethernet, Spacewire, or similar.

• Experience in schematic capture and hardware development using tools such as Altium Designer or equivalent.

• Understanding of PCB design principles, EMC-, grounding- and shielding considerations, manufacturing processes, and product industrialisation.

• Experience with electrical integration, harness design, laboratory testing, and troubleshooting.

• Practical understanding of power systems, communication systems, and embedded electronics.

• Experience working with multidisciplinary engineering teams and complex technical projects.

• Knowledge of space systems and ECSS standards would be a strong advantage.

• Experience leading technical activities, mentoring engineers, or coordinating engineering teams would be considered a significant benefit.

Who You Are

You are pragmatic, technically curious, and motivated by solving challenging engineering problems.

You are known for:

• Technical leadership – providing direction and guidance without necessarily having formal authority.

• Systems thinking – understanding how individual hardware components contribute to mission success.

• Problem solving – methodically analysing issues and driving them to resolution.

• Collaboration – building strong relationships across engineering disciplines.

• Ownership – taking responsibility for delivering results.

• Mentorship – helping colleagues develop and grow.

• Customer focus – understanding that engineering excellence is measured by mission success.

• True leadership – setting standards, building trust, and enabling others to perform at their best.

Why Join Us

You will play a key role in delivering some of Europe's most ambitious nanosatellite and microsatellite missions, working at the intersection of product development, systems engineering, and customer delivery.

This position offers the opportunity to influence technical decisions across multiple programmes, shape future hardware capabilities, and grow into broader technical or people leadership responsibilities as both the team and business continue to expand.

Join our mission

We encourage you to send your application in English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. If you have any questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact:

Kelly Antonini

Systems Engineering and Hardware Manager

klan@gomspace.com

Workplace: Langagervej 6, 9220 Aalborg East, Denmark. Salary and start date will be individually negotiated.

As part of our recruitment process, employment requires you to complete a background check conducted by an authorized third-party provider in accordance with applicable legislation.

About GomSpace

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturised radio technology. At the core of our mission are our values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, and show true leadership.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. jobs.occupation: Experienced Systems Engineer – Architecting Nanosatellite & Microsatellite Systems (DK/LU)
jobs.description:
Do you want to own the technical integrity of a mission from "blank sheet" to flight-ready hardware?

GomSpace is seeking a Lead Systems Engineer to drive our next generation of Nanosatellite and Microsatellite missions. We are looking for a technical visionary who thrives on solving complex system trade-offs for both bespoke single-satellite missions and scaling constellation architectures. In this role, you will navigate the newest market developments, helping our customers transition from initial technology demonstrators to operational fleets.

Since 2007, GomSpace has developed and delivered satellites to customers across more than 60 countries worldwide through technological innovation and the efforts of our highly skilled team.

You will have the chance to be part of an international and dedicated team committed to providing exceptional and innovative small-satellite solutions to customers in the global market. Your objectives will be aligned with your personal development goals, and you will be given the autonomy to lead others towards the same direction.

About the Job

As a Lead Systems Engineer in the Satellite Systems Business Unit, you are the technical heart of the mission. You aren’t just managing requirements; you are architecting the system and ensuring its physical realization. You will bridge the gap between customer vision and engineering execution, guiding teams through the full development lifecycle. You will have the autonomy to make high-impact technical decisions across a diverse portfolio, ensuring exceptional performance for single spacecraft and emerging constellation projects.

Responsibilities include:

• Defining and Architecting end-to-end missions, scaling designs from high-performance single satellites to repeatable constellation architectures.

• Driving the full development lifecycle, from proposal response and mission analysis to design, assembly, integration, and testing (AIT).

• Serving as the Technical Authority in front of the customer, translating complex needs into robust system specifications and verifiable requirements.

• Process Excellence: Designing and implementing value-added engineering processes that maintain high quality without sacrificing the speed required in an agile "New Space" environment.

• Leading and Mentoring project systems teams to solve the industry’s toughest challenges in power, thermal, and high-precision pointing.

• Managing complex interfaces and risk profiles, ensuring seamless integration between payload, bus, and launch providers.

Your profile

You are a driven and dedicated professional with a strong focus on delivering high-quality, advanced solutions. You thrive in collaborative and agile environments.

• Proven Experience: Significant years in a Lead or Senior Systems role within the space industry. Experience taking a satellite through the full "design-to-test" lifecycle is essential.

• Process Champion: You have a deep understanding of where to focus effort in the engineering process. You are skilled at implementing streamlined workflows that add genuine value and encourage team adoption in fast-paced environments.

• The "System" Thinker: You understand how a single component change can affect mission-level link budgets, thermal margins, or mass properties.

• Cross-Disciplinary Communicator: Comfortable discussing software configurations with developers, high-speed data links with RF engineers, structural margins with mechanical leads, etc.—everything that goes into a satellite solution.

• Leadership through Action: You foster a culture of helpfulness and open communication, leading by example in both technical depth and professional integrity.

This position is based in Denmark (Aalborg) or Luxembourg (Esch-sur-Alzette). The expected travel activity is 15 -40 days per year, and we are highly receptive to international applicants.

Qualifications:

• MSc-level (or higher) engineering education in aerospace, systems, software, electrical engineering, or related fields.

• Mastery of ECSS/NASA standards, with the ability to tailor these processes to be effective and agile.

• Expertise in systems engineering principles, including requirements management, architecture, and system-level verification and testing.

• Proficiency in mission analysis tools (e.g., STK, GMAT) for coverage, revisit, and orbital analysis.

• Demonstrated ability to design and drive engineering processes that improve team efficiency and product reliability.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify, assess, and mitigate technical risks in space missions or projects.

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

Why choose GomSpace?

• Growth: Providing leadership within a leading space-industry company where innovation and advanced technologies are used to make a positive societal impact.

• Impact: Working alongside passionate, skilled, and international colleagues, driven by curiosity about “New Space” opportunities.

• Culture: Operating in a dynamic and cooperative culture with transparent communication and multidisciplinary teams.

• Network: Learning and growing through the company’s global network of locations and partnerships.

• International: Being part of project work based on international standards and team-oriented approaches.

JOIN OUR MISSION

Please send your application in English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. If you have any questions regarding the position do not hesitate to contact: Evan Helmeid, Systems Engineering, evhe@gomspace.com

Workplace will be at our premises at Langagervej 6, Aalborg, Denmark, or 1 Boulevard du Jazz, Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg. Salary and start date will be individually negotiated.

Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturized radio technology. As Senior IT Windows Server Architect, you will set the vision for the Windows Server operating system platform across Novo Nordisk, and turn it into a roadmap. You will be the architectural authority for two segregated environments: the General Network for enterprise IT services and the Production Network for business-critical production systems. Your decisions will shape how the platform is designed, secured, automated and run for years to come, keeping the systems our business depends on stable every day.

What you’ll bring

You are an established architect who has already set direction for Windows Server platforms in large enterprise companies. You will bring:

· A proven track record in architecture roles, such as Windows Server Architect or Infrastruc-ture Architect, in large, complex enterprise organisations.

· A clear, well-reasoned vision for building a best-in-class Windows Server operating system platform, and the ability to turn that vision into roadmaps, standards and decisions.

· Deep expertise in Windows Server architecture and engineering at scale, including Active Di-rectory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI/certificate services and Windows authentication.

· Expert knowledge of Windows Server security and hardening, privileged access and adminis-trative security models, risk management and lifecycle management.

· Experience architecting high availability, clustering, backup, disaster recovery and resilience for business-critical production environments.

· Experience designing for strict network segregation, including segmentation, firewalls, load balancing and secure communication between network zones.

· A strong grasp of virtualisation (preferably VMware and/or Hyper-V), monitoring and enter-prise management platforms, PowerShell automation and patching architecture.

· The ability to translate business, security and operational requirements into practical archi-tecture, document it clearly and win support for it across teams.

Useful, but not essential:

· Experience with Azure, Azure Arc, hybrid infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code, configuration management and modern automation platforms (highly desirable).

· Experience from regulated, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, financial, healthcare or other highly controlled environments.

What you’ll do

Together with the product owner, you will decide where the platform goes next. This is a strate-gic architecture role, not day-to-day server administration. You will:

· Own the enterprise Windows Server architecture, vision, roadmap and standards across the General and Production environments.

· Define and govern secure, standardised platforms, covering configuration, networking, stor-age, virtualisation, monitoring, backup and recovery.

· Set the security architecture and hardening standards for privileged access, authentication, service accounts, certificates, vulnerability management and compliance.

· Design architectures for segregated networks with secure integrations, controlled access, and high availability and disaster recovery standards that meet business recovery objectives.

· Lead modernisation, including upgrades, migrations, automation, Infrastructure as Code and reducing technical debt.

· Act as the senior technical authority, leading architectural governance and design reviews, and guiding infrastructure, security and application teams.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Server Platform sub-department within Infrastructure Platforms, part of Enter-prise IT & Quality. The team operates and manages all enterprise servers at Novo Nordisk, cov-ering Windows and Linux in both public and private cloud. Its goal is to streamline server opera-tions across platforms and domains, so they run fast, reliably and in line with compliance re-quirements.

You will work with colleagues in the Philippines, India, Poland, the Czech Republic, Denmark and the United States. Alongside the product owner, you will partner with infrastructure engineer-ing, operations, cybersecurity, network, application, cloud and enterprise architecture teams. Your job is to bring them together around clear architectural decisions and move them forward.

jobs.description:
Portfolio & Capacity Manager for Systematic's Group IT Strategy

Can you bring clarity and control to a fast-moving portfolio, making capacity visible, commitments realistic, and decisions easier to steer?

The job

Group IT (GRIT) is Systematic's internal IT function. It supports all business units with infrastructure, systems, integrations, and governance. As Portfolio & Capacity Manager, you will keep our IT portfolio governed, visible, and deliverable, and give the organisation a clear picture of whether commitments match available capacity.

This role sits close to the top of the organisation. The portfolio and capacity overview you maintain is used directly by our CIO and senior leadership to decide what Systematic takes on next, and what is delayed. The accuracy of your work has a direct bearing on the quality of those decisions.

Some of your key responsibilities will be to:

• Own the live overview of who is working on what and how much capacity is available, by collecting, validating, and maintaining data in Excel, Power BI, or similar tools

• Assess new project requests together with the Enterprise Architect and the Director, so we understand what committing to new work would mean for the portfolio

• Onboard new project managers into our governance model, help them get started properly, and keep documentation consistent across the portfolio

• Support the handover of projects from planning into delivery and operation, so nothing crosses over undocumented

• Prepare decision-ready material for the steering committee, run the meeting cadence, and follow up on decisions and actions

Joining the team

The portfolio machinery you will operate is still being created, and you will help shape it. Our ambition is to mature the portfolio into a transparent and trusted view of what is underway, what will be delivered and when, and the value it creates. This will enable clearer communication with the business, while strengthening follow-through within IT and ensuring that capacity is aligned with demand so commitments can be delivered efficiently and to a high standard.

You will become part of the GRIT Strategy team, a small group where specialists and project managers work closely together to keep our internal strategy on track. Reporting to the Director of Group IT Strategy, you will take over a running portfolio process from an interim consultant and work closely with project managers, the Enterprise Architect, and GRIT leadership.

The team is based in Aarhus. If you are located in Copenhagen, we are open to discussing a hybrid arrangement, but you should expect regular presence in Aarhus (6–8 days per month).

Your qualifications

The most important thing you bring is solid experience from an IT portfolio office - where you have supported IT project delivery, system implementations, IT operations - combined with strong analytical skills and hands-on experience with Excel and Power BI, or similar tools, to build and maintain reliable overviews (experience with Jira is an advantage). Additionally, we expect that you have:

• A good understanding of project management and agile ways of working

• Strong communication skills and the ability to present clearly to senior stakeholders

• Comfort exploring AI tools, like Claude, to work smarter and improve how we report and prioritise

• Fluent English; Danish is an advantage

Personally, you enjoy diligent, hands-on work and take pride in keeping information complete, consistent, and current. You are comfortable following up with stakeholders when inputs are missing or unclear, and you thrive as a senior specialist who takes ownership of your domain and leads through sound judgement, structure, and attention to detail.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables, and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1,100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Nanna Holmann Opstrup, Director of Group IT Strategy.

jobs.occupation: Sales Executive | Financial Services | Accenture Denmark
jobs.description:
Some people sell solutions. Others shape industries.

At Accenture, we believe the future of Financial Services will be defined by those who can connect business ambition with technology innovation.

Right now, Denmark's leading banks, insurers and financial institutions are navigating one of the most significant transformation waves in decades. AI is reshaping customer experiences, operating models are being reinvented, core platforms are being modernised, and new competitors are changing the rules of the game.

The opportunities are enormous.

So are the decisions.

That's why we're looking for a Sales Executive to join our Financial Services practice in Denmark and help clients turn bold ambitions into tangible business outcomes.

The Opportunity

This is not a traditional sales role.

You'll engage directly with senior executives across Denmark's largest financial institutions, helping them navigate complex business challenges and identify new opportunities for growth, efficiency and innovation.

Working alongside some of the industry's leading strategists, technologists and transformation experts, you'll bring together the full breadth of Accenture's capabilities across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Data & AI, Cloud and Security.

You'll be backed by the scale of a global organisation with more than 800,000 people worldwide, while operating in a highly entrepreneurial Nordic environment where relationships, trust and commercial acumen drive success.

Most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to influence the transformation agendas of organisations that impact millions of customers every day.

What You'll Do

As a trusted advisor and business developer, you will:

• Build and strengthen executive-level relationships across Denmark's banking, insurance and broader financial services sector

• Identify and originate new opportunities within strategic client accounts

• Partner closely with Client Account Leads, industry experts and delivery teams to shape compelling client propositions

• Lead complex sales pursuits from opportunity identification through qualification, proposal development, negotiation and contract signature

• Facilitate strategic conversations with C-suite stakeholders around growth, efficiency, digital transformation and AI-enabled innovation

• Develop account strategies and drive sustainable pipeline growth

• Collaborate across Accenture's global network to bring the very best capabilities, insights and experiences to our clients

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured by activity alone.

It's measured by your ability to create trusted relationships, uncover opportunities others don't see, and position Accenture as a strategic partner in some of the most important transformation programmes across the Danish Financial Services market.

You understand how to navigate complex stakeholder environments, connect business challenges with technology-enabled solutions, and create momentum around large-scale transformation initiatives.

You know that the strongest client relationships are built long before a deal is signed.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for an individual who combines commercial drive with strong business acumen and a genuine passion for helping clients succeed.

Ideally, you bring:

• 7-10+ years of experience in consulting-led sales, business development or client relationship management

• A strong network within Banking, Insurance or Financial Services in Denmark

• A proven track record of originating and closing complex, high-value opportunities

• Experience engaging senior executives and facilitating strategic business discussions

• Strong commercial instincts and an entrepreneurial mindset

• The ability to operate effectively across multiple stakeholders, offerings and pursuits simultaneously

• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills

• Fluency in Danish and English

Why Join Accenture?

Because this is where business transformation happens.

Few organisations can combine industry expertise, technology leadership, AI innovation and global delivery capabilities at the scale Accenture can.

As Financial Services leaders across Denmark rethink their future, you'll be at the centre of the conversations that matter most.

You'll help clients solve their toughest challenges, shape industry-defining programmes and create lasting impact for some of the most recognised organisations in the market.

And you'll do it with colleagues who are passionate about innovation, collaboration and delivering meaningful outcomes.

Interested?

Let's have a conversation.

Developing great products for sports applications in a highly technical and dynamic environment?

Join us on our journey to enable athletes around the world with actionable, data-driven insights. Trackman is expanding with an additional Project Lead to lead the development of our next-generation modular hardware platform designed to serve multiple sports applications, from idea generation through production and into the field. Being a Hardware Project Lead at Trackman requires you to work closely together with several senior stakeholders in a very dynamic environment – driven by our passion for the product, the customer and sports.

The position is in the R&D Hardware department, working closely with all hardware teams – mechanics, optics, electronics, and certification – as well as our close colleagues in embedded software, tracking algorithm teams, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, and production.

The workplace for this position is at our HQ in Science Park DTU in Hørsholm.

Your key responsibilities are

• 
Lead the hardware project group together with the Product Owner(s), developing next-generation hardware for golf and other sports applications.

• 
Translate customer and business needs into clear technical requirements and hardware architecture.

• 
Collaborate with stakeholders across Management, Business Development, Tracking, and Manufacturing to align priorities and ensure progress.

• 
Turn technical requirements into actionable tasks, manage resources and dependencies, and maintain the overall hardware project plan.

• 
Represent Trackman in technical discussions with suppliers, including specifications, quality issues, and expectations.

• 
Communicate project status, progress, risks, and key obstacles clearly to management and other stakeholders.

• 
Coordinate international product certifications, including CE, FCC, and UL, together with the Certification team.

• 
Identify and manage hardware risks related to areas such as product quality, obsolescence, suppliers, and certifications.

Are you our new colleague?

We’re looking for an experienced project manager with a strong hardware engineering background who can bridge technical complexity, business needs, and collaboration. Ideally, you bring:

• 
Several years of project management experience in hardware product development, preferably with RF systems.

• 
Experience with complex projects across mechanics, electronics, RF, and embedded software.

• 
Strong understanding of requirements management, design verification, and product industrialization.

• 
Solid business acumen and the ability to translate diverse user needs into robust product solutions.

• 
Experience with project management methodologies and Agile principles, ideally bringing complex electronics products to market.

• 
Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, knowing when to listen, challenge, and take the lead.

Who is Trackman

Trackman is a privately-owned company founded in 2003. The company has experienced consistent high growth driven by a market-leading sports ball tracking technology based on radar and vision tracking, sustained by a strong desire to innovate.

The company employs globally more than 1000+ employees and has offices in Denmark (headquarter in Hørsholm), Aarhus, US (Connecticut and Arizona), Japan, South Korea, and Poland.

While being active in multiple sports including baseball, football, and soccer, Trackman is first and foremost a golf company. Trackman has revolutionised the way golf players train and instructors teach, and is now broadening the technology so all golfers can take advantage – whether they are playing indoors, on driving ranges, or on the golf course.

In baseball, Trackman is the leading technology company in the world with solutions for practice, games, and the largest data sharing network, monetised by selling draft data on amateur players to the Major League Baseball teams. Trackman has also developed practice solutions for American Football and Soccer that are now used among top teams.

Trackman has the largest R&D capacity in the industry and is constantly aiming to push the boundaries for sports, technology, and data. We strive to recruit the best talent from around the world for R&D functions such as Hardware. At our HQ in Denmark, we have an R&D team of more than 250 FTEs representing more than 40 countries around the world. Trackman designs, develops, and produces all of our technology from start to finish in-house under one roof.

Trackman’s 12,500 m² state-of-the-art CO₂-neutral headquarter is located in Science Park DTU in Hørsholm.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Join Saxo’s Enterprise Identity & Data Security (EIDS) team and play a pivotal role in protecting the bank’s most valuable asset it’s data.

About the role

In this role, you will design and implement advanced data protection controls across modern security platforms, with a strong focus on Microsoft Purview and insider risk solutions. You will translate complex regulatory and data risk requirements into scalable, effective technical controls that safeguard sensitive information and strengthen Saxo’s security posture.

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to Saxo’s broader agenda around security, governance, and operational resilience within a highly regulated financial environment, working closely with stakeholders across technology, compliance, and the business.

• Design and implement data protection controls across Microsoft Purview (DLP, Information Protection, Insider Risk Management)

• Translate data security risks and regulatory requirements into robust, enforceable technical solutions

• Lead and support the rollout and optimisation of Insider Risk Management and user activity monitoring tools (e.g. Teramind)

• Drive data discovery, classification, and visibility across structured and unstructured data environments

• Monitor, tune, and continuously improve the effectiveness of data protection policies and controls

• Collaborate with security, compliance, and business stakeholders to mitigate data risks and strengthen governance frameworks

Your profile

We are looking for a proactive and technically strong professional who can balance risk, regulation, and real-world implementation:

• 7–10 years of experience in data security or information security engineering

• Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Purview (DLP, labelling, Insider Risk)

• Strong understanding of data protection risks, insider threats, and mitigation strategies

• Experience working in regulated environments (financial services is an advantage)

• Solid knowledge of Microsoft 365, Azure, and enterprise security tooling

• Experience with automation or scripting (e.g. PowerShell, APIs) is a plus

• Relevant certifications such as SC-400 are preferred

• Supporting the maintenance and reporting on our Standard Cost

• Assisting the team with various analysis, modelling and controlling activities

In this role, you will gain hands-on experience with financial controlling and data-driven decision-making in an international company. You will develop strong analytical and stakeholder management skills while working closely with experienced colleagues on real business challenges.

Despite this, we have an informal atmosphere in the team, where inputs and perspectives from all team members are highly valued.

Did you know? Our team is quite diverse in terms of personality types, making collaboration in the team, and the solutions we produce, much more dynamic.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for an enthusiastic and ambitious student who is eager to apply their knowledge of finance and business controlling while making a real impact on our team. • Are studying a degree in Economics, Business Administration, or another relevant field

• Are curious and enjoy proactively seeking new challenges where you can gain knowledge and new perspectives

• Have a structured approach to your work and thrive in managing your tasks efficiently and effectively

• Enjoy collaboration and have good communication skills, enabling you to interact and build relationships within and outside of Kamstrup

• Are well acquainted with Excel and other MS office tools

Do you know what separates a backlog a team can build from and a backlog a team has to decode? We are looking for an experienced Product Owner who wants backlog craftsmanship to be the centre of the job — across three software teams building the platforms that run Eurowind's energy parks and energy trading.

Who we are

Eurowind Energy is a global and leading developer, owner and operator of energy parks. Based in Denmark, we operate in 16 countries around Europe and in the USA, and we are continuously growing our project portfolio. We believe in a future of renewable energy, and we have an ambitious plan of becoming the next generation's "Power Major". Based on a full value chain from greenfield project development to energy trading, more than 700 team members are dedicated to creating a greener future fueled with nothing but renewable energy!

We are looking for an experienced Product Owner to join our IT Software department. Based at our head office in Hobro, Denmark, you will have your home base in our Automation & Masterdata team — and you will be the Product Owner who owns the backlog itself across all three of our software teams.

The backlog is yours, across three teams

IT Software runs three development teams — Trading & Monitoring, Automation & Masterdata, and Explore & Interact — with more than 15 engineers between them. We have deliberately split product ownership across three people with different centres of gravity rather than one generalist per team. One of your two Product Owner colleagues also holds the Scrum Master role and owns how we work: ceremonies, flow and continuous improvement. The other also holds project management and owns delivery towards the business: timelines, dependencies and stakeholder commitments. You will own the third piece — the backlog itself.

Your day-to-day home is the Automation & Masterdata team, where six developers and a team lead build the automation, data and masterdata foundation the rest of the business relies on. But because a backlog standard is only worth something if it is the same everywhere, your work will touch stories in all three teams.

Work reaches you from two directions. Larger projects and initiatives come in through our IT Portfolio Manager, who owns intake and demand at portfolio level, so a good share of what lands in the backlog arrives already framed and prioritised at a high level. The rest comes straight from the business, often as a half-formed idea from someone who knows their own domain far better than they know software. Turning both kinds into work a team can pick up is where you make the difference.

• Own the backlog as the single source of truth — capture, structure and maintain epics, stories and bugs so the teams always know what is next and why

• Refine feature requests into clear, testable items with acceptance criteria that hold up when development starts

• Set and maintain a shared standard for how work is written across the three teams, so a story reads the same whether it originates in Trading, Automation or Explore

• Make priority and scope calls together with your two Product Owner colleagues, the team leads and our solution architect

• Partner with our IT Portfolio Manager on larger projects and initiatives, and handle direct requests from the business for everything else

• Work with stakeholders across Operations, Trading, Commercial, BI and GIS to turn business needs into work the teams can act on

• Support release readiness — approve completed items and help stakeholders understand what is coming

• Keep Jira and Confluence trustworthy, so progress, dependencies and blockers are visible without anyone having to ask

• Help shape how we use AI in product work — we are currently building Claude skills that support user story intake and refinement, and this role has a real say in how far we take that

You will not be doing this in isolation. The three of you meet weekly with the team leads and our architect, and you will have a direct line to the developers whose week your backlog shapes.

Clear boundaries, real ownership

We lead with direction and mandate rather than detailed instruction. You will get the expectations and the boundaries agreed up front, and from there you decide how the work gets done. That only works if the roles around you are clear — which is why we have written down and agreed what the Manager, Product Owner, Scrum Master, Solution Architect and Team Lead each own, so you know where your decisions start and where they hand over.

• Real mandate over the backlog across three teams, and genuine influence on how the department works

• Two Product Owner colleagues, a Scrum Master, a solution architect and three team leads to spar with — this is not a role where you are the only one thinking about product

• A department leaning into AI in practice rather than in theory — we use it daily and are actively building Claude skills for user story intake and refinement, with the ambition of taking the mechanical part of backlog work off your plate so you can spend your time on the judgement calls

• A department in the middle of building its platforms, so what you shape now will still be visible in a few years

• Flexible working hours and the option to work from home

• Lunch scheme, coffee, tea and fruit, discount agreements and a bonus scheme

• An international environment with colleagues in 16 countries, where English is a natural part of everyday work

You will report to Daniel Otkjær, Senior Manager, Software Development, and become part of the leadership group in IT Software.

Required competencies and skills

This is a senior position. Because the standard you set reaches every story in three teams, we are looking for someone who has done product ownership before and knows what a well-written backlog is worth on a busy week. We put weight on the following:

• Several years of experience as a Product Owner in a software environment, ideally across more than one team or product

• Demonstrated experience with backlog management, refinement and writing acceptance criteria that survive contact with development

• Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps or similar tools; Confluence is an advantage

• Openness to working with AI as part of the job is a clear advantage, and hands-on experience using it for intake, refinement, documentation or stakeholder work is even better

• The ability to hold a shared standard across teams through clarity and collaboration rather than formal authority

• Comfortable moving between audiences — you can talk to a trader, an operations specialist and a developer on the same day and meet each of them where they are

• Structured in your approach, and at ease when priorities shift at short notice, which they will in a company growing in several directions at once

• Fluent in English in speech and writing; Danish is an advantage

• Knowledge of energy trading or the renewable energy sector is a plus, but something you can learn with us

A formal certification such as CSPO or SAFe Product Owner is a plus, but not a requirement — what matters most is what you have actually run.

Please note that this role requires a clean criminal record. A security clearance may become relevant later in the employment, but it is not required in order to apply.

Renewable energy is our future. And so are our people!

At Eurowind Energy we do our best to create a culture where everyone is valued and feels at home. You will notice this in your everyday work life, where you have the freedom to speak up and where your voice means something to us. We know that when you grow, we grow. Therefore, we strive to support you in what you believe is right and in your personal and professional development. We offer you an exciting job in an energetic and international environment. And we promise you: the wind is never standing still.

Developing, operating and managing wind and solar parks is not just pure business for us. It is a way to view the world. And with this worldview comes a genuine ambition to be one of the leading developers in Europe. Because creating a future run entirely on green energy matters to us.

We manage our own portfolio of projects and at the same time, we perform technical and financial management of projects. We have throughout many years experienced sustained economic growth in the number of developed projects and companies in management. And we continue to expect this. Simply because it is in our nature to keep developing – projects, companies and our people.

Read more about Eurowind Energy A/S on our website (eurowindenergy.com) or LinkedIn.

Did we capture your attention?

Great! If you see yourself in this role, do not hesitate to apply for the position. Please use the link below. As we continuously review incoming applications, please send us your CV as soon as possible.

Should you have any questions before applying, please feel free to contact Daniel Otkjær, Senior Manager, Software Development, at dot@ewe.dk.

Application deadline: Rolling – we invite candidates for interviews as applications come in.

Place of work: Hobro, Denmark

Spirii develops world-class charging products and digital solutions for electric vehicles. Our Digital Development department fosters a listen, learn, and lead culture — allowing us to continuously improve how we work. We're looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to build and evolve Spirii's data platform and pipeline infrastructure. Working closely with our Data Lead and domain teams, you'll design and maintain reliable ELT pipelines, ensure data arrives in Amazon Redshift correctly and on time, and support the analytics layer that powers insights across EV charging events, subscriptions, and financial transactions. This is a unique opportunity to shape Spirii's data infrastructure from an early stage — establishing standards for ingestion, orchestration, and data reliability as we scale.

Your Responsibilities

Pipeline & Ingestion

• 
Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines that bring data from product backends, third-party services, and operational systems into Amazon Redshift.

• 
Own ingestion reliability: monitoring, alerting, and incident response for pipeline failures.

• 
Evaluate and improve orchestration tooling and scheduling.

Data Platform & Infrastructure

• 
Evolve Spirii's data platform architecture: storage, compute, access control, and cost optimisation in Redshift.

• 
Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code practices for data workflows (Terraform/CDK or similar).

• 
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure and transformations.

Data Quality & Governance

• 
Implement data quality checks, freshness monitoring, and anomaly detection across ingestion and transformation layers.

• 
Work with Analytics Engineers and domain teams to define and enforce data contracts and schema standards.

• 
Ensure GDPR-compliant data handling: PII identification, access control, and data retention policies.

Collaboration & Stakeholders

• 
Partner with Engineering and Product teams to instrument events correctly at the source — schemas, identifiers, and change management.

• 
Collaborate with Data team to ensure the analytics layer is built on reliable, well-modelled foundations.

• 
Contribute to a strong data culture by creating and enhancing documentation, runbooks, data lineage, discoverability and incident response capabilities.

About You

• 
You care deeply about data reliability and building pipelines that teams can depend on.

• 
You're hands-on: you build, test, and ship pipelines and infrastructure improvements yourself.

• 
You think of data pipelines as products — you care about uptime, observability, and the downstream consumers who depend on them.

• 
You're pragmatic: you know when to engineer robustly and when to keep things lean.

• 
You collaborate well across teams and communicate clearly about trade-offs and status.

Qualifications

• 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• 
3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related role with a strong data focus.

• 
Strong SQL skills and solid experience building production data pipelines.

• 
Hands-on experience with a modern data warehouse (Redshift preferred; BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks also relevant).

• 
Experience with orchestration tools (Apache Airflow or similar).

• 
Proficiency in Python for data work (pipeline scripts, transformations, tooling).

• 
Solid understanding of ELT/ETL concepts, including incremental loading, CDC, and idempotency.

• 
Familiar with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or similar).

• 
Familiar with data governance concepts: access control, PII handling, GDPR-minded practices.

Nice to Have

• 
Experience with data observability tooling.

• 
Experience with event/data contract patterns in product analytics (schemas, versioning, instrumentation).

• 
Experience with finance data and/or subscription/transaction domains.

• 
Experience with dbt (understanding of transformation layer and how it interfaces with pipelines).

• 
Machine learning infrastructure experience is a plus, but not required for this role.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.

• 
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• 
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• 
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• 
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• 
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• 
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• 
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• 
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but fluent English language skills are required.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii has recently celebrated its six-year anniversary as a founded company; however the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

jobs.occupation: Product Owner for backup and recovery service
jobs.description:
Product Owner (Manager Role) for global backup and recovery service

Do you have hands-on experience owning or managing backup and disaster recovery services in an enterprise environment, including RPO, RTO and retention requirements?

For one of our clients, a large Danish company within the Life science & Pharma industry, we are seeking an experienced Product Owner for backup and recovery with leadership experience. You will become part of a dynamic and challenging environment characterized by high ambitions and a corresponding level of complexity. You will take part in shape the future of enterprise backup technology and safeguard the data that enables life-changing treatments to reach millions of patients.

Backup, and recovery

As Product Owner, you’ll lead and own the product vision, roadmap and backlog for the organization’s backup technology. You’ll take an active leading role and you’ll combine deep technical expertise in backup and cloud technologies with strong stakeholder management to ensure our service meets business continuity, compliance and operational objectives while driving continuous improvement and value delivery.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Maintaining the product vision, strategy and roadmap for the IT Backup Service, aligned with business continuity, security and compliance goals

• Owning the product backlog by writing, prioritizing and refining user stories, acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements (RTO, RPO, retention, encryption, etc.)

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams and key stakeholders to ensure seamless service delivery and continuous improvement

• Defining and monitoring KPIs for the backup service to drive performance and reliability

• Ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal backup policies, including data residency, retention, encryption and audit capability

• Managing incident response involvement for major backup/recovery incidents, leading post-incident reviews and implementing preventive measures

• Communicating roadmap, status, risks and outcomes to senior management and stakeholders in clear, executive-level language.

Your skills & qualifications

We’re looking for a Product Owner who can bridge technical depth with strategic vision, stakeholder engagement and leadership of the area.

You’ll bring with you:

• Expertise in people leadership

• Strong technical background in backup and recovery technologies, with solid understanding of RPO/RTO, retention schemes, backup architecture, snapshots, replication and restore workflows

• Proven experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or Technical Lead for infrastructure or platform services in an enterprise environment

• Demonstrated ability to translate technical detail into executive-level communication and vice versa, ensuring clarity across all organizational levels

• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to balance competing priorities and build consensus across diverse teams

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

Experience working within regulatory and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, SOX) in enterprise IT environments is a plus.

Apply now

For additional information about the position, please contact:

• Brian Ranvits on +45 2048 0548

• Christoffer Bjørk Petersen on +45 2080 1638

If you see yourself in the position, please submit your application using the apply button below.

Please note that applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled once the right candidate is identified.

Do you thrive in a role where you are close to the pulse of the business and work directly with executive management? Are you able to ensure an efficient and structured workday while respecting all business priorities? If so, you now have a unique opportunity to bring your professionalism into play and act as a trusted Executive Assistant to the CEO and the rest of the executive team at Norican in Taastrup.

Your role and responsibilities

As an Executive Assistant, you will occupy a key role as the central focal point, setting the direction for management's administration and creating structure. Working within a dynamic team of executives, you will act as the primary point of contact for both internal and external stakeholders globally.

In this position, execution and discretion are priority areas and are seen as a crucial discipline where high quality is paramount. This means your day-to-day work will offer significant professional variety through a wide range of administrative and coordination tasks. In this role, you will act as a gatekeeper, create clarity, and ensure smooth daily operations for the executive management team

Your most important task is to ensure that executive management's visions are effectively supported. You will do this by:

• Managing and prioritizing the CEO's calendar according to the annual business wheel, with a focus on allocating time for strategic meetings and urgent matters

• Acting as the primary liaison and local ambassador, ensuring seamless communication between the executive management, and all internal and external stakeholders

• Planning and organizing meetings, gathering input, and managing logistics

• Handling global travel logistics for the executive team, including flights, hotels, transportation, visa applications, and travel expense reports

To succeed in the role

To succeed in this role, it is crucial that you can maintain oversight and act as a trusted partner to the executive management team. Your success will be measured by the CEO always being well-prepared, meetings being flawlessly organized, and your ability to intuitively anticipate needs before executive management asks. Therefore, you must be able to communicate clearly, exhibit exceptional discretion with confidential information, and handle stakeholders at all levels. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and remain resilient and calm even when deadlines approach and pressure rises.

We hope that you will bring:

• A minimum of 5–10 years of documented, successful experience as a PA/EA supporting C-level management

• A relevant educational background, such as a BA in Business Administration, or equivalent solid experience

• Excellent communication skills, fluent proficiency in English (written and spoken), and strong IT and MS Office capabilities

• Experience navigating complex global travel logistics and an understanding of cross-cultural differences

• A proactive, highly service-minded, and independent approach with a strong "can-do" attitude

Why you should join Norican?

In this role, you will play a crucial part in enabling the executive management team to succeed in driving Norican’s ambitious agenda and continued growth. You will be close to the heart of the business while becoming part of a professional, informal, and down-to-earth culture, where people work closely together, trust each other, and focus on making things happen. Professionally, you will benefit from a direct reporting line to the CEO and hold a central position that ensures the executive team’s continuous efficiency both locally and globally.

Want to know more? Ready to apply?

Ready to learn more and ready to apply?

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. We will process your application confidentially, and it will only be shared with your prior consent. If you have any further questions about the position, feel free to contact our Recruitment Consultant on this role Mille Maegaard-Fast at +45 92 92 08 53.

About Norican

NORICAN. Shaping Industry.

We are Norican, a global industrial group designing, building and supporting best‑in‑class machines and technologies for metal formation and surface treatment.

Bringing together five leading brands - DISA, Simpson, StrikoWestofen, Wheelabrator and Monitizer – we deliver one connected solution across the production process, supported by full‑service expertise and digital solutions.

Across green sand molding, die casting, sand preparation, melting, transport and dosing, and surface treatment, we help manufacturers improve performance and transform production across a wide range of industries. We build lifetime quality and long‑term partnerships by combining the strengths of our legacy brands to lead the industry through innovation, sustainability and profitable growth.

Can you deliver technology initiatives that create measurable operational value and enable business outcomes? At Orifarm, we are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Product Owner to help shape the digital solutions supporting our global Supply Chain operations

About the job

You will play a central role in bridging Supply Chain and Corporate IT, ensuring our solutions deliver value to the business while supporting operational excellence and future growth. Working closely with business stakeholders, IT colleagues, vendors, and partners, you will drive improvements, translate business needs into solutions, and help shape the future direction of our ERP landscape.

The role combines elements of product ownership, ERP expertise, demand management, business engagement and continuous improvement. You will work closely with stakeholders across the organization to understand business needs, translate them into actionable priorities and ensure solutions are delivered and adopted successfully. As part of this, you will also contribute to a significant ERP transformation initiative, representing Supply Chain requirements and helping ensure continuity between current and future solutions.

Your key responsibilities:

• Own and manage the roadmap, backlog and priorities for Supply Chain-related ERP capabilities and supporting solutions

• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain stakeholders to understand business goals, challenges and opportunities

• Translate business and operational requirements into scalable solution designs and delivery priorities

• Function as solution and system owner for relevant Supply Chain platforms and capabilities

• Collaborate with developers, architects, vendors and business stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of enhancements and projects

• Support incident resolution, governance activities and ongoing optimization efforts

• Contribute to our ERP transformation journey by supporting requirements validation, testing, business readiness and adoption activities

Succes in this role means:

• Supply Chain solutions remain stable, secure, compliant and continuously improving

• Business stakeholders experience IT as a trusted and value-adding partner

• Demand and improvement opportunities are translated into clear priorities and successful deliveries

• Operational excellence and long-term transformation objectives are balanced successfully

• New capabilities are supported by standardized, scalable and efficient solutions across Supply Chain

Who are you?

You enjoy working at the intersection of business and technology, and you understand how digital solutions can enable efficient and scalable Supply Chain operations. You move comfortably between strategic discussions and operational challenges, building strong relationships across both business and IT.

You are a pragmatic and proactive problem solver who can balance competing priorities, challenge existing ways of working constructively, take ownership of outcomes and focus on delivering real business value. Most importantly, you understand that technology is only successful when it is adopted and creates measurable outcomes for the business.

We imagine that you have:

• Experience from roles such as Solutions Lead, Product Owner, ERP Consultant, Functional Lead, Lead Business Analyst, Application Manager or similar

• A strong understanding of Supply Chain processes and the systems supporting them

• Experience working with enterprise ERP platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics, SAP, Oracle, IFS, Infor or similar

• Experience managing roadmaps, backlogs and business demand

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Experience working across business and IT functions

• The ability to translate business requirements into scalable and practical solutions

• Fluent English skills, written and spoken

Who are we?

Group & Compliance Solutions is a central function within IT, responsible for delivering and evolving digital capabilities that support critical business processes across Orifarm. We work closely with functions throughout the organization, including Supply Chain, which is at the heart of Orifarm's business model. Supply Chain’s ability to source, repackage, and distribute pharmaceutical products reliably and compliantly across markets depends on effective processes, strong data foundations, and the right technology solutions, making our work an essential enabler of business success.

You will join a skilled and dedicated ERP team within Group & Compliance Solutions that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and helping each other succeed. We offer an informal yet ambitious environment with a strong sense of team spirit, where learning from experience is encouraged and new perspectives are valued. As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to influence both solutions and ways of working.

You will be reporting to the Director of Group & Compliance Solutions.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Key Account Manager – SITS I SecureDevice, Denmark

Location: Copenhagen (Hybrid)

Reports to: Sales Manager, SITS I SecureDevice Denmark

Company: SecureDevice – Part of the SITS Group

Scope: Denmark & Nordic Growth

About SITS I SecureDevice

SITS I SecureDevice is part of the SITS Group, headquartered in Switzerland and active across Northern Europe. We are one of Denmark’s leading cybersecurity solution providers, trusted by over 100 Danish customers across private and public sectors.
